LU.flow: 起於中焦，下絡大腸，還循胃口，上膈屬肺，從肺系橫出腋下，下循臑內，行少陰、心主之前，下肘中，循臂內上骨下廉，入寸口，上魚，循魚際，出大指之端；其支者，從腕後直出次指內廉，出其端（交於手陽明）。
LU.flowEn: Originates in the middle jiao, descends to connect with the Large Intestine, returns along the stomach orifice, ascends through the diaphragm to its home organ the Lung; from the lung system it emerges laterally below the axilla, descends the medial upper arm in front of the Heart and Pericardium channels, passes the cubital fossa, runs along the anterior-medial forearm to the radial pulse (cunkou), over the thenar eminence to the radial tip of the thumb. A branch leaves behind the wrist and ends at the radial tip of the index finger, linking with the Large Intestine channel.
LU.pathology: 咳嗽、氣喘、胸滿、咳血、咽喉腫痛、缺盆中痛、肩背痛、臂內前緣痛、掌中熱、小便頻數或遺尿、外感表證。
LU.pathologyEn: Cough, wheezing, fullness of the chest, haemoptysis, sore swollen throat, pain in the supraclavicular fossa, shoulder and upper-back pain, pain along the anterior-medial arm, heat in the palm, frequent urination or enuresis, exterior patterns from wind invasion.

LI.flow: 起於大指次指之端，循指上廉，出合谷兩骨之間，上入兩筋之中，循臂上廉，入肘外廉，上臑外前廉，上肩，出髃骨之前廉，上出於柱骨之會上（大椎），下入缺盆，絡肺，下膈，屬大腸；其支者，從缺盆上頸，貫頰，入下齒中，還出挾口，交人中，左之右，右之左，上挾鼻孔（交於足陽明）。
LI.flowEn: Begins at the radial tip of the index finger, runs along the dorsal radial border of the finger through Hegu between the first and second metacarpals, between the two tendons at the wrist, up the lateral forearm to the lateral elbow, along the anterior-lateral upper arm to the shoulder, in front of the acromion to the meeting of the yang channels at Dazhui (GV14), then descends into the supraclavicular fossa to connect with the Lung, through the diaphragm to its home organ the Large Intestine. A branch rises from the supraclavicular fossa along the neck, crosses the cheek, enters the lower gums, curves around the lips, crosses at Renzhong (GV26) to the opposite side and ends beside the nostril, linking with the Stomach channel.
LI.pathology: 齒痛、頸腫、咽喉腫痛、鼻衄、流清涕、目黃、口乾、肩前及上臂痛、食指不用、腸鳴腹痛、泄瀉或便秘、腸中寒熱。
LI.pathologyEn: Toothache, swollen neck, sore swollen throat, nosebleed, clear nasal discharge, yellow sclera, dry mouth, pain of the anterior shoulder and upper arm, loss of use of the index finger, borborygmus and abdominal pain, diarrhoea or constipation, cold or heat in the intestines.

ST.flow: 起於鼻之交頞中，旁納太陽之脈，下循鼻外，入上齒中，還出挾口環唇，下交承漿，卻循頤後下廉，出大迎，循頰車，上耳前，過客主人，循髮際，至額顱；其支者，從大迎前下人迎，循喉嚨，入缺盆，下膈，屬胃，絡脾；其直者，從缺盆下乳內廉，下挾臍，入氣街中；其支者，起於胃口，下循腹裡，下至氣街中而合，以下髀關，抵伏兔，下膝臏中，下循脛外廉，下足跗，入中趾內間；其支者，下膝三寸而別，下入中趾外間；其支者，別跗上，入大趾間，出其端（交於足太陰）。
ST.flowEn: Begins beside the nose, meets the Bladder channel at the inner canthus, descends lateral to the nose into the upper gums, curves around the lips to meet at Chengjiang (CV24), runs back along the jaw to Daying and Jiache, ascends in front of the ear past Shangguan and along the hairline to the forehead. A branch descends from Daying to Renying (ST9), along the throat to the supraclavicular fossa, through the diaphragm to its home organ the Stomach, connecting with the Spleen. The main trunk descends from the supraclavicular fossa along the mammary line, beside the umbilicus, to Qichong in the groin; an internal branch from the pylorus rejoins it there, then it descends the anterior-lateral thigh over Biguan and Futu, through the patella, along the lateral tibia to the dorsum of the foot and the lateral tip of the second toe. Branches leave 3 cun below the knee to the middle toe, and from the dorsum to the medial tip of the great toe, linking with the Spleen channel.
ST.pathology: 胃痛、嘔吐、腹脹、腸鳴、消穀善飢或不欲食、鼻衄、口喎、唇疹、咽喉腫痛、頸腫、熱病、發狂登高而歌、膝臏腫痛、循經（胸、乳、腹、股、脛外側、足背）疼痛或不用。
ST.pathologyEn: Epigastric pain, vomiting, abdominal distension, borborygmus, excessive hunger or loss of appetite, nosebleed, deviation of the mouth, lip sores, sore swollen throat, swollen neck, febrile disease, mania, swelling and pain of the knee, and pain or motor loss along the channel (chest, breast, abdomen, thigh, lateral leg, dorsum of foot).

SP.flow: 起於大趾之端，循趾內側白肉際，過核骨後，上內踝前廉，上踹內，循脛骨後，交出厥陰之前，上膝股內前廉，入腹，屬脾，絡胃，上膈，挾咽，連舌本，散舌下；其支者，復從胃，別上膈，注心中（交於手少陰）。
SP.flowEn: Begins at the medial tip of the great toe, runs along the medial border of the foot at the junction of red and white skin, behind the first metatarsal head, in front of the medial malleolus, up the medial calf along the posterior tibial border, crossing in front of the Liver channel, up the anterior-medial thigh and knee, enters the abdomen to its home organ the Spleen, connects with the Stomach, ascends through the diaphragm beside the oesophagus to the root of the tongue, dispersing beneath it. A branch from the stomach crosses the diaphragm and flows into the heart, linking with the Heart channel.
SP.pathology: 舌本強痛、食則嘔、胃脘痛、腹脹善噫、得後與氣則快然、身重、泄瀉、黃疸、水腫、月經病、股膝內側腫痛厥冷、足大趾不用。
SP.pathologyEn: Stiff painful root of the tongue, vomiting after eating, epigastric pain, abdominal distension with belching relieved by flatus or defaecation, heaviness of the body, diarrhoea, jaundice, oedema, menstrual disorders, swelling, pain and coldness of the medial thigh and knee, loss of use of the great toe.

HT.flow: 起於心中，出屬心系，下膈，絡小腸；其支者，從心系上挾咽，繫目系；其直者，復從心系卻上肺，下出腋下，下循臑內後廉，行太陰、心主之後，下肘內，循臂內後廉，抵掌後銳骨之端，入掌內後廉，循小指之內，出其端（交於手太陽）。
HT.flowEn: Originates in the heart, emerges through the heart system, descends through the diaphragm to connect with the Small Intestine. A branch ascends from the heart system beside the oesophagus to the eye system. The main trunk returns from the heart system up to the lung, emerges at the axilla (Jiquan, HT1), descends the posterior-medial upper arm behind the Lung and Pericardium channels, through the medial elbow along the posterior-medial forearm to the pisiform bone, enters the palm and ends at the radial tip of the little finger, linking with the Small Intestine channel.
HT.pathology: 心痛、心悸、心煩、失眠、健忘、癲狂、咽乾、渴而欲飲、目黃、脅痛、臑臂內後廉痛厥、掌中熱痛。
HT.pathologyEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, vexation, insomnia, poor memory, mania and withdrawal, dry throat, thirst, yellow sclera, hypochondriac pain, pain and coldness along the posterior-medial arm, heat and pain in the palm.

SI.flow: 起於小指之端，循手外側上腕，出踝中，直上循臂骨下廉，出肘內側兩骨之間，上循臑外後廉，出肩解，繞肩胛，交肩上，入缺盆，絡心，循咽，下膈，抵胃，屬小腸；其支者，從缺盆循頸上頰，至目銳眥，卻入耳中；其支者，別頰上䪼，抵鼻，至目內眥，斜絡於顴（交於足太陽）。
SI.flowEn: Begins at the ulnar tip of the little finger, runs along the ulnar border of the hand to the wrist, over the styloid process, up the posterior ulnar border of the forearm, between the olecranon and medial epicondyle at the elbow, along the posterior-lateral upper arm to the shoulder joint, zigzags over the scapula, meets at the top of the shoulder, enters the supraclavicular fossa, connects with the Heart, descends along the oesophagus through the diaphragm to the stomach and its home organ the Small Intestine. A branch rises from the supraclavicular fossa along the neck to the cheek, to the outer canthus and into the ear. Another branch crosses the cheek to the infraorbital region and nose, reaching the inner canthus and linking with the Bladder channel.
SI.pathology: 耳聾、耳鳴、目黃、頰腫、咽喉腫痛、頸項強痛不可回顧、肩似拔、臑似折、肘臂外後廉痛、少腹痛脹、小便不利、泄瀉。
SI.pathologyEn: Deafness, tinnitus, yellow sclera, swollen cheek, sore swollen throat, stiff painful neck preventing head rotation, shoulder pain 'as if pulled out', upper-arm pain 'as if broken', pain along the posterior-lateral elbow and forearm, lower abdominal pain and distension, dysuria, diarrhoea.

BL.flow: 起於目內眥，上額，交巔；其支者，從巔至耳上角；其直者，從巔入絡腦，還出別下項，循肩髆內，挾脊，抵腰中，入循膂，絡腎，屬膀胱；其支者，從腰中下挾脊，貫臀，入膕中；其支者，從髆內左右別下貫胛，挾脊內，過髀樞，循髀外後廉，下合膕中，以下貫踹內，出外踝之後，循京骨，至小趾外側（交於足少陰）。
BL.flowEn: Begins at the inner canthus (Jingming, BL1), ascends the forehead and meets at the vertex. A branch goes from the vertex to the upper ear. The main trunk enters from the vertex to connect with the brain, re-emerges and descends the nape, along the medial scapula and beside the spine (first line, 1.5 cun) to the lumbar region, enters the paravertebral muscles to connect with the Kidney and its home organ the Bladder. A branch descends from the lumbar region beside the spine through the buttock into the popliteal fossa. Another branch descends from the scapula along the second line (3 cun from the spine) past the hip joint, down the posterior-lateral thigh to join in the popliteal fossa, then through the calf, behind the lateral malleolus along the fifth metatarsal to the lateral tip of the little toe, linking with the Kidney channel.
BL.pathology: 頭項強痛、目痛、迎風流淚、鼻塞鼻衄、癲狂癇、腰脊痛、膕如結、踹如裂、小便不利、遺尿、瘧疾、外感風寒，以及背俞穴所屬臟腑病證。
BL.pathologyEn: Headache and stiff neck, eye pain, lacrimation on exposure to wind, nasal congestion and nosebleed, mania and epilepsy, lumbar and spinal pain, popliteal fossa 'as if knotted', calf 'as if splitting', dysuria, enuresis, malaria, exterior wind-cold, and disorders of the organs addressed by the back-shu points.

KI.flow: 起於小趾之下，斜走足心，出於然谷之下，循內踝之後，別入跟中，以上踹內，出膕內廉，上股內後廉，貫脊，屬腎，絡膀胱；其直者，從腎上貫肝膈，入肺中，循喉嚨，挾舌本；其支者，從肺出絡心，注胸中（交於手厥陰）。
KI.flowEn: Begins beneath the little toe, crosses obliquely to the sole (Yongquan, KI1), emerges below the navicular tuberosity, runs behind the medial malleolus and into the heel, ascends the medial calf to the medial popliteal fossa, up the posterior-medial thigh, penetrates the spine to its home organ the Kidney and connects with the Bladder. The main trunk ascends from the kidney through the liver and diaphragm into the lung, along the throat to the root of the tongue. A branch leaves the lung to connect with the heart and disperses in the chest, linking with the Pericardium channel.
KI.pathology: 面黑如炭、氣短喘咳、咳唾有血、飢不欲食、心悸、驚恐、目眩、口熱舌乾、咽腫、腰脊痛、股內後側痛、足痿厥冷、足心熱、泄瀉、遺精、陽痿、月經不調、水腫。
KI.pathologyEn: Dark complexion, shortness of breath and cough, blood-streaked sputum, hunger without desire to eat, palpitations and fearfulness, dizziness, hot mouth and dry tongue, swollen throat, lumbar and spinal pain, pain of the posterior-medial thigh, weakness and coldness of the legs, heat in the sole, diarrhoea, seminal emission, impotence, menstrual irregularity, oedema.

PC.flow: 起於胸中，出屬心包絡，下膈，歷絡三焦；其支者，循胸出脅，下腋三寸，上抵腋下，循臑內，行太陰、少陰之間，入肘中，下臂，行兩筋之間，入掌中，循中指，出其端；其支者，別掌中，循小指次指出其端（交於手少陽）。
PC.flowEn: Originates in the chest, emerges to its home organ the Pericardium, descends through the diaphragm to connect successively with the three jiao. A branch runs across the chest to the hypochondrium, emerges 3 cun below the axilla (Tianchi, PC1), rises to the axilla, descends the medial upper arm between the Lung and Heart channels, through the cubital fossa, down the forearm between the two tendons, into the palm (Laogong, PC8) and along the middle finger to its tip. A branch from the palm follows the ring finger to its ulnar tip, linking with the Triple Energizer channel.
PC.pathology: 心痛、心煩、胸悶、心悸、掌中熱、腋腫、臂肘攣急、面赤目黃、喜笑不休、癲狂、胃痛嘔吐（心包與胃相關）。
PC.pathologyEn: Cardiac pain, vexation, chest oppression, palpitations, heat in the palm, axillary swelling, spasm of the arm and elbow, red face and yellow sclera, incessant laughter, mania, and epigastric pain or vomiting (the Pericardium channel's relation to the stomach).

TE.flow: 起於小指次指之端，上出兩指之間，循手表腕，出臂外兩骨之間，上貫肘，循臑外上肩，而交出足少陽之後，入缺盆，布膻中，散絡心包，下膈，循屬三焦；其支者，從膻中上出缺盆，上項，繫耳後，直上出耳上角，以屈下頰至䪼；其支者，從耳後入耳中，出走耳前，過客主人前，交頰，至目銳眥（交於足少陽）。
TE.flowEn: Begins at the ulnar tip of the ring finger, rises between the fourth and fifth metacarpals, over the dorsal wrist, between the radius and ulna, through the olecranon, up the lateral upper arm to the shoulder, crossing behind the Gallbladder channel, enters the supraclavicular fossa, spreads in the chest (Danzhong), connects with the Pericardium, descends through the diaphragm to its home organ, the three jiao. A branch rises from the chest through the supraclavicular fossa along the neck to behind the ear, over the upper ear, curves down the cheek to the infraorbital region. Another branch enters the ear from behind, emerges in front of it, crosses the cheek to the outer canthus, linking with the Gallbladder channel.
TE.pathology: 耳聾、耳鳴、咽喉腫痛、目銳眥痛、頰腫、耳後肩臑肘臂外側痛、小指次指不用、腹脹、水腫、遺尿、小便不利、汗出。
TE.pathologyEn: Deafness, tinnitus, sore swollen throat, pain at the outer canthus, swollen cheek, pain behind the ear and along the lateral shoulder, upper arm, elbow and forearm, loss of use of the ring finger, abdominal distension, oedema, enuresis, dysuria, sweating.

GB.flow: 起於目銳眥，上抵頭角，下耳後，循頸行手少陽之前，至肩上，卻交出手少陽之後，入缺盆；其支者，從耳後入耳中，出走耳前，至目銳眥後；其支者，別銳眥，下大迎，合於手少陽，抵於䪼，下加頰車，下頸合缺盆，以下胸中，貫膈，絡肝，屬膽，循脅裡，出氣街，繞毛際，橫入髀厭中；其直者，從缺盆下腋，循胸，過季脅，下合髀厭中，以下循髀陽，出膝外廉，下外輔骨之前，直下抵絕骨之端，下出外踝之前，循足跗上，入小趾次趾之間；其支者，別跗上，入大趾之間，循大趾歧骨內出其端，還貫爪甲，出三毛（交於足厥陰）。
GB.flowEn: Begins at the outer canthus, ascends to the corner of the forehead, descends behind the ear, along the neck in front of the Triple Energizer channel to the shoulder, crosses behind it into the supraclavicular fossa. A branch enters the ear from behind, emerges in front and reaches behind the outer canthus. Another branch leaves the outer canthus, descends to Daying, meets the Triple Energizer channel at the infraorbital region, passes Jiache, down the neck to the supraclavicular fossa, into the chest, through the diaphragm, connects with the Liver and its home organ the Gallbladder, runs inside the hypochondrium, emerges at Qichong, circles the pubic hair and enters the hip joint (Huantiao, GB30). The main trunk descends from the supraclavicular fossa through the axilla, along the lateral chest and free ribs to the hip, down the lateral thigh and knee, in front of the fibula to its lower end (Xuanzhong, GB39), in front of the lateral malleolus over the dorsum of the foot to the lateral tip of the fourth toe. A branch from the dorsum runs to the great toe and its nail bed, linking with the Liver channel.
GB.pathology: 口苦、善太息、心脅痛不能轉側、偏頭痛、目外眥痛、耳聾耳鳴、瘧疾、頸腋腫、瘰癧、髀膝外側至外踝前及諸節痛、足小趾次趾不用、黃疸。
GB.pathologyEn: Bitter taste, frequent sighing, pain in the chest and flank preventing turning, temporal headache, pain at the outer canthus, deafness and tinnitus, malaria, swelling of the neck and axilla, scrofula, pain along the lateral thigh, knee, leg and in front of the lateral malleolus, loss of use of the fourth toe, jaundice.

LR.direction: 足 → 胸腹（從足走腹胸）
LR.flow: 起於大趾叢毛之際，上循足跗上廉，去內踝一寸，上踝八寸，交出太陰之後，上膕內廉，循股陰，入毛中，環陰器，抵小腹，挾胃，屬肝，絡膽，上貫膈，布脅肋，循喉嚨之後，上入頏顙，連目系，上出額，與督脈會於巔；其支者，從目系下頰裡，環唇內；其支者，復從肝別貫膈，上注肺（交於手太陰）。
LR.flowEn: Begins at the hairy region of the great toe, ascends the dorsum of the foot 1 cun in front of the medial malleolus, 8 cun above the malleolus crosses behind the Spleen channel, up the medial knee and thigh into the pubic region, circles the genitals, reaches the lower abdomen, runs beside the stomach to its home organ the Liver and connects with the Gallbladder, ascends through the diaphragm, spreads in the hypochondrium, runs behind the throat to the nasopharynx, connects with the eye system, emerges at the forehead and meets the Governor vessel at the vertex. A branch descends from the eye system inside the cheek and circles the inner lips. Another branch from the liver crosses the diaphragm and flows into the lung, completing the cycle to the Lung channel.
LR.pathology: 腰痛不可俯仰、脅痛、少腹痛、疝氣、胸滿、嘔逆、飧泄、遺尿、癃閉、婦人少腹腫、月經不調、頭痛眩暈、目赤目疾、情志抑鬱易怒、筋病。
LR.pathologyEn: Lumbar pain preventing flexion and extension, hypochondriac pain, lower abdominal pain, hernia, chest fullness, retching, diarrhoea with undigested food, enuresis, urinary retention, lower abdominal swelling in women, menstrual irregularity, headache and dizziness, red eyes and eye disorders, depression or irritability, disorders of the sinews.

GV.organEn: Brain and spinal cord ('sea of the yang channels')
GV.hours: —（不入十二經流注；八脈交會穴後谿通督）
GV.direction: 會陰 → 頭面（從下走上）
GV.flow: 起於小腹內胞中，下出會陰，後行於腰背正中，循脊柱上行，至項後風府，入屬於腦，上巔，循額，至鼻柱，下至上唇繫帶齦交。督一身之陽經，與腦、髓、腎密切相關。
GV.flowEn: Originates in the lower abdomen (the uterus region), emerges at the perineum, ascends the midline of the back along the spine to Fengfu (GV16) at the nape, enters the brain, continues over the vertex (Baihui, GV20), down the forehead and nose to the upper gum (Yinjiao, GV28). It governs all the yang channels and is intimately related to the brain, marrow and Kidney.
GV.pathology: 脊強反折、角弓反張、頭痛、項強、眩暈、癲癇、癲狂、腰脊痛、頭重、神志病、陽氣虛衰（畏寒、陽痿）。
GV.pathologyEn: Stiffness and opisthotonos of the spine, headache, stiff neck, dizziness, epilepsy, mania, lumbar and spinal pain, heaviness of the head, mental-spirit disorders, debility of yang (cold intolerance, impotence).

CV.organEn: Uterus region ('sea of the yin channels')
CV.hours: —（不入十二經流注；八脈交會穴列缺通任）
CV.flow: 起於小腹內胞中，下出會陰，前行上毛際，循腹裡，上關元，至咽喉，上頤，循面，入目。任一身之陰經，主胞胎，調節月經、妊娠。
CV.flowEn: Originates in the lower abdomen (uterus region), emerges at the perineum, ascends the anterior midline over the pubis, through the abdomen past Guanyuan (CV4), up to the throat, chin and face, entering the eyes. It governs all the yin channels, is responsible for the uterus and foetus, and regulates menstruation and pregnancy.
CV.pathology: 疝氣、帶下、月經不調、崩漏、不孕、遺尿、癃閉、小腹腫痛、胸腹氣逆、虛脫（任脈與諸陰經之氣虛衰）。
CV.pathologyEn: Hernia, leucorrhoea, menstrual irregularity, uterine bleeding, infertility, enuresis, urinary retention, lower abdominal swelling and pain, rebellious qi in the chest and abdomen, collapse from deficiency of the yin channels.

LU1.functions: 宣肺理氣、止咳平喘、清上焦
LU1.functionsEn: Diffuses Lung qi, stops cough and calms wheezing, clears the upper jiao
LU1.indications: 咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、胸悶、肩背痛
LU1.indicationsEn: Cough, asthma, chest pain and oppression, shoulder and upper-back pain
LU1.caution: 位於胸區（第1肋間），深刺可穿透胸膜致氣胸；宜向外斜刺、淺刺
LU1.cautionEn: Thoracic zone (1st intercostal space): deep insertion can puncture the pleura and cause pneumothorax; needle obliquely outward and shallow
LU1.qiNote: 肺之募穴，與肺俞（BL13）為俞募配，前後呼應治肺系疾病。
LU1.qiNoteEn: Front-mu of the Lung; paired with Feishu (BL13) as the classic shu-mu combination for Lung disorders.

categoryEn: Child point of the Lung channel
LU5.functions: 清肺瀉熱、降逆止咳、舒筋活絡、涼血
LU5.functionsEn: Clears Lung heat, descends rebellious qi, stops cough, relaxes the sinews, cools blood
LU5.indications: 咳嗽、氣喘、咯血、咽喉腫痛、潮熱、肘臂攣痛、急性吐瀉、小兒驚風
LU5.indicationsEn: Cough, asthma, haemoptysis, sore throat, tidal fever, spasm and pain of the elbow and arm, acute vomiting and diarrhoea (bleeding), infantile convulsions
LU5.caution: 肘窩有肱動靜脈與正中神經，避開血管神經；刺絡放血需嚴格消毒
LU5.cautionEn: Brachial vessels and median nerve lie in the cubital fossa: avoid them; strict asepsis when bleeding the point
LU5.qiNote: 肺經合水穴，為肺經子穴；「實則瀉其子」，肺實熱證瀉尺澤。
LU5.qiNoteEn: He-sea Water point and child point of the Lung channel: 'in excess, drain the child' - reduce LU5 for Lung excess heat.

LU6.functions: 清熱止血、潤肺止咳、利咽
LU6.functionsEn: Clears heat and stops bleeding, moistens the Lung, stops cough, benefits the throat
LU6.indications: 咯血、咳嗽、氣喘、咽喉腫痛、失音、痔血、肘臂痛
LU6.indicationsEn: Haemoptysis, cough, asthma, sore swollen throat, loss of voice, bleeding haemorrhoids, elbow and arm pain
LU6.caution: 無特殊風險；深部為橈動脈分支，中等刺激
LU6.cautionEn: No special risk; branches of the radial artery lie deep, moderate stimulation
LU6.qiNote: 郄穴主急症與血證，肺經郄穴孔最善治急性咯血。
LU6.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft points treat acute and blood conditions; Kongzui is the point for acute haemoptysis.

categoryEn: Confluent point of the Conception vessel
LU7.functions: 宣肺解表、通經活絡、通調任脈、利咽
LU7.functionsEn: Diffuses the Lung and releases the exterior, activates the channel, regulates the Conception vessel, benefits the throat
LU7.indications: 頭項強痛、感冒、咳嗽、氣喘、咽喉痛、口眼喎斜、齒痛、腕痛、遺尿
LU7.indicationsEn: Headache and stiff neck, common cold, cough, asthma, sore throat, facial paralysis, toothache, wrist pain, enuresis
LU7.caution: 橈骨莖突上方，淺層有橈動脈分支與橈神經淺支，宜平刺
LU7.cautionEn: Above the radial styloid: branches of the radial artery and superficial radial nerve lie shallow; needle transversely
LU7.qiNote: 「頭項尋列缺」；與照海（KI6）為八脈交會配穴，主咽喉、胸膈、肺系。
LU7.qiNoteEn: 'For head and nape seek Lieque'; paired with Zhaohai (KI6) as confluent points for throat, chest and Lung disorders.

LU8.functionsEn: Diffuses the Lung, stops cough, benefits the throat, regulates the vessels
LU8.indications: 咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、咽喉腫痛、手腕痛、無脈症
LU8.indicationsEn: Cough, asthma, chest pain, sore throat, wrist pain, pulseless syndrome
LU8.caution: 位於橈動脈處，必須避開動脈；古籍言禁灸
LU8.cautionEn: Lies over the radial artery: avoid the artery; moxibustion contraindicated in the classics
LU8.qiNote: 肺經經金穴，金經金穴為本穴；經穴主喘咳寒熱。
LU8.qiNoteEn: Jing-river Metal point on a Metal channel (horary point); jing-river points treat cough, wheezing and chills and fever.

categoryEn: Mother point of the Lung channel
LU9.functions: 補肺益氣、止咳化痰、通調血脈
LU9.functionsEn: Tonifies Lung qi, stops cough and resolves phlegm, regulates the blood vessels
LU9.indications: 咳嗽、氣喘、咯血、胸痛、無脈症、腕臂痛、肺虛諸證
LU9.indicationsEn: Cough, asthma, haemoptysis, chest pain, pulseless syndrome, wrist and arm pain, Lung deficiency patterns
LU9.caution: 橈動脈搏動處，取穴時避開動脈
LU9.cautionEn: At the radial pulse: avoid the artery when needling
LU9.qiNote: 「虛則補其母」：肺虛補太淵；脈會太淵，主脈道病。
LU9.qiNoteEn: 'In deficiency, tonify the mother' - tonify Taiyuan for Lung deficiency; as hui-meeting of the vessels it treats vascular disorders.

LU10.functionsEn: Clears Lung heat, benefits the throat, stops cough
LU10.indications: 咳嗽、咯血、咽喉腫痛、失音、發熱、掌中熱、小兒疳積
LU10.indicationsEn: Cough, haemoptysis, sore swollen throat, loss of voice, fever, heat in the palm, infantile malnutrition
LU10.caution: 無特殊風險，大魚際肌肉豐厚
LU10.cautionEn: No special risk; thick thenar muscle
LU10.qiNote: 「滎主身熱」：肺經滎火穴，清肺熱、利咽要穴。
LU10.qiNoteEn: 'Ying-spring points treat heat of the body': the Fire point of the Lung clears heat and benefits the throat.

LU11.functions: 清肺利咽、開竅醒神、瀉熱
LU11.functionsEn: Clears the Lung, benefits the throat, opens the orifices, drains heat
LU11.indications: 咽喉腫痛、鼻衄、高熱、昏迷、中暑、癲狂、小兒驚風
LU11.indicationsEn: Sore swollen throat, nosebleed, high fever, coma, heat stroke, mania, infantile convulsions
LU11.caution: 多以三稜針點刺出血，須消毒；體弱、凝血異常者慎
LU11.cautionEn: Usually pricked to bleed with a three-edged needle under asepsis; caution in the frail or with coagulation disorders
LU11.qiNote: 井穴主「心下滿」、急救開竅；少商點刺出血治急性咽喉腫痛。
LU11.qiNoteEn: Jing-well points treat fullness below the heart and open the orifices in emergencies; bleeding Shaoshang treats acute sore throat.

LI1.functionsEn: Clears heat, benefits the throat, opens the orifices
LI1.indications: 咽喉腫痛、齒痛、耳聾、熱病、昏迷、食指麻木
LI1.indicationsEn: Sore swollen throat, toothache, deafness, febrile disease, coma, numbness of the index finger
LI1.qiNote: 大腸經井金穴，與少商同為咽喉急症放血要穴。
LI1.qiNoteEn: Jing-well Metal point; together with LU11 the main bleeding point for acute throat disorders.

LI2.functionsEn: Clears heat, benefits the throat, reduces swelling and pain
LI2.indications: 齒痛、咽喉腫痛、目痛、鼻衄、口乾、肩背痛
LI2.indicationsEn: Toothache, sore throat, eye pain, nosebleed, dry mouth, shoulder and back pain
LI2.qiNote: 滎水穴清陽明經熱，齒痛、咽痛之對證穴。
LI2.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring Water point clearing yangming heat; a point of choice for toothache and sore throat.

LI3.functionsEn: Clears heat, stops pain, benefits the throat, activates the channel
LI3.indications: 齒痛、目痛、咽喉腫痛、手指腫痛、腸鳴腹瀉
LI3.indicationsEn: Toothache, eye pain, sore throat, swelling of the fingers, borborygmus and diarrhoea
LI3.qiNote: 「輸主體重節痛」；三間配後谿治手指關節痛。
LI3.qiNoteEn: 'Shu-stream points treat heaviness and joint pain'; with SI3 for finger-joint pain.

LI4.functions: 疏風解表、通經活絡、鎮痛、開竅醒神、催產
LI4.functionsEn: Dispels wind and releases the exterior, activates the channel, relieves pain, opens the orifices, promotes labour
LI4.indications: 頭痛、齒痛、面癱、三叉神經痛、感冒、無汗或多汗、咽喉痛、經閉、滯產、上肢痛
LI4.indicationsEn: Headache, toothache, facial paralysis, trigeminal neuralgia, common cold, absent or excessive sweating, sore throat, amenorrhoea, delayed labour, arm pain
LI4.cautionEn: Contraindicated in pregnancy (may induce uterine contraction)
LI4.qiNote: 「面口合谷收」；合谷配太衝為「四關」，開關通竅、鎮靜止痛。
LI4.qiNoteEn: 'For face and mouth collect Hegu'; with Taichong (LR3) forms the Four Gates, calming the mind and relieving pain.

LI5.functionsEn: Clears heat and dispels wind, benefits the joints
LI5.indications: 頭痛、目赤腫痛、齒痛、咽喉痛、腕痛、癲狂
LI5.indicationsEn: Headache, red swollen eyes, toothache, sore throat, wrist pain, mania
LI5.caution: 鼻煙窩內有橈動脈分支，避開
LI5.cautionEn: Branches of the radial artery lie in the anatomical snuffbox: avoid them
LI5.qiNote: 經穴主喘咳寒熱；陽谿為腕部局部要穴。
LI5.qiNoteEn: Jing-river points treat cough and chills-fever; Yangxi is a key local point for the wrist.

LI6.functions: 清熱利尿、通經活絡、聰耳
LI6.functionsEn: Clears heat, promotes urination, activates the channel, benefits the ears
LI6.indications: 耳鳴耳聾、鼻衄、咽喉痛、水腫、小便不利、手臂痠痛
LI6.indicationsEn: Tinnitus and deafness, nosebleed, sore throat, oedema, dysuria, aching arm
LI6.qiNote: 大腸經絡穴，與肺經原穴太淵為原絡（主客）配穴。
LI6.qiNoteEn: Luo-connecting point of the Large Intestine; paired with Taiyuan (LU9) in the host-guest yuan-luo method.

LI7.functionsEn: Clears heat, reduces swelling, regulates qi and stops pain
LI7.indications: 急性腸鳴腹痛、咽喉腫痛、口舌生瘡、面腫、肩臂痠痛
LI7.indicationsEn: Acute borborygmus and abdominal pain, sore swollen throat, mouth ulcers, facial swelling, aching shoulder and arm
LI7.qiNote: 郄穴主急症：陽明急性腹痛、咽痛取溫溜。
LI7.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft point for acute conditions: acute yangming abdominal pain or sore throat.

LI10.functionsEn: Activates the channel, harmonises the stomach and intestines
LI10.indications: 肘臂痛、上肢不遂、齒痛、頰腫、腹痛、腹瀉
LI10.indicationsEn: Elbow and arm pain, upper-limb paralysis, toothache, swollen cheek, abdominal pain, diarrhoea
LI10.qiNote: 與足三里同名「三里」，上下相應，上肢痹痛與胃腸病兼顧。
LI10.qiNoteEn: Its name mirrors Zusanli (ST36); upper-lower correspondence for arm pain with gastrointestinal disorders.

LI11.functions: 清熱解表、祛風止癢、調和氣血、通經活絡、降壓
LI11.functionsEn: Clears heat and releases the exterior, dispels wind and stops itching, harmonises qi and blood, activates the channel, lowers blood pressure
LI11.indications: 熱病、咽喉腫痛、蕁麻疹、濕疹、肘臂痛、上肢不遂、高血壓、腹痛吐瀉、齒痛
LI11.indicationsEn: Febrile disease, sore throat, urticaria, eczema, elbow and arm pain, upper-limb paralysis, hypertension, abdominal pain with vomiting and diarrhoea, toothache
LI11.qiNote: 陽明多氣多血，曲池為陽明合穴，清熱、祛風、通絡皆宜。
LI11.qiNoteEn: Yangming is rich in qi and blood; Quchi as its he-sea point clears heat, dispels wind and activates the channel.

LI14.functions: 清熱明目、通絡止痛、化痰散結
LI14.functionsEn: Clears heat and brightens the eyes, activates the channel, resolves phlegm nodules
LI14.indications: 肩臂痛、上肢不遂、目疾、頸項拘急、瘰癧
LI14.indicationsEn: Shoulder and arm pain, upper-limb paralysis, eye disorders, stiff neck, scrofula
LI14.qiNote: 臂臑為手陽明、陽蹻之會，能上通目系。
LI14.qiNoteEn: Meeting of hand-yangming and the yang qiao vessel; reaches the eyes.

categoryEn: Meeting of hand-yangming and the yang qiao vessel
LI15.functionsEn: Activates the channel, dispels wind and heat
LI15.indications: 肩臂痛、上肢不遂、肩關節活動不利、癮疹、瘰癧
LI15.indicationsEn: Shoulder and arm pain, upper-limb paralysis, restricted shoulder movement, urticaria, scrofula
LI15.caution: 肩關節局部，無特殊風險；向關節腔深刺須謹慎
LI15.cautionEn: Local shoulder point without special risk; care with deep insertion into the joint
LI15.qiNote: 肩髃、肩髎、肩貞合稱「肩三針」，為肩周炎局部要穴。
LI15.qiNoteEn: Jianyu, Jianliao and Jianzhen form the 'three shoulder needles', the local set for frozen shoulder.

categoryEn: Meeting of hand and foot yangming
LI20.functionsEn: Opens the nasal passages, dispels wind and clears heat
LI20.indications: 鼻塞、鼻衄、鼻淵、鼻息肉、口喎、面癢、面腫
LI20.indicationsEn: Nasal congestion, nosebleed, sinusitis, nasal polyps, facial paralysis, facial itching and swelling
LI20.caution: 鼻唇溝處，宜斜刺或平刺
LI20.cautionEn: In the nasolabial groove; needle obliquely or transversely
LI20.qiNote: 「鼻病迎香」：陽明經氣上達鼻竅之處。
LI20.qiNoteEn: 'For nose disorders, Yingxiang': where yangming qi reaches the nose.

ST2.functionsEn: Dispels wind, brightens the eyes, activates the channel and stops pain
ST2.indications: 目赤痛癢、目翳、眼瞼瞤動、口眼喎斜、三叉神經痛（第二支）、頭面痛
ST2.indicationsEn: Red itchy painful eyes, corneal opacity, eyelid twitching, facial paralysis, trigeminal neuralgia (maxillary branch), head and face pain
ST2.caution: 眶下孔處，不宜深刺或大幅提插，以免損傷眶下神經與血管
ST2.cautionEn: At the infraorbital foramen: avoid deep insertion or vigorous lifting-thrusting (infraorbital nerve and vessels)
ST2.qiNote: 四白為陽明經氣上注於面之處，面癱、三叉神經痛局部要穴。
ST2.qiNoteEn: Where yangming qi pours into the face; a key local point for facial paralysis and trigeminal neuralgia.

categoryEn: Meeting of hand & foot yangming and yang qiao
ST4.functionsEn: Dispels wind, activates the channel, stops pain
ST4.indications: 口喎、流涎、齒痛、唇緩不收、三叉神經痛
ST4.indicationsEn: Deviation of the mouth, drooling, toothache, flaccid lips, trigeminal neuralgia
ST4.caution: 面部淺層，常向頰車方向平刺透穴
ST4.cautionEn: Superficial facial point; often needled transversely toward Jiache (ST6)
ST4.qiNote: 地倉透頰車為面癱口角喎斜之經典透刺。
ST4.qiNoteEn: Dicang-through-Jiache is the classic through-needling for mouth deviation in facial paralysis.

ST6.functionsEn: Dispels wind, activates the channel, benefits the jaw joint, stops pain
ST6.indications: 口喎、齒痛、頰腫、牙關緊閉、腮腺炎、面痛
ST6.indicationsEn: Deviation of the mouth, toothache, swollen cheek, trismus, parotitis, facial pain
ST6.cautionEn: Over the masseter; no special risk
ST6.qiNote: 頰車為陽明經面部要穴，「面口合谷收」配合谷遠端治下牙痛。
ST6.qiNoteEn: Key yangming facial point; with Hegu (distal) for lower toothache.

ST7.functions: 疏風清熱、通絡開關、聰耳
ST7.functionsEn: Dispels wind and clears heat, activates the channel, opens the jaw, benefits the ears
ST7.indications: 牙痛、口喎、耳鳴、耳聾、顳下頜關節痛、三叉神經痛、牙關緊閉
ST7.indicationsEn: Toothache, facial paralysis, tinnitus, deafness, temporomandibular joint pain, trigeminal neuralgia, trismus
ST7.caution: 閉口取穴；深部為上頜動脈與翼叢，不宜過深
ST7.cautionEn: Locate with the mouth closed; maxillary artery and pterygoid plexus lie deep: avoid excessive depth
ST7.qiNote: 下關為上牙痛、顳下頜關節病局部要穴。
ST7.qiNoteEn: Key local point for upper toothache and TMJ disorders.

category: 足陽明、足少陽、陽維交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of foot-yangming, foot-shaoyang and yang wei
ST8.functionsEn: Dispels wind, stops pain, clears the head and brightens the eyes
ST8.indications: 前額及側頭痛、目眩、目痛、迎風流淚、眼瞼瞤動
ST8.indicationsEn: Frontal and temporal headache, dizziness, eye pain, lacrimation on exposure to wind, eyelid twitching
ST8.cautionEn: Transverse scalp insertion; no special risk
ST8.qiNote: 頭維為陽明頭痛（前額）之局部要穴。
ST8.qiNoteEn: Key local point for yangming (frontal) headache.

ST9.functions: 利咽散結、理氣降逆、平肝潛陽
ST9.functionsEn: Benefits the throat and dissipates nodules, regulates and descends qi, pacifies Liver yang
ST9.indications: 咽喉腫痛、瘰癧、癭氣、高血壓、氣喘、呃逆
ST9.indicationsEn: Sore swollen throat, scrofula, goitre, hypertension, asthma, hiccup
ST9.caution: 頸動脈竇旁：必須避開頸總動脈，禁深刺、禁雙側同時重刺激，以免反射性心動過緩或血壓驟降
ST9.cautionEn: Beside the carotid sinus: avoid the common carotid artery, never deep, never strong bilateral stimulation (reflex bradycardia or hypotension)
ST9.qiNote: 人迎為「人迎脈口」診處，降壓用時須輕刺。
ST9.qiNoteEn: Site of the classical 'Renying' pulse; needle gently when used for blood pressure.

ST21.functionsEn: Harmonises the stomach, disperses food stagnation, regulates qi and stops pain
ST21.indications: 胃痛、嘔吐、食慾不振、腹脹、泄瀉
ST21.indicationsEn: Epigastric pain, vomiting, poor appetite, abdominal distension, diarrhoea
ST21.caution: 上腹部，肝脾腫大者深刺危險
ST21.cautionEn: Upper abdomen: deep insertion is dangerous with hepatomegaly or splenomegaly
ST21.qiNote: 梁門為胃脘局部穴，與中脘同治食滯胃痛。
ST21.qiNoteEn: Local epigastric point; with Zhongwan (CV12) for food stagnation and epigastric pain.

ST25.functions: 調腸理氣、通便止瀉、調經
ST25.functionsEn: Regulates the intestines and qi, relieves constipation and diarrhoea, regulates menstruation
ST25.indications: 腹痛、腹脹、便秘、腹瀉、痢疾、腸癰、月經不調、肥胖
ST25.indicationsEn: Abdominal pain and distension, constipation, diarrhoea, dysentery, appendicitis, menstrual irregularity, obesity
ST25.caution: 腹部穴，孕婦慎用；深刺可傷腸，腹部脹滿時尤需注意
ST25.cautionEn: Abdominal point: caution in pregnancy; deep insertion can injure the bowel, especially with distension
ST25.qiNote: 大腸之募穴，與大腸俞（BL25）俞募相配，雙向調節腸道。
ST25.qiNoteEn: Front-mu of the Large Intestine; with Dachangshu (BL25) regulates the bowel in both directions.

ST28.functionsEn: Promotes urination, regulates menstruation and leucorrhoea
ST28.indications: 小腹脹滿、小便不利、痛經、月經不調、帶下
ST28.indicationsEn: Lower abdominal distension, dysuria, dysmenorrhoea, menstrual irregularity, leucorrhoea
ST28.caution: 下腹部，孕婦禁；膀胱充盈時慎刺
ST28.cautionEn: Lower abdomen: contraindicated in pregnancy; caution with a full bladder
ST28.qiNote: 水道為「水液之道」，膀胱氣化不利之局部穴。
ST28.qiNoteEn: 'Waterway' - local point for impaired Bladder qi transformation.

ST29.functionsEn: Regulates menstruation and qi, warms the lower jiao
ST29.indications: 月經不調、閉經、帶下、疝氣、少腹痛、陰挺
ST29.indicationsEn: Menstrual irregularity, amenorrhoea, leucorrhoea, hernia, lower abdominal pain, uterine prolapse
ST29.qiNote: 歸來意為「使之歸返」，善治閉經、陰挺之氣虛下陷。
ST29.qiNoteEn: 'Return' - treats amenorrhoea and prolapse, bringing things back to their place.

ST34.functions: 和胃止痛、通經活絡、消腫
ST34.functionsEn: Harmonises the stomach and stops pain, activates the channel, reduces swelling
ST34.indications: 急性胃痛、乳癰、膝腫痛、下肢不遂、膝關節病
ST34.indicationsEn: Acute epigastric pain, mastitis, knee swelling and pain, lower-limb paralysis, knee disorders
ST34.qiNote: 胃經郄穴，急性胃痛首選；又為膝部局部要穴。
ST34.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Stomach: first choice for acute epigastric pain; also a key local knee point.

ST35.functionsEn: Activates the channel, reduces swelling and stops pain
ST35.indications: 膝痛、膝關節屈伸不利、下肢痿痹
ST35.indicationsEn: Knee pain, restricted knee flexion-extension, lower-limb weakness
ST35.caution: 屈膝取穴，向後內斜刺；注意無菌以免關節腔感染
ST35.cautionEn: Locate with the knee flexed, oblique insertion; strict asepsis to avoid joint infection
ST35.qiNote: 犢鼻與內膝眼合稱「膝眼」，膝痛必取。
ST35.qiNoteEn: With the medial Xiyan forms the 'knee eyes', used for virtually all knee pain.

ST36.functions: 健脾和胃、扶正培元、調和氣血、通經活絡、升清降濁
ST36.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and harmonises the stomach, supports the upright qi, harmonises qi and blood, activates the channel
ST36.indications: 胃痛、嘔吐、腹脹、泄瀉、便秘、消化不良、虛勞、暈厥、下肢痿痹、膝痛、高血壓、失眠
ST36.indicationsEn: Epigastric pain, vomiting, abdominal distension, diarrhoea, constipation, dyspepsia, debility, syncope, lower-limb weakness, knee pain, hypertension, insomnia
ST36.caution: 無特殊風險；小兒與體弱者刺激宜輕
ST36.cautionEn: No special risk; gentle stimulation in children and the frail
ST36.qiNote: 「肚腹三里留」；「若要安，三里常不乾」—保健灸要穴，補益後天之本。
ST36.qiNoteEn: 'For the abdomen, keep Zusanli'; a classic health-preserving moxa point tonifying the postnatal root.

categoryEn: Lower he-sea of the Large Intestine
ST37.functions: 調理腸胃、理氣化滯、通經活絡
ST37.functionsEn: Regulates the intestines and stomach, moves qi and resolves stagnation, activates the channel
ST37.indications: 腸鳴腹痛、腹瀉、痢疾、便秘、腸癰、下肢痿痹
ST37.indicationsEn: Borborygmus and abdominal pain, diarrhoea, dysentery, constipation, appendicitis, lower-limb weakness
ST37.qiNote: 「合治內腑」：大腸腑病取其下合穴上巨虛。
ST37.qiNoteEn: 'He-sea points treat the fu': the lower he-sea of the Large Intestine for bowel disorders.

ST38.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews, activates the channel, regulates qi
ST38.indications: 肩臂痛、肩關節活動不利、下肢痿痹、小腿冷痛、轉筋
ST38.indicationsEn: Shoulder pain with restricted movement, lower-limb weakness, cold painful calf, cramps
ST38.caution: 「條口透承山」深刺時避免損傷脛前血管神經
ST38.cautionEn: When needling through to Chengshan (BL57), avoid the anterior tibial vessels and nerve
ST38.qiNote: 條口透承山為肩周炎之上下配穴經典用法，針時令患者活動肩關節。
ST38.qiNoteEn: Tiaokou-through-Chengshan is a classic upper-lower pairing for frozen shoulder, with the patient moving the shoulder during needling.

categoryEn: Lower he-sea of the Small Intestine
ST39.functions: 調理腸胃、通經活絡、清熱
ST39.functionsEn: Regulates the intestines, activates the channel, clears heat
ST39.indications: 小腹痛、腹瀉、乳癰、下肢痿痹、腰脊痛引睪丸
ST39.indicationsEn: Lower abdominal pain, diarrhoea, mastitis, lower-limb weakness, lumbar pain radiating to the testes
ST39.qiNote: 小腸腑病（泌別清濁失常之腹痛泄瀉）取下巨虛。
ST39.qiNoteEn: Lower he-sea of the Small Intestine for its fu disorders (pain and diarrhoea from failure to separate clear and turbid).

ST40.functions: 化痰濕、健脾和胃、定喘、寧神
ST40.functionsEn: Resolves phlegm-damp, fortifies the Spleen, calms wheezing, settles the spirit
ST40.indications: 痰多咳喘、眩暈、頭痛、癲狂、癇證、便秘、肥胖、下肢痿痹
ST40.indicationsEn: Copious phlegm with cough and wheezing, dizziness, headache, mania, epilepsy, constipation, obesity, lower-limb weakness
ST40.qiNote: 「痰多宜向豐隆尋」：豐隆為化痰第一要穴，絡脾而健運。
ST40.qiNoteEn: 'For copious phlegm seek Fenglong': the foremost phlegm-resolving point, connecting to the Spleen.

ST41.functions: 清胃化痰、鎮驚安神、舒筋活絡
ST41.functionsEn: Clears the Stomach and resolves phlegm, calms fright and settles the spirit, relaxes the sinews
ST41.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、癲狂、腹脹、便秘、踝關節腫痛、下肢痿痹、足下垂
ST41.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, mania, abdominal distension, constipation, ankle swelling and pain, lower-limb weakness, foot drop
ST41.caution: 踝前有脛前動脈與腓深神經，避開
ST41.cautionEn: Anterior tibial artery and deep peroneal nerve at the ankle: avoid them
ST41.qiNote: 解谿為踝部前方局部要穴，又能清胃經之熱上擾（頭面）。
ST41.qiNoteEn: Key anterior ankle point; also clears Stomach-channel heat rising to the head.

ST42.functionsEn: Harmonises the stomach, resolves phlegm, activates the channel, settles the spirit
ST42.indications: 口喎、面腫、齒痛、足痿無力、足背腫痛、胃痛、癲狂
ST42.indicationsEn: Facial paralysis, facial swelling, toothache, weakness of the foot, swelling of the dorsum, epigastric pain, mania
ST42.caution: 足背動脈搏動處，避開動脈
ST42.cautionEn: At the dorsalis pedis pulse: avoid the artery
ST42.qiNote: 胃經原穴，診「趺陽脈」之處，候胃氣之有無。
ST42.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Stomach; site of the 'fuyang' pulse used to assess stomach qi.

ST43.functionsEn: Clears heat, reduces swelling, promotes water metabolism
ST43.indications: 面腫、水腫、腸鳴腹痛、足背腫痛、目赤
ST43.indicationsEn: Facial oedema, oedema, borborygmus and abdominal pain, swelling of the dorsum of the foot, red eyes
ST43.qiNote: 輸木穴，主水腫面腫等水氣病。
ST43.qiNoteEn: Shu-stream Wood point for oedema and facial swelling.

ST44.functions: 清胃瀉火、理氣止痛、通腸
ST44.functionsEn: Clears Stomach fire, regulates qi and stops pain, unblocks the bowel
ST44.indications: 齒痛、咽喉腫痛、鼻衄、口臭、胃痛吐酸、腹脹、便秘、熱病、足背腫痛
ST44.indicationsEn: Toothache, sore swollen throat, nosebleed, halitosis, epigastric pain with acid, abdominal distension, constipation, febrile disease, foot swelling
ST44.qiNote: 「滎主身熱」：內庭為清胃火要穴，胃火牙痛必取。
ST44.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring point for heat: the key point for clearing Stomach fire, essential in fire-type toothache.

ST45.functionsEn: Clears heat, harmonises the stomach, calms the spirit
ST45.indications: 鼻衄、齒痛、咽喉腫痛、腹脹、熱病、多夢、癲狂、足脛寒
ST45.indicationsEn: Nosebleed, toothache, sore throat, abdominal distension, febrile disease, dream-disturbed sleep, mania, cold legs
ST45.qiNote: 胃經井穴，「胃不和則臥不安」：多夢失眠屬胃熱者取之。
ST45.qiNoteEn: Jing-well of the Stomach: 'when the stomach is disharmonious, sleep is unquiet' - for dream-disturbed sleep from Stomach heat.

SP1.functions: 健脾統血、調經止血、寧神
SP1.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and controls blood, regulates menstruation and stops bleeding, settles the spirit
SP1.indications: 月經過多、崩漏、便血、尿血、腹脹、癲狂、多夢、小兒驚風
SP1.indicationsEn: Menorrhagia, uterine bleeding, bloody stool, haematuria, abdominal distension, mania, dream-disturbed sleep, infantile convulsions
SP1.caution: 多用艾灸；點刺出血須消毒
SP1.cautionEn: Often treated with moxa; bleed under asepsis
SP1.qiNote: 灸隱白治崩漏（脾不統血）為經典用法。
SP1.qiNoteEn: Moxa on Yinbai for uterine bleeding from the Spleen failing to control blood is a classic use.

categoryEn: Mother point of the Spleen channel
SP2.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and harmonises the middle, drains heat
SP2.indications: 腹脹、胃痛、嘔吐、泄瀉、便秘、熱病無汗、身重
SP2.indicationsEn: Abdominal distension, epigastric pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, febrile disease without sweating, heaviness
SP2.qiNote: 脾經滎火穴為脾經母穴：「虛則補其母」，脾虛可補大都。
SP2.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring Fire point and mother point of the Spleen: tonify Dadu for Spleen deficiency.

SP3.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and resolves damp, regulates qi and harmonises the stomach
SP3.indications: 胃痛、腹脹、泄瀉、便秘、痢疾、嘔吐、身重肢倦、足趾痛
SP3.indicationsEn: Epigastric pain, abdominal distension, diarrhoea, constipation, dysentery, vomiting, heaviness and fatigue, pain of the toes
SP3.qiNote: 脾經原穴，土經土穴，健脾化濕之本。
SP3.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Spleen and Earth point on the Earth channel: the root point for fortifying the Spleen and resolving damp.

categoryEn: Confluent point of the Chong vessel
SP4.functions: 健脾和胃、理氣化濕、調衝脈、寧心
SP4.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and harmonises the stomach, regulates qi and resolves damp, regulates the Chong vessel, calms the heart
SP4.indications: 胃痛、嘔吐、腹痛、泄瀉、痢疾、心煩失眠、月經不調
SP4.indicationsEn: Epigastric pain, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, dysentery, vexation and insomnia, menstrual irregularity
SP4.qiNote: 「公孫衝脈胃心胸，內關陰維下總同」：公孫配內關治心、胸、胃病。
SP4.qiNoteEn: 'Gongsun and the Chong vessel for stomach, heart and chest; Neiguan and the yin wei together': SP4 + PC6 is the confluent pair for the heart, chest and stomach.

SP5.functions: 健脾化濕、通調腸胃、舒筋活絡
SP5.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and resolves damp, regulates the intestines, relaxes the sinews
SP5.indications: 腹脹、泄瀉、便秘、黃疸、足踝痛、舌本強痛
SP5.indicationsEn: Abdominal distension, diarrhoea, constipation, jaundice, ankle pain, stiff painful tongue root
SP5.qiNote: 商丘為內踝前方局部穴，踝扭傷內側取之。
SP5.qiNoteEn: Local point in front of the medial malleolus; used for medial ankle sprain.

categoryEn: Meeting of the three foot yin channels
SP6.functions: 健脾益血、調肝補腎、安神、調經、利濕
SP6.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and nourishes blood, regulates the Liver and tonifies the Kidney, calms the spirit, regulates menstruation, resolves damp
SP6.indications: 腹脹、泄瀉、月經不調、痛經、帶下、不孕、遺精、陽痿、遺尿、失眠、高血壓、下肢痿痹、濕疹
SP6.indicationsEn: Abdominal distension, diarrhoea, menstrual irregularity, dysmenorrhoea, leucorrhoea, infertility, seminal emission, impotence, enuresis, insomnia, hypertension, lower-limb weakness, eczema
SP6.cautionEn: Contraindicated in pregnancy (may induce uterine contraction)
SP6.qiNote: 三陰交為肝脾腎三經交會，婦科、脾胃、泌尿生殖要穴。
SP6.qiNoteEn: Meeting of the Liver, Spleen and Kidney channels: the key point for gynaecology, digestion and the urogenital system.

SP8.functions: 健脾滲濕、調經止帶、止痛
SP8.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and drains damp, regulates menstruation and leucorrhoea, stops pain
SP8.indications: 痛經、崩漏、月經不調、腹痛、泄瀉、水腫、小便不利
SP8.indicationsEn: Dysmenorrhoea, uterine bleeding, menstrual irregularity, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, oedema, dysuria
SP8.qiNote: 脾經郄穴，急性痛經（實證）之要穴。
SP8.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Spleen: a key point for acute (excess) dysmenorrhoea.

SP9.functions: 健脾滲濕、益腎調經、通利三焦、利水
SP9.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and drains damp, benefits the Kidney and regulates menstruation, regulates the three jiao, promotes urination
SP9.indications: 腹脹、泄瀉、水腫、黃疸、小便不利、遺尿、帶下、膝痛、陰部痛
SP9.indicationsEn: Abdominal distension, diarrhoea, oedema, jaundice, dysuria, enuresis, leucorrhoea, knee pain, genital pain
SP9.qiNote: 陰陵泉為利濕第一要穴；與陽陵泉內外相對，膝痛並用。
SP9.qiNoteEn: The foremost damp-resolving point; opposite Yanglingquan (GB34) across the knee, used together for knee pain.

SP10.functions: 調經統血、健脾化濕、祛風止癢
SP10.functionsEn: Regulates menstruation and blood, fortifies the Spleen and resolves damp, dispels wind and stops itching
SP10.indications: 月經不調、痛經、崩漏、閉經、蕁麻疹、濕疹、丹毒、膝痛
SP10.indicationsEn: Menstrual irregularity, dysmenorrhoea, uterine bleeding, amenorrhoea, urticaria, eczema, erysipelas, knee pain
SP10.qiNote: 「治風先治血，血行風自滅」：血海配曲池治風疹瘙癢。
SP10.qiNoteEn: 'To treat wind first treat blood; when blood moves, wind is extinguished': SP10 + LI11 for itching skin disorders.

categoryEn: Meeting of foot-taiyin and yin wei
SP15.functionsEn: Regulates the bowel, moves qi and stops pain
SP15.indications: 腹痛、泄瀉、便秘、痢疾、肥胖
SP15.indicationsEn: Abdominal pain, diarrhoea, constipation, dysentery, obesity
SP15.cautionEn: Abdominal point; deep insertion can injure the bowel
SP15.qiNote: 大橫與天樞橫列，調腸通便之局部配穴。
SP15.qiNoteEn: Lies level with Tianshu (ST25): local combination for bowel regulation.

SP21.functionsEn: Controls the blood, expands the chest, regulates qi, activates the collaterals
SP21.indications: 胸脅痛、氣喘、全身疼痛、四肢無力
SP21.indicationsEn: Chest and hypochondriac pain, asthma, generalised body pain, weakness of the limbs
SP21.caution: 胸區（第6肋間），深刺致氣胸，宜沿肋斜刺
SP21.cautionEn: Thoracic zone (6th intercostal space): deep insertion causes pneumothorax; needle obliquely along the rib
SP21.qiNote: 「脾之大絡，總統陰陽諸絡」：實則身盡痛，虛則百節皆縱。
SP21.qiNoteEn: The great luo of the Spleen governs all the collaterals: in excess the whole body aches, in deficiency the joints are flaccid.

HT1.functionsEn: Expands the chest and settles the spirit, activates the channel
HT1.indications: 心痛、心悸、脅肋痛、肩臂痛、上肢不遂、瘰癧、腋臭
HT1.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, flank pain, shoulder and arm pain, upper-limb paralysis, scrofula, axillary odour
HT1.caution: 腋動脈搏動處，避開動脈與臂叢
HT1.cautionEn: At the axillary pulse: avoid the artery and brachial plexus
HT1.qiNote: 極泉為心經起點，中風後上肢不遂常用（彈撥法）。
HT1.qiNoteEn: Starting point of the Heart channel; used for post-stroke arm paralysis.

HT3.functionsEn: Calms the heart and settles the spirit, regulates qi, activates the channel
HT3.indications: 心痛、肘臂攣痛、手顫、瘰癧、腋脅痛、癲狂、健忘
HT3.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, spasm and pain of the elbow and arm, hand tremor, scrofula, axillary pain, mania, poor memory
HT3.caution: 肘內側，避開尺神經溝與肱動脈
HT3.cautionEn: Medial elbow: avoid the ulnar groove and brachial artery
HT3.qiNote: 心經合水穴，水能制火，心火擾神兼肘臂痛者宜。
HT3.qiNoteEn: He-sea Water point: Water controls Fire, suited to Heart fire disturbing the spirit with elbow pain.

HT4.functionsEn: Calms the heart, settles the spirit, restores the voice
HT4.indications: 心痛、心悸、暴喑、舌強、肘臂攣痛
HT4.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, sudden loss of voice, stiff tongue, spasm of the elbow and arm
HT4.cautionEn: Beside the ulnar artery: avoid it
HT4.qiNote: 心開竅於舌，靈道通心氣而開音。
HT4.qiNoteEn: The Heart opens into the tongue; Lingdao frees Heart qi and restores the voice.

HT5.functionsEn: Calms the heart and spirit, frees the tongue collateral, clears the heart
HT5.indications: 心悸怔忡、暴喑、舌強不語、腕臂痛、月經過多
HT5.indicationsEn: Palpitations, sudden loss of voice, stiff tongue and aphasia, wrist and arm pain, menorrhagia
HT5.qiNote: 心經絡穴別走小腸並「繫舌本」，中風失語要穴。
HT5.qiNoteEn: Luo point linking to the Small Intestine and 'tied to the tongue root': key point for post-stroke aphasia.

HT6.functions: 清心安神、固表止汗、涼血止血
HT6.functionsEn: Clears the heart and settles the spirit, consolidates the exterior and stops sweating, cools blood and stops bleeding
HT6.indications: 心痛、心悸、骨蒸盜汗、吐血、衄血、暴喑
HT6.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, steaming-bone fever with night sweats, haematemesis, nosebleed, sudden loss of voice
HT6.qiNote: 心經郄穴，陰虛盜汗要穴（配復溜）。
HT6.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Heart; key point for night sweats from yin deficiency (with KI7).

categoryEn: Child point of the Heart channel
HT7.functionsEn: Calms the heart and settles the spirit, clears the heart and regulates qi
HT7.indications: 心痛、心煩、失眠、健忘、癲狂癇、痴呆、心悸、掌中熱
HT7.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, vexation, insomnia, poor memory, mania and epilepsy, dementia, palpitations, heat in the palm
HT7.caution: 尺動脈位於穴之尺側，避開
HT7.cautionEn: The ulnar artery lies on the ulnar side: avoid it
HT7.qiNote: 心經原穴，神志病第一要穴；「心藏神」，失眠、心悸必取。
HT7.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Heart and the foremost point for the spirit: 'the Heart stores the shen' - essential in insomnia and palpitations.

HT8.functionsEn: Clears Heart fire, settles the spirit, stops itching
HT8.indications: 心悸、胸痛、心煩、小指攣急、掌中熱、陰癢陰痛、小便不利
HT8.indicationsEn: Palpitations, chest pain, vexation, spasm of the little finger, heat in the palm, genital itching and pain, dysuria
HT8.qiNote: 滎火穴，心火亢盛（口舌生瘡、煩躁）瀉之。
HT8.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring Fire point: reduce it for exuberant Heart fire (mouth ulcers, agitation).

HT9.functionsEn: Clears heat, opens the orifices, calms the heart
HT9.indications: 心悸、心痛、熱病、昏迷、中風、癲狂、胸脅痛
HT9.indicationsEn: Palpitations, cardiac pain, febrile disease, coma, wind-stroke, mania, chest and flank pain
HT9.qiNote: 心經井穴，急救醒神「十二井」之一。
HT9.qiNoteEn: Jing-well of the Heart; one of the twelve well points used to revive consciousness.

SI1.functionsEn: Clears heat and promotes lactation, benefits the throat, opens the orifices
SI1.indications: 乳癰、乳少、頭痛、目翳、咽喉腫痛、昏迷、熱病、耳聾
SI1.indicationsEn: Mastitis, insufficient lactation, headache, corneal opacity, sore throat, coma, febrile disease, deafness
SI1.qiNote: 少澤為催乳要穴，井穴而通乳，取「通」之意。
SI1.qiNoteEn: Shaoze is the key point for promoting lactation.

SI2.functionsEn: Clears heat, benefits the throat, benefits the ears and eyes
SI2.indications: 頭痛、目痛、耳鳴、咽喉腫痛、乳少、手指麻木
SI2.indicationsEn: Headache, eye pain, tinnitus, sore throat, insufficient lactation, numbness of the fingers
SI2.qiNote: 太陽經滎水穴，清太陽經熱。
SI2.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring Water point clearing taiyang heat.

categoryEn: Confluent point of the Governor vessel
SI3.functions: 清熱寧神、通督舒筋、利頸項腰背
SI3.functionsEn: Clears heat and settles the spirit, regulates the Governor vessel and relaxes the sinews, benefits the neck and back
SI3.indications: 頭項強痛、腰背痛、落枕、急性腰扭傷、癲狂癇、瘧疾、目赤、耳聾、手指攣急、盜汗
SI3.indicationsEn: Headache and stiff neck, back pain, stiff neck (torticollis), acute lumbar sprain, mania and epilepsy, malaria, red eyes, deafness, finger spasm, night sweats
SI3.cautionEn: Locate with a loose fist; no special risk
SI3.qiNote: 「後谿督脈內眥頸」：配申脈（BL62）通督脈，主頸項腰脊。
SI3.qiNoteEn: 'Houxi with the Governor vessel for the inner canthus and neck': paired with Shenmai (BL62) for the neck and spine.

SI4.functions: 舒筋活絡、泌別清濁、退黃、清熱
SI4.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews, separates the clear and turbid, relieves jaundice, clears heat
SI4.indications: 頭項強痛、耳鳴、目翳、黃疸、熱病、消渴、腕痛、手指攣急
SI4.indicationsEn: Headache and stiff neck, tinnitus, corneal opacity, jaundice, febrile disease, wasting-thirst, wrist pain, finger spasm
SI4.qiNote: 小腸經原穴，與通里（HT5）為原絡配穴。
SI4.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Small Intestine; paired with Tongli (HT5) in the yuan-luo method.

SI5.functionsEn: Clears heat, benefits the eyes and ears, settles the spirit
SI5.indications: 頭痛、目眩、耳鳴耳聾、齒痛、癲狂、腕痛
SI5.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, tinnitus and deafness, toothache, mania, wrist pain
SI5.qiNote: 經火穴，清太陽經熱而寧神。
SI5.qiNoteEn: Jing-river Fire point clearing taiyang heat and settling the spirit.

SI6.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews, activates the channel, brightens the eyes, stops pain
SI6.indications: 目視不明、肩背肘臂痠痛、急性腰痛、落枕、腕痛
SI6.indicationsEn: Blurred vision, aching shoulder, back and arm, acute lumbar pain, stiff neck, wrist pain
SI6.qiNote: 小腸經郄穴，急性落枕、急性腰扭傷之遠端要穴。
SI6.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Small Intestine: distal point for acute stiff neck and lumbar sprain.

SI7.functionsEn: Clears heat and releases the exterior, settles the spirit, activates the channel
SI7.indications: 頭痛、項強、肘臂痠痛、癲狂、熱病、手指不能握
SI7.indicationsEn: Headache, stiff neck, aching elbow and arm, mania, febrile disease, inability to grip
SI7.qiNote: 小腸經絡穴，別走心經，神志病兼項臂痛取之。
SI7.qiNoteEn: Luo point linking to the Heart; for mental-spirit disorders with neck and arm pain.

SI8.functionsEn: Clears heat, settles the spirit, activates the channel
SI8.indications: 肘臂痛、癲癇、頰腫、頸項痛、齒齦腫痛
SI8.indicationsEn: Elbow and arm pain, epilepsy, swollen cheek, neck pain, swollen gums
SI8.caution: 尺神經溝附近，避免直接刺中尺神經（觸電感即退）
SI8.cautionEn: Near the ulnar groove: avoid hitting the ulnar nerve (withdraw on electric sensation)
SI8.qiNote: 太陽經合穴，肘部外後側局部穴。
SI8.qiNoteEn: He-sea of the taiyang channel; local point for the posterior-lateral elbow.

SI9.indications: 肩臂痛、肩胛痛、上肢不遂、瘰癧、耳鳴
SI9.indicationsEn: Shoulder and arm pain, scapular pain, upper-limb paralysis, scrofula, tinnitus
SI9.caution: 腋後，向外斜刺；勿向胸腔方向深刺
SI9.cautionEn: Behind the axilla, oblique lateral insertion; never deep toward the thoracic cavity
SI9.qiNote: 「肩三針」之一（太陽經），肩後側痛要穴。
SI9.qiNoteEn: One of the 'three shoulder needles' (taiyang); key point for posterior shoulder pain.

category: 手太陽、陽維、陽蹻交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of hand-taiyang, yang wei and yang qiao
SI10.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews, activates the channel, dissipates nodules
SI10.indications: 肩臂痛、肩腫、肩關節活動不利、瘰癧
SI10.indicationsEn: Shoulder and arm pain, shoulder swelling, restricted shoulder movement, scrofula
SI10.qiNote: 臑俞與肩貞合用，肩周炎後側痛取之。
SI10.qiNoteEn: With Jianzhen for posterior shoulder pain in frozen shoulder.

SI11.functions: 舒筋活絡、理氣消腫、通乳
SI11.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews, regulates qi and reduces swelling, promotes lactation
SI11.indications: 肩胛痛、肩背痛、上肢後側痛、氣喘、乳癰、乳少
SI11.indicationsEn: Scapular pain, shoulder and back pain, posterior arm pain, asthma, mastitis, insufficient lactation
SI11.caution: 位於肩胛骨岡下窩，有骨承托，但勿越過肩胛骨緣向肋間深刺
SI11.cautionEn: In the infraspinous fossa over bone; do not pass the scapular border into the intercostal space
SI11.qiNote: 天宗為肩胛區阿是常見部位，乳房病亦取（前後相應）。
SI11.qiNoteEn: Common ashi site in the scapular region; also used for breast disorders (front-back correspondence).

SI18.functionsEn: Dispels wind, activates the channel, reduces swelling and stops pain
SI18.indications: 口喎、眼瞼瞤動、齒痛、頰腫、三叉神經痛（第二支）
SI18.indicationsEn: Facial paralysis, eyelid twitching, toothache, swollen cheek, trigeminal neuralgia (maxillary branch)
SI18.cautionEn: Below the zygoma; no special risk
SI18.qiNote: 顴髎為面部要穴，面癱、面痛、面肌痙攣皆取。
SI18.qiNoteEn: Key facial point for paralysis, pain and spasm.

category: 手足少陽、手太陽交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of hand & foot shaoyang and hand-taiyang
SI19.functionsEn: Benefits the ears and opens the orifices, settles the spirit
SI19.indications: 耳鳴、耳聾、聤耳、齒痛、癲狂、顳下頜關節痛
SI19.indicationsEn: Tinnitus, deafness, otitis, toothache, mania, TMJ pain
SI19.caution: 張口取穴，直刺；深部有外耳道與腮腺
SI19.cautionEn: Locate with the mouth open; external auditory canal and parotid lie deep
SI19.qiNote: 「耳三針」（聽宮、聽會、翳風）之一，耳病局部要穴。
SI19.qiNoteEn: One of the three ear points (SI19, GB2, TE17), the local set for ear disorders.

category: 手足太陽、足陽明、陰陽蹻交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of hand & foot taiyang, foot-yangming, yin & yang qiao
BL1.functionsEn: Brightens the eyes, dispels wind, clears heat
BL1.indications: 目赤腫痛、迎風流淚、近視、夜盲、色盲、目翳、急性腰痛
BL1.indicationsEn: Red swollen painful eyes, lacrimation on exposure to wind, myopia, night blindness, colour blindness, corneal opacity, acute lumbar pain
BL1.caution: 眼眶內緣：推開眼球緊靠眶緣緩慢直刺，不捻轉、不提插，禁灸；出針後按壓防血腫（教學僅講原則）
BL1.cautionEn: Inside the orbital rim: push the globe aside, insert slowly along the rim, no rotation or lifting-thrusting, moxa contraindicated; press after withdrawal to prevent haematoma (principle only)
BL1.qiNote: 睛明為太陽經起點，眼病局部要穴，須配風池、光明等遠端穴。
BL1.qiNoteEn: Starting point of the Bladder channel and key local eye point; combine with distal GB20 and GB37.

BL2.functions: 清熱明目、祛風通絡、止呃
BL2.functionsEn: Clears heat and brightens the eyes, dispels wind, activates the channel, stops hiccup
BL2.indications: 頭痛、眉棱骨痛、目赤腫痛、眼瞼下垂、眼瞼瞤動、口喎、呃逆、急性腰痛
BL2.indicationsEn: Headache, supraorbital pain, red swollen eyes, ptosis, eyelid twitching, facial paralysis, hiccup, acute lumbar pain
BL2.cautionEn: At the eyebrow head; transverse insertion or pricking
BL2.qiNote: 攢竹治呃逆、眉棱骨痛為經驗要穴。
BL2.qiNoteEn: Empirical key point for hiccup and supraorbital pain.

BL10.functions: 祛風通絡、清頭明目、寧神
BL10.functionsEn: Dispels wind, activates the channel, clears the head and brightens the eyes, settles the spirit
BL10.indications: 頭痛、項強、眩暈、目赤、鼻塞、肩背痛、落枕、癲狂癇
BL10.indicationsEn: Headache, stiff neck, dizziness, red eyes, nasal congestion, shoulder and back pain, stiff neck, mania and epilepsy
BL10.caution: 枕下區：不可向內上方深刺，以免傷及延髓
BL10.cautionEn: Suboccipital zone: never deep toward the medulla (inward-upward direction)
BL10.qiNote: 天柱為太陽頭痛（後頭項）之局部要穴，配後谿遠端。
BL10.qiNoteEn: Local key point for taiyang (occipital) headache; with distal Houxi (SI3).

categoryEn: Meeting of hand and foot taiyang
BL11.functionsEn: Strengthens bones and sinews, dispels wind and releases the exterior, diffuses the Lung
BL11.indications: 項強、肩背痛、咳嗽、發熱、骨病、骨質疏鬆
BL11.indicationsEn: Stiff neck, shoulder and back pain, cough, fever, bone disorders, osteoporosis
BL11.caution: 胸背區（T1旁），深刺可致氣胸
BL11.cautionEn: Upper thoracic back (beside T1): deep insertion risks pneumothorax
BL11.qiNote: 「骨會大杼」，骨病、頸椎病取之；配髓會懸鐘。
BL11.qiNoteEn: Hui-meeting of bone: for bone disorders and cervical spondylosis; with Xuanzhong (GB39), hui of marrow.

categoryEn: Meeting of the Governor vessel and foot-taiyang
BL12.functionsEn: Dispels wind and releases the exterior, diffuses the Lung and stops cough
BL12.indications: 感冒、咳嗽、發熱頭痛、項強、鼻塞、肩背痛、蕁麻疹
BL12.indicationsEn: Common cold, cough, fever and headache, stiff neck, nasal congestion, shoulder and back pain, urticaria
BL12.caution: 胸背區（T2旁），深刺可致氣胸；宜斜刺或拔罐、灸
BL12.cautionEn: Thoracic back (beside T2): deep insertion risks pneumothorax; oblique insertion, cupping or moxa preferred
BL12.qiNote: 風門為「風邪出入之門」，風寒感冒灸之、拔罐之。
BL12.qiNoteEn: 'Gate of wind': moxa or cupping for wind-cold invasion.

BL13.functions: 宣肺理氣、止咳平喘、補肺、清虛熱
BL13.functionsEn: Diffuses Lung qi, stops cough and calms wheezing, tonifies the Lung, clears deficiency heat
BL13.indications: 咳嗽、氣喘、咯血、骨蒸潮熱、盜汗、鼻塞、皮膚病、背痛
BL13.indicationsEn: Cough, asthma, haemoptysis, steaming-bone fever, night sweats, nasal congestion, skin disorders, back pain
BL13.caution: 胸背區（T3旁），深刺可致氣胸，宜斜刺
BL13.cautionEn: Thoracic back (beside T3): deep insertion risks pneumothorax; oblique insertion
BL13.qiNote: 肺之背俞，俞募相配中府（LU1）；肺虛補之、肺實瀉之。
BL13.qiNoteEn: Back-shu of the Lung, paired with Zhongfu (LU1); tonify for deficiency, reduce for excess.

BL14.functionsEn: Expands the chest and regulates qi, calms the heart, descends rebellion
BL14.indications: 心痛、心悸、咳嗽、胸悶、嘔吐、胸痹
BL14.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, cough, chest oppression, vomiting, chest bi
BL14.caution: 胸背區（T4旁），深刺可致氣胸
BL14.qiNote: 厥陰俞為心包背俞，與膻中（CV17）俞募相配治胸痹。
BL14.qiNoteEn: Back-shu of the Pericardium, paired with Danzhong (CV17) for chest bi.

BL15.functions: 寧心安神、理血調氣、寬胸
BL15.functionsEn: Calms the heart and settles the spirit, regulates blood and qi, expands the chest
BL15.indications: 心痛、心悸、失眠、健忘、癲癇、咳嗽、吐血、盜汗、夢遺
BL15.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, insomnia, poor memory, epilepsy, cough, haematemesis, night sweats, nocturnal emission
BL15.caution: 胸背區（T5旁），深刺可致氣胸
BL15.qiNote: 心之背俞，配巨闕（CV14）俞募；配腎俞交通心腎。
BL15.qiNoteEn: Back-shu of the Heart, paired with Juque (CV14); with Shenshu (BL23) to link Heart and Kidney.

BL17.functions: 活血化瘀、理氣寬膈、止血、養血
BL17.functionsEn: Invigorates blood and dispels stasis, regulates qi and relaxes the diaphragm, stops bleeding, nourishes blood
BL17.indications: 嘔吐、呃逆、氣喘、吐血、貧血、血瘀諸證、蕁麻疹、盜汗、背痛
BL17.indicationsEn: Vomiting, hiccup, asthma, haematemesis, anaemia, blood stasis patterns, urticaria, night sweats, back pain
BL17.caution: 胸背區（T7旁），深刺可致氣胸
BL17.qiNote: 「血會膈俞」：一切血證（瘀、虛、出血）皆可取。
BL17.qiNoteEn: Hui-meeting of blood: for all blood disorders - stasis, deficiency and bleeding.

BL18.functions: 疏肝利膽、明目、息風、養血
BL18.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and benefits the Gallbladder, brightens the eyes, extinguishes wind, nourishes blood
BL18.indications: 脅痛、黃疸、目疾、眩暈、癲狂、月經不調、脊背痛、抑鬱
BL18.indicationsEn: Hypochondriac pain, jaundice, eye disorders, dizziness, mania, menstrual irregularity, back pain, depression
BL18.caution: 胸背區（T9旁），右側深刺傷肝、亦有氣胸風險
BL18.cautionEn: Thoracic back (beside T9): deep insertion risks liver injury (right) and pneumothorax
BL18.qiNote: 肝之背俞，配期門（LR14）俞募；「肝開竅於目」，眼病常取。
BL18.qiNoteEn: Back-shu of the Liver, paired with Qimen (LR14); the Liver opens into the eyes, so it is used in eye disorders.

BL19.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and benefits the Gallbladder, clears heat and resolves damp
BL19.indications: 黃疸、脅痛、口苦、嘔吐、肺癆潮熱、失眠膽怯
BL19.indicationsEn: Jaundice, hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, vomiting, tidal fever of consumption, insomnia with timidity
BL19.qiNote: 膽俞配日月（GB24）俞募；心膽氣虛失眠配心俞。
BL19.qiNoteEn: Paired with Riyue (GB24); with Xinshu (BL15) for insomnia from Heart-Gallbladder qi deficiency.

BL20.functions: 健脾化濕、益氣統血、和胃
BL20.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and resolves damp, boosts qi and controls blood, harmonises the stomach
BL20.indications: 腹脹、泄瀉、嘔吐、水腫、黃疸、便血、月經過多、背痛、消化不良
BL20.indicationsEn: Abdominal distension, diarrhoea, vomiting, oedema, jaundice, bloody stool, menorrhagia, back pain, dyspepsia
BL20.caution: 胸背區下緣（T11旁），深刺仍有風險
BL20.cautionEn: Lower thoracic back (beside T11): depth risk remains
BL20.qiNote: 脾之背俞，配章門（LR13）俞募；脾胃虛弱灸之。
BL20.qiNoteEn: Back-shu of the Spleen, paired with Zhangmen (LR13); moxa for Spleen-Stomach deficiency.

BL21.functionsEn: Harmonises the stomach and descends rebellion, fortifies the Spleen and disperses food
BL21.indications: 胃脘痛、嘔吐、腹脹、腸鳴、完穀不化、背痛
BL21.indicationsEn: Epigastric pain, vomiting, abdominal distension, borborygmus, undigested food in stool, back pain
BL21.cautionEn: Beside T12: deep insertion may injure the kidney or pleura
BL21.qiNote: 胃俞配中脘（CV12）為俞募配穴之典型。
BL21.qiNoteEn: Weishu + Zhongwan (CV12) is the archetypal shu-mu pairing.

BL22.functions: 通利三焦、利水消腫、調氣
BL22.functionsEn: Regulates the three jiao, promotes urination and reduces oedema, regulates qi
BL22.indications: 水腫、小便不利、腹脹、腸鳴泄瀉、腰背痛
BL22.indicationsEn: Oedema, dysuria, abdominal distension, borborygmus and diarrhoea, back pain
BL22.cautionEn: Kidney region (beside L1): deep insertion may injure the kidney
BL22.qiNote: 三焦俞配石門（CV5）俞募，主水液代謝。
BL22.qiNoteEn: Paired with Shimen (CV5); governs fluid metabolism.

BL23.functions: 補腎益精、強腰、聰耳明目、溫陽利水
BL23.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and essence, strengthens the lumbar region, benefits ears and eyes, warms yang and promotes urination
BL23.indications: 遺精、陽痿、月經不調、遺尿、耳鳴耳聾、腰痛、水腫、氣喘、眩暈
BL23.indicationsEn: Seminal emission, impotence, menstrual irregularity, enuresis, tinnitus and deafness, lumbar pain, oedema, asthma, dizziness
BL23.caution: 腎區（L2旁），不可深刺，以免傷腎
BL23.cautionEn: Kidney region (beside L2): never deep, to avoid injuring the kidney
BL23.qiNote: 腎之背俞，配京門（GB25）俞募；「腰為腎之府」，腎虛腰痛必取。
BL23.qiNoteEn: Back-shu of the Kidney, paired with Jingmen (GB25); 'the lumbar region is the mansion of the Kidney'.

BL25.functionsEn: Regulates the bowel, strengthens the lumbar region and stops pain
BL25.indications: 腹痛、腹脹、泄瀉、便秘、痢疾、腰腿痛
BL25.indicationsEn: Abdominal pain and distension, diarrhoea, constipation, dysentery, lumbar and leg pain
BL25.qiNote: 大腸俞配天樞（ST25）俞募；又為腰痛局部要穴。
BL25.qiNoteEn: Paired with Tianshu (ST25); also a key local lumbar point.

BL27.functionsEn: Regulates urination and defaecation, clears damp-heat
BL27.indications: 腹痛、泄瀉、遺精、遺尿、尿血、帶下、腰骶痛
BL27.indicationsEn: Abdominal pain, diarrhoea, seminal emission, enuresis, haematuria, leucorrhoea, lumbosacral pain

BL28.functionsEn: Benefits the Bladder, strengthens the lumbar region, clears heat
BL28.indications: 小便不利、遺尿、尿頻、泄瀉、便秘、腰骶痛
BL28.indicationsEn: Dysuria, enuresis, frequent urination, diarrhoea, constipation, lumbosacral pain
BL28.qiNote: 膀胱俞配中極（CV3）俞募，膀胱氣化不利諸證。
BL28.qiNoteEn: Paired with Zhongji (CV3) for impaired Bladder qi transformation.

BL32.functions: 補腎強腰、調經止帶、通利二便
BL32.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and strengthens the lumbar region, regulates menstruation and leucorrhoea, benefits urination and defaecation
BL32.indications: 腰骶痛、月經不調、痛經、帶下、小便不利、遺精、下肢痿痹
BL32.indicationsEn: Lumbosacral pain, menstrual irregularity, dysmenorrhoea, leucorrhoea, dysuria, seminal emission, lower-limb weakness
BL32.cautionEn: Second posterior sacral foramen: contraindicated in pregnancy
BL32.qiNote: 次髎為八髎中最常用，婦科與泌尿、腰骶痛要穴。
BL32.qiNoteEn: Most used of the eight liao; key for gynaecological, urinary and lumbosacral disorders.

categoryEn: Lower he-sea of the Triple Energizer
BL39.functions: 通利三焦、利水、舒筋活絡
BL39.functionsEn: Regulates the three jiao, promotes urination, relaxes the sinews
BL39.indications: 小便不利、小腹脹滿、腰脊強痛、腿足攣痛
BL39.indicationsEn: Dysuria, lower abdominal fullness, stiff painful lumbar spine, leg cramps and pain
BL39.caution: 膕窩外側，有腓總神經，避免直刺神經
BL39.cautionEn: Lateral popliteal fossa: avoid the common peroneal nerve
BL39.qiNote: 三焦下合穴，水道不利（癃閉）取之。
BL39.qiNoteEn: Lower he-sea of the Triple Energizer: for impaired waterways (retention).

BL40.functions: 舒筋通絡、涼血清熱、強腰、止吐瀉
BL40.functionsEn: Relaxes sinews and activates the channel, cools blood and clears heat, strengthens the lumbar region, stops vomiting and diarrhoea
BL40.indications: 腰背痛、下肢痿痹、腹痛、吐瀉、丹毒、濕疹、小便不利、遺尿、中暑
BL40.indicationsEn: Back pain, lower-limb weakness, abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhoea, erysipelas, eczema, dysuria, enuresis, heat stroke
BL40.caution: 膕窩中央有膕動靜脈與脛神經，避開；刺絡放血需消毒
BL40.cautionEn: Popliteal vessels and tibial nerve in the fossa: avoid them; asepsis when bleeding
BL40.qiNote: 「腰背委中求」；委中放血治急性腰扭傷、暑熱。
BL40.qiNoteEn: 'For the lumbar region seek Weizhong'; bleeding it treats acute lumbar sprain and summer heat.

BL43.functions: 補虛益損、調理肺氣、養陰
BL43.functionsEn: Tonifies deficiency, regulates Lung qi, nourishes yin
BL43.indications: 肺癆、咳嗽、氣喘、盜汗、健忘、遺精、虛勞羸瘦
BL43.indicationsEn: Consumption, cough, asthma, night sweats, poor memory, seminal emission, debility and emaciation
BL43.caution: 胸背區（T4旁開3寸），氣胸高風險，宜灸不宜深刺
BL43.cautionEn: Thoracic back (3 cun beside T4): high pneumothorax risk; moxa preferred over deep needling
BL43.qiNote: 「病入膏肓」：膏肓俞為補虛勞第一灸穴。
BL43.qiNoteEn: 'The illness has entered the gaohuang': the foremost moxa point for deficiency and consumption.

BL52.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and essence, strengthens the lumbar region, promotes urination
BL52.indications: 遺精、陽痿、小便不利、水腫、腰脊強痛
BL52.indicationsEn: Seminal emission, impotence, dysuria, oedema, stiff painful lumbar spine
BL52.cautionEn: Kidney region (3 cun beside L2): deep insertion may injure the kidney
BL52.qiNote: 志室與腎俞橫列，「腎藏志」，補腎固精。
BL52.qiNoteEn: Level with Shenshu; 'the Kidney stores the will' - tonifies the Kidney and secures essence.

BL54.functions: 舒筋活絡、強腰、通利二便
BL54.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews, strengthens the lumbar region, benefits urination and defaecation
BL54.indications: 腰骶痛、下肢痿痹、坐骨神經痛、痔疾、小便不利、便秘
BL54.indicationsEn: Lumbosacral pain, lower-limb weakness, sciatica, haemorrhoids, dysuria, constipation
BL54.caution: 臀部深刺，得氣放射即止
BL54.cautionEn: Deep gluteal point: stop once the propagated sensation is obtained
BL54.qiNote: 秩邊為坐骨神經痛（太陽經型）局部要穴。
BL54.qiNoteEn: Key local point for taiyang-type sciatica.

BL57.functions: 舒筋活絡、理腸療痔、止痙
BL57.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews and activates the channel, regulates the bowel and treats haemorrhoids, stops cramps
BL57.indications: 腰腿痛、腓腸肌痙攣、痔疾、便秘、腳氣、肩痛（配條口）
BL57.indicationsEn: Lumbar and leg pain, calf cramps, haemorrhoids, constipation, beriberi, shoulder pain (with ST38)
BL57.qiNote: 承山為小腿轉筋、痔瘡之經驗要穴。
BL57.qiNoteEn: Empirical key point for calf cramps and haemorrhoids.

BL58.functionsEn: Clears heat and dispels wind, activates the channel and stops pain
BL58.indications: 頭痛、目眩、鼻衄、腰腿痛、痔疾
BL58.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, nosebleed, lumbar and leg pain, haemorrhoids
BL58.qiNote: 膀胱經絡穴，與腎經原穴太谿（KI3）原絡相配。
BL58.qiNoteEn: Luo point of the Bladder, paired with Taixi (KI3) in the yuan-luo method.

BL60.functions: 舒筋活絡、清頭明目、安神、催產
BL60.functionsEn: Relaxes sinews and activates the channel, clears the head and brightens the eyes, settles the spirit, promotes labour
BL60.indications: 頭痛、項強、目眩、鼻衄、肩背痛、腰痛、足跟痛、踝痛、癲癇、難產
BL60.indicationsEn: Headache, stiff neck, dizziness, nosebleed, shoulder and back pain, lumbar pain, heel pain, ankle pain, epilepsy, difficult labour
BL60.cautionEn: Contraindicated in pregnancy (may induce uterine contraction)
BL60.qiNote: 崑崙上通頭項、下主足踝，太陽經氣所行。
BL60.qiNoteEn: Reaches the head above and the ankle below, following the course of taiyang qi.

categoryEn: Confluent point of the yang qiao vessel
BL62.functions: 安神、舒筋、清頭目、通陽蹻
BL62.functionsEn: Settles the spirit, relaxes the sinews, clears the head and eyes, regulates the yang qiao vessel
BL62.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、失眠、嗜睡、癲狂癇、腰腿痛、目赤痛
BL62.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, somnolence, mania and epilepsy, lumbar and leg pain, red painful eyes
BL62.qiNote: 「申脈陽蹻絡亦通」；瀉申脈、補照海治失眠（陽蹻盛則目不瞑）。
BL62.qiNoteEn: Confluent of the yang qiao; reduce BL62 and tonify KI6 for insomnia (excess yang qiao prevents the eyes closing).

BL63.functionsEn: Settles the spirit and calms fright, relaxes the sinews
BL63.indications: 癲癇、小兒驚風、腰痛、外踝痛、下肢痿痹
BL63.indicationsEn: Epilepsy, infantile convulsions, lumbar pain, lateral malleolus pain, lower-limb weakness
BL63.qiNote: 膀胱經郄穴，急性腰痛、驚癇取之。
BL63.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Bladder: for acute lumbar pain and convulsions.

BL64.functionsEn: Clears the head and brightens the eyes, settles the spirit, relaxes the sinews
BL64.indications: 頭痛、項強、目翳、癲癇、腰腿痛
BL64.indicationsEn: Headache, stiff neck, corneal opacity, epilepsy, lumbar and leg pain
BL64.qiNote: 膀胱經原穴，與大鐘（KI4）原絡配穴。
BL64.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Bladder, paired with Dazhong (KI4).

BL65.functionsEn: Activates the channel, clears the head and brightens the eyes
BL65.indications: 頭痛、項強、目眩、癲狂、腰腿痛
BL65.indicationsEn: Headache, stiff neck, dizziness, mania, lumbar and leg pain
BL65.qiNote: 「輸主體重節痛」，太陽經循行處疼痛取之。
BL65.qiNoteEn: Shu-stream point for pain along the taiyang pathway.

BL66.indications: 頭痛、項強、目眩、鼻衄、癲狂
BL66.indicationsEn: Headache, stiff neck, dizziness, nosebleed, mania
BL66.qiNote: 太陽經滎水穴，清太陽經熱。
BL66.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring Water point clearing taiyang heat.

BL67.functions: 矯正胎位、清頭明目、通竅
BL67.functionsEn: Corrects foetal position, clears the head and brightens the eyes, opens the orifices
BL67.indications: 胎位不正、難產、頭痛、目痛、鼻塞、鼻衄
BL67.indicationsEn: Breech presentation, difficult labour, headache, eye pain, nasal congestion, nosebleed
BL67.caution: 矯正胎位用艾灸（溫和灸）而非針刺，並須在產科監督下施行；孕期禁針
BL67.cautionEn: Breech correction uses gentle moxa, not needling, under obstetric supervision; needling contraindicated in pregnancy
BL67.qiNote: 灸至陰矯正胎位為針灸學經典應用（孕28–32週）。
BL67.qiNoteEn: Moxa on Zhiyin to turn a breech presentation (weeks 28-32) is a classic application.

KI1.functions: 開竅醒神、瀉熱降逆、滋陰
KI1.functionsEn: Opens the orifices and revives consciousness, drains heat and descends rebellion, nourishes yin
KI1.indications: 昏厥、癲狂、小兒驚風、頭痛眩暈、咽喉腫痛、失音、便秘、足心熱、高血壓
KI1.indicationsEn: Syncope, mania, infantile convulsions, headache and dizziness, sore throat, loss of voice, constipation, heat in the sole, hypertension
KI1.caution: 刺激強烈、疼痛明顯，體弱者慎；可用灸或敷貼
KI1.cautionEn: Strongly painful; caution in the frail; moxa or herbal plaster alternatives
KI1.qiNote: 湧泉引火下行，上實下虛之頭痛眩暈取之；急救醒神要穴。
KI1.qiNoteEn: Draws fire downward for headache and dizziness from upper excess with lower deficiency; key resuscitation point.

KI2.functionsEn: Nourishes yin and clears heat, regulates menstruation, benefits the throat
KI2.indications: 月經不調、陰癢、遺精、消渴、泄瀉、咽喉腫痛、足跗痛、小兒臍風
KI2.indicationsEn: Menstrual irregularity, genital itching, seminal emission, wasting-thirst, diarrhoea, sore throat, foot pain, neonatal tetanus
KI2.qiNote: 腎經滎火穴，瀉之清腎經虛火。
KI2.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring Fire point; reduce to clear deficiency fire of the Kidney channel.

KI3.functions: 滋陰益腎、壯陽、強腰、聰耳、納氣
KI3.functionsEn: Nourishes yin and tonifies the Kidney, strengthens yang and the lumbar region, benefits the ears, grasps qi
KI3.indications: 月經不調、遺精、陽痿、小便頻數、消渴、咳喘、咯血、耳鳴耳聾、齒痛、失眠、腰痛、足跟痛
KI3.indicationsEn: Menstrual irregularity, seminal emission, impotence, frequent urination, wasting-thirst, cough and wheezing, haemoptysis, tinnitus and deafness, toothache, insomnia, lumbar pain, heel pain
KI3.caution: 脛後動脈在穴之後方，避開
KI3.cautionEn: The posterior tibial artery lies behind: avoid it
KI3.qiNote: 腎經原穴，滋補腎陰之要穴；腎為先天之本，久病必取。
KI3.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Kidney and key point for nourishing Kidney yin; the Kidney is the prenatal root, essential in chronic disease.

KI4.functions: 益腎平喘、調理二便、安神強腰
KI4.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and calms wheezing, regulates urination and defaecation, settles the spirit, strengthens the lumbar region
KI4.indications: 咳血、氣喘、腰脊痛、足跟痛、痴呆、嗜臥、二便不利
KI4.indicationsEn: Haemoptysis, asthma, lumbar pain, heel pain, dementia, somnolence, difficult urination and defaecation
KI4.qiNote: 腎經絡穴別走膀胱，與京骨（BL64）原絡相配。
KI4.qiNoteEn: Luo point linking to the Bladder, paired with Jinggu (BL64).

KI5.functionsEn: Regulates menstruation and stops pain, promotes urination
KI5.indications: 月經不調、痛經、閉經、小便不利、陰挺
KI5.indicationsEn: Menstrual irregularity, dysmenorrhoea, amenorrhoea, dysuria, uterine prolapse
KI5.qiNote: 腎經郄穴，急性痛經、閉經取之。
KI5.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Kidney: for acute dysmenorrhoea and amenorrhoea.

categoryEn: Confluent point of the yin qiao vessel
KI6.functions: 滋陰清熱、利咽、安神、調經
KI6.functionsEn: Nourishes yin and clears heat, benefits the throat, settles the spirit, regulates menstruation
KI6.indications: 咽喉乾痛、失眠、癲癇夜發、月經不調、帶下、陰挺、小便頻數、便秘、目赤
KI6.indicationsEn: Dry sore throat, insomnia, nocturnal epilepsy, menstrual irregularity, leucorrhoea, uterine prolapse, frequent urination, constipation, red eyes
KI6.qiNote: 「列缺任脈行肺系，陰蹻照海膈喉嚨」：配列缺治咽喉；補照海瀉申脈治失眠。
KI6.qiNoteEn: Confluent of the yin qiao: with Lieque (LU7) for the throat; tonify KI6 and reduce BL62 for insomnia.

categoryEn: Mother point of the Kidney channel
KI7.functions: 補腎益陰、利水消腫、調汗
KI7.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and nourishes yin, promotes urination and reduces oedema, regulates sweating
KI7.indications: 水腫、腹脹、泄瀉、盜汗、無汗或汗出不止、腰脊痛、下肢痿痹
KI7.indicationsEn: Oedema, abdominal distension, diarrhoea, night sweats, absence of sweating or incessant sweating, lumbar pain, lower-limb weakness
KI7.qiNote: 「虛則補其母」：腎虛補復溜；合谷配復溜雙向調汗。
KI7.qiNoteEn: 'Tonify the mother' for Kidney deficiency; Hegu (LI4) + Fuliu regulate sweating in both directions.

KI10.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and regulates menstruation, promotes urination, clears heat
KI10.indications: 陽痿、疝痛、崩漏、小便不利、膝痛、癲狂
KI10.indicationsEn: Impotence, hernia pain, uterine bleeding, dysuria, knee pain, mania
KI10.qiNote: 腎經合水穴（本穴），膝內側痛兼腎虛者取之。
KI10.qiNoteEn: He-sea Water (horary) point; for medial knee pain with Kidney deficiency.

KI27.functionsEn: Stops cough and calms wheezing, harmonises the stomach and descends rebellion
KI27.indications: 咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、嘔吐、不嗜食
KI27.indicationsEn: Cough, asthma, chest pain, vomiting, poor appetite
KI27.caution: 胸區（鎖骨下），深刺可致氣胸
KI27.cautionEn: Thoracic zone (below the clavicle): pneumothorax risk
KI27.qiNote: 俞府為腎經終點，腎不納氣之喘可取。
KI27.qiNoteEn: Terminal point of the Kidney channel; for wheezing from the Kidney failing to grasp qi.

PC1.functionsEn: Expands the chest and regulates qi, dissipates nodules and reduces swelling
PC1.indications: 胸悶、脅肋痛、咳嗽、乳癰、乳汁少、腋腫
PC1.indicationsEn: Chest oppression, hypochondriac pain, cough, mastitis, insufficient lactation, axillary swelling
PC1.caution: 胸區（第4肋間），氣胸高風險，宜沿肋平刺淺刺
PC1.cautionEn: Thoracic zone (4th intercostal space): high pneumothorax risk; shallow transverse insertion along the rib
PC1.qiNote: 天池為心包經起點，乳房病局部穴。
PC1.qiNoteEn: Starting point of the Pericardium channel; local point for breast disorders.

PC3.functions: 清心除煩、和胃降逆、涼血、舒筋
PC3.functionsEn: Clears the heart and eliminates vexation, harmonises the stomach and descends rebellion, cools blood, relaxes the sinews
PC3.indications: 心痛、心悸、胃痛、嘔吐、熱病煩躁、肘臂痛、暑熱吐瀉（刺絡）
PC3.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, epigastric pain, vomiting, febrile agitation, elbow and arm pain, summer-heat vomiting and diarrhoea (bleeding)
PC3.caution: 肘窩內有肱動脈與正中神經，避開
PC3.cautionEn: Brachial artery and median nerve in the cubital fossa: avoid them
PC3.qiNote: 曲澤刺絡放血治急性吐瀉（霍亂）為經典急救法。
PC3.qiNoteEn: Bleeding Quze for acute vomiting and diarrhoea is a classic emergency method.

PC4.functions: 寧心安神、清營止血、理氣止痛
PC4.functionsEn: Calms the heart and settles the spirit, clears the nutritive level and stops bleeding, regulates qi and stops pain
PC4.indications: 心痛、心悸、心煩、胸痹、咯血嘔血、癲狂
PC4.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, vexation, chest bi, haemoptysis and haematemesis, mania
PC4.caution: 正中神經在兩筋之間深部
PC4.cautionEn: Median nerve lies deep between the tendons
PC4.qiNote: 心包經郄穴，急性心痛、心悸首選。
PC4.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Pericardium: first choice for acute cardiac pain and palpitations.

PC5.functions: 寧心安神、和胃化痰、截瘧
PC5.functionsEn: Calms the heart and settles the spirit, harmonises the stomach and resolves phlegm, checks malaria
PC5.indications: 心痛、心悸、胃痛、嘔吐、癲狂癇、瘧疾、熱病、失語
PC5.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, epigastric pain, vomiting, mania and epilepsy, malaria, febrile disease, aphasia
PC5.qiNote: 間使為截瘧、癲狂之經驗穴，配鳩尾治癇。
PC5.qiNoteEn: Empirical point for malaria and mania; with Jiuwei (CV15) for epilepsy.

categoryEn: Confluent point of the yin wei vessel
PC6.functions: 寧心安神、和胃降逆、寬胸理氣、鎮痛
PC6.functionsEn: Calms the heart and settles the spirit, harmonises the stomach and descends rebellion, expands the chest and regulates qi, relieves pain
PC6.indications: 心痛、心悸、胸悶、胃痛、嘔吐、呃逆、失眠、癲狂、暈車、眩暈、肘臂痛
PC6.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, chest oppression, epigastric pain, vomiting, hiccup, insomnia, mania, motion sickness, dizziness, elbow and arm pain
PC6.caution: 兩筋間深部為正中神經，得氣（麻電感）後勿再深刺或強捻以免神經損傷
PC6.cautionEn: Median nerve lies deep between the tendons: after deqi (tingling) do not deepen or rotate forcefully
PC6.qiNote: 「內關胃心胸」：配公孫（SP4）治心、胸、胃之疾，止嘔第一要穴。
PC6.qiNoteEn: 'Neiguan for stomach, heart and chest': with Gongsun (SP4) for the heart, chest and stomach; the foremost anti-emetic point.

PC7.functions: 寧心安神、和胃寬胸、清熱
PC7.functionsEn: Calms the heart and settles the spirit, harmonises the stomach and expands the chest, clears heat
PC7.indications: 心痛、心悸、胃痛、嘔吐、癲狂、口臭、腕痛、腕隧道症候群
PC7.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, epigastric pain, vomiting, mania, halitosis, wrist pain, carpal tunnel syndrome
PC7.caution: 正中神經在腕管內，不宜深刺或強刺激
PC7.cautionEn: Median nerve lies in the carpal tunnel: avoid deep or strong stimulation
PC7.qiNote: 心包經原穴，實證瀉之清心包之火；腕隧道局部要穴。
PC7.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Pericardium; reduce for excess fire; key local point for carpal tunnel.

PC8.functions: 清心瀉熱、開竅醒神、涼血
PC8.functionsEn: Clears Heart heat, opens the orifices and revives consciousness, cools blood
PC8.indications: 中風昏迷、中暑、心痛、癲狂癇、口瘡、口臭、鵝掌風、掌中熱
PC8.indicationsEn: Coma from wind-stroke, heat stroke, cardiac pain, mania and epilepsy, mouth ulcers, halitosis, palmar eczema, heat in the palm
PC8.cautionEn: Centre of the palm; fairly painful
PC8.qiNote: 勞宮與湧泉相配，上下清心腎之火、醒神開竅。
PC8.qiNoteEn: With Yongquan (KI1) clears Heart and Kidney fire and revives consciousness.

PC9.functionsEn: Opens the orifices and revives consciousness, clears Heart heat
PC9.indications: 昏迷、中暑、熱病、小兒驚風、舌強腫痛、心痛
PC9.indicationsEn: Coma, heat stroke, febrile disease, infantile convulsions, stiff swollen tongue, cardiac pain
PC9.qiNote: 中衝為急救醒神之井穴，配水溝、十宣。
PC9.qiNoteEn: Jing-well point for resuscitation, with Shuigou (GV26) and Shixuan (EX-UE11).

TE1.functionsEn: Clears heat and benefits the throat and tongue, benefits the ears, opens the orifices
TE1.indications: 頭痛、目赤、耳聾耳鳴、咽喉腫痛、舌強、熱病、昏厥
TE1.indicationsEn: Headache, red eyes, deafness and tinnitus, sore throat, stiff tongue, febrile disease, syncope
TE1.qiNote: 三焦經井穴，少陽鬱熱之耳病、咽痛放血。
TE1.qiNoteEn: Jing-well of the Triple Energizer: bleed for shaoyang heat in ear and throat disorders.

TE2.functionsEn: Clears heat, benefits the ears and throat
TE2.indications: 頭痛、目赤、耳鳴耳聾、咽喉痛、瘧疾、手臂痛、手指麻木
TE2.indicationsEn: Headache, red eyes, tinnitus and deafness, sore throat, malaria, arm pain, numb fingers
TE2.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring Water point clearing shaoyang heat.

TE3.functionsEn: Clears heat and benefits the ears, activates the channel and stops pain
TE3.indications: 頭痛、目赤、耳鳴耳聾、咽喉痛、肩背肘臂痛、手指不能屈伸、落枕
TE3.indicationsEn: Headache, red eyes, tinnitus and deafness, sore throat, shoulder and arm pain, inability to flex the fingers, stiff neck
TE3.qiNote: 中渚為耳鳴耳聾遠端要穴（少陽經入耳中）。
TE3.qiNoteEn: Key distal point for tinnitus and deafness (shaoyang enters the ear).

TE4.functionsEn: Clears heat and activates the channel, nourishes yin and generates fluids
TE4.indications: 腕痛、肩臂痛、瘧疾、耳聾、消渴、口乾
TE4.indicationsEn: Wrist pain, shoulder and arm pain, malaria, deafness, wasting-thirst, dry mouth
TE4.qiNote: 三焦經原穴，與內關（PC6）原絡相配；腕背局部要穴。
TE4.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Triple Energizer, paired with Neiguan (PC6); key local point for the dorsal wrist.

categoryEn: Confluent point of the yang wei vessel
TE5.functions: 解表清熱、聰耳明目、通經活絡
TE5.functionsEn: Releases the exterior and clears heat, benefits the ears and eyes, activates the channel
TE5.indications: 熱病、感冒、頭痛、頰痛、目赤、耳鳴耳聾、脅肋痛、肩背肘臂痛、手顫、落枕
TE5.indicationsEn: Febrile disease, common cold, headache, cheek pain, red eyes, tinnitus and deafness, hypochondriac pain, shoulder and arm pain, hand tremor, stiff neck
TE5.qiNote: 「外關陽維目銳眥」：配足臨泣（GB41）治少陽頭痛、耳目、脅肋病。
TE5.qiNoteEn: 'Waiguan with the yang wei for the outer canthus': with Zulinqi (GB41) for shaoyang headache, ear, eye and flank disorders.

TE6.functions: 清熱通便、理氣、疏利脅肋
