TE6.functionsEn: Clears heat and relieves constipation, regulates qi, benefits the hypochondrium
TE6.indications: 便秘、脅肋痛、耳鳴耳聾、暴喑、熱病、肩背痠痛、帶狀疱疹
TE6.indicationsEn: Constipation, hypochondriac pain, tinnitus and deafness, sudden loss of voice, febrile disease, aching shoulder and back, herpes zoster
TE6.qiNote: 支溝為治便秘（氣秘、熱秘）之經驗要穴，通調三焦氣機。
TE6.qiNoteEn: Empirical key point for constipation (qi or heat type), regulating the qi of the three jiao.

TE7.functionsEn: Clears heat and benefits the ears, settles the spirit
TE7.qiNote: 三焦經郄穴，突發耳聾取之。
TE7.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Triple Energizer: for sudden deafness.

TE10.functionsEn: Clears heat and resolves phlegm, dissipates nodules, activates the channel
TE10.indications: 偏頭痛、脅肋痛、瘰癧、癭氣、癲癇、肘臂痛
TE10.indicationsEn: Temporal headache, hypochondriac pain, scrofula, goitre, epilepsy, elbow and arm pain
TE10.cautionEn: Above the olecranon; no special risk
TE10.qiNote: 三焦經合穴，痰核瘰癧（少陽痰火）要穴。
TE10.qiNoteEn: He-sea of the Triple Energizer: for phlegm nodules and scrofula.

TE14.functionsEn: Activates the channel, dispels wind and benefits the joint
TE14.indications: 肩臂痛、臂不能舉、肩關節活動不利
TE14.indicationsEn: Shoulder and arm pain, inability to raise the arm, restricted shoulder movement
TE14.qiNote: 「肩三針」之一（少陽經），肩外側痛要穴。
TE14.qiNoteEn: One of the 'three shoulder needles' (shaoyang); for lateral shoulder pain.

categoryEn: Meeting of hand and foot shaoyang
TE17.functions: 聰耳開竅、祛風通絡、止呃
TE17.functionsEn: Benefits the ears and opens the orifices, dispels wind and activates the channel, stops hiccup
TE17.indications: 耳鳴、耳聾、口喎、牙關緊閉、頰腫、瘰癧、呃逆、面痛
TE17.indicationsEn: Tinnitus, deafness, facial paralysis, trismus, swollen cheek, scrofula, hiccup, facial pain
TE17.caution: 耳後凹陷，深部有面神經幹與頸外動脈，得氣即止
TE17.cautionEn: Depression behind the ear: facial nerve trunk and external carotid lie deep; stop at deqi
TE17.qiNote: 翳風為面癱、耳病雙用要穴（面神經出莖乳孔處）。
TE17.qiNoteEn: Key point for both facial paralysis and ear disorders (facial nerve exit at the stylomastoid foramen).

TE23.functionsEn: Clears the head and brightens the eyes, dispels wind and stops pain
TE23.indications: 頭痛、偏頭痛、目眩、目赤痛、眼瞼瞤動、齒痛、癲狂
TE23.indicationsEn: Headache, migraine, dizziness, red painful eyes, eyelid twitching, toothache, mania
TE23.cautionEn: At the eyebrow tail; transverse insertion
TE23.qiNote: 「絲竹空透率谷」為偏頭痛經典透刺。
TE23.qiNoteEn: Sizhukong-through-Shuaigu (GB8) is the classic through-needling for migraine.

category: 手太陽、手足少陽交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of hand-taiyang and hand & foot shaoyang
GB1.functionsEn: Dispels wind and clears heat, brightens the eyes and stops pain
GB1.indications: 頭痛、目赤腫痛、目翳、青盲、羞明流淚、口喎
GB1.indicationsEn: Headache, red swollen eyes, corneal opacity, optic atrophy, photophobia and lacrimation, facial paralysis
GB1.caution: 眶外緣，向後平刺，勿刺入眶內
GB1.cautionEn: Lateral orbital margin: transverse insertion backward, never into the orbit
GB1.qiNote: 膽經起點，目外眥病與少陽頭痛取之。
GB1.qiNoteEn: Starting point of the Gallbladder channel; for outer-canthus and shaoyang disorders.

GB2.functionsEn: Benefits the ears and opens the orifices, dispels wind and activates the channel
GB2.indications: 耳鳴、耳聾、聤耳、齒痛、口喎、下頜關節痛
GB2.indicationsEn: Tinnitus, deafness, otitis, toothache, facial paralysis, TMJ pain
GB2.qiNote: 「耳三針」之一，少陽經「從耳後入耳中」。
GB2.qiNoteEn: One of the three ear points; shaoyang 'enters the ear from behind'.

GB8.functionsEn: Dispels wind and stops pain, pacifies the Liver and stops vomiting
GB8.indications: 偏頭痛、眩暈、嘔吐、小兒驚風、酒醉
GB8.indicationsEn: Migraine, dizziness, vomiting, infantile convulsions, intoxication
GB8.qiNote: 率谷為少陽偏頭痛局部首選穴。
GB8.qiNoteEn: First-choice local point for shaoyang migraine.

categoryEn: Meeting of foot-shaoyang and yang wei
GB13.functionsEn: Settles the spirit and will, extinguishes wind
GB13.indications: 頭痛、目眩、癲癇、中風、小兒驚風、失眠
GB13.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, epilepsy, wind-stroke, infantile convulsions, insomnia
GB13.qiNote: 「本神」主神志，帕金森、癲癇頭針常用。
GB13.qiNoteEn: 'Root of the spirit': commonly used for Parkinson's and epilepsy.

categoryEn: Meeting of foot-shaoyang and yang wei
GB14.functionsEn: Dispels wind and brightens the eyes, activates the channel and stops pain
GB14.indications: 前額痛、眼瞼下垂、眼瞼瞤動、口喎、目痛、視物模糊
GB14.indicationsEn: Frontal headache, ptosis, eyelid twitching, facial paralysis, eye pain, blurred vision
GB14.qiNote: 陽白為面癱抬眉不能之局部要穴。
GB14.qiNoteEn: Key local point for inability to raise the eyebrow in facial paralysis.

categoryEn: Meeting of foot-shaoyang and yang wei
GB20.functions: 疏風解表、清頭明目、聰耳、平肝息風
GB20.functionsEn: Dispels wind and releases the exterior, clears the head and brightens the eyes, benefits the ears, pacifies the Liver and extinguishes wind
GB20.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、項強、目赤痛、鼻塞、耳鳴、感冒、中風、癲癇、熱病、高血壓、失眠
GB20.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, stiff neck, red painful eyes, nasal congestion, tinnitus, common cold, wind-stroke, epilepsy, febrile disease, hypertension, insomnia
GB20.caution: 枕下區：針尖朝鼻尖或對側眼方向，不可向內上方深刺，以免傷及延髓
GB20.cautionEn: Suboccipital zone: direct the tip toward the nose tip or opposite eye, never deep inward-upward toward the medulla
GB20.qiNote: 風池為內外風要穴：外風（感冒）、內風（眩暈、中風）皆取。
GB20.qiNoteEn: Key point for both external wind (colds) and internal wind (dizziness, stroke).

categoryEn: Meeting of hand & foot shaoyang and yang wei
GB21.functions: 通經活絡、降氣、催產、散結
GB21.functionsEn: Activates the channel, descends qi, promotes labour, dissipates nodules
GB21.indications: 頸項強痛、肩背痛、上肢不舉、乳癰、乳少、難產、瘰癧
GB21.indicationsEn: Stiff painful neck, shoulder and back pain, inability to raise the arm, mastitis, insufficient lactation, difficult labour, scrofula
GB21.caution: 孕婦禁針；下方為肺尖，深刺可致氣胸，宜淺刺或拿法
GB21.cautionEn: Contraindicated in pregnancy; lung apex lies below: deep insertion causes pneumothorax, needle shallow or use grasping massage
GB21.qiNote: 肩井為「氣機下行」之穴，肩頸僵硬要穴，惟深刺之險須牢記。
GB21.qiNoteEn: Point that descends qi; key for neck-shoulder stiffness, but the depth hazard must be remembered.

GB24.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and benefits the Gallbladder, descends rebellion and stops vomiting
GB24.indications: 脅肋痛、黃疸、嘔吐、吞酸、呃逆、膽絞痛
GB24.indicationsEn: Hypochondriac pain, jaundice, vomiting, acid regurgitation, hiccup, biliary colic
GB24.caution: 胸區（第7肋間），深刺可致氣胸或傷肝，宜沿肋斜刺
GB24.cautionEn: Thoracic zone (7th intercostal space): deep insertion risks pneumothorax or liver injury; oblique along the rib
GB24.qiNote: 膽之募穴，配膽俞（BL19）俞募治膽病。
GB24.qiNoteEn: Front-mu of the Gallbladder, paired with Danshu (BL19).

GB25.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and promotes urination, strengthens the lumbar region, regulates the intestines
GB25.indications: 腰痛、脅痛、腹脹、泄瀉、小便不利、水腫
GB25.indicationsEn: Lumbar pain, flank pain, abdominal distension, diarrhoea, dysuria, oedema
GB25.caution: 第12肋游離端下，深刺可傷腎
GB25.cautionEn: Below the free end of the 12th rib: deep insertion may injure the kidney
GB25.qiNoteEn: Front-mu of the Kidney, paired with Shenshu (BL23).

categoryEn: Meeting of foot-shaoyang and the Dai vessel
GB26.functionsEn: Regulates menstruation and leucorrhoea, benefits the lumbar region, regulates qi
GB26.indications: 月經不調、帶下、疝氣、腰脅痛、閉經
GB26.indicationsEn: Menstrual irregularity, leucorrhoea, hernia, lumbar and flank pain, amenorrhoea
GB26.cautionEn: Lateral abdomen: deep insertion may injure the bowel
GB26.qiNote: 帶脈穴主帶下與帶脈病，配足臨泣（八脈交會）。
GB26.qiNoteEn: Dai vessel point for leucorrhoea; with Zulinqi (GB41), its confluent point.

GB30.functions: 祛風濕、利腰腿、通經活絡
GB30.functionsEn: Dispels wind-damp, benefits the lumbar region and legs, activates the channel
GB30.indications: 腰腿痛、下肢痿痹、半身不遂、坐骨神經痛、髖關節痛
GB30.indicationsEn: Lumbar and leg pain, lower-limb weakness, hemiplegia, sciatica, hip pain
GB30.caution: 深部為坐骨神經，得氣放射至足即止，勿反覆捅刺
GB30.cautionEn: Sciatic nerve lies deep: stop when sensation propagates to the foot; never repeatedly jab
GB30.qiNote: 環跳為下肢痿痹、坐骨神經痛第一要穴。
GB30.qiNoteEn: The foremost point for lower-limb paralysis and sciatica.

GB31.functionsEn: Dispels wind, activates the channel, stops itching
GB31.indications: 下肢痿痹、半身不遂、遍身瘙癢、蕁麻疹、股外側痛
GB31.indicationsEn: Lower-limb weakness, hemiplegia, generalised itching, urticaria, lateral thigh pain
GB31.qiNote: 「風市」為風邪聚散之市，皮膚瘙癢與下肢風痹取之。
GB31.qiNoteEn: 'Wind market' - for itching skin and wind bi of the leg.

GB33.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews and benefits the joint, dispels wind-damp
GB33.indications: 膝腫痛、膕筋攣急、小腿麻木、膝外側痛
GB33.indicationsEn: Knee swelling and pain, popliteal tightness, numb calf, lateral knee pain
GB33.qiNote: 膝陽關為膝外側局部穴，配陽陵泉。
GB33.qiNoteEn: Local point for the lateral knee; with Yanglingquan (GB34).

GB34.functions: 舒筋活絡、疏肝利膽、清熱化濕、止痛
GB34.functionsEn: Relaxes sinews and activates the channel, spreads the Liver and benefits the Gallbladder, clears damp-heat, stops pain
GB34.indications: 脅痛、口苦、黃疸、嘔吐、膝腫痛、下肢痿痹、半身不遂、肩痛、筋病、小兒驚風、帶狀疱疹
GB34.indicationsEn: Hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, jaundice, vomiting, knee pain, lower-limb weakness, hemiplegia, shoulder pain, sinew disorders, infantile convulsions, herpes zoster
GB34.caution: 腓骨小頭前下方，腓總神經在其後方，避免向後深刺
GB34.cautionEn: Antero-inferior to the fibular head; the common peroneal nerve lies behind: avoid deep posterior insertion
GB34.qiNote: 「筋會陽陵」：一切筋病（拘攣、痿痹）皆取；膽腑病下合穴。
GB34.qiNoteEn: Hui-meeting of the sinews: for all sinew disorders (spasm, weakness); lower he-sea for Gallbladder fu disorders.

GB36.functionsEn: Clears heat and toxins, relaxes the sinews
GB36.indications: 頸項強痛、胸脅痛、下肢痿痹、癲狂、犬咬傷（古法）
GB36.indicationsEn: Stiff painful neck, chest and flank pain, lower-limb weakness, mania, rabid dog bite (classical)
GB36.qiNote: 膽經郄穴，急性少陽脅痛取之。
GB36.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Gallbladder: for acute shaoyang flank pain.

GB37.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and brightens the eyes, activates the channel
GB37.indications: 目痛、夜盲、目翳、乳房脹痛、膝痛、下肢痿痹
GB37.indicationsEn: Eye pain, night blindness, corneal opacity, breast distension, knee pain, lower-limb weakness
GB37.qiNote: 「光明」為眼病遠端要穴，膽經絡穴別走肝經（肝開竅於目）。
GB37.qiNoteEn: 'Bright light': key distal point for eye disorders; the luo point links to the Liver, which opens into the eyes.

GB38.functionsEn: Clears heat and dispels wind, relaxes the sinews
GB38.indications: 偏頭痛、目外眥痛、腋下痛、瘰癧、脅痛、下肢外側痛、口苦
GB38.indicationsEn: Temporal headache, outer-canthus pain, axillary pain, scrofula, flank pain, lateral leg pain, bitter taste
GB38.qiNote: 膽經子穴，「實則瀉其子」：膽火偏頭痛瀉陽輔。
GB38.qiNoteEn: Child point of the Gallbladder: 'in excess, drain the child' - reduce Yangfu for Gallbladder-fire migraine.

GB39.functions: 補髓強筋骨、祛風清熱、通絡
GB39.functionsEn: Tonifies marrow and strengthens bones and sinews, dispels wind and clears heat, activates the channel
GB39.indications: 項強、落枕、偏頭痛、半身不遂、下肢痿痹、腋下腫、咽喉痛、痔疾
GB39.indicationsEn: Stiff neck, torticollis, migraine, hemiplegia, lower-limb weakness, axillary swelling, sore throat, haemorrhoids
GB39.qiNote: 「髓會絕骨」：骨髓病、頸椎病、落枕要穴，配大杼（骨會）。
GB39.qiNoteEn: Hui-meeting of marrow: for marrow and bone disorders, cervical spondylosis and stiff neck; with Dazhu (BL11).

GB40.functions: 疏肝利膽、通經活絡、清熱
GB40.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and benefits the Gallbladder, activates the channel, clears heat
GB40.indications: 胸脅痛、外踝腫痛、踝扭傷、下肢痿痹、瘧疾、目赤、頸項痛
GB40.indicationsEn: Chest and flank pain, lateral malleolus swelling, ankle sprain, lower-limb weakness, malaria, red eyes, neck pain
GB40.qiNote: 膽經原穴，外踝扭傷局部要穴；與蠡溝（LR5）原絡相配。
GB40.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Gallbladder; key local point for lateral ankle sprain; paired with Ligou (LR5).

categoryEn: Confluent point of the Dai vessel
GB41.functions: 疏肝利膽、清頭目、調帶脈、通乳
GB41.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and benefits the Gallbladder, clears the head and eyes, regulates the Dai vessel, promotes lactation
GB41.indications: 偏頭痛、目赤腫痛、脅痛、乳癰、乳房脹痛、月經不調、帶下、足跗腫痛
GB41.indicationsEn: Migraine, red swollen eyes, flank pain, mastitis, breast distension, menstrual irregularity, leucorrhoea, swelling of the dorsum of the foot
GB41.qiNote: 「臨泣膽經連帶脈」：配外關（TE5）治少陽頭痛、耳目、脅肋病。
GB41.qiNoteEn: 'Linqi with the Dai vessel': with Waiguan (TE5) for shaoyang headache, ear, eye and flank disorders.

GB43.functionsEn: Clears heat, benefits the ears and eyes, spreads the Liver
GB43.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、目赤、耳鳴耳聾、脅痛、熱病、乳癰、足趾腫痛
GB43.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, red eyes, tinnitus and deafness, flank pain, febrile disease, mastitis, toe swelling
GB43.qiNote: 膽經滎水穴，清肝膽火上擾耳目之要穴。
GB43.qiNoteEn: Ying-spring Water point clearing Liver-Gallbladder fire rising to the ears and eyes.

GB44.functionsEn: Clears heat, benefits the ears and eyes, settles the spirit
GB44.indications: 偏頭痛、目赤痛、耳鳴耳聾、脅痛、失眠、多夢、熱病
GB44.indicationsEn: Migraine, red painful eyes, tinnitus and deafness, flank pain, insomnia, dream-disturbed sleep, febrile disease
GB44.qiNote: 膽經井穴，少陽鬱熱失眠多夢取之。
GB44.qiNoteEn: Jing-well of the Gallbladder: for insomnia and dreams from shaoyang constrained heat.

LR1.functions: 疏肝理氣、止血、開竅、調經
LR1.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and regulates qi, stops bleeding, opens the orifices, regulates menstruation
LR1.indications: 疝氣、遺尿、癃閉、崩漏、月經不調、陰挺、癲癇、昏厥
LR1.indicationsEn: Hernia, enuresis, urinary retention, uterine bleeding, menstrual irregularity, uterine prolapse, epilepsy, syncope
LR1.cautionEn: Often moxa or pricking under asepsis
LR1.qiNote: 「大敦治疝」：肝經環陰器，疝氣與前陰病取之；灸大敦治崩漏。
LR1.qiNoteEn: 'Dadun for hernia': the Liver channel circles the genitals; moxa for uterine bleeding.

LR2.functions: 清肝瀉火、息風、調經、清熱
LR2.functionsEn: Clears Liver fire, extinguishes wind, regulates menstruation, clears heat
LR2.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、目赤腫痛、口喎、脅痛、月經不調、崩漏、遺尿、癲癇、失眠、易怒
LR2.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, red swollen eyes, facial paralysis, flank pain, menstrual irregularity, uterine bleeding, enuresis, epilepsy, insomnia, irritability
LR2.qiNote: 肝經子穴，「實則瀉其子」：肝火上炎瀉行間。
LR2.qiNoteEn: Child point of the Liver: 'in excess, drain the child' - reduce Xingjian for Liver fire flaring.

LR3.functions: 平肝息風、疏肝理氣、清熱、調經、通絡
LR3.functionsEn: Pacifies the Liver and extinguishes wind, spreads the Liver and regulates qi, clears heat, regulates menstruation, activates the channel
LR3.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、目赤痛、口喎、脅痛、月經不調、痛經、崩漏、疝氣、遺尿、癲癇、小兒驚風、下肢痿痹、高血壓、鬱證
LR3.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, red painful eyes, facial paralysis, flank pain, menstrual irregularity, dysmenorrhoea, uterine bleeding, hernia, enuresis, epilepsy, infantile convulsions, lower-limb weakness, hypertension, depression
LR3.caution: 足背動脈分支處，避開血管
LR3.cautionEn: Branches of the dorsalis pedis artery: avoid vessels
LR3.qiNote: 肝經原穴，「四關」之一；平肝、疏肝、息風三用，情志病要穴。
LR3.qiNoteEn: Yuan-source of the Liver and one of the Four Gates: pacifies, spreads and calms Liver wind; key emotional point.

LR4.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and regulates qi, activates the channel, clears heat
LR4.indications: 疝氣、遺精、小便不利、腰痛、內踝痛、脅痛
LR4.indicationsEn: Hernia, seminal emission, dysuria, lumbar pain, medial ankle pain, flank pain
LR4.caution: 踝前內側，避開脛前血管
LR4.qiNote: 肝經經金穴，內踝前方局部穴。
LR4.qiNoteEn: Jing-river Metal point; local point in front of the medial malleolus.

LR5.functions: 疏肝理氣、調經止帶、止癢
LR5.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and regulates qi, regulates menstruation and leucorrhoea, stops itching
LR5.indications: 月經不調、帶下、陰癢、疝氣、小便不利、足脛痛、鬱證
LR5.indicationsEn: Menstrual irregularity, leucorrhoea, genital itching, hernia, dysuria, leg pain, depression
LR5.qiNote: 肝經絡穴別走膽經，主前陰病；與丘墟（GB40）原絡相配。
LR5.qiNoteEn: Luo point linking to the Gallbladder, for genital disorders; paired with Qiuxu (GB40).

LR6.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and regulates qi, regulates menstruation and stops bleeding
LR6.indications: 疝氣、崩漏、惡露不盡、泄瀉、脛痛、急性脅痛
LR6.indicationsEn: Hernia, uterine bleeding, persistent lochia, diarrhoea, leg pain, acute flank pain
LR6.qiNote: 肝經郄穴，急性血證（崩漏）與急性脅痛。
LR6.qiNoteEn: Xi-cleft of the Liver: for acute bleeding (uterine) and acute flank pain.

LR8.functions: 滋陰清熱、疏肝、利濕、通絡
LR8.functionsEn: Nourishes yin and clears heat, spreads the Liver, resolves damp, activates the channel
LR8.indications: 月經不調、痛經、帶下、陰癢、小便不利、膝內側痛、遺精、陽痿
LR8.indicationsEn: Menstrual irregularity, dysmenorrhoea, leucorrhoea, genital itching, dysuria, medial knee pain, seminal emission, impotence
LR8.qiNote: 肝經母穴（合水），肝血虛補曲泉；膝內側痛局部穴。
LR8.qiNoteEn: Mother point of the Liver (He-sea Water): tonify for Liver blood deficiency; local for medial knee pain.

LR13.functions: 疏肝健脾、理氣消積、化瘀
LR13.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and fortifies the Spleen, regulates qi and disperses accumulation, dispels stasis
LR13.indications: 腹脹、泄瀉、脅痛、痞塊、嘔吐、消化不良
LR13.indicationsEn: Abdominal distension, diarrhoea, flank pain, abdominal masses, vomiting, dyspepsia
LR13.caution: 第11肋游離端，深刺可傷肝（右）或脾（左）
LR13.cautionEn: Free end of the 11th rib: deep insertion may injure the liver (right) or spleen (left)
LR13.qiNote: 「臟會章門」，脾之募穴：五臟病與肝脾不和取之。
LR13.qiNoteEn: Hui-meeting of the zang and front-mu of the Spleen: for zang disorders and Liver-Spleen disharmony.

category: 足厥陰、足太陰、陰維交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of foot-jueyin, foot-taiyin and yin wei
LR14.functions: 疏肝理氣、活血化瘀、健脾和胃
LR14.functionsEn: Spreads the Liver and regulates qi, invigorates blood and dispels stasis, fortifies the Spleen and harmonises the stomach
LR14.indications: 胸脅脹痛、嘔吐、吞酸、腹脹、乳癰、呃逆、鬱證
LR14.indicationsEn: Chest and hypochondriac distension, vomiting, acid regurgitation, abdominal distension, mastitis, hiccup, depression
LR14.caution: 胸區（第6肋間），深刺可致氣胸或傷肝，宜沿肋斜刺
LR14.cautionEn: Thoracic zone (6th intercostal space): deep insertion risks pneumothorax or liver injury; oblique along the rib
LR14.qiNote: 肝之募穴，配肝俞（BL18）俞募，疏肝理氣要穴。
LR14.qiNoteEn: Front-mu of the Liver, paired with Ganshu (BL18); key point for spreading Liver qi.

category: 督脈、足少陰、足少陽交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of the Governor vessel, foot-shaoyin and foot-shaoyang
GV1.functions: 調理腸腑、安神鎮痙、通督
GV1.functionsEn: Regulates the bowel, settles the spirit and stops convulsions, regulates the Governor vessel
GV1.indications: 痔疾、脫肛、便血、泄瀉、便秘、癲狂癇、腰脊尾骶痛
GV1.indicationsEn: Haemorrhoids, rectal prolapse, bloody stool, diarrhoea, constipation, mania and epilepsy, lumbosacral and coccygeal pain
GV1.caution: 緊貼尾骨前緣斜刺，避免刺入直腸
GV1.cautionEn: Oblique insertion hugging the anterior coccyx; avoid penetrating the rectum
GV1.qiNote: 督脈絡穴，別走任脈；痔瘡、脫肛要穴。
GV1.qiNoteEn: Luo point of the Governor vessel linking to the Conception vessel; key for haemorrhoids and prolapse.

GV3.functionsEn: Strengthens the lumbar region and tonifies the Kidney, dispels cold-damp
GV3.indications: 腰骶痛、下肢痿痹、月經不調、遺精、陽痿、寒濕腰痛
GV3.indicationsEn: Lumbosacral pain, lower-limb weakness, menstrual irregularity, seminal emission, impotence, cold-damp lumbar pain
GV3.caution: L4棘突下，深刺可入椎管（馬尾）；孕婦慎
GV3.cautionEn: Below L4 spinous process: deep insertion may enter the spinal canal (cauda equina); caution in pregnancy
GV3.qiNote: 腰陽關為「陽氣通關」之處，寒濕腰痛灸之。
GV3.qiNoteEn: 'Lumbar yang gate': moxa for cold-damp lumbar pain.

GV4.functions: 補腎壯陽、強腰固精、溫陽
GV4.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and strengthens yang, strengthens the lumbar region and secures essence, warms yang
GV4.indications: 腰脊強痛、陽痿、遺精、帶下、月經不調、泄瀉（五更）、小便頻數、虛寒諸證
GV4.indicationsEn: Stiff painful lumbar spine, impotence, seminal emission, leucorrhoea, menstrual irregularity, dawn diarrhoea, frequent urination, cold-deficiency patterns
GV4.caution: L2棘突下，深刺可傷脊髓圓錐
GV4.cautionEn: Below L2 spinous process: deep insertion may injure the conus medullaris
GV4.qiNote: 「命門之火」：腎陽虛諸證灸命門，配關元前後相應。
GV4.qiNoteEn: 'Fire of the gate of life': moxa for Kidney-yang deficiency, with Guanyuan (CV4) front and back.

GV12.functionsEn: Diffuses the Lung and clears heat, settles the spirit, strengthens the spine
GV12.indications: 咳嗽、氣喘、癲癇、脊背強痛、疔瘡、小兒疳積
GV12.indicationsEn: Cough, asthma, epilepsy, stiff painful spine, boils, infantile malnutrition
GV12.cautionEn: Below T3 spinous process: deep insertion may enter the spinal canal
GV12.qiNote: 身柱為小兒保健灸穴，又為癲癇、咳喘要穴。
GV12.qiNoteEn: Paediatric health-preserving moxa point; also for epilepsy and cough.

categoryEn: Meeting of all yang channels with the Governor vessel
GV14.functions: 清熱解表、截瘧、寧神、通陽、益氣
GV14.functionsEn: Clears heat and releases the exterior, checks malaria, settles the spirit, unblocks yang, boosts qi
GV14.indications: 熱病、瘧疾、感冒、咳嗽、氣喘、項強、癲癇、骨蒸、蕁麻疹、虛勞
GV14.indicationsEn: Febrile disease, malaria, common cold, cough, asthma, stiff neck, epilepsy, steaming-bone fever, urticaria, debility
GV14.caution: C7棘突下，不可向上深刺（脊髓）；宜微斜向下
GV14.cautionEn: Below C7 spinous process: never deep upward (spinal cord); slight downward angle
GV14.qiNote: 「諸陽之會」：清熱首選，退熱刺絡拔罐；灸之又能補陽。
GV14.qiNoteEn: Meeting of all yang: first choice for clearing heat (bleeding and cupping); moxa tonifies yang.

categoryEn: Meeting of the Governor vessel and yang wei
GV16.functionsEn: Dispels wind, revives the spirit, benefits the throat, extinguishes wind
GV16.indications: 頭痛、項強、眩暈、中風、癲狂、咽喉痛、失音、舌緩不語
GV16.indicationsEn: Headache, stiff neck, dizziness, wind-stroke, mania, sore throat, loss of voice, flaccid tongue with aphasia
GV16.caution: 枕下正中：針尖向下頜方向緩慢進針，不可向上深刺（延髓）；禁灸
GV16.cautionEn: Midline suboccipital: advance slowly toward the mandible, never deep upward (medulla); moxa contraindicated
GV16.qiNote: 「風府」為風邪入腦之門戶，內外風皆治，惟刺法須謹。
GV16.qiNoteEn: 'Palace of wind': gateway of wind into the brain, treats internal and external wind, but needling demands care.

category: 督脈、足太陽交會穴（三陽五會）
categoryEn: Meeting of the Governor vessel and foot-taiyang (all yang)
GV20.functions: 升陽舉陷、醒腦開竅、安神、平肝息風
GV20.functionsEn: Raises yang and lifts prolapse, awakens the brain and opens the orifices, settles the spirit, pacifies the Liver and extinguishes wind
GV20.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、中風、失語、癲狂、失眠、健忘、脫肛、陰挺、泄瀉（久）、暈厥
GV20.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, wind-stroke, aphasia, mania, insomnia, poor memory, rectal prolapse, uterine prolapse, chronic diarrhoea, syncope
GV20.caution: 嬰幼兒囟門未閉禁針；頭皮平刺
GV20.cautionEn: Contraindicated in infants with an open fontanelle; transverse scalp insertion
GV20.qiNote: 「百會」諸陽之會：升提（灸）與鎮降（針）兩用，神志要穴。
GV20.qiNoteEn: Meeting of all yang: lifts (moxa) and calms (needle); key point for the spirit.

GV23.functionsEn: Clears the head and brightens the eyes, opens the nose
GV23.indications: 頭痛、目痛、鼻衄、鼻淵、鼻塞、癲狂
GV23.indicationsEn: Headache, eye pain, nosebleed, sinusitis, nasal congestion, mania
GV23.cautionEn: Contraindicated in infants with an open fontanelle
GV23.qiNoteEn: Key scalp point for nasal disorders.

category: 督脈、足太陽、足陽明交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of the Governor vessel, foot-taiyang and foot-yangming
GV24.functionsEn: Settles the spirit, clears the head and brightens the eyes, opens the nose
GV24.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、失眠、癲狂癇、鼻淵、驚悸
GV24.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, mania and epilepsy, sinusitis, fright palpitations
GV24.cautionEn: Caution near the fontanelle in infants
GV24.qiNote: 「神庭」主神志，失眠、焦慮頭針常用。
GV24.qiNoteEn: 'Court of the spirit': commonly used for insomnia and anxiety.

categoryEn: Meeting of the Governor vessel with hand & foot yangming
GV26.functions: 醒神開竅、清熱、通督、止痛
GV26.functionsEn: Revives consciousness and opens the orifices, clears heat, regulates the Governor vessel, stops pain
GV26.indications: 昏迷、暈厥、中暑、中風閉證、癲狂癇、小兒驚風、口喎、牙關緊閉、急性腰扭傷、面腫
GV26.indicationsEn: Coma, syncope, heat stroke, wind-stroke closed pattern, mania and epilepsy, infantile convulsions, facial paralysis, trismus, acute lumbar sprain, facial swelling
GV26.caution: 刺激強烈；急救以眼球濕潤、神志恢復為度，向上斜刺
GV26.cautionEn: Strong stimulus; in resuscitation stimulate until the eyes moisten and consciousness returns; oblique upward
GV26.qiNote: 「水溝」為急救第一要穴，與內關、十宣合用醒神。
GV26.qiNoteEn: 'Shuigou' is the foremost resuscitation point, with Neiguan (PC6) and Shixuan (EX-UE11).

categoryEn: Meeting of the three foot yin with the Conception vessel
CV3.functions: 益腎調經、止帶、利膀胱、清利濕熱
CV3.functionsEn: Tonifies the Kidney and regulates menstruation, stops leucorrhoea, benefits the Bladder, clears damp-heat
CV3.indications: 遺尿、小便不利、尿頻、遺精、陽痿、月經不調、痛經、帶下、不孕、陰挺
CV3.indicationsEn: Enuresis, dysuria, frequent urination, seminal emission, impotence, menstrual irregularity, dysmenorrhoea, leucorrhoea, infertility, uterine prolapse
CV3.caution: 孕婦禁針；排尿後針，膀胱充盈時深刺可傷膀胱
CV3.cautionEn: Contraindicated in pregnancy; needle after voiding - deep insertion into a full bladder can injure it
CV3.qiNote: 膀胱之募穴，配膀胱俞（BL28）；泌尿生殖要穴。
CV3.qiNoteEn: Front-mu of the Bladder, paired with Pangguangshu (BL28); key urogenital point.

categoryEn: Meeting of the three foot yin with the Conception vessel
CV4.functions: 培元固本、補腎壯陽、調經、回陽救逆
CV4.functionsEn: Cultivates the origin and secures the root, tonifies the Kidney and strengthens yang, regulates menstruation, restores yang and rescues from collapse
CV4.indications: 虛脫、遺尿、小便頻數、遺精、陽痿、月經不調、不孕、痛經、泄瀉、中風脫證（灸）、虛勞
CV4.indicationsEn: Collapse, enuresis, frequent urination, seminal emission, impotence, menstrual irregularity, infertility, dysmenorrhoea, diarrhoea, wind-stroke collapse (moxa), debility
CV4.caution: 孕婦禁針；膀胱充盈時慎刺
CV4.cautionEn: Contraindicated in pregnancy; caution with a full bladder
CV4.qiNote: 關元為「元氣之關」，保健灸與回陽救逆要穴；配命門前後相應。
CV4.qiNoteEn: 'Gate of origin': key moxa point for health preservation and rescuing yang; with Mingmen (GV4) front and back.

CV5.functions: 理氣止痛、通利水道、調經止帶
CV5.functionsEn: Regulates qi and stops pain, frees the waterways, regulates menstruation and leucorrhoea
CV5.indications: 腹脹、腹痛、水腫、小便不利、泄瀉、疝氣、經閉、崩漏、帶下
CV5.indicationsEn: Abdominal distension and pain, oedema, dysuria, diarrhoea, hernia, amenorrhoea, uterine bleeding, leucorrhoea
CV5.caution: 孕婦禁針；古籍載「婦人禁針灸」，下腹部深刺注意膀胱
CV5.cautionEn: Contraindicated in pregnancy; the classics warn against needling or moxa in women of child-bearing age; mind the bladder with deep lower-abdominal insertion
CV5.qiNote: 三焦之募穴，配三焦俞（BL22）俞募相應，主水液代謝與下焦氣化。
CV5.qiNoteEn: Front-mu of the Triple Energizer, paired with Sanjiaoshu (BL22); governs fluid metabolism and lower-jiao qi transformation.

CV6.functions: 補氣升陽、益腎固精、理氣
CV6.functionsEn: Tonifies qi and raises yang, tonifies the Kidney and secures essence, regulates qi
CV6.indications: 虛脫、乏力、泄瀉、便秘、遺尿、月經不調、崩漏、疝氣、中風脫證、氣虛諸證
CV6.indicationsEn: Collapse, fatigue, diarrhoea, constipation, enuresis, menstrual irregularity, uterine bleeding, hernia, wind-stroke collapse, qi-deficiency patterns
CV6.caution: 孕婦慎用；下腹部深刺注意
CV6.cautionEn: Caution in pregnancy; attention to depth in the lower abdomen
CV6.qiNote: 「氣海」為一身之氣所聚，氣虛下陷灸之。
CV6.qiNoteEn: 'Sea of qi': moxa for qi deficiency and sinking.

CV8.functions: 溫陽救逆、健脾利水、固脫
CV8.functionsEn: Warms yang and rescues from collapse, fortifies the Spleen and promotes urination, secures against collapse
CV8.indications: 泄瀉、腹痛、脫肛、中風脫證、虛脫、水腫（隔鹽灸、隔薑灸）
CV8.indicationsEn: Diarrhoea, abdominal pain, rectal prolapse, wind-stroke collapse, collapse, oedema (salt- or ginger-moxa)
CV8.caution: 臍部禁針；宜隔鹽灸、隔薑灸
CV8.cautionEn: Needling of the umbilicus is forbidden; use salt- or ginger-insulated moxa
CV8.qiNote: 神闕禁針宜灸：隔鹽灸救虛脫、治久瀉為經典。
CV8.qiNoteEn: Shenque is never needled, only moxa'd: salt moxa for collapse and chronic diarrhoea is classic.

CV9.functionsEn: Promotes urination and reduces oedema, harmonises the stomach
CV9.indications: 水腫、腹脹、泄瀉、小便不利、腹水
CV9.indicationsEn: Oedema, abdominal distension, diarrhoea, dysuria, ascites
CV9.caution: 腹部，深刺注意；腹水者慎
CV9.cautionEn: Abdomen: attention to depth; caution in ascites
CV9.qiNote: 「水分」為水液分利之處，水腫灸之。

categoryEn: Meeting of foot-taiyin and the Conception vessel
CV10.functionsEn: Fortifies the Spleen and harmonises the stomach, disperses food and resolves stagnation
CV10.indications: 腹脹、胃痛、嘔吐、食積、泄瀉、痞塊
CV10.indicationsEn: Abdominal distension, epigastric pain, vomiting, food stagnation, diarrhoea, abdominal masses
CV10.qiNote: 下脘主食積不化，與中脘、梁門同用。
CV10.qiNoteEn: Treats undigested food accumulation; with Zhongwan (CV12) and Liangmen (ST21).

category: 手太陽少陽、足陽明、任脈交會穴
categoryEn: Meeting of hand-taiyang, hand-shaoyang, foot-yangming and the Conception vessel
CV12.functions: 和胃健脾、降逆止嘔、化痰、安神
CV12.functionsEn: Harmonises the stomach and fortifies the Spleen, descends rebellion and stops vomiting, resolves phlegm, settles the spirit
CV12.indications: 胃痛、嘔吐、腹脹、泄瀉、便秘、食積、癲狂、眩暈、失眠、消化不良
CV12.indicationsEn: Epigastric pain, vomiting, abdominal distension, diarrhoea, constipation, food stagnation, mania, dizziness, insomnia, dyspepsia
CV12.caution: 上腹部，肝腫大者慎；深刺注意
CV12.cautionEn: Upper abdomen: caution with hepatomegaly; attention to depth
CV12.qiNote: 「腑會中脘」，胃之募穴：六腑病與脾胃病皆取，配胃俞（BL21）。
CV12.qiNoteEn: Hui-meeting of the fu and front-mu of the Stomach: for all fu disorders; paired with Weishu (BL21).

CV14.functionsEn: Calms the heart and settles the spirit, expands the chest and descends rebellion
CV14.indications: 心痛、心悸、癲狂癇、胸痛、嘔吐、吞酸、呃逆
CV14.indicationsEn: Cardiac pain, palpitations, mania and epilepsy, chest pain, vomiting, acid regurgitation, hiccup
CV14.caution: 劍突下，深刺可傷肝左葉或心，宜向下斜刺淺刺
CV14.cautionEn: Below the xiphoid: deep insertion may injure the left liver lobe or heart; shallow oblique downward
CV14.qiNote: 心之募穴，配心俞（BL15）俞募治心病、癲癇。
CV14.qiNoteEn: Front-mu of the Heart, paired with Xinshu (BL15) for heart disorders and epilepsy.

CV15.functionsEn: Settles the spirit and will, expands the chest, descends rebellion
CV15.indications: 癲狂癇、心痛、胸滿、嘔吐、呃逆、心煩
CV15.indicationsEn: Mania and epilepsy, cardiac pain, chest fullness, vomiting, hiccup, vexation
CV15.caution: 劍突下方，深刺可傷肝或心，宜向下斜刺
CV15.cautionEn: Below the xiphoid: deep insertion may injure the liver or heart; oblique downward
CV15.qiNote: 鳩尾為治癲癇要穴，配間使（PC5）、豐隆。
CV15.qiNoteEn: Key point for epilepsy, with Jianshi (PC5) and Fenglong (ST40).

CV17.functions: 寬胸理氣、止咳平喘、通乳、降逆
CV17.functionsEn: Expands the chest and regulates qi, stops cough and calms wheezing, promotes lactation, descends rebellion
CV17.indications: 胸悶、胸痛、心悸、咳嗽、氣喘、呃逆、嘔吐、乳少、乳癰、鬱證
CV17.indicationsEn: Chest oppression and pain, palpitations, cough, asthma, hiccup, vomiting, insufficient lactation, mastitis, depression
CV17.caution: 胸骨上平刺；胸骨下緣以下深刺可達縱隔
CV17.cautionEn: Transverse insertion over the sternum; below its lower border deep insertion can reach the mediastinum
CV17.qiNote: 「氣會膻中」：一切氣病（胸悶、氣鬱、氣喘）皆取。
CV17.qiNoteEn: Hui-meeting of qi: for all qi disorders - oppression, constraint, wheezing.

categoryEn: Meeting of the Conception vessel and yin wei
CV22.functions: 宣肺化痰、利咽開音、降逆
CV22.functionsEn: Diffuses the Lung and resolves phlegm, benefits the throat and voice, descends rebellion
CV22.indications: 咳嗽、氣喘、胸痛、咽喉腫痛、暴喑、梅核氣、呃逆、噎膈
CV22.indicationsEn: Cough, asthma, chest pain, sore swollen throat, sudden loss of voice, plum-stone qi, hiccup, dysphagia
CV22.caution: 先淺直刺，再轉針尖沿胸骨柄後緣向下；不可向後或向側深刺（氣管、主動脈弓、無名靜脈）
CV22.cautionEn: Shallow perpendicular insertion, then redirect downward along the posterior manubrium; never deep backward or sideways (trachea, aortic arch, brachiocephalic vein)
CV22.qiNote: 天突為平喘利咽要穴，刺法要求嚴格。
CV22.qiNoteEn: Key point for wheezing and the throat; needling technique must be precise.

categoryEn: Meeting of the Conception vessel and yin wei
CV23.functionsEn: Benefits the throat and tongue, opens the tongue orifice, generates fluids
CV23.indications: 舌強不語、暴喑、吞嚥困難、流涎、舌下腫痛、口乾
CV23.indicationsEn: Stiff tongue with aphasia, sudden loss of voice, dysphagia, drooling, sublingual swelling, dry mouth
CV23.caution: 向舌根方向斜刺，勿過深
CV23.cautionEn: Oblique insertion toward the tongue root; avoid excessive depth
CV23.qiNote: 廉泉為中風失語、吞嚥困難要穴。
CV23.qiNoteEn: Key point for post-stroke aphasia and dysphagia.

categoryEn: Meeting of the Conception vessel and foot-yangming
CV24.functionsEn: Dispels wind and activates the channel, generates fluids, settles the spirit
CV24.indications: 口喎、齒痛、流涎、暴喑、癲狂、面腫、消渴
CV24.indicationsEn: Facial paralysis, toothache, drooling, sudden loss of voice, mania, facial swelling, wasting-thirst
CV24.qiNote: 承漿為下牙痛、面癱口角流涎之局部穴。
CV24.qiNoteEn: Local point for lower toothache and drooling in facial paralysis.

EX-HN1.functions: 鎮靜安神、清頭明目、益智
EX-HN1.functionsEn: Calms and settles the spirit, clears the head and brightens the eyes, benefits the intellect
EX-HN1.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、失眠、健忘、癲癇、中風後遺
EX-HN1.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, poor memory, epilepsy, post-stroke sequelae
EX-HN1.caution: 嬰幼兒囟門未閉禁針；頭皮平刺
EX-HN1.cautionEn: Contraindicated with an open fontanelle; transverse scalp insertion
EX-HN1.qiNote: 四神聰環繞百會，安神定志、健腦益智。
EX-HN1.qiNoteEn: Surrounding Baihui, the four points calm the spirit and benefit the brain.

EX-HN3.functionsEn: Settles the spirit, brightens the eyes and opens the nose, dispels wind
EX-HN3.indications: 頭痛、眩暈、失眠、鼻淵、鼻衄、小兒驚風、前額痛
EX-HN3.indicationsEn: Headache, dizziness, insomnia, sinusitis, nosebleed, infantile convulsions, frontal pain
EX-HN3.cautionEn: Pinch the skin and insert transversely
EX-HN3.qiNote: 印堂為「上丹田」，安神與通鼻兩用。
EX-HN3.qiNoteEn: The 'upper dantian': used both to calm the spirit and to open the nose.

EX-HN5.functionsEn: Clears heat, stops pain, brightens the eyes, dispels wind
EX-HN5.indications: 頭痛、偏頭痛、目赤腫痛、口喎、齒痛、三叉神經痛
EX-HN5.indicationsEn: Headache, migraine, red swollen eyes, facial paralysis, toothache, trigeminal neuralgia
EX-HN5.caution: 顳淺動脈淺層經過，避開；刺絡放血須消毒
EX-HN5.cautionEn: Superficial temporal artery passes nearby: avoid it; asepsis if bleeding
EX-HN5.qiNote: 太陽為側頭痛局部首選，可向率谷透刺。
EX-HN5.qiNoteEn: First-choice local point for temporal headache; may be needled through toward Shuaigu (GB8).

EX-HN16.indications: 失眠、頭痛、眩暈、心悸、癲狂、高血壓
EX-HN16.indicationsEn: Insomnia, headache, dizziness, palpitations, mania, hypertension
EX-HN16.caution: 翳風與風池之間，勿向內上方深刺
EX-HN16.cautionEn: Between Yifeng and Fengchi: never deep inward-upward
EX-HN16.qiNote: 安眠穴為失眠經驗要穴。

EX-B1.functionsEn: Stops cough and calms wheezing, activates the channel
EX-B1.indications: 哮喘、咳嗽、項強、肩背痛、蕁麻疹
EX-B1.indicationsEn: Asthma, cough, stiff neck, shoulder and back pain, urticaria
EX-B1.caution: 胸背區（大椎旁），深刺可致氣胸，宜斜刺
EX-B1.cautionEn: Upper thoracic back (beside GV14): pneumothorax risk; oblique insertion
EX-B1.qiNote: 定喘為哮喘經驗要穴，發作期與緩解期皆用。
EX-B1.qiNoteEn: Empirical key point for asthma in both acute and remission phases.

EX-B2.functions: 調理臟腑、通經活絡、止痛
EX-B2.functionsEn: Regulates the zang-fu, activates the channel, stops pain
EX-B2.indications: 相應節段之內臟病（胸段：心肺上肢；腰段：腸胃、腰腿）、脊柱病、帶狀疱疹後神經痛
EX-B2.indicationsEn: Visceral disorders of the corresponding segment (thoracic: heart, lung, arm; lumbar: bowel, lumbar region, leg), spinal disorders, post-herpetic neuralgia
EX-B2.caution: 胸段夾脊深刺可致氣胸；向內深刺可入椎管
EX-B2.cautionEn: Thoracic jiaji: pneumothorax risk; deep medial insertion may enter the spinal canal
EX-B2.qiNote: 華佗夾脊穴按節段取用，內臟與肢體病兼治。
EX-B2.qiNoteEn: Hua Tuo's jiaji points are chosen by segment for visceral and limb disorders.

EX-B7.functionsEn: Strengthens the lumbar region and tonifies the Kidney
EX-B7.indications: 腰痛、月經不調、帶下、尿頻
EX-B7.indicationsEn: Lumbar pain, menstrual irregularity, leucorrhoea, frequent urination
EX-B7.cautionEn: About 3.5 cun beside L4; no special risk
EX-B7.qiNote: 腰眼為慢性腎虛腰痛要穴，宜灸。
EX-B7.qiNoteEn: Key point for chronic Kidney-deficient lumbar pain; moxa suits it.

EX-UE7.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews, activates the channel, stops pain
EX-UE7.cautionEn: Have the patient move the lumbar region during needling
EX-UE7.qiNote: 腰痛點為急性腰扭傷遠端經驗穴（動氣針法）。
EX-UE7.qiNoteEn: Empirical distal point for acute lumbar sprain, used with movement.

EX-UE8.functionsEn: Relaxes the sinews, activates the channel
EX-UE8.indications: 落枕、手背腫痛、手指麻木
EX-UE8.indicationsEn: Stiff neck (torticollis), swelling of the dorsum of the hand, numb fingers
EX-UE8.cautionEn: Have the patient rotate the neck during needling
EX-UE8.qiNote: 外勞宮（落枕穴）為落枕遠端首選。
EX-UE8.qiNoteEn: First-choice distal point for acute stiff neck.

EX-UE9.functionsEn: Dispels wind, activates the channel, clears heat and reduces swelling
EX-UE9.indications: 手指麻木、手背腫痛、手指關節痛、煩熱、目痛、毒蛇咬傷
EX-UE9.indicationsEn: Numb fingers, swelling of the dorsum of the hand, finger-joint pain, vexing heat, eye pain, snake bite
EX-UE9.cautionEn: At the web spaces; pricking or oblique insertion
EX-UE9.qiNote: 八邪為手指麻木、類風濕手指痛常用。
EX-UE9.qiNoteEn: Commonly used for numb fingers and rheumatoid finger pain.

EX-UE11.functionsEn: Clears heat and opens the orifices, emergency resuscitation
EX-UE11.indications: 昏迷、中暑、高熱、癲癇、咽喉腫痛、指端麻木
EX-UE11.indicationsEn: Coma, heat stroke, high fever, epilepsy, sore throat, numb fingertips
EX-UE11.caution: 點刺出血，疼痛強烈，須消毒
EX-UE11.cautionEn: Bleed by pricking; very painful; asepsis
EX-UE11.qiNote: 十宣點刺放血為高熱、昏迷急救要法。
EX-UE11.qiNoteEn: Bleeding the ten Xuan points is a key emergency method for high fever and coma.

EX-LE2.indications: 膝痛、膝關節屈伸不利、下肢痿痹
EX-LE2.indicationsEn: Knee pain, restricted knee movement, lower-limb weakness
EX-LE2.qiNote: 鶴頂與膝眼合用為膝痛局部三針。
EX-LE2.qiNoteEn: With the two knee eyes forms the local trio for knee pain.

EX-LE4.indications: 膝痛、膝關節屈伸不利、下肢痿痹
EX-LE4.indicationsEn: Knee pain, restricted knee movement, lower-limb weakness
EX-LE4.caution: 屈膝取穴，向後外斜刺；注意無菌
EX-LE4.cautionEn: Locate with the knee flexed, oblique postero-lateral; strict asepsis
EX-LE4.qiNote: 內外膝眼對刺為膝痛局部標配。
EX-LE4.qiNoteEn: Needling both knee eyes toward each other is the standard local treatment for knee pain.

EX-LE6.functionsEn: Benefits the Gallbladder and stops pain
EX-LE6.indications: 膽絞痛、膽道蛔蟲、膽囊炎、下肢痿痹
EX-LE6.indicationsEn: Biliary colic, biliary ascariasis, cholecystitis, lower-limb weakness
EX-LE6.qiNote: 膽囊穴為膽囊炎壓痛反應點，配陽陵泉。
EX-LE6.qiNoteEn: Reactive tender point in cholecystitis; with Yanglingquan (GB34).

EX-LE10.functionsEn: Dispels wind, activates the channel, clears heat
EX-LE10.indications: 足趾麻木、足背腫痛、頭痛、牙痛、月經不調、毒蛇咬傷
EX-LE10.indicationsEn: Numb toes, swelling of the dorsum of the foot, headache, toothache, menstrual irregularity, snake bite
EX-LE10.cautionEn: At the toe webs; pricking or oblique insertion
EX-LE10.qiNote: 八風為足趾麻木、糖尿病周圍神經病變常用。
EX-LE10.qiNoteEn: Commonly used for numb toes and diabetic peripheral neuropathy.

riskZones.zh: 胸背區（肺野之上）：胸前、腋側、肩上與背部肋間的穴位，深刺可穿透胸膜造成氣胸。原則上沿肋骨斜刺或平刺、嚴格控制深度，瘦弱、肺氣腫患者尤須謹慎；教學上只講原則，不給具體深度數字。
riskZones.en: Thoracic region over the lung fields: points on the anterior chest, lateral chest, top of the shoulder and intercostal back. Deep insertion can puncture the pleura and cause pneumothorax. Needle obliquely or transversely along the rib with strictly controlled depth; be especially careful in thin patients and those with emphysema. Teaching gives principles only, never depth numbers.
riskZones.consequence: 氣胸：突發胸痛、呼吸困難、乾咳、血氧下降，嚴重時休克；須立即停針、保持坐位、送醫處理。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Pneumothorax: sudden chest pain, dyspnoea, dry cough, falling oxygen saturation and in severe cases shock. Stop needling at once, keep the patient sitting and refer to hospital.

riskZones.zh: 枕下區：風府、啞門、天柱、風池及其附近穴位下方為枕骨大孔與延髓；若針尖朝向內上方深刺，可能刺入延髓或椎動脈。風池針尖應朝鼻尖或對側眼，風府、啞門針尖朝下頜方向，皆不可深刺。
riskZones.en: Suboccipital region: beneath Fengfu, Yamen, Tianzhu, Fengchi and neighbouring points lie the foramen magnum and medulla; deep insertion directed inward and upward can enter the medulla or vertebral artery. Direct GB20 toward the nose tip or opposite eye and GV15/GV16 toward the mandible; never deep.
riskZones.consequence: 延髓損傷：突發劇烈頭痛、嘔吐、呼吸心跳異常、意識喪失，甚至死亡；蛛網膜下腔出血。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Medullary injury: sudden severe headache, vomiting, respiratory and cardiac irregularity, loss of consciousness and even death; subarachnoid haemorrhage.

riskZones.zh: 眼眶區：睛明、承泣、球後位於眶內或眶緣，深刺或提插捻轉可傷眼球、視神經或眶內血管；四白、瞳子髎、魚腰在眶緣外，不可向眶內刺。
riskZones.en: Orbital region: Jingming, Chengqi and Qiuhou lie inside or at the orbital rim; deep insertion, lifting-thrusting or rotation can injure the globe, optic nerve or orbital vessels. Sibai, Tongziliao and Yuyao lie outside the rim and must never be directed into the orbit.
riskZones.consequence: 眼球穿刺、眶內血腫（熊貓眼）、視力受損。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Globe perforation, orbital haematoma ('panda eye'), visual impairment.

riskZones.zh: 頸動脈區：人迎正當頸動脈竇，水突、扶突、天容緊鄰頸總動脈。必須避開搏動，禁深刺、禁強刺激與雙側同時刺激。
riskZones.en: Carotid region: Renying lies over the carotid sinus; Shuitu, Futu and Tianrong adjoin the common carotid artery. Avoid the pulsation; no deep insertion, no strong or simultaneous bilateral stimulation.
riskZones.consequence: 頸動脈竇反射：心動過緩、血壓驟降、暈厥；動脈損傷出血或血腫壓迫氣道。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Carotid-sinus reflex: bradycardia, sudden hypotension, syncope; arterial injury with bleeding or haematoma compressing the airway.

riskZones.zh: 天突：後方為氣管，深部有主動脈弓與無名靜脈。先淺直刺再沿胸骨柄後緣向下，不可向後或向側深刺。
riskZones.en: Tiantu: the trachea lies behind and the aortic arch and brachiocephalic vein deeper. Insert shallowly then redirect downward along the posterior manubrium; never deep backward or sideways.
riskZones.consequence: 刺傷氣管（劇咳、皮下氣腫）或大血管（大出血、縱隔血腫）。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Tracheal puncture (violent cough, subcutaneous emphysema) or great-vessel injury (major haemorrhage, mediastinal haematoma).

riskZones.zh: 神闕禁針（宜灸）：臍部皮薄、易感染且直通腹腔。傳統以隔鹽灸、隔薑灸取效。
riskZones.en: Shenque is never needled, only moxa'd: the umbilical skin is thin, easily infected and leads directly into the peritoneal cavity. Salt- or ginger-insulated moxa is the traditional method.

riskZones.zh: 孕婦禁用／慎用：合谷、三陰交、崑崙、至陰、肩井等傳統催產穴，以及下腹部（臍以下）與腰骶部穴位，可能引發宮縮或影響胎元。妊娠三個月內下腹部穴禁針，三個月後上腹部穴亦慎；至陰矯正胎位只用溫和灸並須產科監督。
riskZones.en: Contraindicated or used with caution in pregnancy: Hegu, Sanyinjiao, Kunlun, Zhiyin and Jianjing (classic labour-inducing points) and all points on the lower abdomen (below the umbilicus) and lumbosacral region may induce uterine contraction or disturb the foetus. Lower-abdominal points are forbidden in the first trimester and upper-abdominal points thereafter; breech correction at Zhiyin uses gentle moxa only, under obstetric supervision.
riskZones.consequence: 宮縮、流產或早產風險；下腹深刺可傷及子宮。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Risk of uterine contraction, miscarriage or premature labour; deep lower-abdominal insertion can injure the gravid uterus.

riskZones.zh: 腹部：肝脾腫大、膀胱充盈、妊娠或腹脹時深刺危險。上腹部慎防刺傷肝（右）、脾（左）、胃；下腹部須排尿後針以免傷膀胱；劍突下穴（巨闕、鳩尾）向下斜刺以避肝、心。
riskZones.en: Abdomen: deep insertion is dangerous with hepatomegaly or splenomegaly, a full bladder, pregnancy or distension. On the upper abdomen beware the liver (right), spleen (left) and stomach; on the lower abdomen have the patient void first to protect the bladder; sub-xiphoid points (CV14, CV15) are angled downward to avoid the liver and heart.
riskZones.consequence: 內臟穿刺：腹膜炎、內出血、膀胱穿孔（血尿、下腹痛）。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Visceral puncture: peritonitis, internal bleeding, bladder perforation (haematuria, lower abdominal pain).

riskZones.zh: 大血管／神經旁：太淵、經渠（橈動脈）、極泉（腋動脈）、少海、曲澤（肱動脈、正中神經）、神門（尺動脈）、內關、大陵（正中神經）、小海（尺神經）、箕門、衝門、氣衝、急脈（股動脈）、委中（膕動脈、脛神經）、太谿（脛後動脈）、衝陽、解谿（足背／脛前動脈）、環跳（坐骨神經）、陽陵泉（腓總神經）、翳風（面神經）、太陽（顳淺動脈）。避開搏動與神經幹，得氣後不強捻強刺。
riskZones.en: Beside major vessels or nerves: Taiyuan and Jingqu (radial artery), Jiquan (axillary artery), Shaohai and Quze (brachial artery, median nerve), Shenmen (ulnar artery), Neiguan and Daling (median nerve), Xiaohai (ulnar nerve), Jimen, Chongmen, Qichong and Jimai (femoral artery), Weizhong (popliteal artery, tibial nerve), Taixi (posterior tibial artery), Chongyang and Jiexi (dorsalis pedis / anterior tibial artery), Huantiao (sciatic nerve), Yanglingquan (common peroneal nerve), Yifeng (facial nerve), Taiyang (superficial temporal artery). Avoid the pulsation and nerve trunks; do not rotate or stimulate forcefully after deqi.
riskZones.consequence: 出血、血腫、假性動脈瘤；神經刺傷致持續麻木、放射痛或運動障礙。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Bleeding, haematoma, pseudoaneurysm; nerve injury with persistent numbness, radiating pain or motor deficit.

riskZones.zh: 嬰幼兒囟門未閉禁針：前囟約於一歲半閉合前，百會、前頂、囟會、上星、神庭、四神聰及承光、五處等穴不可針刺；可用輕柔手法或灸。
riskZones.en: Infants with an open fontanelle: until the anterior fontanelle closes (around 18 months) Baihui, Qianding, Xinhui, Shangxing, Shenting, Sishencong, Chengguang and Wuchu must not be needled; gentle tuina or moxa may be used instead.
riskZones.consequence: 刺入顱內：腦膜損傷、顱內出血、感染。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Intracranial penetration: meningeal injury, intracranial haemorrhage, infection.

riskZones.zh: 脊柱正中（棘突間）：督脈腰陽關至大椎諸穴與十七椎、夾脊，若針尖朝向椎管深刺可傷脊髓或馬尾。宜微斜向上或向下淺刺，得氣（局部脹感）即止；出現下肢觸電感須立即退針。
riskZones.en: Spinal midline (interspinous): Governor-vessel points from Yaoyangguan to Dazhui, Shiqizhui and the jiaji points can injure the spinal cord or cauda equina if directed deep into the canal. Insert shallowly with a slight upward or downward angle and stop at local deqi; withdraw immediately on an electric sensation in the legs.
riskZones.consequence: 脊髓／馬尾損傷：下肢麻木無力、大小便失禁、截癱；硬膜外血腫。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Spinal cord / cauda equina injury: limb numbness and weakness, incontinence, paraplegia; epidural haematoma.

riskZones.zh: 腎區：三焦俞、腎俞、肓門、志室、京門、痞根位於腎臟體表投影（第12肋至第3腰椎），深刺可傷腎實質。宜直刺適度或斜刺，體瘦者尤慎。
riskZones.en: Kidney region: Sanjiaoshu, Shenshu, Huangmen, Zhishi, Jingmen and Pigen overlie the kidneys (12th rib to L3); deep insertion can lacerate the renal parenchyma. Needle to moderate depth or obliquely, with particular care in thin patients.
riskZones.consequence: 腎損傷：腰痛、血尿、腎周血腫。
riskZones.consequenceEn: Renal injury: flank pain, haematuria, perirenal haematoma.

comboPrinciples.text: 患處局部（或鄰近）穴配合循經遠端穴。局部穴「通其所滯」，遠端穴「導其所行」，又取「經脈所過，主治所及」之意；頭面病配四肢遠端穴（四總穴、井滎）尤為常用。
comboPrinciples.textEn: A local (or adjacent) point at the affected site combined with a distal point on the same channel. The local point frees stagnation where it sits; the distal point draws channel qi through the region ('where the channel passes, its points treat'). For head and face disorders, distal points on the limbs (the four command points, jing-well and ying-spring points) are especially common.

comboPrinciples.text: 臟腑之背俞穴（陽，在背）與募穴（陰，在胸腹）相配，「從陰引陽、從陽引陰」，前後夾擊，直達病所。臟病多取俞、腑病多取募，合用則陰陽相濟。
comboPrinciples.textEn: The back-shu point (yang, on the back) of an organ paired with its front-mu point (yin, on the chest or abdomen): 'draw yang from yin and yin from yang', attacking from front and back to reach the organ directly. Zang disorders favour the shu, fu disorders the mu; together they balance yin and yang.

comboPrinciples.text: 先病之經取原穴為「主」，後病之表裡經取絡穴為「客」。原穴通三焦原氣、絡穴聯繫表裡兩經，主客相配治表裡兩經同病。
comboPrinciples.textEn: The yuan-source point of the channel first affected is the 'host'; the luo-connecting point of its interiorly-exteriorly paired channel is the 'guest'. Yuan points connect to the source qi of the three jiao, luo points link the paired channels, so together they treat disorders involving both.

comboPrinciples.text: 十二經與奇經八脈相通之八穴，上下配對：公孫（衝）配內關（陰維）主心胸胃；後谿（督）配申脈（陽蹻）主頸項肩背、內眥；足臨泣（帶）配外關（陽維）主目銳眥、耳後、頰、頸、肩；列缺（任）配照海（陰蹻）主肺系、咽喉、胸膈。
comboPrinciples.textEn: Eight points where the twelve channels communicate with the extraordinary vessels, used in upper-lower pairs: Gongsun (Chong) + Neiguan (yin wei) for the heart, chest and stomach; Houxi (Governor) + Shenmai (yang qiao) for the nape, shoulders, back and inner canthus; Zulinqi (Dai) + Waiguan (yang wei) for the outer canthus, retroauricular region, cheek, neck and shoulder; Lieque (Conception) + Zhaohai (yin qiao) for the Lung, throat, chest and diaphragm.

comboPrinciples.text: 身前（胸腹，屬陰）與身後（背腰，屬陽）之穴相配，俞募配穴即其代表；亦用於非俞募之前後對應，如關元配命門、中脘配脾俞，前後呼應，陰陽同調。
comboPrinciples.textEn: Points on the front of the body (chest and abdomen, yin) paired with those on the back (yang). The shu-mu method is its archetype, but it also covers non-shu-mu correspondences such as Guanyuan with Mingmen or Zhongwan with Pishu, regulating yin and yang in concert.

comboPrinciples.text: 上肢（或上半身）穴與下肢（或下半身）穴相配，如內關配足三里治胃痛嘔吐、合谷配太衝（四關）鎮靜止痛、條口透承山配肩髃治肩痛；八脈交會穴亦屬此類。上下同取則經氣上下貫通。
comboPrinciples.textEn: A point on the upper limb (or upper body) paired with one on the lower limb (or lower body): Neiguan with Zusanli for epigastric pain and vomiting, Hegu with Taichong (the Four Gates) to calm and relieve pain, Tiaokou-through-Chengshan with Jianyu for shoulder pain. The eight confluent pairs belong here too. Taking upper and lower together lets channel qi flow through the whole body.

comboPrinciples.text: 經脈左右交叉，「左病取右，右病取左」：巨刺取健側經穴（病在經），繆刺取健側絡穴或井穴點刺（病在絡）。常用於面癱、偏癱、一側肢體扭傷，或患側腫痛不便針刺時。亦可左右同名穴同取以加強。
comboPrinciples.textEn: The channels cross left and right, so 'for disease on the left, needle the right, and vice versa': juci uses channel points on the healthy side (disease in the channel), miuci uses luo or jing-well points on the healthy side (disease in the collaterals). Commonly used for facial paralysis, hemiplegia, unilateral sprains, or when the affected side is too swollen to needle. Bilateral use of the same point strengthens the effect.

comboPrinciples.text: 互為表裡之兩經穴位同用（如肺與大腸、脾與胃），一經有病常累及表裡經；原絡配穴為其特例。列缺配合谷治感冒咳嗽，足三里配三陰交健脾和胃，太衝配陽陵泉疏肝利膽。
comboPrinciples.textEn: Points from two interiorly-exteriorly paired channels used together (Lung with Large Intestine, Spleen with Stomach, etc.), since disease in one often involves the other; yuan-luo pairing is a special case. Lieque with Hegu for colds and cough, Zusanli with Sanyinjiao to fortify the Spleen and harmonise the Stomach, Taichong with Yanglingquan to spread the Liver and benefit the Gallbladder.

conditions.overview: 先辨經絡：前額屬陽明（頭維、印堂、合谷、內庭），側頭屬少陽（太陽、率谷、外關、足臨泣），後頭連項屬太陽（天柱、風池、後谿、崑崙），巔頂屬厥陰（百會、四神聰、太衝、湧泉）；再辨證：外感（風寒、風熱、風濕）屬實，內傷分肝陽上亢、痰濁、瘀血（實）與氣血虧虛、腎虛（虛）。基本方：百會、太陽、風池、阿是穴、合谷，依經與證加減。
conditions.overviewEn: First differentiate the channel: frontal pain belongs to yangming (ST8, EX-HN3, LI4, ST44), temporal to shaoyang (EX-HN5, GB8, TE5, GB41), occipital-nuchal to taiyang (BL10, GB20, SI3, BL60), vertex to jueyin (GV20, EX-HN1, LR3, KI1). Then differentiate the pattern: external invasion (wind-cold, wind-heat, wind-damp) is excess; internal headache divides into Liver yang rising, phlegm turbidity and blood stasis (excess) versus qi-blood deficiency and Kidney deficiency (deficiency). Base prescription: GV20, EX-HN5, GB20, ashi points, LI4, modified by channel and pattern.
conditions.redFlags: 突發雷擊樣劇烈頭痛、伴發燒頸僵、神經學缺損（複視、肢體無力、言語不清）、意識改變、外傷後頭痛、50歲以後新發或進行性加重、清晨嘔吐、妊娠期新發頭痛 → 轉急診／影像檢查，不以針灸處理。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Sudden thunderclap headache, fever with neck stiffness, neurological deficit (diplopia, limb weakness, slurred speech), altered consciousness, post-traumatic headache, new or progressive headache after 50, morning vomiting, new headache in pregnancy: refer for emergency assessment and imaging; do not treat with acupuncture.

patterns.presentation: 頭痛連及項背、遇風加重、惡風寒、無汗、鼻塞流清涕，苔薄白、脈浮緊
patterns.presentationEn: Headache extending to the nape and upper back, worse in wind, aversion to wind and cold, no sweating, clear nasal discharge; thin white coat, floating tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, activate the channel and stop pain
patterns.methodEn: Reducing method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 風池疏散風邪、為外風要穴；百會、太陽局部通絡止痛；合谷為面口要穴，發汗解表；風門、列缺宣肺散寒，崑崙循太陽經止後頭痛。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fengchi disperses wind and is the key point for external wind; Baihui and Taiyang free the local channels; Hegu commands the face and head and promotes sweating; Fengmen and Lieque diffuse the Lung and scatter cold; Kunlun follows the taiyang channel for occipital pain.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。滋補腎陰之穴用於外感頭痛，延誤解表。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6、CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Kidney-yin tonifying points in an exterior headache delay release of the exterior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6, CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。內庭、曲池清熱偏涼，風寒者惡寒加劇；大椎在風寒亦宜灸不宜瀉。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Neiting and Quchi are cooling; in wind-cold the chills intensify. Dazhui here should be moxa'd rather than reduced.

wrong.zh: 枕下穴朝內上方深刺可傷延髓（風險區：medulla），此處針向與深度錯誤屬危險選擇。風府、天柱雖對證，若向上深刺則為危險選擇。
wrong.en: Suboccipital points directed deep inward-upward can injure the medulla (risk zone: medulla); wrong direction or depth here is a dangerous choice. Fengfu and Tianzhu suit the pattern, but become dangerous if directed deep upward.

patterns.presentation: 頭脹痛、以兩側或巔頂為甚、眩暈、面紅目赤、煩躁易怒、口苦、失眠，舌紅苔黃、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Distending headache worst at the temples or vertex, dizziness, red face and eyes, irritability, bitter taste, insomnia; red tongue with yellow coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Pacify the Liver and subdue yang, extinguish wind and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 太衝為肝經原穴、俠谿為膽經滎水穴，瀉之以平肝膽上亢之火；風池、太陽、率谷清利頭目（少陽）；太谿滋水涵木；外關配足臨泣為少陽八脈交會對。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong (Liver yuan) and Xiaxi (Gallbladder ying-spring Water) are reduced to subdue Liver-Gallbladder fire; Fengchi, Taiyang and Shuaigu clear the head (shaoyang); Taixi enriches Water to nourish Wood; Waiguan and Zulinqi form the shaoyang confluent pair.

wrong.zh: 升提、助陽之穴（或灸）用於肝陽上亢、火熱上擾，助陽上衝：頭痛眩暈加劇、血壓上升。灸百會、補氣海足三里升舉陽氣，肝陽上亢者頭痛更劇。［風險區 infant-fontanelle：GV20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］
wrong.en: Lifting or yang-assisting points (or moxa) in Liver-yang rising or fire flaring push yang further upward: headache and dizziness intensify and blood pressure climbs. Moxa on Baihui or tonifying Qihai and Zusanli lifts yang; in Liver-yang rising the headache intensifies. [risk zone infant-fontanelle: GV20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：列缺、風門、迎香為太陰／太陽／陽明外感頭痛之穴， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Lieque, Fengmen and Yingxiang address exterior headache on other channels; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。肝俞、腎俞補法於肝火正盛時助火。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying Ganshu and Shenshu while Liver fire blazes feeds the fire. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

patterns.presentation: 頭痛昏蒙如裹、胸脘痞悶、噁心嘔吐痰涎、身重倦怠，苔白膩、脈滑
patterns.presentationEn: Dull heavy headache 'as if wrapped', chest and epigastric oppression, nausea with phlegmy vomiting, heaviness and fatigue; white greasy coat, slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and resolve phlegm, descend rebellion and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 豐隆化痰要穴、中脘腑會和胃化痰；頭維為陽明與痰濁上蒙之局部穴；陰陵泉健脾滲濕治痰之本；內關降逆止嘔；百會、印堂清頭醒腦。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fenglong is the key phlegm point and Zhongwan (hui of the fu) harmonises the stomach; Touwei is the local yangming point for turbidity clouding the head; Yinlingquan drains damp at the root of phlegm; Neiguan descends rebellion; Baihui and Yintang clear the head.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。太谿、三陰交、膈俞滋陰養血，痰濕者徒增膩滯。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. Taixi, Sanyinjiao and Geshu nourish yin and blood and only add cloying dampness. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：太陽經穴主後頭項痛， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 medulla：BL10］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Taiyang points govern occipital pain; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone medulla: BL10]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。井穴放血清熱，與痰濕無關。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Bleeding jing-well points clears heat and has nothing to do with phlegm-damp.

patterns.presentation: 頭痛隱隱、綿綿不休、勞累加重、面色少華、心悸失眠、神疲乏力，舌淡苔薄、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Dull lingering headache worse with exertion, lustreless complexion, palpitations, insomnia, fatigue; pale tongue with thin coat, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify qi and blood, raise the clear and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 百會灸之升舉清陽；足三里、三陰交、脾俞補益脾胃以生氣血；氣海補氣、肝俞膈俞養血；風池輕刺引氣上達頭目。
patterns.rationaleEn: Moxa on Baihui raises clear yang; Zusanli, Sanyinjiao and Pishu tonify the Spleen and Stomach to generate qi and blood; Qihai tonifies qi while Ganshu and Geshu nourish blood; Fengchi, needled gently, guides qi to the head.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。太陽、合谷強刺、俠谿瀉法於氣血虛者更傷正氣，頭暈乏力。［風險區 vessels-nerves：EX-HN5］［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong needling at Taiyang and Hegu or reducing Xiaxi further depletes the already weak upright qi. [risk zone vessels-nerves: EX-HN5] [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。化痰利水之穴耗傷氣血。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Phlegm- and water-draining points consume qi and blood. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

combos.why: 風池、太陽、百會為頭部局部要穴；合谷配太衝為四關，上下相應、鎮靜止痛，適用於各型頭痛之基礎。
combos.whyEn: Fengchi, Taiyang and Baihui are the key local head points; Hegu with Taichong forms the Four Gates, pairing upper and lower to calm and relieve pain - a base for every type of headache.

combos.zh: 循經取穴組（少陽側頭痛）
combos.why: 率谷、太陽、風池為少陽局部；外關、足臨泣為八脈交會對穴，專主少陽頭側、耳目之病。
combos.whyEn: Shuaigu, Taiyang and Fengchi are local shaoyang points; Waiguan and Zulinqi are the confluent pair governing shaoyang disorders of the temple, ear and eye.

combos.zh: 循經取穴組（太陽後頭痛）
combos.why: 天柱、風池、風府局部疏風；後谿通督脈、崑崙循太陽經，上下相應治後頭項痛。
combos.whyEn: Tianzhu, Fengchi and Fengfu disperse wind locally; Houxi opens the Governor vessel and Kunlun follows taiyang, pairing upper and lower for occipito-nuchal pain.

combos.zh: 循經取穴組（陽明前額痛）
combos.why: 頭維、印堂局部；合谷為面口要穴、內庭清陽明經熱，遠近結合。
combos.whyEn: Touwei and Yintang locally; Hegu commands the face and Neiting clears yangming heat - local and distal together.

conditions.overview: 偏頭痛多屬少陽經病，病機以肝鬱化火、肝陽上亢為主，兼痰濁、瘀血；久病多虛實夾雜。發作期以瀉少陽、平肝為主，緩解期調肝脾腎以治本。先兆、畏光畏聲、搏動性單側頭痛為辨識要點。
conditions.overviewEn: Migraine is mainly a shaoyang channel disorder; the core mechanism is Liver constraint transforming to fire or Liver yang rising, with phlegm turbidity or blood stasis in some cases and mixed excess-deficiency in chronic cases. During attacks reduce shaoyang and pacify the Liver; between attacks regulate Liver, Spleen and Kidney to treat the root. Aura, photophobia, phonophobia and pulsating unilateral pain are the identifying features.
conditions.redFlags: 首次或「一生最嚴重」頭痛、伴神經缺損或先兆持續超過一小時、發燒頸僵、50歲後新發、頭痛型態改變、妊娠或產後新發 → 轉診排除出血、血管病變與顱內病變。
conditions.redFlagsEn: First or 'worst ever' headache, neurological deficit or aura lasting over an hour, fever with neck stiffness, new onset after 50, change in headache pattern, new onset in pregnancy or post-partum: refer to exclude haemorrhage, vascular and intracranial disease.

patterns.presentation: 一側搏動性劇痛、畏光畏聲、噁心嘔吐、煩躁、口苦，舌紅苔黃、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Severe pulsating unilateral pain, photophobia and phonophobia, nausea and vomiting, agitation, bitter taste; red tongue with yellow coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear Liver fire, free the shaoyang channel
patterns.rationale: 率谷、太陽（可透刺）、風池為少陽局部；外關配足臨泣為少陽八脈交會對；行間、俠谿為肝膽滎火穴，瀉之清火；陽輔為膽經子穴（實則瀉其子）；內關止嘔。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shuaigu, Taiyang (may be needled through) and Fengchi are local shaoyang points; Waiguan with Zulinqi is the shaoyang confluent pair; Xingjian and Xiaxi, ying-spring Fire points of Liver and Gallbladder, are reduced to clear fire; Yangfu is the Gallbladder child point; Neiguan stops vomiting.

wrong.zh: 升提、助陽之穴（或灸）用於肝陽上亢、火熱上擾，助陽上衝：頭痛眩暈加劇、血壓上升。灸百會、關元、命門助陽升火。［風險區 infant-fontanelle：GV20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Lifting or yang-assisting points (or moxa) in Liver-yang rising or fire flaring push yang further upward: headache and dizziness intensify and blood pressure climbs. Moxa on Baihui, Guanyuan or Mingmen lifts yang and feeds the fire. [risk zone infant-fontanelle: GV20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：陽明經穴主前額痛，少陽側頭痛僅可作輔助， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Yangming points govern frontal pain and are at best adjuncts in shaoyang temporal pain; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。補肝俞、膽俞於火盛時助火。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18、BL19］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying Ganshu and Danshu while fire blazes feeds it. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18, BL19] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

patterns.en: Phlegm and stasis obstructing the collaterals (chronic)
patterns.presentation: 頭痛反覆多年、痛處固定如刺或昏重、經期易發、胸悶噁心，舌暗或有瘀點苔膩、脈弦滑或澀
patterns.presentationEn: Years of recurrent headache, fixed stabbing or dull heavy pain, triggered by menstruation, chest oppression and nausea; dusky tongue or stasis spots with greasy coat, wiry slippery or choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Resolve phlegm and dispel stasis, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 太陽（阿是處刺絡放血）與風池通局部瘀阻；豐隆化痰；血海、膈俞（血會）活血化瘀；三陰交、太衝調肝脾、理氣血以治經期誘發。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taiyang (bled at the ashi point) and Fengchi free local obstruction; Fenglong resolves phlegm; Xuehai and Geshu (hui of blood) invigorate blood; Sanyinjiao and Taichong regulate Liver and Spleen for the menstrual trigger.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 胸背穴深刺有氣胸風險（風險區：thorax-pneumothorax）；若用，必須沿肋淺刺或改灸、拔罐。膈俞、肝俞對證但須淺刺。
wrong.en: Deep needling of chest or back points risks pneumothorax (risk zone: thorax-pneumothorax); if used they must be needled shallowly along the rib, or replaced by moxa or cupping. Geshu and Ganshu suit the pattern but must be shallow.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。解表穴對久病痰瘀無用。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Exterior-releasing points do nothing for chronic phlegm-stasis. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

patterns.presentation: 頭痛隱隱、時發時止、頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、五心煩熱、失眠，舌紅少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Intermittent dull headache, dizziness and tinnitus, weak aching lumbar region and knees, heat in the palms and soles, insomnia; red tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish the Liver and Kidney, pacify the Liver and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 太谿、三陰交滋腎養陰；太衝平肝；肝俞、腎俞補益肝腎之本；曲泉為肝經母穴（虛則補母）；風池、百會、四神聰輕刺清頭安神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi and Sanyinjiao enrich Kidney yin; Taichong pacifies the Liver; Ganshu and Shenshu tonify the root; Ququan is the Liver mother point; Fengchi, Baihui and Sishencong, needled gently, clear the head and calm the spirit.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。緩解期瀉火放血傷陰。［風險區 vessels-nerves：EX-HN5］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Reducing fire or bleeding during remission injures yin. [risk zone vessels-nerves: EX-HN5]

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸命門、關元助陽傷陰。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa on Mingmen or Guanyuan warms yang and scorches yin. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

combos.why: 局部（率谷、太陽、風池）加八脈交會對（外關、足臨泣）加平肝原穴太衝，是偏頭痛發作期的標準處方。
combos.whyEn: Local points (Shuaigu, Taiyang, Fengchi) plus the confluent pair (Waiguan, Zulinqi) plus Taichong to pacify the Liver: the standard prescription for a migraine attack.

combos.why: 絲竹空透率谷、太陽透率谷為偏頭痛經典透刺，風池疏風，內關止嘔止痛。
combos.whyEn: Sizhukong-through-Shuaigu and Taiyang-through-Shuaigu are the classic through-needlings for migraine; Fengchi disperses wind and Neiguan stops vomiting and pain.

combos.why: 滋腎平肝、健脾養血，配風池、百會輕刺以減少發作頻率。
combos.whyEn: Enrich the Kidney, pacify the Liver, fortify the Spleen and nourish blood, with gently needled Fengchi and Baihui to reduce attack frequency.

conditions.overview: 不寐病位在心，與肝、脾、腎、膽相關；病機為陽不入陰、神不守舍。實證：肝火擾心、痰熱內擾；虛證：心脾兩虛、心腎不交、心膽氣虛。基本方：神門、三陰交、百會、安眠、照海（補）、申脈（瀉），依證加減。
conditions.overviewEn: Insomnia is located in the Heart and involves the Liver, Spleen, Kidney and Gallbladder; the mechanism is yang failing to enter yin and the spirit not keeping to its abode. Excess: Liver fire or phlegm-heat harassing the Heart; deficiency: Heart-Spleen deficiency, Heart-Kidney non-communication, Heart-Gallbladder qi deficiency. Base prescription: HT7, SP6, GV20, EX-HN16, KI6 (tonify) and BL62 (reduce), modified by pattern.
conditions.redFlags: 失眠伴明顯憂鬱、自殺意念、精神病性症狀、躁狂（整夜不睡而精力旺盛）、嚴重睡眠呼吸中止（鼾聲、白天嗜睡）或新發於藥物／物質使用 → 轉精神科或睡眠醫學評估。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Insomnia with marked depression, suicidal ideation, psychotic symptoms, mania (no sleep yet abundant energy), significant sleep apnoea (snoring, daytime somnolence) or new onset with medication or substance use: refer to psychiatry or sleep medicine.

patterns.presentation: 多夢易醒、心悸健忘、神疲食少、面色少華，舌淡苔薄、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Dream-disturbed sleep with easy waking, palpitations, poor memory, fatigue and poor appetite, lustreless complexion; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Heart and Spleen, nourish blood and calm the spirit
patterns.rationale: 神門為心經原穴安神；三陰交、足三里、脾俞健脾生血；心俞養心；百會、安眠、四神聰鎮靜安神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shenmen, yuan of the Heart, calms the spirit; Sanyinjiao, Zusanli and Pishu fortify the Spleen to generate blood; Xinshu nourishes the Heart; Baihui, Anmian and Sishencong settle the spirit.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。瀉行間、少府、內庭清火，心脾虛者愈虛。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Reducing Xingjian, Shaofu or Neiting clears fire and further weakens Heart and Spleen.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。化痰利濕無益於血虛。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Phlegm- and damp-resolving points do not help blood deficiency. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

patterns.presentation: 心煩不寐、入睡困難、五心煩熱、頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、口乾，舌紅少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Vexation preventing sleep, difficulty falling asleep, heat in the palms and soles, dizziness and tinnitus, weak lumbar region and knees, dry mouth; red tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish yin and descend fire, reconnect Heart and Kidney
patterns.method: 補照海、太谿，瀉申脈、神門
patterns.methodEn: Tonify KI6 and KI3; reduce BL62 and HT7
patterns.rationale: 太谿滋腎陰、照海通陰蹻（補）、申脈通陽蹻（瀉），使陽入於陰；神門清心；心俞腎俞交通心腎；陰郄清心除煩止盜汗。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi enriches Kidney yin; Zhaohai (tonified) opens the yin qiao and Shenmai (reduced) restrains the yang qiao so yang enters yin; Shenmen clears the Heart; Xinshu with Shenshu reconnects Heart and Kidney; Yinxi clears the Heart and stops night sweats.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸命門、關元助火傷陰。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4、CV6］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa on Mingmen or Guanyuan adds fire and injures yin. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4, CV6]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。疏風解表穴與陰虛無關。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］［風險區 medulla：GB20］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Wind-releasing points are unrelated to yin deficiency. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4] [risk zone medulla: GB20]

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

patterns.presentation: 急躁易怒、不寐多夢、頭脹目赤、口苦口乾、便秘尿黃，舌紅苔黃、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Irritability, insomnia with many dreams, distending head and red eyes, bitter dry mouth, constipation and dark urine; red tongue with yellow coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Spread the Liver and drain fire, calm the Heart
patterns.rationale: 行間、俠谿為肝膽滎火穴，瀉之清肝膽之火；風池清頭；神門寧心；太衝疏肝；肝俞、膽俞淺刺瀉之。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xingjian and Xiaxi, ying-spring Fire points of Liver and Gallbladder, are reduced to clear their fire; Fengchi clears the head; Shenmen calms the Heart; Taichong spreads the Liver; Ganshu and Danshu are reduced shallowly.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。補脾胃氣血於肝火者助熱。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying Spleen-Stomach points while Liver fire rages adds heat. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸百會、關元助火上炎。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa on Baihui or Guanyuan fans the rising fire. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

patterns.presentation: 不寐、胸悶脘痞、頭重目眩、噁心噯氣、口苦痰多，苔黃膩、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Insomnia, chest and epigastric oppression, heavy head and dizziness, nausea and belching, bitter taste with copious phlegm; yellow greasy coat, slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and resolve phlegm, harmonise the middle and calm the spirit
patterns.rationale: 豐隆化痰、中脘和胃；內庭、厲兌清胃熱（「胃不和則臥不安」）；神門安神；內關寬胸；陰陵泉健脾滲濕治痰之源。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fenglong resolves phlegm and Zhongwan harmonises the stomach; Neiting and Lidui clear Stomach heat ('when the stomach is disharmonious, sleep is unquiet'); Shenmen calms the spirit; Neiguan expands the chest; Yinlingquan drains damp at the source of phlegm.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸脾俞、關元、足三里助熱生痰。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa on Pishu, Guanyuan or Zusanli feeds heat and phlegm. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.presentation: 不寐易驚、膽怯心悸、多夢易醒、氣短倦怠、遇事善恐，舌淡、脈弦細
patterns.presentationEn: Insomnia with easy startling, timidity and palpitations, dreams and easy waking, shortness of breath, fearfulness; pale tongue, wiry thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Boost qi and settle fright, calm the spirit and the will
patterns.rationale: 心俞、膽俞補心膽之氣；神門安神；丘墟為膽經原穴壯膽；百會、四神聰定志；足三里益氣。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xinshu and Danshu tonify Heart and Gallbladder qi; Shenmen calms the spirit; Qiuxu, yuan of the Gallbladder, strengthens resolve; Baihui and Sishencong settle the will; Zusanli boosts qi.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。瀉肝膽火於膽虛者更虛。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Reducing Liver-Gallbladder fire points further weakens the timid Gallbladder.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：ST25］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：ST25］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: ST25] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: ST25]

combos.why: 神門、三陰交養心調脾腎；百會、安眠鎮靜；補照海瀉申脈調陰陽蹻，使陽入於陰，為各型失眠基礎。
combos.whyEn: Shenmen and Sanyinjiao nourish the Heart and regulate Spleen and Kidney; Baihui and Anmian sedate; tonifying Zhaohai and reducing Shenmai balance the qiao vessels so yang enters yin - the base for all patterns.

combos.why: 俞穴與足三里、三陰交同補心脾，百會升清安神，宜加灸。
combos.whyEn: Back-shu points with Zusanli and Sanyinjiao tonify Heart and Spleen together; Baihui raises the clear and calms; add moxa.

combos.why: 太谿、照海滋陰，神門、申脈瀉陽，心俞腎俞前後相應，使水火既濟。
combos.whyEn: Taixi and Zhaohai enrich yin; Shenmen and Shenmai restrain yang; Xinshu and Shenshu correspond front to back so Water and Fire meet.

conditions.overview: 「諸風掉眩，皆屬於肝」、「無痰不作眩」、「無虛不作眩」：眩暈分實（肝陽上亢、痰濕中阻、瘀血阻竅）與虛（氣血虧虛、腎精不足）。基本方：百會、風池、內關，實者配太衝、豐隆，虛者配足三里、肝俞、腎俞。
conditions.overviewEn: 'All wind, shaking and dizziness belong to the Liver', 'no phlegm, no dizziness', 'no deficiency, no dizziness': vertigo divides into excess (Liver yang rising, phlegm-damp obstructing the middle, blood stasis blocking the orifices) and deficiency (qi-blood deficiency, Kidney essence insufficiency). Base prescription: GV20, GB20, PC6; excess adds LR3 and ST40, deficiency adds ST36, BL18 and BL23.
conditions.redFlags: 中樞性眩暈徵象：突發伴複視、構音障礙、吞嚥困難、肢體無力麻木、步態不穩、劇烈頭痛、意識改變；突發單側聽力喪失；心律不整或暈厥；頸部外傷後眩暈 → 急診評估中風、後循環病變。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Signs of central vertigo: sudden onset with diplopia, dysarthria, dysphagia, limb weakness or numbness, gait ataxia, severe headache or altered consciousness; sudden unilateral hearing loss; arrhythmia or syncope; vertigo after neck trauma: emergency assessment for stroke and posterior-circulation disease.

patterns.presentation: 眩暈耳鳴、頭脹痛、遇煩勞惱怒加重、面紅目赤、急躁、口苦、失眠，舌紅苔黃、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Dizziness and tinnitus, distending headache worse with stress or anger, red face and eyes, irritability, bitter taste, insomnia; red tongue with yellow coat, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Pacify the Liver and subdue yang, enrich Water to nourish Wood
patterns.rationale: 風池、百會清利頭目（百會針刺不灸）；太衝、行間、俠谿瀉肝膽之亢；太谿補腎水以涵木；內關、印堂寧神止嘔。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fengchi and Baihui clear the head (Baihui needled, never moxa'd here); Taichong, Xingjian and Xiaxi reduce the hyperactive Liver-Gallbladder; Taixi tonifies Kidney Water to nourish Wood; Neiguan and Yintang calm the spirit and stop nausea.

wrong.zh: 升提、助陽之穴（或灸）用於肝陽上亢、火熱上擾，助陽上衝：頭痛眩暈加劇、血壓上升。灸百會、氣海、命門。［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Lifting or yang-assisting points (or moxa) in Liver-yang rising or fire flaring push yang further upward: headache and dizziness intensify and blood pressure climbs. Moxa on Baihui, Qihai or Mingmen. [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。補法用於肝陽亢盛助火。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18、BL20］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying method here feeds the hyperactive yang. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18, BL20]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12]

patterns.presentation: 眩暈頭重如裹、胸悶噁心、嘔吐痰涎、食少多寐，苔白膩、脈濡滑
patterns.presentationEn: Dizziness with a heavy wrapped head, chest oppression and nausea, phlegmy vomiting, poor appetite and somnolence; white greasy coat, soggy slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and resolve phlegm, dispel damp and stop dizziness
patterns.rationale: 頭維、風池、百會清利頭目；中脘、豐隆、陰陵泉為化痰除濕主穴；足三里、脾俞健運中焦以絕痰源；內關止嘔。
patterns.rationaleEn: Touwei, Fengchi and Baihui clear the head; Zhongwan, Fenglong and Yinlingquan are the main phlegm-damp points; Zusanli and Pishu strengthen the middle to cut the source of phlegm; Neiguan stops vomiting.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。瀉火放血與痰濕無關。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Fire-draining or bleeding has nothing to do with phlegm-damp.

wrong.zh: 胸背穴深刺有氣胸風險（風險區：thorax-pneumothorax）；若用，必須沿肋淺刺或改灸、拔罐。脾俞、胃俞對證，須淺刺。
wrong.en: Deep needling of chest or back points risks pneumothorax (risk zone: thorax-pneumothorax); if used they must be needled shallowly along the rib, or replaced by moxa or cupping. Pishu and Weishu fit the pattern but must be shallow.

patterns.presentation: 眩暈動則加劇、勞累即發、面白無華、唇甲不華、心悸失眠、神疲懶言，舌淡、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Dizziness worse on movement and exertion, pale lustreless complexion, pale lips and nails, palpitations, insomnia, fatigue; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify qi and blood, strengthen the Spleen and Stomach
patterns.rationale: 百會灸之升清；足三里、三陰交、脾俞、胃俞補益後天以生氣血；氣海、關元補氣；膈俞養血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Moxa on Baihui raises the clear; Zusanli, Sanyinjiao, Pishu and Weishu tonify the postnatal root to make qi and blood; Qihai and Guanyuan tonify qi; Geshu nourishes blood.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。瀉肝膽於虛者更虛。［風險區 vessels-nerves：EX-HN5］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Reducing Liver-Gallbladder points in deficiency depletes further. [risk zone vessels-nerves: EX-HN5]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。化痰利水耗氣血。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
