wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Phlegm- and water-draining consume qi and blood. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

patterns.presentation: 眩暈日久、耳鳴耳聾、腰膝痠軟、健忘、遺精或月經量少；偏陰虛者五心煩熱、偏陽虛者畏寒肢冷
patterns.presentationEn: Long-standing dizziness, tinnitus or deafness, weak lumbar region and knees, poor memory, seminal emission or scanty menses; with heat in the palms and soles if yin-leaning, cold limbs if yang-leaning
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Kidney and replenish essence, fill the brain and marrow
patterns.method: 補法；陽虛加灸，陰虛不灸
patterns.methodEn: Tonifying; add moxa for yang deficiency, none for yin deficiency
patterns.rationale: 太谿、腎俞補腎；懸鐘為髓會，填髓止眩；百會、風池引氣上達；三陰交、關元補益下元；陽虛加灸命門。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi and Shenshu tonify the Kidney; Xuanzhong, hui of marrow, fills the marrow; Baihui and Fengchi guide qi upward; Sanyinjiao and Guanyuan tonify the lower origin; moxa Mingmen for yang deficiency.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］［風險區 kidney-region：BL22］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9] [risk zone kidney-region: BL22]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

combos.why: 百會、風池清頭目，內關止嘔定眩，太衝平肝，足三里健脾，虛實皆可為基礎。
combos.whyEn: Baihui and Fengchi clear the head, Neiguan stops nausea and steadies, Taichong pacifies the Liver, Zusanli fortifies the Spleen - a base for both excess and deficiency.

combos.why: 瀉肝膽、補腎水、印堂寧神。
combos.whyEn: Reduce Liver-Gallbladder, tonify Kidney Water, Yintang calms the spirit.

combos.why: 化痰除濕與清利頭目並行。
combos.whyEn: Resolve phlegm-damp while clearing the head.

conditions.overview: 中風分中經絡（無神志改變）與中臟腑（昏迷，閉證／脫證）。急性期為西醫急救範疇；針灸主要用於恢復期與後遺症期之偏癱、口喎、失語、吞嚥困難。治以醒腦開竅、疏通經絡，取患側陽經穴為主（「治痿獨取陽明」），配合健側（巨刺）。病機：肝陽暴亢、風痰阻絡、氣虛血瘀、陰虛風動。
conditions.overviewEn: Stroke is classified as channel-level (no change in consciousness) or organ-level (coma: closed or collapse pattern). The acute phase belongs to emergency medicine; acupuncture is mainly for hemiplegia, facial deviation, aphasia and dysphagia in the recovery and sequelae phases. Treatment awakens the brain, opens the orifices and frees the channels, mainly yang-channel points on the affected side ('for wei, take yangming alone'), with contralateral needling. Mechanisms: Liver yang surging, wind-phlegm obstructing the collaterals, qi deficiency with blood stasis, yin deficiency stirring wind.
conditions.redFlags: 急性期（突發口角歪斜、單側肢體無力、言語不清、劇烈頭痛、意識改變）為溶栓／取栓時間窗內之急症，立即送急診，不得以針灸延誤；復發徵象、新發頭痛、血壓極高、吞嚥困難伴嗆咳肺炎徵象 → 轉診。脫證（汗出肢冷、二便失禁）以急救為先，灸關元神闕僅為輔助。
conditions.redFlagsEn: The acute phase (sudden facial droop, unilateral limb weakness, slurred speech, severe headache, altered consciousness) is an emergency within the thrombolysis/thrombectomy window: send to the emergency department immediately and never delay with acupuncture. Signs of recurrence, new headache, extreme blood pressure, or dysphagia with aspiration pneumonia: refer. In the collapse pattern (sweating, cold limbs, incontinence) resuscitation comes first; moxa at Guanyuan and Shenque is only an adjunct.

patterns.zh: 中經絡—半身不遂（氣虛血瘀）
patterns.en: Channel stroke - hemiplegia (qi deficiency with blood stasis)
patterns.presentation: 一側肢體軟弱無力或偏癱、肢體麻木、面色萎黃、氣短乏力、舌暗淡或有瘀斑、脈細澀
patterns.presentationEn: Unilateral limb weakness or hemiplegia, numbness, sallow complexion, shortness of breath and fatigue; dusky pale tongue with stasis marks, thin choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Boost qi and invigorate blood, free the channels and collaterals
patterns.method: 患側平補平瀉或補法，可配健側巨刺；加灸氣海、足三里
patterns.methodEn: Even or tonifying method on the affected side, with contralateral needling; moxa Qihai and Zusanli
patterns.rationale: 上肢取肩髃、曲池、外關、合谷，下肢取環跳、陽陵泉（筋會）、足三里、解谿，均為手足陽明少陽之穴（治痿取陽明）；百會、風池醒腦息風；內關、三陰交為醒腦開竅法之主穴；氣海、血海益氣活血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Arm: Jianyu, Quchi, Waiguan, Hegu; leg: Huantiao, Yanglingquan (hui of sinews), Zusanli, Jiexi - all yangming and shaoyang points ('for wei take yangming'); Baihui and Fengchi awaken the brain and extinguish wind; Neiguan and Sanyinjiao are the core of the 'awakening the brain' method; Qihai and Xuehai boost qi and move blood.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。氣虛血瘀者瀉火放血更傷氣。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Fire-draining or bleeding in qi deficiency with stasis injures qi further.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：陰經滎穴主清熱，不主肢體痿廢； 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Yin-channel ying-spring points clear heat and do not govern limb paralysis; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor.

wrong.zh: 出現紅旗徵象時，針灸不是答案：任何穴位（包括這些）都不應取代急救或轉診，延誤即是傷害。急性期出現時以急診為先。
wrong.en: When red flags are present acupuncture is not the answer: no point (including these) may replace emergency care or referral; delay itself is harm. When the acute phase appears, emergency care comes first.

patterns.zh: 中經絡—肝陽暴亢、風痰阻絡
patterns.en: Channel stroke - Liver yang surging with wind-phlegm
patterns.presentation: 半身不遂、口舌喎斜、眩暈頭痛、面紅目赤、煩躁、痰多、舌紅苔黃膩、脈弦滑
patterns.presentationEn: Hemiplegia, deviated mouth and tongue, dizziness and headache, red face and eyes, agitation, copious phlegm; red tongue with yellow greasy coat, wiry slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Pacify the Liver and extinguish wind, resolve phlegm and free the collaterals
patterns.rationale: 風池、太衝平肝息風；豐隆化痰；曲池、外關、陽陵泉、環跳疏通患側經絡；太谿滋水涵木；地倉、頰車治口喎。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fengchi and Taichong pacify the Liver and extinguish wind; Fenglong resolves phlegm; Quchi, Waiguan, Yanglingquan and Huantiao free the affected limbs; Taixi enriches Water to nourish Wood; Dicang and Jiache treat the deviated mouth.

wrong.zh: 升提、助陽之穴（或灸）用於肝陽上亢、火熱上擾，助陽上衝：頭痛眩暈加劇、血壓上升。灸百會、關元、命門、氣海於肝陽暴亢者助陽升。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4、CV6］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Lifting or yang-assisting points (or moxa) in Liver-yang rising or fire flaring push yang further upward: headache and dizziness intensify and blood pressure climbs. Moxa on Baihui, Guanyuan, Mingmen or Qihai lifts yang in a surging-yang patient. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4, CV6] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。肝腎補法於風痰盛時非所宜。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying Liver-Kidney points is wrong while wind-phlegm is exuberant. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 枕下穴朝內上方深刺可傷延髓（風險區：medulla），此處針向與深度錯誤屬危險選擇。對證，但針向錯誤則危險。
wrong.en: Suboccipital points directed deep inward-upward can injure the medulla (risk zone: medulla); wrong direction or depth here is a dangerous choice. Correct, but dangerous with the wrong direction.

patterns.presentation: 言語不清或不能言、舌強、流涎、吞嚥困難，多伴偏癱
patterns.presentationEn: Slurred speech or inability to speak, stiff tongue, drooling, dysphagia, usually with hemiplegia
patterns.principleEn: Awaken the brain and open the orifices, free the tongue collaterals
patterns.method: 平補平瀉；金津玉液點刺出血；啞門刺法須嚴格
patterns.methodEn: Even method; prick Jinjin/Yuye to bleed; Yamen needled with strict technique
patterns.rationale: 廉泉、金津玉液直通舌本；通里為心經絡穴「繫舌本」；啞門為治失語專穴；翳風、風池助吞嚥；百會、內關醒腦。
patterns.rationaleEn: Lianquan and Jinjin/Yuye reach the root of the tongue directly; Tongli, luo of the Heart, is 'tied to the tongue root'; Yamen is the specific point for aphasia; Yifeng and Fengchi help swallowing; Baihui and Neiguan awaken the brain.

wrong.zh: 枕下穴朝內上方深刺可傷延髓（風險區：medulla），此處針向與深度錯誤屬危險選擇。啞門、風府深刺向上可傷延髓。
wrong.en: Suboccipital points directed deep inward-upward can injure the medulla (risk zone: medulla); wrong direction or depth here is a dangerous choice. Deep upward needling of Yamen or Fengfu can injure the medulla.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：下肢穴與舌竅無關， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 vessels-nerves：GB30、BL40、ST41］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Leg points have no relation to the tongue; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone vessels-nerves: GB30, BL40, ST41]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：ST25］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：ST25、CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: ST25] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: ST25, CV12]

patterns.presentation: 突然昏仆、目合口張、鼻鼾息微、手撒肢冷、汗出如油、二便失禁，脈微欲絕
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden collapse, closed eyes and open mouth, snoring with feeble breath, limp hands and cold limbs, oily sweat, incontinence; faint pulse
patterns.principle: 回陽固脫（同時急救送醫）
patterns.principleEn: Restore yang and secure against collapse (simultaneous emergency care)
patterns.method: 大艾炷灸關元、神闕（隔鹽），不拘壯數；此為急救輔助，立即送醫
patterns.methodEn: Large moxa cones on Guanyuan and salt-insulated Shenque without counting; adjunct to immediate emergency transfer
patterns.rationale: 關元、氣海為元氣所在，神闕隔鹽灸回陽救逆；百會、足三里、命門助陽固脫。針刺瀉法此時絕對禁忌。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan and Qihai hold the original qi; salt moxa at Shenque restores yang and rescues from collapse; Baihui, Zusanli and Mingmen support yang. Reducing needling is absolutely forbidden here.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。開竅瀉法（水溝、十宣放血）為閉證所用，脫證用之氣散而亡。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Orifice-opening reducing methods (Shuigou, bleeding Shixuan) belong to the closed pattern; in collapse they scatter the last qi.

wrong.zh: 出現紅旗徵象時，針灸不是答案：任何穴位（包括這些）都不應取代急救或轉診，延誤即是傷害。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: When red flags are present acupuncture is not the answer: no point (including these) may replace emergency care or referral; delay itself is harm. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

combos.why: 上下肢陽經要穴並取，患側為主，依「治痿取陽明」與「筋會陽陵」原則。
combos.whyEn: Key yang-channel points for both limbs, affected side first, on the principles 'for wei take yangming' and 'sinews meet at Yanglingquan'.

combos.why: 以水溝、內關、三陰交為主，極泉、尺澤、委中為輔，醒腦開竅、滋補肝腎、疏通經絡（石學敏法）。
combos.whyEn: Shuigou, Neiguan and Sanyinjiao as principals with Jiquan, Chize and Weizhong as assistants: awaken the brain, nourish Liver-Kidney and free the channels (Shi Xuemin's method).

combos.why: 舌本與咽喉局部配心經絡穴，風池翳風利咽，百會醒腦。
combos.whyEn: Local tongue-throat points with the Heart luo point; Fengchi and Yifeng benefit the throat; Baihui awakens the brain.

conditions.overview: 口眼喎斜：病在面部陽明、少陽經筋，多因正氣不足、脈絡空虛，風寒或風熱之邪乘虛侵襲。急性期（一週內）面部穴宜少、淺、輕，以遠端穴為主；恢復期加強局部透刺與電針；後遺症期補益氣血、活血通絡。
conditions.overviewEn: Deviation of the eye and mouth: a disorder of the yangming and shaoyang sinew channels of the face, usually from deficient upright qi leaving the collaterals empty for wind-cold or wind-heat to invade. In the acute phase (first week) use few, shallow, light facial points and rely on distal points; in recovery add local through-needling and electroacupuncture; in the sequelae phase tonify qi and blood and invigorate the collaterals.
conditions.redFlags: 中樞性面癱（額紋保留、可皺眉，伴肢體無力或言語障礙）為中風徵象 → 急診；伴耳部疱疹（Ramsay Hunt）、聽力改變、腮腺腫塊、緩慢進行性或雙側面癱、外傷後 → 轉診耳鼻喉／神經科。急性期須抗病毒／類固醇治療與眼睛保護，不可單靠針灸。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Central facial palsy (forehead spared, able to frown, with limb weakness or speech disturbance) signals stroke: emergency referral. Vesicles in the ear (Ramsay Hunt), hearing change, parotid mass, slowly progressive or bilateral palsy, or trauma: refer to ENT or neurology. The acute phase requires antiviral/steroid treatment and eye protection; acupuncture alone is insufficient.

patterns.presentation: 突然口眼喎斜、面部緊繃或拘急、受涼後發病、耳後痛，苔薄白、脈浮緊
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden deviation of mouth and eye, tight facial feeling, onset after exposure to cold, retroauricular pain; thin white coat, floating tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, activate the channel
patterns.method: 遠端瀉法；面部穴淺刺輕刺激，可加溫和灸
patterns.methodEn: Reduce distal points; facial points shallow and light, with gentle moxa
patterns.rationale: 合谷（對側，面口合谷收）與風池、列缺疏散風寒；翳風為面神經出口處局部要穴；陽白、地倉、頰車、四白、顴髎為面部經筋局部穴，急性期輕刺。
patterns.rationaleEn: Hegu (contralateral - 'face and mouth collect at Hegu'), Fengchi and Lieque dispel wind-cold; Yifeng is the local key point at the facial-nerve exit; Yangbai, Dicang, Jiache, Sibai and Quanliao are local sinew-channel points, needled lightly in the acute phase.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：太陽經下肢穴與面部陽明少陽經筋無涉， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Taiyang leg points have no bearing on the facial yangming-shaoyang sinews; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

patterns.presentation: 口眼喎斜、耳後疼痛明顯、或伴耳內疱疹、發熱咽痛、口乾，舌紅苔薄黃、脈浮數
patterns.presentationEn: Deviation with marked retroauricular pain, possibly vesicles in the ear, fever and sore throat, dry mouth; red tongue with thin yellow coat, floating rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and clear heat, free the collaterals
patterns.methodEn: Reduce distal points; shallow facial needling
patterns.rationale: 合谷、曲池清陽明之熱；外關清少陽風熱；大椎退熱；內庭清胃經熱上攻面部；翳風、陽白、地倉局部。
patterns.rationaleEn: Hegu and Quchi clear yangming heat; Waiguan clears shaoyang wind-heat; Dazhui reduces fever; Neiting clears Stomach heat attacking the face; Yifeng, Yangbai and Dicang locally.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。風門、風池、大椎加灸或溫法於風熱者助熱。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa or warming at Fengmen, Fengchi or Dazhui in wind-heat feeds the heat. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：SP6、CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: SP6, CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 急性期局部強刺激或深刺，加重局部氣血壅滯、腫脹出血；急性期宜先取遠端、健側穴（繆刺），局部輕刺或不刺。［風險區 eye：ST2］
wrong.en: Strong or deep local needling in the acute phase worsens local stagnation, swelling and bleeding; the acute phase calls first for distal and contralateral points (miuci), with light or no local needling. [risk zone eye: ST2]

patterns.zh: 氣血不足（恢復／後遺症期）
patterns.presentation: 病程超過數週、面肌鬆弛無力或連帶運動、面部麻木、神疲乏力，舌淡、脈細
patterns.presentationEn: Course over several weeks, flaccid weak facial muscles or synkinesis, facial numbness, fatigue; pale tongue, thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify qi and blood, invigorate blood and free the collaterals
patterns.method: 局部透刺（地倉透頰車、陽白透魚腰）配合電針；足三里、三陰交補法加灸
patterns.methodEn: Local through-needling (Dicang to Jiache, Yangbai to Yuyao) with electroacupuncture; tonify and moxa Zusanli and Sanyinjiao
patterns.rationale: 足三里、三陰交、氣海補益氣血以榮經筋；血海活血；面部透刺激發經氣、恢復肌力；合谷、翳風遠近配合。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli, Sanyinjiao and Qihai tonify qi and blood to nourish the sinews; Xuehai moves blood; facial through-needling rouses channel qi and muscle tone; Hegu and Yifeng combine distal and local.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。清熱瀉法於氣血虛者無益反害。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Heat-clearing reducing points harm the deficient patient. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：下肢穴（非足三里、三陰交之補益作用者）與面部經筋無關， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3、BL40］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Leg points other than the tonifying ST36/SP6 have no relation to the facial sinews; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3, BL40]

combos.why: 陽白、四白、顴髎、頰車、地倉覆蓋額、眼、頰、口各區經筋，翳風為神經出口局部，合谷取對側為遠端總穴。
combos.whyEn: Yangbai, Sibai, Quanliao, Jiache and Dicang cover the forehead, eye, cheek and mouth sinews; Yifeng is local to the nerve exit; contralateral Hegu is the distal command point.

combos.why: 急性期以遠端疏風為主，面部僅翳風、陽白輕刺。
combos.whyEn: In the acute phase rely on distal wind-dispelling points, with only Yifeng and Yangbai needled lightly on the face.

combos.why: 地倉透頰車、陽白透魚腰激發經筋，足三里、三陰交補益氣血。
combos.whyEn: Dicang-through-Jiache and Yangbai-through-Yuyao rouse the sinews; Zusanli and Sanyinjiao tonify qi and blood.

conditions.overview: 面痛多屬陽明、少陽、太陽經之病，分支取穴：第一支（眼）取攢竹、陽白、絲竹空、頭維；第二支（上頜）取四白、顴髎、迎香、下關；第三支（下頜）取頰車、承漿、翳風、下關。證型：風寒、風熱、肝胃鬱熱、氣血瘀滯。遠端以合谷、內庭、太衝為主。
conditions.overviewEn: Facial pain belongs to the yangming, shaoyang and taiyang channels, and points follow the branch: ophthalmic - BL2, GB14, TE23, ST8; maxillary - ST2, SI18, LI20, ST7; mandibular - ST6, CV24, TE17, ST7. Patterns: wind-cold, wind-heat, Liver-Stomach constrained heat, qi and blood stasis. Distal points centre on LI4, ST44 and LR3.
conditions.redFlags: 年輕患者新發、雙側疼痛、伴面部感覺缺損、角膜反射消失、其他顱神經症狀、聽力下降、持續性而非發作性疼痛 → MRI 排除腫瘤、多發性硬化、血管壓迫；牙源性疼痛先轉牙科。
conditions.redFlagsEn: New onset in a young patient, bilateral pain, facial sensory loss, absent corneal reflex, other cranial-nerve signs, hearing loss, or constant rather than paroxysmal pain: MRI to exclude tumour, multiple sclerosis or vascular compression; dental pain goes to the dentist first.

patterns.presentation: 面痛突發如刀割、遇風寒誘發加重、得溫稍減、面部拘急，苔薄白、脈浮緊
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden knife-like facial pain triggered by wind or cold, slightly eased by warmth, facial tightness; thin white coat, floating tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.methodEn: Reducing method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 下關、四白為面部各支共用局部穴；合谷為面口總穴（對側）；風池、列缺散風寒；依分支加攢竹（I）、顴髎（II）、頰車（III）。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xiaguan and Sibai are local points shared by the branches; Hegu commands the face (contralateral); Fengchi and Lieque scatter wind-cold; add Cuanzhu (V1), Quanliao (V2) or Jiache (V3) by branch.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：下肢足太陽少陽穴不主面痛， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：GB34、BL40］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Leg taiyang/shaoyang points do not govern facial pain; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: GB34, BL40]

patterns.presentation: 面痛灼熱如火燎、煩躁易怒、口苦口臭、牙齦腫痛、便秘，舌紅苔黃、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Burning scorching facial pain, irritability, bitter taste and halitosis, swollen gums, constipation; red tongue with yellow coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear the Liver and drain the Stomach, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 內庭瀉胃火（陽明經上行於面）、行間瀉肝火；合谷、曲池清陽明；下關、四白、顴髎局部；外關、俠谿清少陽。
patterns.rationaleEn: Neiting drains Stomach fire (yangming ascends to the face) and Xingjian drains Liver fire; Hegu and Quchi clear yangming; Xiaguan, Sibai and Quanliao locally; Waiguan and Xiaxi clear shaoyang.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸足三里、中脘、胃俞助胃熱。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL21］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa on Zusanli, Zhongwan or Weishu feeds Stomach heat. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL21]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12]

patterns.presentation: 面痛反覆多年、痛如針刺、固定不移、夜間加重、面色晦暗，舌暗有瘀斑、脈細澀
patterns.presentationEn: Years of recurrent stabbing pain, fixed location, worse at night, dusky complexion; dark tongue with stasis spots, thin choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Invigorate blood and dispel stasis, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 四關（合谷配太衝）行氣活血止痛；膈俞（血會）、血海、三陰交活血化瘀；下關、四白、顴髎局部；內關鎮痛寧神。
patterns.rationaleEn: The Four Gates (Hegu with Taichong) move qi and blood and stop pain; Geshu (hui of blood), Xuehai and Sanyinjiao dispel stasis; Xiaguan, Sibai and Quanliao locally; Neiguan relieves pain and calms.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。久病瘀阻而無熱象者，清熱放血徒傷正。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. With chronic stasis and no heat signs, heat-clearing or bleeding merely injures the upright qi.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

combos.why: 下關、四白、頰車覆蓋第二、三支，合谷、內庭清陽明，太衝疏肝止痛（四關）。
combos.whyEn: Xiaguan, Sibai and Jiache cover V2 and V3; Hegu and Neiting clear yangming; Taichong spreads the Liver and stops pain (Four Gates).

combos.why: 眼眶上緣局部穴配合谷、風池。
combos.whyEn: Supraorbital local points with Hegu and Fengchi.

combos.why: 瀉陽明與肝火為主，局部輔之。
combos.whyEn: Drain yangming and Liver fire, with local assistance.

conditions.overview: 項痛屬太陽（天柱、後谿、崑崙）、少陽（風池、肩井、懸鐘、外關）、督脈（大椎、後谿）。落枕為急性經筋拘急，取遠端動氣（外勞宮、後谿、懸鐘）配局部阿是；頸椎病分型：神經根型加上肢循經穴，椎動脈型加百會太陽，脊髓型須轉診。證型：風寒痹阻、氣滯血瘀、肝腎不足。
conditions.overviewEn: Nuchal pain belongs to taiyang (BL10, SI3, BL60), shaoyang (GB20, GB21, GB39, TE5) and the Governor vessel (GV14, SI3). Acute stiff neck is an acute sinew spasm: distal points with movement (EX-UE8, SI3, GB39) plus local ashi points. Cervical spondylosis: radicular type adds channel points on the arm, vertebral-artery type adds GV20 and EX-HN5, myelopathic type must be referred. Patterns: wind-cold bi, qi stagnation and blood stasis, Liver-Kidney deficiency.
conditions.redFlags: 脊髓型徵象（步態不穩、雙手精細動作障礙、下肢痙攣、大小便改變、病理反射）、外傷後頸痛、發燒伴頸僵、進行性肌無力或肌萎縮、夜間痛與體重減輕 → 影像與外科評估，非針灸適應。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Myelopathic signs (unsteady gait, loss of fine hand movement, leg spasticity, bladder or bowel change, pathological reflexes), neck pain after trauma, fever with neck stiffness, progressive weakness or atrophy, night pain with weight loss: imaging and surgical assessment; not an acupuncture indication.

patterns.presentation: 晨起頸項強痛、轉側不利、一側項肌痙攣壓痛、多因睡姿不當或受涼
patterns.presentationEn: Stiff painful neck on waking, restricted rotation, unilateral spasm and tenderness, usually after awkward sleep or cold exposure
patterns.principleEn: Relax the sinews, activate the channel and stop pain
patterns.method: 先取遠端穴瀉法並令患者緩慢轉動頸部（動氣針法），後取局部
patterns.methodEn: Reduce distal points first while the patient slowly rotates the neck (needling with movement), then local points
patterns.rationale: 外勞宮（落枕穴）、後谿（通督、主頸項）、懸鐘（髓會、少陽）為落枕遠端三要穴，動氣針法效佳；養老為小腸經郄穴治急痛；風池、天柱、肩井局部。
patterns.rationaleEn: Wailaogong (Luozhen), Houxi (confluent of the Governor vessel, governs the nape) and Xuanzhong (hui of marrow, shaoyang) are the three distal key points, best with movement; Yanglao, xi-cleft of the Small Intestine, treats acute pain; Fengchi, Tianzhu and Jianjing locally.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡，所取之經不過病所。 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points - the channel chosen does not pass through the affected region. Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

patterns.presentation: 頸項僵痛、遇寒加重得溫減、肩背沉重、或上肢麻木，苔白膩、脈弦緊
patterns.presentationEn: Stiff painful neck worse in cold and eased by warmth, heavy shoulders and back, possibly arm numbness; white greasy coat, wiry tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, eliminate damp and free the collaterals
patterns.methodEn: Reducing method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 頸夾脊、天柱、風池局部通絡；大椎為諸陽之會、散寒通陽（宜灸）；後谿通督脈主頸項；風門散風寒；外關、合谷治上肢放射。
patterns.rationaleEn: Cervical jiaji, Tianzhu and Fengchi free the local collaterals; Dazhui, meeting of all yang, scatters cold and frees yang (moxa suits it); Houxi opens the Governor vessel; Fengmen scatters wind-cold; Waiguan and Hegu treat radiation to the arm.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

patterns.presentation: 頸痛綿綿、反覆發作、頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、手指麻木無力，舌淡紅、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Lingering recurrent neck pain, dizziness and tinnitus, weak lumbar region and knees, numb weak fingers; pale red tongue, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Liver and Kidney, strengthen sinews and bones
patterns.rationale: 懸鐘（髓會）、大杼（骨會）補髓壯骨；太谿、腎俞、肝俞補肝腎；陽陵泉（筋會）柔筋；頸夾脊、風池局部；足三里補後天。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xuanzhong (hui of marrow) and Dazhu (hui of bone) fill marrow and strengthen bone; Taixi, Shenshu and Ganshu tonify Liver-Kidney; Yanglingquan (hui of sinews) softens the sinews; cervical jiaji and Fengchi locally; Zusanli tonifies the postnatal root.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。強刺瀉法傷正。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：GB21］［風險區 pregnancy：GB21］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong reducing injures the upright qi. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: GB21] [risk zone pregnancy: GB21] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14] [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

combos.why: 三遠端穴配合轉頸，再加風池、天柱局部。
combos.whyEn: Three distal points with neck rotation, then Fengchi and Tianzhu locally.

combos.why: 夾脊、風池、天柱、大椎局部，後谿、懸鐘遠端，肩井淺刺。
combos.whyEn: Jiaji, Fengchi, Tianzhu and Dazhui locally; Houxi and Xuanzhong distally; Jianjing shallow.

combos.why: 頸部局部加上肢陽明少陽循經穴治放射痛麻。
combos.whyEn: Local neck points plus yangming-shaoyang arm points for radiating pain and numbness.

conditions.overview: 肩痛循經辨位：肩前陽明（肩髃、合谷、曲池）、肩外少陽（肩髎、外關）、肩後太陽（肩貞、臑俞、後谿）；「肩三針」肩髃、肩髎、肩貞為局部標準。遠端條口透承山（令患者活動肩關節）為經典上下配穴。證型：風寒濕痹、氣滯血瘀、氣血虧虛。
conditions.overviewEn: Locate the pain by channel: anterior shoulder yangming (LI15, LI4, LI11), lateral shoulder shaoyang (TE14, TE5), posterior shoulder taiyang (SI9, SI10, SI3); the 'three shoulder needles' LI15, TE14 and SI9 are the local standard. Distal Tiaokou-through-Chengshan with active shoulder movement is the classic upper-lower pairing. Patterns: wind-cold-damp bi, qi stagnation and blood stasis, qi and blood deficiency.
conditions.redFlags: 外傷後劇痛畸形（脫位、骨折）、紅腫熱痛伴發燒（化膿性關節炎）、夜間痛伴體重減輕或腫瘤史、肩痛伴胸悶冷汗（心肌缺血放射痛）、進行性肌萎縮 → 影像／急診評估。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Severe pain with deformity after trauma (dislocation, fracture), red hot swollen joint with fever (septic arthritis), night pain with weight loss or cancer history, shoulder pain with chest oppression and cold sweat (referred cardiac ischaemia), progressive muscle wasting: imaging or emergency assessment.

patterns.presentation: 肩痛遇寒加重、得溫則減、夜間痛甚、活動受限、肩部沉重，苔白、脈弦緊
patterns.presentationEn: Shoulder pain worse in cold and eased by warmth, severe at night, restricted movement, heaviness; white coat, wiry tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, eliminate damp and free the collaterals
patterns.method: 瀉法加灸，條口透承山時令患者活動肩關節
patterns.methodEn: Reducing with moxa; have the patient move the shoulder while Tiaokou is needled through to Chengshan
patterns.rationale: 肩三針溫通局部；條口透承山為肩痛遠端經典；曲池、外關循經；陽陵泉筋會舒筋；風門散風寒；灸法溫經散寒。
patterns.rationaleEn: The three shoulder needles warm and free the local region; Tiaokou-through-Chengshan is the classic distal method; Quchi and Waiguan follow the channels; Yanglingquan (hui of sinews) relaxes sinews; Fengmen scatters wind-cold; moxa warms the channel.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。曲池用瀉法清熱配合可，但以清熱為目的之組合於寒痹不宜。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Quchi can serve as a channel point, but a heat-clearing combination is wrong in cold bi. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6、CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6, CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡，所取之經不過病所。 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：GB30、KI3］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points - the channel chosen does not pass through the affected region. Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: GB30, KI3]

patterns.presentation: 肩痛如刺、痛處固定拒按、夜間加重、活動時劇痛、或有外傷史，舌暗有瘀點、脈弦澀
patterns.presentationEn: Stabbing fixed pain refusing pressure, worse at night and on movement, possibly after injury; dusky tongue with stasis spots, wiry choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Invigorate blood and dispel stasis, move qi and stop pain
patterns.method: 瀉法，阿是穴可刺絡拔罐
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; ashi points may be bled and cupped
patterns.rationale: 肩三針局部；膈俞、血海活血；四關（合谷太衝）行氣止痛；條口透承山；天宗為肩後阿是常見處。
patterns.rationaleEn: Three shoulder needles locally; Geshu and Xuehai move blood; the Four Gates move qi and stop pain; Tiaokou to Chengshan; Tianzong is a common posterior ashi point.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

patterns.presentation: 肩痛日久、痠痛無力、肌肉萎縮、活動受限、勞累加重、面色少華，舌淡、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Long-standing dull weak pain, muscle wasting, restricted movement, worse with fatigue, lustreless complexion; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify qi and blood, relax the sinews and free the collaterals
patterns.rationale: 肩三針輕刺加灸溫養局部；足三里、三陰交、氣海、關元、脾俞補益氣血；陽陵泉柔筋；手三里循經。
patterns.rationaleEn: Three shoulder needles gently needled and moxa'd to warm the region; Zusanli, Sanyinjiao, Qihai, Guanyuan and Pishu tonify qi and blood; Yanglingquan softens sinews; Shousanli follows the channel.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.
