Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3, GB30]

combos.why: 三經局部要穴加條口透承山（動氣）與筋會陽陵泉。
combos.whyEn: Local points of three channels plus Tiaokou-through-Chengshan with movement and Yanglingquan, hui of sinews.

combos.why: 肩前痛循陽明經取穴，上下相應。
combos.whyEn: Anterior pain treated along the yangming channel, upper and lower.

combos.why: 肩後痛循太陽經，後谿、崑崙遠端。
combos.whyEn: Posterior pain along taiyang with Houxi and Kunlun distally.

conditions.overview: 肱骨外上髁處為手陽明經所過，屬慢性勞損之筋傷、經筋氣血瘀滯。局部阿是（多刺／圍刺）配陽明經曲池、肘髎、手三里、合谷；內上髁（高爾夫球肘）則屬少陰、太陰（少海、小海）。證型：風寒阻絡、氣血瘀滯、氣血虧虛。
conditions.overviewEn: The lateral epicondyle lies on the hand-yangming channel; the condition is a chronic sinew injury with local qi-blood stasis. Local ashi (multiple or surround needling) with yangming points LI11, LI12, LI10 and LI4; medial epicondylalgia (golfer's elbow) belongs to shaoyin/taiyin (HT3, SI8). Patterns: wind-cold obstruction, qi-blood stasis, qi-blood deficiency.
conditions.redFlags: 外傷後腫脹畸形（骨折）、關節紅腫熱伴發燒、肘關節絞鎖或不穩、前臂進行性無力麻木（神經卡壓）、兒童肘痛 → 影像／專科。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Swelling and deformity after trauma (fracture), red hot joint with fever, locking or instability, progressive forearm weakness or numbness (nerve entrapment), elbow pain in children: imaging or specialist referral.

patterns.presentation: 肘外側痛、遇寒加重、得溫則減、活動不利，苔白、脈緊
patterns.presentationEn: Lateral elbow pain worse in cold and eased by warmth, restricted movement; white coat, tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, warm the channel and free the collaterals
patterns.methodEn: Reducing method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 曲池、肘髎為外上髁局部要穴；手三里、合谷循陽明；外關、天井為少陽肘部；尺澤表裡經相配；溫針灸效佳。
patterns.rationaleEn: Quchi and Zhouliao are the local key points at the epicondyle; Shousanli and Hegu follow yangming; Waiguan and Tianjing serve the shaoyang elbow; Chize pairs the interior-exterior channel; warm-needle moxa works well.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：少海、小海、曲澤為肘內側穴，外上髁痛取之不循經， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 vessels-nerves：HT3、SI8、PC3］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Shaohai, Xiaohai and Quze are medial-elbow points, off the channel for lateral pain; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT3, SI8, PC3]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

patterns.presentation: 肘外側痛固定如刺、壓痛明顯、握物無力、反覆勞作加重，舌暗、脈澀
patterns.presentationEn: Fixed stabbing lateral pain with marked tenderness, weak grip, worse with repeated use; dusky tongue, choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Invigorate blood and dispel stasis, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.method: 阿是穴圍刺或多針刺，瀉法，可配刺絡拔罐
patterns.methodEn: Surround or multiple needling at the ashi point, reducing, with bleeding-cupping if suitable
patterns.rationale: 局部圍刺鬆解經筋瘀滯；曲池、肘髎、手三里循經；膈俞、血海活血；太衝配合谷行氣止痛。
patterns.rationaleEn: Surround needling releases local sinew stasis; Quchi, Zhouliao and Shousanli along the channel; Geshu and Xuehai move blood; Taichong with Hegu moves qi and stops pain.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

patterns.presentation: 肘痛綿綿、痠軟無力、勞累即發、日久不癒，舌淡、脈細
patterns.presentationEn: Lingering dull weak elbow pain, triggered by exertion, unhealed for a long time; pale tongue, thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify qi and blood, nourish the sinews
patterns.rationale: 局部穴補法加灸溫養；足三里、三陰交、氣海、脾俞補益氣血；陽陵泉為筋會。
patterns.rationaleEn: Local points tonified and moxa'd; Zusanli, Sanyinjiao, Qihai and Pishu tonify qi and blood; Yanglingquan is the hui of sinews.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。局部強刺、放血於虛者更傷。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong local needling or bleeding in deficiency injures further. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡，所取之經不過病所。 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 vessels-nerves：SI8、HT3］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points - the channel chosen does not pass through the affected region. Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone vessels-nerves: SI8, HT3]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：ST25］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：ST25］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: ST25] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: ST25]

combos.why: 外上髁局部三穴配合谷、外關。
combos.whyEn: Three local epicondyle points with Hegu and Waiguan.

combos.why: 阿是圍刺加活血要穴。
combos.whyEn: Surround needling with key blood-moving points.

conditions.overview: 正中神經受壓：病在手厥陰、太陰、陽明經之腕部，氣血不通則麻木疼痛。局部取大陵、內關（慎正中神經）、陽谿、陽池、勞宮，遠端取外關、合谷，配八邪通絡。證型：寒濕阻絡、氣滯血瘀、氣血不足；夜間麻痛、甩手緩解為特徵。
conditions.overviewEn: Compression of the median nerve: the disorder lies at the wrist on the hand-jueyin, taiyin and yangming channels, with numbness and pain from obstructed qi and blood. Local PC7, PC6 (careful of the nerve), LI5, TE4, PC8; distal TE5 and LI4; EX-UE9 to free the collaterals. Patterns: cold-damp obstruction, qi stagnation and blood stasis, qi-blood deficiency. Night-time numbness relieved by shaking the hand is characteristic.
conditions.redFlags: 大魚際肌萎縮、持續感覺喪失、拇指對掌無力（嚴重卡壓）、雙側伴頸痛（頸椎病鑑別）、妊娠／甲狀腺／糖尿病相關 → 神經傳導檢查、專科；嚴重者需減壓手術。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Thenar atrophy, persistent sensory loss, weak thumb opposition (severe entrapment), bilateral symptoms with neck pain (cervical differential), association with pregnancy, thyroid disease or diabetes: nerve conduction study and specialist review; severe cases need surgical decompression.

patterns.presentation: 腕部麻木脹痛、遇寒加重、晨起手僵、手指腫脹，苔白膩、脈濡
patterns.presentationEn: Numb distended wrist pain worse in cold, morning stiffness, swollen fingers; white greasy coat, soggy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm the channel and scatter cold, eliminate damp and free the collaterals
patterns.method: 淺刺平補平瀉，加溫和灸；大陵、內關得氣即止
patterns.methodEn: Shallow even method with gentle moxa; stop at deqi for Daling and Neiguan
patterns.rationale: 大陵、內關為腕管局部（正中神經處，手法輕）；陽池、陽谿為腕背相對穴；外關、合谷循經遠端；八邪通指間；灸法溫散寒濕。
patterns.rationaleEn: Daling and Neiguan are local to the tunnel (median nerve - gentle technique); Yangchi and Yangxi are the dorsal counterparts; Waiguan and Hegu distally; Baxie frees the fingers; moxa warms and scatters cold-damp.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：尺側穴主小指側， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 vessels-nerves：HT7］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Ulnar-side points govern the little-finger side; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT7]

patterns.presentation: 腕痛麻木固定、夜間加劇、甩手稍緩、手指刺痛、勞作加重，舌暗、脈澀
patterns.presentationEn: Fixed numb wrist pain worse at night and eased by shaking, tingling fingers, worse with use; dusky tongue, choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Move qi and blood, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 腕部局部四穴通腕管氣血；外關、合谷、太衝行氣止痛；血海、膈俞活血；八邪通指絡。
patterns.rationaleEn: Four local wrist points free the tunnel; Waiguan, Hegu and Taichong move qi and stop pain; Xuehai and Geshu move blood; Baxie frees the finger collaterals.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

patterns.presentation: 麻木日久、手指無力、肌肉萎縮、面色少華、乏力，舌淡、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Long-standing numbness, weak fingers, muscle wasting, lustreless complexion, fatigue; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify qi and blood, nourish the sinews
patterns.rationale: 局部輕刺加灸；足三里、三陰交、氣海、脾俞補益氣血；魚際局部大魚際養肌。
patterns.rationaleEn: Light local needling with moxa; Zusanli, Sanyinjiao, Qihai and Pishu tonify qi and blood; Yuji nourishes the thenar muscle.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。強刺放血傷正。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong needling or bleeding injures the upright qi.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡，所取之經不過病所。 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points - the channel chosen does not pass through the affected region. Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

combos.why: 腕掌側與腕背側對應穴加遠端循經穴。
combos.whyEn: Palmar and dorsal wrist points with distal channel points.

combos.why: 大陵、勞宮、八邪通手指麻木。
combos.whyEn: Daling, Laogong and Baxie for numb fingers.

conditions.overview: 「腰為腎之府」，腰痛病位在腎與足太陽、督脈、帶脈。急性扭傷屬瘀血阻絡，先取遠端動氣（水溝、腰痛點、後谿、委中）；慢性分寒濕、瘀血、腎虛（陽虛／陰虛）。基本方：腎俞、大腸俞、委中、阿是，依證加減。
conditions.overviewEn: 'The lumbar region is the mansion of the Kidney': low back pain involves the Kidney, the foot-taiyang and Governor vessels and the Dai vessel. Acute sprain is blood stasis obstructing the collaterals and takes distal points with movement first (GV26, EX-UE7, SI3, BL40); chronic pain divides into cold-damp, blood stasis and Kidney deficiency (yang or yin). Base prescription: BL23, BL25, BL40 and ashi points, modified by pattern.
conditions.redFlags: 馬尾症候群（鞍區麻木、大小便失禁或瀦留、雙下肢無力）為外科急症；重大外傷、骨質疏鬆或類固醇使用者之新發劇痛（骨折）、腫瘤史、發燒、夜間痛與體重減輕、進行性神經缺損、腹主動脈瘤（搏動性腹塊）→ 急診／影像，不以針灸處理。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Cauda equina syndrome (saddle anaesthesia, incontinence or retention, bilateral leg weakness) is a surgical emergency; new severe pain after major trauma or in osteoporosis/steroid users (fracture), cancer history, fever, night pain with weight loss, progressive neurological deficit, abdominal aortic aneurysm (pulsatile mass): emergency assessment or imaging, not acupuncture.

patterns.presentation: 閃挫後腰痛劇烈、不能轉側俯仰、痛處固定拒按、肌肉痙攣，舌暗、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Severe pain after a wrenching injury, unable to bend or turn, fixed pain refusing pressure, muscle spasm; dusky tongue, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Invigorate blood and dispel stasis, relax sinews and stop pain
patterns.method: 先取遠端穴瀉法並令患者緩慢活動腰部，後取局部；委中可刺絡放血
patterns.methodEn: Reduce distal points first while the patient slowly moves the lumbar region, then local points; Weizhong may be bled
patterns.rationale: 水溝通督止痛、腰痛點為經驗奇穴、後谿通督脈主腰脊，三穴動氣針法；「腰背委中求」，委中放血祛瘀；養老為小腸郄穴治急痛；局部腎俞、大腸俞、腰陽關後取。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shuigou opens the Governor vessel, Yaotongdian is the empirical extra point, Houxi governs the spine - three distal points with movement; 'for the back seek Weizhong', bled to dispel stasis; Yanglao, xi-cleft of the Small Intestine, treats acute pain; local Shenshu, Dachangshu and Yaoyangguan afterwards.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。急性瘀阻補腎無益。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying the Kidney does nothing for acute stasis. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：上肢陽明厥陰穴與腰部太陽督脈不相干（水溝、腰痛點除外）， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：PC6］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Yangming and jueyin arm points (other than GV26 and EX-UE7) have no link to the taiyang-Governor lumbar region; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: PC6]

patterns.presentation: 腰部冷痛重著、轉側不利、遇陰雨寒冷加重、得溫則減，苔白膩、脈沉遲
patterns.presentationEn: Cold heavy aching lumbar region, restricted turning, worse in damp cold weather and eased by warmth; white greasy coat, deep slow pulse
patterns.principleEn: Scatter cold and eliminate damp, warm the channel and free the collaterals
patterns.method: 瀉法加灸，或溫針灸、拔罐
patterns.methodEn: Reducing with moxa, warm-needle or cupping
patterns.rationale: 腰陽關、命門溫通督脈之陽；腎俞、大腸俞、腰眼、志室局部溫經散寒；委中通太陽經；陰陵泉健脾除濕。
patterns.rationaleEn: Yaoyangguan and Mingmen warm the yang of the Governor vessel; Shenshu, Dachangshu, Yaoyan and Zhishi warm the region; Weizhong frees the taiyang channel; Yinlingquan eliminates damp.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：HT7］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT7]

patterns.presentation: 腰痛綿綿、痠軟無力、喜按喜溫、勞累加重、畏寒肢冷、小便清長、夜尿，舌淡、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Lingering weak aching pain liking pressure and warmth, worse with exertion, cold intolerance, clear copious urine and nocturia; pale tongue, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm and tonify Kidney yang, strengthen the lumbar region and bones
patterns.rationale: 腎俞、命門、關元前後相配灸之溫補腎陽；太谿補腎；志室、腰眼強腰；足三里補後天；懸鐘填髓。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shenshu, Mingmen and Guanyuan, front and back, are moxa'd to warm Kidney yang; Taixi tonifies the Kidney; Zhishi and Yaoyan strengthen the lumbar region; Zusanli supports the postnatal root; Xuanzhong fills marrow.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。急性瀉法放血於腎虛者犯虛虛。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Acute reducing or bleeding in Kidney deficiency depletes the deficient. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

patterns.presentation: 腰痠隱痛、五心煩熱、口乾咽燥、失眠盜汗、頭暈耳鳴，舌紅少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Dull aching lumbar pain, heat in the palms and soles, dry mouth and throat, insomnia and night sweats, dizziness and tinnitus; red tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish Kidney yin, strengthen the lumbar region and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 太谿、照海、三陰交滋腎陰；腎俞補腎；然谷清虛火；懸鐘填髓；曲泉為肝經母穴滋肝腎。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi, Zhaohai and Sanyinjiao enrich Kidney yin; Shenshu tonifies; Rangu clears deficiency fire; Xuanzhong fills marrow; Ququan, Liver mother point, nourishes Liver-Kidney.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸命門、關元、腰陽關助火傷陰。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4、GV3］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、GV3］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa on Mingmen, Guanyuan or Yaoyangguan adds fire and injures yin. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4, GV3] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, GV3] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］［風險區 kidney-region：BL22］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9] [risk zone kidney-region: BL22]

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

combos.why: 「腰背委中求」加局部腎俞、大腸俞、腰陽關、腰眼，各型腰痛基礎。
combos.whyEn: 'For the back seek Weizhong' plus local Shenshu, Dachangshu, Yaoyangguan and Yaoyan - the base for all types.

combos.why: 遠端動氣三穴加委中放血。
combos.whyEn: Three distal points with movement plus bleeding Weizhong.

combos.why: 俞募前後與原穴並補，灸法為主。
combos.whyEn: Back-shu, front points and the yuan point tonified together, mainly by moxa.

conditions.overview: 依放射路徑辨經：痛沿臀後、大腿後、小腿後至足外側為足太陽型（秩邊、殷門、委中、承山、崑崙）；沿大腿外側、小腿外側至足背為足少陽型（環跳、風市、陽陵泉、懸鐘、丘墟）。環跳為兩型共用要穴。證型：寒濕、瘀血、肝腎虧虛。
conditions.overviewEn: Identify the channel from the radiation: pain down the posterior buttock, thigh and calf to the lateral foot is foot-taiyang (BL54, BL37, BL40, BL57, BL60); down the lateral thigh and leg to the dorsum is foot-shaoyang (GB30, GB31, GB34, GB39, GB40). Huantiao is shared by both. Patterns: cold-damp, blood stasis, Liver-Kidney deficiency.
conditions.redFlags: 馬尾症候群、進行性足下垂或肌力減退、雙側症狀、外傷後、發燒、腫瘤史、夜間劇痛 → 急診／MRI／外科；疑髖關節或血管病變（間歇性跛行、足背動脈搏動消失）轉相應專科。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Cauda equina syndrome, progressive foot drop or weakness, bilateral symptoms, trauma, fever, cancer history, severe night pain: emergency, MRI or surgery; suspected hip or vascular disease (claudication, absent pedal pulse) goes to the relevant specialist.

patterns.presentation: 腰臀痛沿大腿後側、膕窩、小腿後側放射至足外側，遇寒加重、按壓秩邊承山壓痛
patterns.presentationEn: Pain from the lumbar-gluteal region down the posterior thigh, popliteal fossa and calf to the lateral foot, worse in cold, tender at Zhibian and Chengshan
patterns.principleEn: Dispel cold and damp, invigorate blood and free the collaterals
patterns.method: 瀉法，環跳、秩邊以放射感至足為度；可加灸、電針
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; Huantiao and Zhibian until sensation reaches the foot; moxa or electroacupuncture may be added
patterns.rationale: 循太陽經由上而下取穴，大腸俞、次髎、秩邊為神經根與臀部出口，殷門、委中、承山、崑崙沿經分段通絡；環跳深部為坐骨神經幹，得氣放射即止。
patterns.rationaleEn: Points follow the taiyang channel from above downward: Dachangshu, Ciliao and Zhibian at the root and gluteal exit, Yinmen, Weizhong, Chengshan and Kunlun segmentally along the channel; Huantiao overlies the sciatic trunk - stop at the propagated sensation.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：陽明、太陰、厥陰穴不在放射路徑上， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 vessels-nerves：ST41］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Yangming, taiyin and jueyin points are off the radiation path; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone vessels-nerves: ST41] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。寒濕瘀阻初期純補無益。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Pure tonification is useless in early cold-damp stasis. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

patterns.en: Foot-shaoyang type (qi stagnation and blood stasis)
patterns.presentation: 痛沿髖外側、大腿外側、小腿外側放射至足背外側，如刺如灼、夜間加重，舌暗、脈弦澀
patterns.presentationEn: Pain from the lateral hip down the lateral thigh and leg to the lateral dorsum, stabbing or burning, worse at night; dusky tongue, wiry choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Move qi and blood, free the shaoyang channel
patterns.method: 瀉法；環跳放射感至足為度；可電針
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; Huantiao until sensation reaches the foot; electroacupuncture may be used
patterns.rationale: 環跳、風市、陽陵泉（筋會）、懸鐘（髓會）、丘墟沿少陽經分段取穴；足臨泣通帶脈；血海、膈俞活血；太衝疏肝理氣。
patterns.rationaleEn: Huantiao, Fengshi, Yanglingquan (hui of sinews), Xuanzhong (hui of marrow) and Qiuxu segmentally along shaoyang; Zulinqi opens the Dai vessel; Xuehai and Geshu move blood; Taichong moves Liver qi.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：太陽經穴不在外側放射路徑， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Taiyang points lie off the lateral radiation path; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

patterns.presentation: 腰腿痠痛綿綿、反覆發作、勞累加重、下肢無力麻木、腰膝痠軟，舌淡、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Lingering recurrent aching, worse with exertion, weak numb leg, weak lumbar region and knees; pale tongue, deep thin pulse
patterns.principle: 補益肝腎、強筋壯骨、通絡
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Liver and Kidney, strengthen sinews and bones, free the collaterals
patterns.rationale: 腎俞、肝俞、太谿補肝腎；懸鐘補髓、陽陵泉柔筋；環跳、委中輕刺通絡；命門灸、足三里補氣血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shenshu, Ganshu and Taixi tonify Liver-Kidney; Xuanzhong fills marrow and Yanglingquan softens sinews; Huantiao and Weizhong gently free the channel; moxa Mingmen and tonify Zusanli.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。久病虛者強刺放血更虛。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong needling or bleeding in chronic deficiency depletes further.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

combos.why: 沿後側放射路徑由上而下分段通絡。
combos.whyEn: Segmental points down the posterior radiation path.

combos.why: 沿外側放射路徑分段取穴。
combos.whyEn: Segmental points down the lateral radiation path.

combos.why: 神經根、臀部出口與膝下遠端兼顧，太谿補腎固本。
combos.whyEn: Nerve root, gluteal exit and distal points below the knee, with Taixi to tonify the Kidney.

conditions.overview: 膝為筋之府，膝痛與肝腎、脾相關。局部標準：內外膝眼、鶴頂、梁丘、血海、陰陵泉、陽陵泉、足三里；依痛位加膝陽關（外）、曲泉（內）。證型：風寒濕痹（行痹、痛痹、著痹）、濕熱痹、瘀血、肝腎虧虛。
conditions.overviewEn: The knee is the 'mansion of the sinews' and knee pain relates to Liver, Kidney and Spleen. Local standard: medial and lateral Xiyan, Heding, Liangqiu, Xuehai, Yinlingquan, Yanglingquan, Zusanli; add Xiyangguan (lateral) or Ququan (medial) by site. Patterns: wind-cold-damp bi, damp-heat bi, blood stasis, Liver-Kidney deficiency.
conditions.redFlags: 關節紅腫熱痛伴發燒（化膿性關節炎、痛風急性）、外傷後不能負重或關節畸形（骨折、韌帶斷裂）、關節絞鎖、兒童膝痛（鑑別髖病、腫瘤）、單側腫脹伴小腿腫痛（深部靜脈血栓）→ 影像／急診。關節腔內注射或人工關節者局部針刺須嚴格無菌。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Red hot swollen joint with fever (septic arthritis, acute gout), inability to bear weight or deformity after trauma (fracture, ligament rupture), locking, knee pain in children (hip disease, tumour), unilateral swelling with calf pain (deep-vein thrombosis): imaging or emergency. Strict asepsis for local needling after intra-articular injection or with a prosthetic joint.

patterns.presentation: 膝痛冷痛或重著、遇寒加重得溫減、屈伸不利、陰雨加重，苔白膩、脈弦緊
patterns.presentationEn: Cold or heavy knee pain worse in cold and eased by warmth, restricted flexion, worse in damp weather; white greasy coat, wiry tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, eliminate damp and free the collaterals
patterns.rationale: 內外膝眼、鶴頂為膝部局部三針；陽陵泉筋會、陰陵泉利濕內外相對；梁丘胃經郄穴止痛；血海活血祛風；溫針灸散寒濕。
patterns.rationaleEn: The two Xiyan and Heding form the local trio; Yanglingquan (hui of sinews) and Yinlingquan (damp) face each other across the knee; Liangqiu, xi-cleft of the Stomach, stops pain; Xuehai moves blood and dispels wind; warm-needle moxa scatters cold-damp.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：上肢穴與膝無關， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：PC6］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Arm points have no relation to the knee; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: PC6]

patterns.presentation: 膝關節紅腫熱痛、觸之灼熱、屈伸不利、口渴煩悶、小便黃，苔黃膩、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Red hot swollen painful knee, hot to touch, restricted movement, thirst and vexation, dark urine; yellow greasy coat, slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and drain damp, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.method: 瀉法，不灸；局部可刺絡拔罐
patterns.methodEn: Reducing, no moxa; local bleeding-cupping if suitable
patterns.rationale: 膝眼局部；陰陵泉、商丘利濕；內庭、曲池、大椎清熱；陽陵泉清少陽濕熱；血海涼血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Local Xiyan; Yinlingquan and Shangqiu drain damp; Neiting, Quchi and Dazhui clear heat; Yanglingquan clears shaoyang damp-heat; Xuehai cools blood.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸關元、命門於濕熱者助熱。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa on Guanyuan or Mingmen feeds the heat. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: SP6] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

patterns.presentation: 膝痛固定如刺、腫脹青紫、夜間加重、活動受限、或有外傷史，舌暗有瘀斑、脈澀
patterns.presentationEn: Fixed stabbing pain, swelling and bruising, worse at night, restricted movement, history of injury; dusky tongue with stasis spots, choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Invigorate blood and dispel stasis, reduce swelling and stop pain
patterns.method: 平補平瀉；急性腫脹期局部輕刺，先遠端
patterns.methodEn: Even method; in acute swelling needle locally lightly and start distally
patterns.rationale: 血海、膈俞活血；梁丘郄穴止急痛；膝眼局部；委中放血祛瘀；太衝、三陰交行氣活血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xuehai and Geshu move blood; Liangqiu stops acute pain; Xiyan locally; Weizhong bled to dispel stasis; Taichong and Sanyinjiao move qi and blood.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：上肢穴與膝部經筋無關， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Arm points have no relation to the knee sinews; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。化痰、解表之穴於外傷瘀血無用。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Phlegm-resolving or exterior-releasing points do nothing for traumatic stasis. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

patterns.presentation: 膝痛綿綿、痠軟無力、久行久立加重、腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴，舌淡、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Lingering weak aching pain worse after walking or standing, weak lumbar region and knees, dizziness and tinnitus; pale tongue, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Liver and Kidney, strengthen sinews and bones
patterns.rationale: 膝眼局部加灸；太谿、腎俞、肝俞補肝腎；陽陵泉筋會、懸鐘髓會；曲泉肝經母穴；足三里、三陰交補氣血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Local Xiyan with moxa; Taixi, Shenshu and Ganshu tonify Liver-Kidney; Yanglingquan (sinews) and Xuanzhong (marrow); Ququan, Liver mother point; Zusanli and Sanyinjiao tonify qi and blood.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

combos.why: 膝眼三針加膝上梁丘血海、膝下陰陽陵泉，覆蓋膝關節周圍。
combos.whyEn: The three Xiyan points with Liangqiu and Xuehai above and the two Lingquan below, covering the whole joint.

combos.why: 局部配補腎填髓。
combos.whyEn: Local points with Kidney and marrow tonification.

conditions.overview: 多為外踝（少陽、太陽）扭傷，氣血瘀阻經筋。急性期（48小時內）以遠端、健側為主（繆刺：對側腕部相應穴如陽池、陽谿，或健側同名穴），局部輕刺或不刺；慢性期局部阿是配丘墟、解谿、崑崙、申脈、商丘，可加灸。
conditions.overviewEn: Usually a lateral (shaoyang/taiyang) sprain with qi-blood stasis in the sinews. In the acute phase (first 48 hours) use distal and contralateral points (miuci: corresponding wrist points such as TE4 or LI5 on the opposite side, or the same point on the healthy side) with light or no local needling; in the chronic phase local ashi with GB40, ST41, BL60, BL62 and SP5, moxa may be added.
conditions.redFlags: Ottawa 踝規則：踝骨後緣或尖端壓痛、不能負重走四步 → X 光排除骨折；明顯畸形、關節不穩、足部麻木蒼白（血管神經損傷）、小腿腫痛（血栓）→ 急診。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Ottawa ankle rules: tenderness over the posterior malleolus or tip, or inability to bear weight for four steps: X-ray to exclude fracture; obvious deformity, instability, numb pale foot (neurovascular injury), calf swelling (thrombosis): emergency.

patterns.presentation: 扭傷後踝部腫脹疼痛、青紫、活動受限、拒按
patterns.presentationEn: Swelling, pain and bruising after the twist, restricted movement, refuses pressure
patterns.principle: 活血消腫、通絡止痛（遠端為主）
patterns.principleEn: Invigorate blood and reduce swelling, free the collaterals (mainly distal)
patterns.method: 健側對應腕穴（陽池、陽谿）繆刺並令患者活動踝關節；患側局部輕淺刺，不灸
patterns.methodEn: Miuci at corresponding contralateral wrist points (Yangchi, Yangxi) with ankle movement; light shallow local needling on the injured side, no moxa
patterns.rationale: 踝與腕上下相應，陽池對丘墟、陽谿對解谿，健側取穴動氣止痛；丘墟（膽原）、解谿（胃經）為踝前外局部要穴；崑崙、申脈外踝後下；商丘內踝；陽陵泉筋會。
patterns.rationaleEn: Ankle and wrist correspond: Yangchi to Qiuxu, Yangxi to Jiexi, needled on the healthy side with movement; Qiuxu (Gallbladder yuan) and Jiexi are key antero-lateral points; Kunlun and Shenmai behind and below the lateral malleolus; Shangqiu medially; Yanglingquan for the sinews.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：內側穴對外踝扭傷不循經（內踝扭傷則反之）， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Medial points are off the channel for a lateral sprain (and vice versa); Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

patterns.zh: 慢性期（筋脈失養、寒濕留滯）
patterns.presentation: 扭傷後數週仍痠痛無力、反覆扭傷、遇寒加重、關節不穩
patterns.presentationEn: Weeks after injury still aching and weak, recurrent sprains, worse in cold, joint instability
patterns.principleEn: Warm the channel and free the collaterals, relax the sinews and strengthen the ankle
patterns.methodEn: Even method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 局部五穴環繞踝關節通絡；陽陵泉、懸鐘強筋骨；足三里、三陰交、太谿補益以養筋；灸法溫通。
patterns.rationaleEn: Five local points surround the ankle; Yanglingquan and Xuanzhong strengthen sinews and bones; Zusanli, Sanyinjiao and Taixi nourish the sinews; moxa warms and frees.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 vessels-nerves：PC6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone vessels-nerves: PC6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12]

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。慢性虛者放血強刺無益。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Bleeding or strong needling helps nothing in chronic deficiency. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

combos.why: 健側腕穴動氣加筋會陽陵泉，患側丘墟輕刺。
combos.whyEn: Contralateral wrist points with movement plus Yanglingquan; light Qiuxu on the injured side.

combos.why: 踝周五穴加懸鐘，溫針灸。
combos.whyEn: Five peri-ankle points plus Xuanzhong with warm-needle moxa.

conditions.overview: 外邪犯肺衛：辨風寒（惡寒重、無汗、流清涕）、風熱（發熱重、咽痛、流黃涕）、暑濕（夏季、身熱不揚、胸悶、苔膩）與體虛感冒（反覆、氣短）。基本方：風池、列缺、合谷、大椎；風寒加灸風門，風熱加曲池、魚際、少商放血。
conditions.overviewEn: External pathogens invading the Lung defensive level: differentiate wind-cold (marked chills, no sweating, clear discharge), wind-heat (marked fever, sore throat, yellow discharge), summer-damp (summer, muffled fever, chest oppression, greasy coat) and deficiency colds (recurrent, breathless). Base: GB20, LU7, LI4, GV14; wind-cold adds moxa at BL12, wind-heat adds LI11, LU10 and bleeding LU11.
conditions.redFlags: 高燒不退（>39.5°C 超過三天）、呼吸困難或呼吸急促、胸痛、意識改變、嚴重頭痛頸僵、嬰幼兒／老人／孕婦／免疫低下者脫水或嗜睡、疑流感重症或肺炎 → 轉診，針灸僅輔助。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Persistent high fever (>39.5°C over three days), dyspnoea or tachypnoea, chest pain, altered consciousness, severe headache with neck stiffness, dehydration or lethargy in infants, the elderly, pregnant or immunocompromised, suspected severe influenza or pneumonia: refer; acupuncture is adjunctive only.

patterns.presentation: 惡寒重發熱輕、無汗、頭痛身痛、鼻塞流清涕、咳嗽痰稀，苔薄白、脈浮緊
patterns.presentationEn: Marked chills with mild fever, no sweating, headache and body aches, blocked nose with clear discharge, cough with thin sputum; thin white coat, floating tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, diffuse the Lung and release the exterior
patterns.method: 瀉法，風門、大椎加灸或拔罐
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; moxa or cupping at Fengmen and Dazhui
patterns.rationale: 風池、風府祛風；風門（灸）散寒解表；列缺宣肺（頭項尋列缺）；合谷發汗解表；大椎通陽散寒；迎香通鼻。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fengchi and Fengfu dispel wind; Fengmen (moxa) scatters cold and releases the exterior; Lieque diffuses the Lung; Hegu promotes sweating; Dazhui frees yang and scatters cold; Yingxiang opens the nose.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。曲池、魚際、少商放血為風熱所設。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Quchi, Yuji and bleeding Shaoshang are for wind-heat.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6、CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6, CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

patterns.presentation: 發熱重惡寒輕、有汗、咽喉腫痛、鼻塞流黃涕、口渴、咳嗽痰黃，舌尖紅苔薄黃、脈浮數
patterns.presentationEn: Marked fever with mild chills, sweating, sore swollen throat, yellow nasal discharge, thirst, cough with yellow sputum; red tongue tip with thin yellow coat, floating rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and clear heat, diffuse the Lung and benefit the throat
patterns.method: 瀉法，少商點刺出血，大椎可刺絡拔罐；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; bleed Shaoshang; Dazhui may be bled and cupped; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 大椎為諸陽之會，清熱退燒要穴；曲池、合谷清陽明之熱；魚際清肺熱利咽；少商放血治急性咽痛；外關清少陽風熱。
patterns.rationaleEn: Dazhui, meeting of all yang, is the key fever-reducing point; Quchi and Hegu clear yangming heat; Yuji clears Lung heat and benefits the throat; bleeding Shaoshang treats acute sore throat; Waiguan clears shaoyang wind-heat.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。風門、風池加灸助熱；足三里補益於熱盛無益。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa at Fengmen or Fengchi feeds the heat; tonifying Zusanli is wrong in exuberant heat. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12]

wrong.zh: 固表止汗、收斂之穴用於外感表證，表閉邪留：無汗、發熱更甚。復溜、陰郄止汗、太淵補肺於表熱未解時閉邪。［風險區 vessels-nerves：HT6、LU9］
wrong.en: Exterior-consolidating, sweat-stopping or astringent points in an exterior pattern lock the pathogen in: anhidrosis and fever worsen. Fuliu and Yinxi stop sweating and Taiyuan tonifies the Lung, locking the pathogen in before the exterior is released. [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT6, LU9]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

patterns.presentation: 夏季發病、身熱不揚、汗出不暢、頭重如裹、胸悶噁心、肢體困重、納呆、便溏，苔黃膩、脈濡數
patterns.presentationEn: Summer onset, muffled fever, hampered sweating, heavy head, chest oppression and nausea, heavy limbs, poor appetite, loose stool; yellow greasy coat, soggy rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear summer heat and resolve damp, release the exterior and harmonise the middle
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; Weizhong may be bled; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 合谷、大椎解表清熱；中脘、陰陵泉、豐隆化濕和中；內關止嘔寬胸；委中放血清暑；印堂止頭重。
patterns.rationaleEn: Hegu and Dazhui release the exterior and clear heat; Zhongwan, Yinlingquan and Fenglong resolve damp; Neiguan stops nausea; bleeding Weizhong clears summer heat; Yintang relieves the heavy head.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。暑濕者滋陰助濕。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. Yin-nourishing points in summer-damp feed the damp. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

patterns.presentation: 反覆感冒、遇風即病、惡風自汗、氣短乏力、咳嗽無力、鼻涕清稀，舌淡、脈浮弱
patterns.presentationEn: Recurrent colds at the slightest draught, aversion to wind with spontaneous sweating, shortness of breath, weak cough, thin clear discharge; pale tongue, floating weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Boost qi and consolidate the exterior while gently releasing it
patterns.method: 列缺、合谷、風池平補平瀉；足三里、氣海補法加灸；緩解期灸足三里、肺俞預防
patterns.methodEn: Even method at LU7, LI4 and GB20; tonify and moxa ST36 and CV6; between episodes moxa ST36 and BL13 for prevention
patterns.rationale: 足三里、氣海、太淵、肺俞補益肺脾之氣以固表；列缺、合谷、風池輕瀉以祛邪而不傷正——扶正祛邪並行。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli, Qihai, Taiyuan and Feishu tonify Lung and Spleen qi to consolidate the exterior; Lieque, Hegu and Fengchi are lightly reduced to expel the pathogen without harming the upright - support and expel together.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。大椎刺絡、少商放血、曲池強瀉於氣虛者愈虛。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Bleeding Dazhui or Shaoshang or strongly reducing Quchi depletes the qi-deficient patient. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

combos.why: 祛風散寒加灸風門大椎。
combos.whyEn: Dispel wind and cold, moxa Fengmen and Dazhui.

combos.why: 大椎清熱為主，少商放血利咽。
combos.whyEn: Dazhui to clear heat, Shaoshang bled for the throat.

combos.why: 緩解期灸之益氣固表。
combos.whyEn: Moxa between episodes to boost qi and consolidate the exterior.

conditions.overview: 咳嗽分外感（風寒、風熱、燥邪）與內傷（痰濕、痰熱、肝火犯肺、肺陰虛、肺氣虛）。外感宜宣肺祛邪：肺俞、列缺、合谷、尺澤；內傷宜調臟腑：肺俞、太淵、三陰交，痰濕加脾俞豐隆，肝火加行間魚際，陰虛加膏肓太谿。「五臟六腑皆令人咳」。
conditions.overviewEn: Cough divides into external (wind-cold, wind-heat, dryness) and internal (phlegm-damp, phlegm-heat, Liver fire invading the Lung, Lung yin deficiency, Lung qi deficiency). External cough: diffuse the Lung and expel the pathogen with BL13, LU7, LI4, LU5; internal cough: regulate the organs with BL13, LU9, SP6 - phlegm-damp adds BL20 and ST40, Liver fire adds LR2 and LU10, yin deficiency adds BL43 and KI3. 'All the zang-fu can cause cough.'
conditions.redFlags: 咳血、持續超過三週、體重減輕、夜汗（結核、腫瘤）、呼吸困難、胸痛、發紺、吸菸者咳嗽型態改變、兒童嗆咳後持續咳（異物）→ 胸部影像與專科評估。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Haemoptysis, cough over three weeks, weight loss, night sweats (tuberculosis, malignancy), dyspnoea, chest pain, cyanosis, change in a smoker's cough, persistent cough after choking in a child (foreign body): chest imaging and specialist assessment.

patterns.presentation: 咳嗽聲重、痰白稀、鼻塞流清涕、惡寒頭痛、無汗，苔薄白、脈浮緊
patterns.presentationEn: Loud cough with thin white sputum, blocked nose with clear discharge, chills and headache, no sweating; thin white coat, floating tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, diffuse the Lung and stop cough
patterns.rationale: 肺俞（灸）宣肺散寒；列缺宣肺、合谷解表為肺與大腸表裡配穴；風門散風寒；尺澤降肺氣止咳；天突止咳平喘。
patterns.rationaleEn: Feishu (moxa) diffuses the Lung and scatters cold; Lieque and Hegu are the Lung-Large Intestine interior-exterior pair; Fengmen scatters wind-cold; Chize descends Lung qi; Tiantu stops cough.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。太淵、膏肓補肺於外感閉邪。［風險區 vessels-nerves：LU9、KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL43］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying Taiyuan or Gaohuang during an external invasion locks the pathogen in. [risk zone vessels-nerves: LU9, KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL43]

patterns.presentation: 咳嗽反覆、痰多白黏易咳出、晨起或食後加重、胸悶脘痞、納呆，苔白膩、脈濡滑
patterns.presentationEn: Recurrent cough with copious sticky white sputum easily expectorated, worse in the morning or after meals, chest and epigastric oppression, poor appetite; white greasy coat, soggy slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and dry damp, resolve phlegm and stop cough
patterns.methodEn: Even method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 「脾為生痰之源，肺為貯痰之器」：脾俞、中脘、足三里、陰陵泉健脾化濕治本；豐隆化痰；肺俞、太淵、尺澤調肺氣；膻中氣會寬胸。
patterns.rationaleEn: 'The Spleen generates phlegm, the Lung stores it': Pishu, Zhongwan, Zusanli and Yinlingquan fortify the Spleen at the root; Fenglong resolves phlegm; Feishu, Taiyuan and Chize regulate Lung qi; Danzhong (hui of qi) expands the chest.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL43］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL43]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。痰濕無熱象者清熱助濕。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Heat-clearing with no heat signs aggravates damp.

patterns.presentation: 氣逆作咳、咳時面紅脅痛、痰少黏難咳、口苦咽乾、情緒激動加重，舌紅苔薄黃、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Cough from rebellious qi with red face and flank pain, scanty sticky sputum, bitter dry throat, worse with emotion; red tongue with thin yellow coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear Liver fire, depurate the Lung and stop cough
patterns.rationale: 尺澤（肺經合水、子穴）瀉肺熱；行間瀉肝火（木火刑金）；魚際清肺利咽；期門、肝俞、陽陵泉疏肝；膻中理氣。
patterns.rationaleEn: Chize (Lung he-sea Water, child point) drains Lung heat; Xingjian drains Liver fire (Wood-fire scorching Metal); Yuji clears the Lung; Qimen, Ganshu and Yanglingquan spread the Liver; Danzhong regulates qi.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸風門大椎、補足三里助火。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa at Fengmen or Dazhui or tonifying Zusanli feeds the fire. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：LU9、KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL43］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: LU9, KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL43]

patterns.presentation: 乾咳少痰或痰中帶血、聲音嘶啞、口乾咽燥、午後潮熱、盜汗、顴紅，舌紅少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Dry cough with scanty or blood-streaked sputum, hoarseness, dry mouth and throat, afternoon tidal fever, night sweats, flushed cheeks; red tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish yin and moisten the Lung, stop cough
patterns.method: 補法，不灸（或膏肓少量灸）
patterns.methodEn: Tonifying, no moxa (or minimal moxa at Gaohuang)
patterns.rationale: 肺俞、膏肓補肺陰（膏肓為虛勞要穴）；太淵補肺；太谿、照海金水相生滋腎潤肺；孔最止咯血；陰郄止盜汗。
patterns.rationaleEn: Feishu and Gaohuang nourish Lung yin (Gaohuang is the key point for consumption); Taiyuan tonifies the Lung; Taixi and Zhaohai enrich the Kidney to moisten the Lung (Metal and Water generate each other); Kongzui stops haemoptysis; Yinxi stops night sweats.

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。合谷發汗、陰陵泉豐隆燥濕傷陰。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. Hegu promotes sweating and Yinlingquan/Fenglong dry damp - all injure yin. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

combos.why: 肺俞、列缺、合谷、尺澤宣肺解表，風池祛風。
combos.whyEn: Feishu, Lieque, Hegu and Chize diffuse the Lung and release the exterior; Fengchi dispels wind.

combos.why: 肺俞配太淵（俞原）補肺，三陰交足三里培土生金，膻中理氣。
combos.whyEn: Feishu with Taiyuan tonifies the Lung; Sanyinjiao and Zusanli build Earth to generate Metal; Danzhong regulates qi.

combos.why: 健脾化痰治本。
combos.whyEn: Fortify the Spleen and resolve phlegm at the root.

conditions.overview: 「發時治標、平時治本」：發作期分寒哮（痰白、惡寒）、熱哮（痰黃、煩熱），治以宣肺平喘：肺俞、定喘、天突、膻中、尺澤、列缺、豐隆；緩解期分肺氣虛、脾氣虛、腎不納氣，治以補肺健脾益腎：肺俞、膏肓、腎俞、足三里、太淵、太谿、關元，三伏天灸為預防要法。
conditions.overviewEn: 'Treat the branch during attacks, the root between them': attacks divide into cold wheezing (white sputum, chills) and heat wheezing (yellow sputum, heat and agitation), treated by diffusing the Lung and calming wheezing - BL13, EX-B1, CV22, CV17, LU5, LU7, ST40; remission divides into Lung qi, Spleen qi and Kidney-not-grasping-qi deficiency, treated by tonifying Lung, Spleen and Kidney - BL13, BL43, BL23, ST36, LU9, KI3, CV4; dog-day moxa is the key preventive method.
conditions.redFlags: 急性重度／致命性哮喘（說話不成句、呼吸極快、三凹徵、發紺、意識改變、血氧低、安靜胸）為急診，須支氣管擴張劑、類固醇與氧氣，針灸絕非急救手段；患者須持續控制藥物，不可因針灸停藥。胸背穴深刺之氣胸於哮喘者尤其危險。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Acute severe or life-threatening asthma (cannot complete sentences, very rapid breathing, retractions, cyanosis, altered consciousness, low saturation, silent chest) is an emergency requiring bronchodilators, steroids and oxygen; acupuncture is never a rescue treatment, and patients must keep their controller medication. Pneumothorax from deep chest or back needling is especially dangerous in asthmatics.

patterns.presentation: 喘息氣促、喉中哮鳴、痰白清稀、胸悶、惡寒、遇冷誘發，苔白滑、脈弦緊
patterns.presentationEn: Wheezing and breathlessness, rattling in the throat, thin white sputum, chest oppression, chills, triggered by cold; white slippery coat, wiry tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm the Lung and scatter cold, resolve phlegm and calm wheezing
patterns.method: 瀉法，肺俞、定喘、風門加灸或拔罐；天突刺法嚴格
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; moxa or cupping at Feishu, Dingchuan and Fengmen; Tiantu with strict technique
patterns.rationale: 肺俞、定喘為平喘局部要穴；天突、膻中降氣平喘；列缺、合谷宣肺解表；豐隆化痰；風門、大椎散寒（灸）。
patterns.rationaleEn: Feishu and Dingchuan are the key local points for wheezing; Tiantu and Danzhong descend qi; Lieque and Hegu diffuse the Lung; Fenglong resolves phlegm; Fengmen and Dazhui scatter cold (moxa).

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。發作期補腎納氣不能解當下之痰阻。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying the Kidney during an attack cannot clear the present phlegm obstruction. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

patterns.presentation: 喘急氣粗、哮鳴聲高、痰黃黏稠、煩熱面赤、口渴、便秘，舌紅苔黃膩、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Rapid coarse breathing, loud wheeze, thick yellow sputum, heat and red face, thirst, constipation; red tongue with yellow greasy coat, slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and diffuse the Lung, resolve phlegm and calm wheezing
patterns.method: 瀉法，不灸；大椎可刺絡拔罐
patterns.methodEn: Reducing, no moxa; Dazhui may be bled and cupped
patterns.rationale: 尺澤為肺經合水穴清肺熱；大椎、曲池清熱；魚際清肺利咽；豐隆化痰；肺俞、定喘平喘；內庭清陽明以通便。
patterns.rationaleEn: Chize, Lung he-sea Water point, clears Lung heat; Dazhui and Quchi clear heat; Yuji clears the Lung and throat; Fenglong resolves phlegm; Feishu and Dingchuan calm wheezing; Neiting clears yangming and frees the bowels.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸風門、關元、命門助熱。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa at Fengmen, Guanyuan or Mingmen feeds the heat. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：LU9］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL43］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: LU9] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL43]

patterns.presentation: 平素氣短自汗、易感冒、咳痰清稀、食少便溏、倦怠乏力，舌淡、脈弱
patterns.presentationEn: Habitual shortness of breath and spontaneous sweating, frequent colds, thin sputum, poor appetite and loose stool, fatigue; pale tongue, weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Lung and Spleen, boost qi and consolidate the exterior
patterns.method: 補法加灸；三伏天灸肺俞、定喘、膏肓
patterns.methodEn: Tonifying with moxa; dog-day moxa at Feishu, Dingchuan and Gaohuang
patterns.rationale: 肺俞配太淵補肺；脾俞、足三里、中脘、三陰交培土生金；氣海補氣；膏肓補虛勞。
patterns.rationaleEn: Feishu with Taiyuan tonifies the Lung; Pishu, Zusanli, Zhongwan and Sanyinjiao build Earth to generate Metal; Qihai tonifies qi; Gaohuang tonifies deficiency.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。緩解期清瀉傷正。［風險區 vessels-nerves：LU5］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Clearing and reducing in remission injures the upright qi. [risk zone vessels-nerves: LU5] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

patterns.presentation: 喘促日久、動則氣喘、呼多吸少、腰膝痠軟、畏寒肢冷或潮熱盜汗，舌淡或紅、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Chronic wheezing worse on exertion, more exhalation than inhalation, weak lumbar region and knees, cold limbs or tidal fever with night sweats; pale or red tongue, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Kidney to grasp qi, calm wheezing
patterns.method: 補法；陽虛加灸關元、命門，陰虛不灸
patterns.methodEn: Tonifying; moxa Guanyuan and Mingmen for yang deficiency, none for yin deficiency
patterns.rationale: 腎俞、太谿、關元補腎納氣；氣海納氣歸元；命門溫腎陽；俞府為腎經止於胸之穴，止喘；肺俞、膏肓補肺；膻中氣會。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shenshu, Taixi and Guanyuan tonify the Kidney to grasp qi; Qihai returns qi to its origin; Mingmen warms Kidney yang; Shufu, where the Kidney channel ends on the chest, stops wheezing; Feishu and Gaohuang tonify the Lung; Danzhong is the hui of qi.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 vessels-nerves：LU5］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone vessels-nerves: LU5] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。偏陽虛者寒涼之穴更傷腎陽。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. In the yang-deficient type cooling points further injure Kidney yang.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。瀉肝膽、通便之穴與腎不納氣無關。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Liver-Gallbladder draining or bowel-freeing points have nothing to do with the Kidney failing to grasp qi.

combos.why: 背部肺俞定喘、前胸天突膻中前後夾擊，尺澤列缺宣降肺氣，豐隆化痰。
combos.whyEn: Feishu and Dingchuan behind with Tiantu and Danzhong in front, Chize and Lieque to diffuse and descend Lung qi, Fenglong for phlegm.

combos.why: 肺脾腎三臟同補，以灸為主（三伏灸）。
combos.whyEn: Tonify Lung, Spleen and Kidney together, mainly by moxa (dog-day moxa).

combos.why: 任脈胸部穴配內關寬胸、俞府納氣。
combos.whyEn: Conception-vessel chest points with Neiguan to expand the chest and Shufu to grasp qi.

conditions.overview: 病位在胃，涉及肝、脾。實證：寒邪犯胃、飲食停滯、肝氣犯胃、瘀血停胃；虛證：脾胃虛寒、胃陰不足。基本方：中脘（胃募、腑會）、內關、足三里（「肚腹三里留」），配公孫（內關公孫對）。急性胃痛加梁丘（郄穴）。
conditions.overviewEn: Located in the Stomach and involving the Liver and Spleen. Excess: cold invading the Stomach, food stagnation, Liver qi invading the Stomach, blood stasis; deficiency: Spleen-Stomach deficiency cold, Stomach yin deficiency. Base: CV12 (Stomach mu, hui of the fu), PC6, ST36 ('for the abdomen keep Zusanli'), with SP4 (the PC6-SP4 pair). Acute pain adds ST34 (xi-cleft).
conditions.redFlags: 嘔血或黑便、劇烈腹痛伴板狀腹（穿孔）、持續嘔吐、吞嚥困難、體重減輕、貧血、50歲以上新發、上腹痛放射至胸背伴冷汗（心肌梗塞、主動脈剝離、胰臟炎）、黃疸 → 急診／內視鏡，不以針灸處理。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Haematemesis or melaena, severe pain with a rigid abdomen (perforation), persistent vomiting, dysphagia, weight loss, anaemia, new onset over 50, epigastric pain radiating to the chest or back with cold sweat (myocardial infarction, aortic dissection, pancreatitis), jaundice: emergency or endoscopy, not acupuncture.

patterns.presentation: 胃痛暴作、惡寒喜暖、得溫痛減、遇寒加重、口不渴、喜熱飲，苔白、脈弦緊
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden epigastric pain, aversion to cold and liking warmth, eased by warmth and worse with cold, no thirst, prefers hot drinks; white coat, wiry tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm the middle and scatter cold, harmonise the Stomach and stop pain
patterns.methodEn: Reducing with moxa; ginger moxa at Shenque
patterns.rationale: 中脘、胃俞俞募相配，灸之溫中；梁丘郄穴止急痛；足三里、內關、公孫和胃止痛；神闕隔薑灸散寒。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zhongwan and Weishu (shu-mu pair) moxa'd to warm the middle; Liangqiu stops acute pain; Zusanli, Neiguan and Gongsun harmonise the Stomach; ginger moxa on Shenque scatters cold.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。內庭、曲池清胃熱於寒證加重。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Neiting and Quchi clear Stomach heat and worsen a cold pattern. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

patterns.presentation: 胃脘脹痛拒按、噯腐吞酸、嘔吐不消化食物、吐後痛減、厭食、大便不爽，苔厚膩、脈滑
patterns.presentationEn: Distending pain refusing pressure, sour putrid belching, vomiting of undigested food relieving the pain, aversion to food, unsatisfying stool; thick greasy coat, slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Disperse food and guide out stagnation, harmonise the Stomach
patterns.rationale: 中脘、下脘、建里、梁門消積導滯（局部）；足三里、內庭瀉陽明通降；內關、公孫止嘔；天樞通腑。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zhongwan, Xiawan, Jianli and Liangmen disperse accumulation locally; Zusanli and Neiting reduce yangming to restore descent; Neiguan and Gongsun stop vomiting; Tianshu frees the bowel.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。補脾於食滯更壅。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、SP6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying the Spleen during food stagnation worsens the blockage. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, SP6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。食積化熱者灸之助熱。［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa when stagnation has transformed to heat feeds it. [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

patterns.presentation: 胃脘脹痛連脅、攻撐走竄、噯氣頻繁、情緒不暢加重、善太息、矢氣則舒，苔薄白、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Distending pain spreading to the flanks, wandering, frequent belching, worse with stress, sighing, relieved by flatus; thin white coat, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Spread the Liver and regulate qi, harmonise the Stomach and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 太衝疏肝、期門肝募、陽陵泉膽合，三穴平木以安土；中脘、足三里和胃；內關寬胸理氣止痛；膻中氣會。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong spreads the Liver, Qimen is the Liver mu, Yanglingquan the Gallbladder he-sea - the three calm Wood to settle Earth; Zhongwan and Zusanli harmonise the Stomach; Neiguan regulates qi and stops pain; Danzhong is the hui of qi.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡，所取之經不過病所。 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points - the channel chosen does not pass through the affected region. Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.presentation: 胃痛隱隱綿綿、喜溫喜按、空腹痛甚得食則緩、泛吐清水、神疲肢冷、便溏，舌淡苔白、脈虛弱
patterns.presentationEn: Dull lingering pain liking warmth and pressure, worse when hungry and eased by food, vomiting of clear fluid, fatigue and cold limbs, loose stool; pale tongue with white coat, weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm the middle and fortify the Spleen, harmonise the Stomach
patterns.rationale: 脾俞、胃俞、中脘俞募相配補益脾胃；足三里補中；氣海、關元溫補元氣；神闕隔薑灸；公孫、內關和胃。
patterns.rationaleEn: Pishu, Weishu and Zhongwan (shu-mu) tonify Spleen and Stomach; Zusanli tonifies the middle; Qihai and Guanyuan warm the original qi; ginger moxa at Shenque; Gongsun and Neiguan harmonise.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

patterns.presentation: 胃脘隱隱灼痛、嘈雜似飢而不欲食、口燥咽乾、大便乾結、五心煩熱，舌紅少津少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Dull burning pain, gnawing hunger without desire to eat, dry mouth and throat, dry stool, heat in the palms and soles; red dry tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish yin and benefit the Stomach, harmonise the middle
patterns.rationale: 三陰交、太谿、照海滋陰；中脘、足三里益胃；內庭輕瀉清虛熱；內關和胃止痛。
patterns.rationaleEn: Sanyinjiao, Taixi and Zhaohai nourish yin; Zhongwan and Zusanli benefit the Stomach; Neiting lightly reduced clears deficiency heat; Neiguan harmonises and stops pain.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸之傷陰。［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa injures yin. [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］

combos.why: 胃募腑會配肚腹三里，內關公孫為八脈交會對治心胸胃，各型胃痛基礎。
combos.whyEn: Stomach mu and hui of the fu with Zusanli; Neiguan and Gongsun as the confluent pair for the chest and stomach - the base for every type.

combos.why: 梁丘郄穴主急性胃痛。
combos.whyEn: Liangqiu, the xi-cleft point, for acute epigastric pain.

combos.why: 中脘配胃俞脾俞前後補虛，加灸。
combos.whyEn: Zhongwan with Weishu and Pishu front and back, with moxa.

conditions.overview: 胃失和降、氣逆於上。實證：外邪犯胃、飲食停滯、痰飲內阻、肝氣犯胃；虛證：脾胃虛寒、胃陰不足。基本方：中脘、內關、足三里、公孫；內關為止嘔第一要穴。
conditions.overviewEn: The Stomach loses its harmonious descent and qi rebels upward. Excess: external pathogen, food stagnation, phlegm-fluids, Liver qi invading the Stomach; deficiency: Spleen-Stomach deficiency cold, Stomach yin deficiency. Base: CV12, PC6, ST36, SP4; Neiguan is the foremost anti-emetic point.
conditions.redFlags: 噴射性嘔吐伴劇烈頭痛或意識改變（顱內壓升高）、嘔血或咖啡渣樣物、劇烈腹痛腹膜炎徵象、腸阻塞（腹脹無排氣）、嚴重脫水、妊娠劇吐伴酮症、糖尿病酮酸中毒、嬰幼兒持續嘔吐 → 急診。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Projectile vomiting with severe headache or altered consciousness (raised intracranial pressure), haematemesis or coffee-ground vomitus, severe abdominal pain with peritoneal signs, bowel obstruction (distension without flatus), severe dehydration, hyperemesis gravidarum with ketosis, diabetic ketoacidosis, persistent vomiting in infants: emergency.

patterns.presentation: 突然嘔吐、胸脘滿悶、惡寒發熱、頭身疼痛，苔白、脈濡緩
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden vomiting, chest and epigastric fullness, chills and fever, head and body aches; white coat, soggy moderate pulse
patterns.principleEn: Expel the pathogen and release the exterior, harmonise the Stomach and descend rebellion
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; moxa may be added at Shangwan and Weishu
patterns.rationale: 上脘、中脘局部和胃；內關降逆止嘔；足三里、公孫和中；合谷、風池解表祛邪；胃俞灸之溫胃。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shangwan and Zhongwan harmonise locally; Neiguan descends rebellion; Zusanli and Gongsun harmonise the middle; Hegu and Fengchi release the exterior; Weishu moxa'd warms the Stomach.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］

[risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

patterns.presentation: 食入即吐、嘔吐酸苦、口臭口渴、便秘尿黃、煩躁，舌紅苔黃、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Vomiting immediately after eating, sour bitter vomitus, halitosis and thirst, constipation and dark urine, agitation; red tongue with yellow coat, slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear Stomach heat, descend rebellion and stop vomiting
patterns.method: 瀉法，金津玉液、曲澤可點刺出血；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; Jinjin/Yuye and Quze may be bled; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 內庭瀉胃火、合谷曲池清陽明；金津玉液點刺出血清胃熱止嘔；曲澤刺絡治熱吐；內關、中脘和胃降逆。
patterns.rationaleEn: Neiting drains Stomach fire, Hegu and Quchi clear yangming; bleeding Jinjin/Yuye clears Stomach heat and stops vomiting; bleeding Quze treats heat vomiting; Neiguan and Zhongwan harmonise and descend.

wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa feeds the heat. [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL21] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

patterns.presentationEn: Vomiting with acid regurgitation, frequent belching, chest and flank fullness, triggered by emotion, vexation; thin greasy coat, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Spread the Liver and harmonise the Stomach, descend rebellion
patterns.rationale: 太衝、陽陵泉疏肝利膽；期門肝募；內關、中脘降逆止嘔；膻中理氣；足三里、公孫和中。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong and Yanglingquan spread the Liver and Gallbladder; Qimen is the Liver mu; Neiguan and Zhongwan descend rebellion; Danzhong regulates qi; Zusanli and Gongsun harmonise.

patterns.presentationEn: Vomiting after slight excess of food, intermittent, pale and fatigued, likes warmth and dislikes cold, no thirst, loose stool; pale tongue, soggy weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm the middle and fortify the Spleen, harmonise the Stomach
patterns.rationale: 脾俞、胃俞、中脘俞募相配溫補；足三里補中；氣海、關元、神闕灸之溫陽；內關、公孫和胃。
patterns.rationaleEn: Pishu, Weishu and Zhongwan (shu-mu) warm and tonify; Zusanli tonifies the middle; Qihai, Guanyuan and Shenque moxa'd warm yang; Neiguan and Gongsun harmonise.

combos.whyEn: Neiguan-Gongsun confluent pair with Zhongwan and Zusanli.

combos.whyEn: Shu-mu pairs with ginger moxa at Shenque.

conditions.overview: 胃氣上逆動膈。實證：胃寒、胃火、氣機鬱滯；虛證：脾胃陽虛、胃陰不足。基本方：膈俞（血會，近膈）、內關、中脘、足三里、膻中；攢竹、翳風為治呃逆經驗奇效穴。
conditions.overviewEn: Stomach qi rebelling upward and stirring the diaphragm. Excess: Stomach cold, Stomach fire, qi constraint; deficiency: Spleen-Stomach yang deficiency, Stomach yin deficiency. Base: BL17 (hui of blood, near the diaphragm), PC6, CV12, ST36, CV17; Cuanzhu (BL2) and Yifeng (TE17) are empirical points of remarkable effect.

patterns.rationaleEn: Geshu relaxes the diaphragm; Neiguan descends rebellion; Zhongwan, Shangwan and Weishu warm the Stomach (moxa); Zusanli harmonises; Cuanzhu and Yifeng are the empirical hiccup points.

combos.whyEn: Geshu for the diaphragm, Neiguan to descend, Zhongwan and Zusanli to harmonise, Danzhong for qi.

conditions.overview: 病位在脾、胃、大小腸，關鍵在脾虛濕盛。急性：寒濕、濕熱、食滯；慢性：脾虛、腎陽虛（五更泄）、肝鬱乘脾。基本方：天樞（大腸募）、大腸俞、上巨虛（大腸下合）、足三里、陰陵泉；寒濕、虛證灸神闕。
conditions.overviewEn: Located in the Spleen, Stomach and intestines; the key is Spleen deficiency with exuberant damp. Acute: cold-damp, damp-heat, food stagnation; chronic: Spleen deficiency, Kidney yang deficiency (dawn diarrhoea), Liver constraint overacting on the Spleen. Base: ST25 (Large Intestine mu), BL25, ST37 (lower he-sea), ST36, SP9; moxa Shenque for cold-damp and deficiency.
conditions.redFlags: 血便或黑便、高燒、嚴重脫水（尿少、意識改變）、劇烈腹痛、嬰幼兒與老人脫水、腹瀉超過兩週、體重減輕、近期抗生素使用（偽膜性腸炎）、旅行者腹瀉伴發燒 → 轉診。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Bloody or black stool, high fever, severe dehydration (oliguria, altered consciousness), severe abdominal pain, dehydration in infants or the elderly, diarrhoea over two weeks, weight loss, recent antibiotics (pseudomembranous colitis), traveller's diarrhoea with fever: refer.

patterns.presentation: 泄瀉清稀如水、腹痛腸鳴、脘悶食少、惡寒或身痛，苔白膩、脈濡緩
patterns.presentationEn: Watery stool, abdominal pain and borborygmus, epigastric oppression and poor appetite, chills or body aches; white greasy coat, soggy moderate pulse
patterns.principleEn: Scatter cold and resolve damp, fortify the Spleen and stop diarrhoea
patterns.method: 平補平瀉；神闕（隔薑灸，禁針）、天樞加灸
patterns.methodEn: Even method; moxa Shenque (ginger moxa only, never needled) and Tianshu
patterns.rationale: 天樞、上巨虛募合相配調腸；陰陵泉化濕；神闕隔薑灸散寒止瀉；中脘、足三里健脾；大腸俞、脾俞背部相應。
patterns.rationaleEn: Tianshu and Shangjuxu (mu with lower he-sea) regulate the bowel; Yinlingquan resolves damp; ginger moxa at Shenque scatters cold and stops diarrhoea; Zhongwan and Zusanli fortify the Spleen; Dachangshu and Pishu on the back.

wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT7]

patterns.presentation: 泄瀉腹痛、瀉下急迫、糞色黃褐臭穢、肛門灼熱、煩熱口渴、尿黃，苔黃膩、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Urgent diarrhoea with abdominal pain, foul yellow-brown stool, burning anus, heat and thirst, dark urine; yellow greasy coat, slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and drain damp, regulate the bowel
patterns.rationale: 天樞、上巨虛調腸；陰陵泉利濕；內庭、曲池、合谷清陽明濕熱；中脘和中。
patterns.rationaleEn: Tianshu and Shangjuxu regulate the bowel; Yinlingquan drains damp; Neiting, Quchi and Hegu clear yangming damp-heat; Zhongwan harmonises.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸之助熱。［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa feeds the heat. [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。濕熱盛時補益留邪。［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying while damp-heat is exuberant retains the pathogen. [risk zone pregnancy: SP6] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

patterns.presentation: 大便時溏時瀉、反覆發作、食油膩則加重、食少腹脹、面黃倦怠，舌淡苔白、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Alternating loose stool and diarrhoea, recurrent, worse with greasy food, poor appetite and distension, sallow and fatigued; pale tongue with white coat, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and boost qi, drain damp and stop diarrhoea
patterns.rationale: 脾俞、足三里、太白補脾；中脘、關元、神闕灸之溫中；天樞、上巨虛調腸；陰陵泉滲濕。
patterns.rationaleEn: Pishu, Zusanli and Taibai tonify the Spleen; Zhongwan, Guanyuan and Shenque moxa'd warm the middle; Tianshu and Shangjuxu regulate the bowel; Yinlingquan drains damp.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

wrong.zh: 沉降、通下之穴用於氣虛下陷，正氣更陷：脫肛、泄瀉、乏力加重。通下、瀉陽明之穴用瀉法於脾虛久瀉，更瀉。
wrong.en: Descending or purging points in sinking qi deficiency drive the qi further down: prolapse, diarrhoea and fatigue worsen. Bowel-freeing or yangming-reducing points in chronic Spleen-deficient diarrhoea loosen it further.

patterns.presentation: 黎明前腹痛腸鳴即瀉、瀉後則安、形寒肢冷、腰膝痠軟，舌淡苔白、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Pre-dawn abdominal pain and borborygmus with diarrhoea relieved afterward, cold body and limbs, weak lumbar region and knees; pale tongue with white coat, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm the Kidney and fortify the Spleen, astringe and stop diarrhoea
patterns.rationale: 腎俞、命門、關元前後相配灸之溫腎陽（命門火衰）；脾俞、足三里補脾；神闕隔鹽灸固澀；天樞、大腸俞調腸。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shenshu, Mingmen and Guanyuan front and back moxa'd warm Kidney yang (decline of the gate-of-life fire); Pishu and Zusanli tonify the Spleen; salt moxa at Shenque astringes; Tianshu and Dachangshu regulate the bowel.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。陰陵泉利濕於腎陽虛者更傷陽。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Yinlingquan drains damp and further injures yang in Kidney-yang deficiency.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

patterns.en: Liver constraint overacting on the Spleen
patterns.presentation: 腹痛即瀉、瀉後痛減、情緒緊張誘發、胸脅脹悶、噯氣食少，舌淡紅、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Abdominal pain followed by diarrhoea that relieves it, triggered by stress, chest and flank oppression, belching and poor appetite; pale red tongue, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Restrain the Liver and support the Spleen, regulate qi and stop diarrhoea
patterns.method: 補瀉兼施：虛者補、實者瀉
patterns.methodEn: Combined: tonify the deficient aspect, reduce the excess aspect
patterns.rationale: 太衝、陽陵泉、期門瀉以疏肝；足三里、脾俞、三陰交補以扶脾（痛瀉要方之意）；天樞、上巨虛調腸；內關寧神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong, Yanglingquan and Qimen reduced to spread the Liver; Zusanli, Pishu and Sanyinjiao tonified to support the Spleen (the idea of Tong Xie Yao Fang); Tianshu and Shangjuxu regulate the bowel; Neiguan calms.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。補肝於肝鬱更鬱。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying the Liver while it is constrained tightens the constraint. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14] [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

combos.why: 大腸募、下合、足三里、陰陵泉、大腸俞，各型基礎。
combos.whyEn: Large Intestine mu, lower he-sea, Zusanli, Yinlingquan and Dachangshu - base for all types.

combos.why: 神闕隔鹽灸配關元、脾俞、腎俞、足三里。
combos.whyEn: Salt moxa at Shenque with Guanyuan, Pishu, Shenshu and Zusanli.

combos.why: 抑木扶土。
combos.whyEn: Restrain Wood and support Earth.

conditions.overview: 大腸傳導失常。實秘：熱秘、氣秘；虛秘：氣虛、血虛、陰虛、陽虛（冷秘）。基本方：天樞、支溝（通便經驗要穴）、上巨虛、大腸俞；熱秘加合谷曲池內庭，氣秘加太衝中脘，虛秘補脾俞氣海足三里，冷秘灸神闕關元。
conditions.overviewEn: Failure of Large Intestine transmission. Excess: heat constipation, qi constipation; deficiency: qi, blood, yin or yang deficiency (cold constipation). Base: ST25, TE6 (empirical point for constipation), ST37, BL25; heat adds LI4, LI11 and ST44; qi adds LR3 and CV12; deficiency tonifies BL20, CV6 and ST36; cold constipation moxas CV8 and CV4.
conditions.redFlags: 便血、黑便、體重減輕、貧血、50歲以上新發排便習慣改變、腸阻塞徵象（腹脹劇痛嘔吐無排氣）、腹部腫塊、神經症狀 → 腸鏡／急診。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Rectal bleeding, melaena, weight loss, anaemia, new change in bowel habit over 50, signs of obstruction (distension, severe pain, vomiting, no flatus), abdominal mass, neurological signs: colonoscopy or emergency.

patterns.presentation: 大便乾結、腹脹腹痛、面紅身熱、口乾口臭、尿黃，舌紅苔黃燥、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Dry hard stool, abdominal distension and pain, red face and heat, dry mouth and halitosis, dark urine; red tongue with dry yellow coat, slippery rapid pulse
