patterns.principleEn: Clear heat, moisten the intestines and free the bowels
patterns.rationale: 天樞、上巨虛、大腸俞調大腸；支溝通三焦氣機而通便；曲池、合谷、內庭清陽明之熱；中脘和胃通降。
patterns.rationaleEn: Tianshu, Shangjuxu and Dachangshu regulate the Large Intestine; Zhigou frees the qi of the three jiao and the bowels; Quchi, Hegu and Neiting clear yangming heat; Zhongwan restores descent.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸之助熱結。［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa worsens the heat binding. [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: SP6] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20] [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.presentation: 大便不暢、欲便不得、噯氣頻作、胸脅痞滿、腹脹痛、情志不遂加重，苔薄膩、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Unsatisfying defaecation with urge but no result, frequent belching, chest and flank fullness, distending pain, worse with stress; thin greasy coat, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Regulate qi and guide out stagnation, free the bowels
patterns.rationale: 太衝、陽陵泉疏肝理氣；支溝、膻中、氣海調氣機；天樞、中脘、上巨虛導滯通便；內關寬胸。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong and Yanglingquan spread Liver qi; Zhigou, Danzhong and Qihai regulate qi; Tianshu, Zhongwan and Shangjuxu guide out stagnation; Neiguan expands the chest.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

patterns.presentation: 大便不乾硬但排出困難、臨廁努掙乏力、便後汗出氣短、面白頭暈、心悸，舌淡、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Stool not hard yet hard to pass, straining without strength, sweating and breathlessness after defaecation, pale face and dizziness, palpitations; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Boost qi and nourish blood, moisten the intestines
patterns.rationale: 足三里、脾俞、胃俞、氣海補氣；三陰交、膈俞養血；照海滋陰潤腸；天樞、上巨虛調腸（輕刺）。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli, Pishu, Weishu and Qihai tonify qi; Sanyinjiao and Geshu nourish blood; Zhaohai enriches yin to moisten; Tianshu and Shangjuxu gently regulate the bowel.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。攻下通瀉之穴於虛者愈虛。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Purging points in deficiency deplete further. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

patterns.presentation: 大便艱澀、排出困難、腹中冷痛、喜熱怕冷、小便清長、腰膝冷痛，舌淡苔白、脈沉遲
patterns.presentationEn: Difficult sluggish defaecation, cold abdominal pain, likes warmth, clear copious urine, cold aching lumbar region and knees; pale tongue with white coat, deep slow pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm yang and free the bowels
patterns.rationale: 關元、氣海、神闕（隔鹽灸，禁針）溫下焦；腎俞、命門溫腎陽；天樞、大腸俞、上巨虛調腸；足三里補中。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan, Qihai and Shenque (salt moxa only, never needled) warm the lower jiao; Shenshu and Mingmen warm Kidney yang; Tianshu, Dachangshu and Shangjuxu regulate the bowel; Zusanli tonifies the middle.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。攻下強瀉於陽虛冷秘更傷陽氣。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Purging reduction in yang-deficient cold constipation further injures yang. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］［風險區 vessels-nerves：HT7］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20] [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT7]

combos.why: 大腸募俞與下合穴加支溝。
combos.whyEn: Large Intestine mu, shu and lower he-sea with Zhigou.

combos.why: 天樞支溝通便，曲池合谷內庭清瀉陽明之熱。
combos.whyEn: Tianshu and Zhigou free the bowels; Quchi, Hegu and Neiting clear yangming heat.

combos.why: 補氣養血滋陰以潤腸，天樞輕刺調腸，不用攻下。
combos.whyEn: Tonify qi, blood and yin to moisten the intestines; Tianshu lightly regulates the bowel; no purging.

conditions.overview: 「不通則痛」（實：氣滯血瘀、寒凝血瘀）與「不榮則痛」（虛：氣血虛弱、肝腎虧虛）。實證：中極、三陰交、地機（郄穴）、次髎、血海，經前或經期治；虛證：關元、足三里、三陰交、氣海（補、灸），經後治。衝任、胞宮為病位。
conditions.overviewEn: 'Obstruction causes pain' (excess: qi stagnation with blood stasis, cold congealing) and 'lack of nourishment causes pain' (deficiency: qi-blood weakness, Liver-Kidney deficiency). Excess: CV3, SP6, SP8 (xi-cleft), BL32, SP10, treated before and during menses; deficiency: CV4, ST36, SP6, CV6 (tonify, moxa), treated after menses. The disorder lies in the Chong and Ren vessels and uterus.
conditions.redFlags: 可能懷孕者之下腹痛（異位妊娠）、發燒伴分泌物（骨盆腔炎）、繼發性痛經進行性加重（子宮內膜異位、肌瘤、腺肌症）、非經期疼痛、大量出血 → 婦科評估；確認未懷孕後方可取三陰交、合谷、下腹穴。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Lower abdominal pain in a woman who could be pregnant (ectopic pregnancy), fever with discharge (pelvic inflammatory disease), progressive secondary dysmenorrhoea (endometriosis, fibroids, adenomyosis), pain outside menses, heavy bleeding: gynaecological assessment; SP6, LI4 and lower-abdominal points only after pregnancy is excluded.

patterns.presentation: 經前或經期小腹脹痛拒按、經血量少不暢、色暗有塊、塊下痛減、胸脅乳房脹痛，舌暗有瘀點、脈弦澀
patterns.presentationEn: Premenstrual or menstrual distending pain refusing pressure, scanty unsmooth dark clotted flow eased when clots pass, breast and flank distension; dusky tongue with stasis spots, wiry choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Move qi and invigorate blood, dispel stasis and stop pain
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; begin 3-5 days before the period
patterns.rationale: 中極為任脈與足三陰交會、通調衝任；三陰交調肝脾腎、地機脾經郄穴止急痛；太衝疏肝理氣；血海、膈俞活血；次髎為婦科腰骶要穴；合谷配三陰交行氣活血（確認未孕）。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zhongji, meeting of the Conception vessel and three foot yin, regulates Chong and Ren; Sanyinjiao regulates Liver, Spleen and Kidney and Diji, the Spleen xi-cleft, stops acute pain; Taichong spreads Liver qi; Xuehai and Geshu move blood; Ciliao is the key sacral gynaecological point; Hegu with Sanyinjiao moves qi and blood (pregnancy excluded).

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。實證經前補益，瘀更滯。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying before menses in an excess pattern thickens the stasis. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：上肢肺、大腸、三焦經穴與衝任胞宮無關， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Arm points of the Lung, Large Intestine and Triple Energizer have no link to Chong, Ren or the uterus; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。化痰利水之穴對氣滯血瘀無益；且取合谷三陰交前必須排除懷孕。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Phlegm- and water-draining points do nothing for qi-blood stasis; and pregnancy must be excluded before Hegu or Sanyinjiao are used at all. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

patterns.presentation: 經前或經期小腹冷痛、得熱痛減、經血量少色暗、畏寒肢冷、面色青白，苔白、脈沉緊
patterns.presentationEn: Cold lower abdominal pain eased by warmth, scanty dark flow, cold intolerance and cold limbs, pale bluish complexion; white coat, deep tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm the channels and scatter cold, dispel stasis and stop pain
patterns.method: 瀉法加灸；關元、歸來溫和灸或隔薑灸
patterns.methodEn: Reducing with moxa; gentle or ginger moxa at Guanyuan and Guilai
patterns.rationale: 關元、歸來灸之溫暖胞宮；三陰交、地機調經止痛；中極通調衝任；次髎、腎俞、命門溫腎散寒；血海活血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan and Guilai moxa'd warm the uterus; Sanyinjiao and Diji regulate menses and stop pain; Zhongji regulates Chong and Ren; Ciliao, Shenshu and Mingmen warm the Kidney; Xuehai moves blood.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］［風險區 vessels-nerves：HT7］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20] [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT7]

patterns.presentation: 經後小腹隱痛喜按、經血量少色淡質稀、面色萎黃、神疲乏力、頭暈心悸，舌淡、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Dull post-menstrual pain liking pressure, scanty pale thin flow, sallow complexion, fatigue, dizziness and palpitations; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify qi and nourish blood, regulate menses and stop pain
patterns.method: 補法加灸；經後開始治療
patterns.methodEn: Tonifying with moxa; begin after the period
patterns.rationale: 關元、氣海補益元氣；足三里、脾俞、胃俞健脾生血；三陰交、膈俞、血海養血調經；腎俞補腎。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan and Qihai tonify original qi; Zusanli, Pishu and Weishu fortify the Spleen to make blood; Sanyinjiao, Geshu and Xuehai nourish blood and regulate menses; Shenshu tonifies the Kidney.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。瀉法行氣活血於虛者更虛。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4、BL32］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Reducing qi- and blood-moving points in deficiency depletes further. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4, BL32]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。清熱寒涼於氣血虛者更傷陽氣。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Cooling points further injure yang in qi-blood deficiency.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20] [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.presentation: 經後小腹綿綿作痛、腰骶痠痛、經血量少色淡、頭暈耳鳴、潮熱，舌淡紅少苔、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Lingering post-menstrual pain, aching lumbosacral region, scanty pale flow, dizziness and tinnitus, tidal fever; pale red tongue with scanty coat, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish the Liver and Kidney, regulate menses and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 太谿、腎俞、肝俞補肝腎；曲泉肝經母穴；照海滋陰；關元、中極調衝任；三陰交總調三陰。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi, Shenshu and Ganshu tonify Liver-Kidney; Ququan is the Liver mother point; Zhaohai enriches yin; Guanyuan and Zhongji regulate Chong and Ren; Sanyinjiao regulates the three yin.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 pregnancy：SP10］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone pregnancy: SP10]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。偏陰虛有潮熱者灸之傷陰。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa with tidal fever from yin deficiency injures yin. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone forbidden: CV8]

combos.why: 經前瀉之行氣活血。
combos.whyEn: Reduced before menses to move qi and blood.

combos.why: 經後補之，加灸。
combos.whyEn: Tonified after menses, with moxa.

combos.why: 溫暖胞宮。
combos.whyEn: Warm the uterus.

conditions.overview: 分月經先期（血熱、氣虛）、月經後期（血寒、血虛、氣滯）、先後不定期（肝鬱、腎虛）。病位在衝任、胞宮，與肝脾腎相關。先期：關元、三陰交、血海；後期：氣海、三陰交、歸來；不定期：關元、三陰交、肝俞、腎俞。
conditions.overviewEn: Divided into early periods (blood heat, qi deficiency), late periods (blood cold, blood deficiency, qi stagnation) and irregular periods (Liver constraint, Kidney deficiency). The disorder lies in Chong, Ren and the uterus, involving Liver, Spleen and Kidney. Early: CV4, SP6, SP10; late: CV6, SP6, ST29; irregular: CV4, SP6, BL18, BL23.
conditions.redFlags: 停經後出血、大量出血伴頭暈心悸（貧血、休克）、妊娠期出血、不規則出血伴體重改變／多毛／泌乳（內分泌病）、異常出血於40歲以上（排除子宮內膜病變）→ 婦科評估；取穴前須排除懷孕。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Post-menopausal bleeding, heavy bleeding with dizziness and palpitations (anaemia, shock), bleeding in pregnancy, irregular bleeding with weight change, hirsutism or galactorrhoea (endocrine disease), abnormal bleeding over 40 (exclude endometrial pathology): gynaecological assessment; exclude pregnancy before point selection.

patterns.presentation: 經期提前、量多色紅質稠、心煩口渴、面紅、尿黃便結，舌紅苔黃、脈數
patterns.presentationEn: Periods arriving early with heavy red thick flow, vexation and thirst, red face, dark urine and dry stool; red tongue with yellow coat, rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and cool blood, regulate menses
patterns.rationale: 關元調衝任；三陰交調三陰；血海涼血調經；行間瀉肝火、然谷清腎經虛火；地機脾郄止血；膈俞血會。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan regulates Chong and Ren; Sanyinjiao regulates the three yin; Xuehai cools blood; Xingjian drains Liver fire and Rangu clears Kidney-channel fire; Diji, Spleen xi-cleft, stops bleeding; Geshu is the hui of blood.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸之助熱動血，出血更多。［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa adds heat and stirs the blood, increasing bleeding. [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。血熱者補氣升提助熱。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying and lifting qi in blood heat feeds the heat. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20]

patterns.presentation: 經期提前、量多色淡質稀、神疲乏力、氣短懶言、小腹空墜、食少便溏，舌淡、脈弱
patterns.presentationEn: Early periods with heavy pale thin flow, fatigue, breathlessness, bearing-down sensation, poor appetite and loose stool; pale tongue, weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify qi to contain blood, regulate menses
patterns.rationale: 足三里、脾俞補脾攝血；關元、氣海補元氣；百會升提；隱白（灸）統血；三陰交調經。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli and Pishu tonify the Spleen to contain blood; Guanyuan and Qihai tonify original qi; Baihui lifts; Yinbai (moxa) controls blood; Sanyinjiao regulates menses.

wrong.zh: 活血破瘀之穴用於氣不攝血／出血證，血行更妄，出血加重。［風險區 pregnancy：SP10］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］
wrong.en: Blood-moving, stasis-breaking points in a bleeding pattern from qi failing to contain blood make the blood run wilder and bleeding increases. [risk zone pregnancy: SP10] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17]

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

patterns.presentation: 經期延後、量少色暗有塊、小腹冷痛得熱減、畏寒肢冷，苔白、脈沉緊
patterns.presentationEn: Delayed periods with scanty dark clotted flow, cold lower abdominal pain eased by warmth, cold intolerance; white coat, deep tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm the channels and scatter cold, regulate menses
patterns.rationale: 氣海、關元、歸來灸之溫暖胞宮；命門、腎俞溫腎；三陰交、地機調經；次髎溫通腰骶。
patterns.rationaleEn: Qihai, Guanyuan and Guilai moxa'd warm the uterus; Mingmen and Shenshu warm the Kidney; Sanyinjiao and Diji regulate menses; Ciliao warms the sacrum.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20]

patterns.presentation: 經期延後、量少色淡質稀、面色萎黃、頭暈眼花、心悸失眠，舌淡、脈細
patterns.presentationEn: Delayed scanty pale thin periods, sallow complexion, dizziness and blurred vision, palpitations and insomnia; pale tongue, thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish blood and the nutritive, regulate menses
patterns.rationale: 足三里、脾俞健脾生血；膈俞、血海、肝俞養血；氣海、關元補氣生血；三陰交調經；太谿補腎。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli and Pishu fortify the Spleen to make blood; Geshu, Xuehai and Ganshu nourish blood; Qihai and Guanyuan tonify qi to generate blood; Sanyinjiao regulates menses; Taixi tonifies the Kidney.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。血虛者利水更耗陰血。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. Draining water in blood deficiency further exhausts yin and blood. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

patterns.presentation: 經期先後不定、量或多或少、經行不暢、胸脅乳房脹痛、情志抑鬱、善太息，苔薄、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Unpredictable timing and amount, unsmooth flow, breast and flank distension, low mood and sighing; thin coat, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Spread the Liver and regulate qi, regulate menses
patterns.method: 補瀉兼施：虛者補、實者瀉
patterns.methodEn: Combined: tonify the deficient aspect, reduce the excess aspect
patterns.rationale: 太衝、期門、陽陵泉疏肝；肝俞、腎俞調補；關元、三陰交調衝任；內關寧神；血海活血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong, Qimen and Yanglingquan spread the Liver; Ganshu and Shenshu regulate and tonify; Guanyuan and Sanyinjiao regulate Chong and Ren; Neiguan calms; Xuehai moves blood.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。純補於肝鬱者更鬱。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Pure tonification in Liver constraint tightens it. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。肝鬱易化火，灸命門神闕助火。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Liver constraint readily turns to fire; moxa at Mingmen or Shenque feeds it. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone forbidden: CV8]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12]

combos.why: 關元三陰交調衝任三陰，血海調血，肝俞腎俞調本。
combos.whyEn: Guanyuan and Sanyinjiao regulate Chong, Ren and the three yin; Xuehai regulates blood; Ganshu and Shenshu regulate the root.

combos.why: 血熱先期：血海涼血、行間瀉肝火、地機止血，關元三陰交調衝任。
combos.whyEn: Early periods from blood heat: Xuehai cools blood, Xingjian drains Liver fire, Diji stops bleeding, Guanyuan and Sanyinjiao regulate Chong and Ren.

combos.why: 血寒血虛後期：灸氣海關元歸來命門溫養胞宮，足三里三陰交生血。
combos.whyEn: Late periods from cold or blood deficiency: moxa Qihai, Guanyuan, Guilai and Mingmen to warm the uterus; Zusanli and Sanyinjiao make blood.

conditions.zh: 不孕（輔助）／胎位不正（禁忌說明）
conditions.overview: 不孕以腎虛為本，兼肝鬱、痰濕、血瘀；針灸為輔助（含輔助生殖週期），取關元、子宮、三陰交、腎俞、足三里，依證加減。胎位不正：孕28–32週以溫和灸至陰（BL67）矯正，不針刺，須產科監督並排除禁忌（前置胎盤、多胎、羊水異常）。本條重點教學：一旦懷孕，合谷、三陰交、下腹腰骶穴即屬禁忌。
conditions.overviewEn: Infertility is rooted in Kidney deficiency with Liver constraint, phlegm-damp or blood stasis; acupuncture is adjunctive (including in assisted-reproduction cycles), using CV4, EX-CA1, SP6, BL23 and ST36 by pattern. Breech presentation: gentle moxa at Zhiyin (BL67) at 28-32 weeks, never needling, under obstetric supervision after excluding contraindications (placenta praevia, multiple pregnancy, abnormal liquor). The teaching point of this entry: once pregnancy exists, Hegu, Sanyinjiao and lower-abdominal or lumbosacral points become contraindicated.
conditions.redFlags: 不孕須先完成基本評估（排卵、輸卵管、精液、內分泌）而非單靠針灸；疑懷孕者於治療前必須驗孕；胎位不正灸至陰須產科同意與監測，若陰道出血、腹痛、胎動異常、破水 → 立即產科；孕婦禁針合谷、三陰交、崑崙、至陰、肩井及下腹腰骶穴。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Infertility requires a basic work-up (ovulation, tubes, semen, endocrine) rather than acupuncture alone; test for pregnancy before treatment whenever possible; moxa at Zhiyin for breech needs obstetric consent and monitoring, and vaginal bleeding, abdominal pain, abnormal foetal movement or rupture of membranes mean immediate obstetric care; in pregnancy Hegu, Sanyinjiao, Kunlun, Zhiyin, Jianjing and lower-abdominal or lumbosacral points are contraindicated for needling.

patterns.presentation: 婚久不孕、月經後期量少色淡、腰膝痠軟、頭暈耳鳴、性慾淡漠；陽虛畏寒、陰虛潮熱
patterns.presentationEn: Long-standing infertility, late scanty pale periods, weak lumbar region and knees, dizziness and tinnitus, low libido; cold intolerance if yang-deficient, tidal fever if yin-deficient
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Kidney and essence, regulate Chong and Ren
patterns.method: 補法；陽虛加灸關元、命門；陰虛不灸。確認未懷孕，排卵後、疑懷孕期停用下腹與三陰交
patterns.methodEn: Tonifying; moxa Guanyuan and Mingmen for yang deficiency, none for yin deficiency. Confirm non-pregnancy; stop lower-abdominal points and SP6 once pregnancy is possible
patterns.rationale: 關元、子宮穴直接溫養胞宮；腎俞、太谿補腎精；三陰交調三陰；命門溫腎陽；足三里補後天；次髎、中極通調衝任。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan and Zigong nourish the uterus directly; Shenshu and Taixi tonify Kidney essence; Sanyinjiao regulates the three yin; Mingmen warms Kidney yang; Zusanli tonifies the postnatal root; Ciliao and Zhongji regulate Chong and Ren.

wrong.zh: 孕婦取合谷、三陰交、崑崙、至陰、肩井或下腹／腰骶穴可能引發宮縮，有流產早產之虞（風險區：pregnancy）。若已受孕而繼續針刺這些穴位，可能引發宮縮、流產。
wrong.en: In pregnancy Hegu, Sanyinjiao, Kunlun, Zhiyin, Jianjing and lower-abdominal or lumbosacral points may induce uterine contraction with risk of miscarriage or premature labour (risk zone: pregnancy). Continuing to needle these points after conception may provoke contractions and miscarriage.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 pregnancy：SP10］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone pregnancy: SP10]

patterns.presentation: 婚久不孕、月經先後不定、經前乳脹、胸脅脹痛、情志抑鬱、善太息，脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Infertility with irregular timing, premenstrual breast distension, flank distension, low mood and sighing; wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Spread the Liver and resolve constraint, regulate Chong and Ren
patterns.method: 補瀉兼施：虛者補、實者瀉
patterns.methodEn: Combined: tonify the deficient aspect, reduce the excess aspect
patterns.rationale: 太衝、期門、陽陵泉疏肝；膻中、內關理氣寧神；肝俞調肝；關元、子宮、三陰交調衝任養胞宮。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong, Qimen and Yanglingquan spread the Liver; Danzhong and Neiguan regulate qi and calm; Ganshu regulates the Liver; Guanyuan, Zigong and Sanyinjiao regulate Chong and Ren and nourish the uterus.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。純補於肝鬱更鬱。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Pure tonification tightens the constraint. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：上肢陽經穴與衝任胞宮無涉， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Arm yang-channel points have no bearing on Chong, Ren or the uterus; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。且一旦受孕，下腹穴與三陰交即須停用。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. And once conception occurs, abdominal points and Sanyinjiao must be stopped. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

patterns.presentation: 形體肥胖、月經後期甚至閉經、帶下量多黏稠、胸悶痰多、倦怠，苔白膩、脈滑
patterns.presentationEn: Obesity, late periods or amenorrhoea, copious sticky leucorrhoea, chest oppression with phlegm, fatigue; white greasy coat, slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dry damp and resolve phlegm, regulate Chong and Ren
patterns.methodEn: Even method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 豐隆、中脘、陰陵泉化痰除濕；足三里、脾俞健脾治痰之源；帶脈穴止帶；關元、子宮、三陰交調衝任。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fenglong, Zhongwan and Yinlingquan resolve phlegm-damp; Zusanli and Pishu treat the Spleen source of phlegm; Daimai stops leucorrhoea; Guanyuan, Zigong and Sanyinjiao regulate Chong and Ren.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

patterns.presentation: 孕28–32週超音波確認臀位或橫位、無產科禁忌、孕婦一般狀況良好
patterns.presentationEn: Breech or transverse lie confirmed by ultrasound at 28-32 weeks, no obstetric contraindication, mother in good general condition
patterns.principle: 溫通經脈、促使胎轉（僅灸）
patterns.principleEn: Warm the channels to encourage version (moxa only)
patterns.method: 雙側至陰溫和艾條灸，每日一次，孕婦鬆開腰帶取舒適臥位或坐位，產科監督下施行；絕不針刺
patterns.methodEn: Gentle moxa-stick warming at both Zhiyin once daily, mother with loosened clothing in a comfortable reclining or sitting position, under obstetric supervision; never needled
patterns.rationale: 至陰為膀胱經井穴，足太陽經「入絡腎」而腎系胞，灸之激發經氣、調整胎位，是針灸學中唯一以灸矯正胎位之經典法。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zhiyin is the jing-well of the Bladder channel, which connects internally with the Kidney, and the Kidney governs the uterus; moxa here rouses channel qi to adjust foetal position - the single classic moxa method for breech in acupuncture.

wrong.zh: 孕婦取合谷、三陰交、崑崙、至陰、肩井或下腹／腰骶穴可能引發宮縮，有流產早產之虞（風險區：pregnancy）。此時這些催產穴絕對禁用；至陰本身也只灸不針。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：GB21］
wrong.en: In pregnancy Hegu, Sanyinjiao, Kunlun, Zhiyin, Jianjing and lower-abdominal or lumbosacral points may induce uterine contraction with risk of miscarriage or premature labour (risk zone: pregnancy). These labour-inducing points are absolutely forbidden now; Zhiyin itself is moxa'd, never needled. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: GB21]

wrong.zh: 孕期下腹與腰骶穴針刺可傷胎元、引發宮縮（風險區 pregnancy、abdomen-viscera），絕不可用於胎位矯正。
wrong.en: Needling lower-abdominal or lumbosacral points in pregnancy can harm the foetus and induce contractions (risk zones: pregnancy, abdomen-viscera); never used for version.

combos.why: 溫養胞宮、補腎益精，經後至排卵前施治，疑孕即停。
combos.whyEn: Nourish the uterus and Kidney essence, treated after menses until ovulation, stopped once pregnancy is possible.

combos.why: 太衝內關膻中疏肝理氣寧神，關元三陰交調衝任；排卵後疑孕即停腹部穴。
combos.whyEn: Taichong, Neiguan and Danzhong spread the Liver and calm; Guanyuan and Sanyinjiao regulate Chong and Ren; abdominal points stop once pregnancy is possible.

combos.why: 唯一正確組合：雙側至陰溫和灸，產科監督。
combos.whyEn: The only correct set: gentle moxa at both Zhiyin under obstetric supervision.

conditions.overview: 膀胱失約，多因腎氣不足、下元虛冷；亦有脾肺氣虛（氣不攝水）、肝經濕熱（實）。基本方：關元、中極（膀胱募）、膀胱俞、三陰交、腎俞；夜間遺尿加百會醒神。
conditions.overviewEn: Loss of Bladder control, usually from Kidney qi insufficiency with cold deficiency of the lower origin; also Lung-Spleen qi deficiency (qi failing to control water) and Liver-channel damp-heat (excess). Base: CV4, CV3 (Bladder mu), BL28, SP6, BL23; nocturnal enuresis adds GV20 to rouse the spirit.
conditions.redFlags: 繼發性遺尿（已控制後再發）、伴尿痛血尿發燒（泌尿道感染）、多飲多尿（糖尿病、尿崩）、日間失禁、脊柱異常或下肢神經症狀（隱性脊柱裂、脊髓病變）、五歲以下屬生理性 → 兒科／泌尿評估。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Secondary enuresis (relapse after control), dysuria, haematuria or fever (urinary infection), polydipsia and polyuria (diabetes, diabetes insipidus), daytime incontinence, spinal abnormality or leg neurological signs (spina bifida occulta, cord lesion); under five years it is physiological: paediatric or urological assessment.

patterns.presentation: 睡中遺尿、每夜一次以上、小便清長、面白神疲、肢涼怕冷、腰膝痠軟，舌淡、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Bed-wetting during sleep more than once nightly, clear copious urine, pale and tired, cold limbs, weak lumbar region and knees; pale tongue, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm and tonify Kidney qi, secure the lower origin
patterns.rationale: 關元、中極溫補下元；腎俞、命門、太谿補腎；膀胱俞配中極俞募固膀胱；三陰交調三陰；百會升陽醒神（夜間易醒）。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan and Zhongji warm the lower origin; Shenshu, Mingmen and Taixi tonify the Kidney; Pangguangshu with Zhongji (shu-mu) secures the Bladder; Sanyinjiao regulates the three yin; Baihui raises yang and rouses the spirit so the child wakes.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。利水清熱瀉法於腎虛者更虛。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL39］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Draining and heat-clearing reduction worsens Kidney deficiency. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL39]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。下元虛冷者寒涼更傷。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Cooling points further injure a cold-deficient lower origin. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：上肢陽經穴不主下焦膀胱， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Arm yang-channel points do not govern the lower-jiao Bladder; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor.

patterns.presentation: 遺尿、白天尿頻、易感冒、氣短乏力、食少便溏、面黃，舌淡、脈弱
patterns.presentationEn: Enuresis with daytime frequency, frequent colds, breathlessness and fatigue, poor appetite and loose stool, sallow; pale tongue, weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify Spleen and Lung, boost qi to secure
patterns.rationale: 肺俞、太淵補肺（肺主通調水道）；脾俞、足三里補脾；氣海補氣升提；關元、中極、膀胱俞固攝膀胱。
patterns.rationaleEn: Feishu and Taiyuan tonify the Lung (which regulates the waterways); Pishu and Zusanli tonify the Spleen; Qihai tonifies and lifts qi; Guanyuan, Zhongji and Pangguangshu secure the Bladder.

wrong.zh: 沉降、通下之穴用於氣虛下陷，正氣更陷：脫肛、泄瀉、乏力加重。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL39］
wrong.en: Descending or purging points in sinking qi deficiency drive the qi further down: prolapse, diarrhoea and fatigue worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL39]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

patterns.presentation: 遺尿、尿黃量少、尿味臊臭、性情急躁、夜間磨牙或夢語、面赤唇紅，苔黃膩、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Enuresis with scanty dark foul urine, irritable temperament, night grinding or sleep-talking, red face and lips; yellow greasy coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear the Liver and drain damp, regulate the Bladder
patterns.rationale: 行間瀉肝經濕熱（肝經環陰器）；陰陵泉利濕；中極、膀胱俞通調膀胱；陽陵泉、太衝疏肝。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xingjian drains Liver-channel damp-heat (the Liver channel circles the genitals); Yinlingquan drains damp; Zhongji and Pangguangshu regulate the Bladder; Yanglingquan and Taichong spread the Liver.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸溫補於濕熱者助熱。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Warming moxa in damp-heat feeds the heat. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20]

combos.why: 任脈下腹二穴配膀胱俞募與腎俞、三陰交。
combos.whyEn: Two lower-abdominal Conception-vessel points with the Bladder shu-mu pair, Shenshu and Sanyinjiao.

combos.why: 關元腎俞命門前後灸之溫補下元，太谿補腎，百會升陽醒神。
combos.whyEn: Guanyuan, Shenshu and Mingmen moxa'd front and back warm the lower origin; Taixi tonifies the Kidney; Baihui raises yang and rouses the spirit.

conditions.overview: 膀胱氣化失司。實證：膀胱濕熱、肝鬱氣滯、尿路瘀阻；虛證：腎陽虛衰、脾氣不升。基本方：中極、膀胱俞、三陰交、陰陵泉、秩邊（透水道方向，得氣達前陰）；術後、產後尿瀦留針灸效佳。下腹穴須注意膀胱充盈。
conditions.overviewEn: Failure of Bladder qi transformation. Excess: Bladder damp-heat, Liver qi constraint, obstruction of the urinary tract; deficiency: Kidney yang decline, Spleen qi not rising. Base: CV3, BL28, SP6, SP9, BL54 (directed toward Shuidao so sensation reaches the perineum); post-operative and post-partum retention respond well. Lower-abdominal points must respect the distended bladder.
conditions.redFlags: 急性完全尿瀦留伴劇烈脹痛以導尿為先，針灸為輔；伴發燒腰痛（腎盂腎炎）、血尿、脊髓損傷或馬尾徵象、前列腺腫大伴腎功能惡化、藥物引起 → 泌尿／急診。膀胱極度充盈時下腹穴不可深刺。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Acute complete retention with severe painful distension needs catheterisation first, acupuncture second; fever with flank pain (pyelonephritis), haematuria, spinal-cord or cauda equina signs, prostatic enlargement with deteriorating renal function, drug-induced retention: urology or emergency. Never needle lower-abdominal points deeply over a grossly distended bladder.

patterns.presentation: 小便點滴不通或量少灼熱、小腹脹滿、口苦口黏、便秘，舌紅苔黃膩、脈數
patterns.presentationEn: Dribbling or scanty burning urination, lower abdominal fullness, bitter sticky mouth, constipation; red tongue with yellow greasy coat, rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and drain damp, free the Bladder
patterns.method: 瀉法，不灸；中極向下斜刺淺刺
patterns.methodEn: Reducing, no moxa; Zhongji shallow and angled downward
patterns.rationale: 中極、膀胱俞俞募通調膀胱；陰陵泉清利濕熱；委陽三焦下合穴通水道；行間清肝經濕熱；水道、秩邊局部。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zhongji and Pangguangshu (shu-mu) regulate the Bladder; Yinlingquan clears damp-heat; Weiyang, lower he-sea of the Triple Energizer, frees the waterways; Xingjian clears Liver-channel damp-heat; Shuidao and Zhibian locally.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone forbidden: CV8]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

patterns.presentation: 小便不通或通而不暢、情志抑鬱或緊張後發、脅腹脹滿、善太息，苔薄、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Retention or hesitancy after emotional upset or tension, flank and abdominal distension, sighing; thin coat, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Spread the Liver and regulate qi, promote urination
patterns.rationale: 太衝、大敦（肝經環陰器）疏肝利尿；陽陵泉疏膽；中極、膀胱俞通膀胱；氣海調下焦氣機；秩邊透水道得氣達前陰；內關寧神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong and Dadun (the Liver channel circles the genitals) spread the Liver and promote urination; Yanglingquan spreads the Gallbladder; Zhongji and Pangguangshu free the Bladder; Qihai regulates lower-jiao qi; Zhibian directed toward Shuidao until sensation reaches the perineum; Neiguan calms.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14] [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.presentation: 小便不通或滴瀝、排出無力、面白神疲、畏寒肢冷、腰膝痠冷，舌淡苔白、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Retention or dribbling with no force, pale and tired, cold intolerance and cold limbs, cold aching lumbar region and knees; pale tongue with white coat, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm and tonify Kidney yang, transform qi to move water
patterns.rationale: 關元、腎俞、命門灸之溫腎助氣化；中極、膀胱俞通膀胱；太谿補腎；氣海補氣行水；秩邊通利。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan, Shenshu and Mingmen moxa'd warm the Kidney to aid qi transformation; Zhongji and Pangguangshu free the Bladder; Taixi tonifies the Kidney; Qihai tonifies qi to move water; Zhibian frees the flow.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL39］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL39]

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。放血強瀉於腎陽虛者更傷陽。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Bleeding or strong reduction further injures yang in Kidney-yang deficiency. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

wrong.zh: 出現紅旗徵象時，針灸不是答案：任何穴位（包括這些）都不應取代急救或轉診，延誤即是傷害。急性完全瀦留劇痛者先導尿；疏風安神之穴更無關。［風險區 medulla：GB20］［風險區 vessels-nerves：HT7］
wrong.en: When red flags are present acupuncture is not the answer: no point (including these) may replace emergency care or referral; delay itself is harm. Acute complete retention with severe pain needs catheterisation first; wind-dispelling or spirit-calming points are beside the point. [risk zone medulla: GB20] [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT7]

combos.why: 俞募配三陰交陰陵泉，秩邊透水道。
combos.whyEn: Shu-mu pair with Sanyinjiao and Yinlingquan; Zhibian directed toward Shuidao.

combos.why: 補氣化水，灸關元氣海。
combos.whyEn: Tonify qi to transform water; moxa Guanyuan and Qihai.

conditions.overview: 耳為腎之竅，少陽經脈入耳中。實證（暴發、聲大、按之不減）：肝膽火盛、痰火鬱結、外感風邪；虛證（漸起、聲細、按之減輕）：腎精虧虛、脾胃虛弱。局部：翳風、聽會、聽宮（耳三針）、耳門；遠端：中渚、俠谿（實）、太谿、腎俞（虛）。
conditions.overviewEn: The ear is the orifice of the Kidney and the shaoyang channels enter it. Excess (sudden, loud, not eased by pressure): Liver-Gallbladder fire, phlegm-fire, external wind; deficiency (gradual, faint, eased by pressure): Kidney essence deficiency, Spleen-Stomach weakness. Local: TE17, GB2, SI19 (three ear points), TE21; distal: TE3 and GB43 (excess), KI3 and BL23 (deficiency).
conditions.redFlags: 突發性感音神經性耳聾（72小時內需類固醇等急治）、單側耳鳴伴進行性聽力下降（聽神經瘤）、搏動性耳鳴（血管病變）、伴眩暈嘔吐、頭部外傷、耳漏、耳痛發燒 → 耳鼻喉科急診／聽力檢查，針灸僅為輔助。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss (needs steroids within 72 hours), unilateral tinnitus with progressive hearing loss (acoustic neuroma), pulsatile tinnitus (vascular), with vertigo and vomiting, head trauma, otorrhoea, ear pain with fever: urgent ENT and audiology; acupuncture is adjunctive.

patterns.presentation: 耳鳴暴發如潮如雷、按之不減、聽力驟降、面紅目赤、口苦、煩躁易怒、便秘，舌紅苔黃、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden tinnitus like a tide or thunder, not eased by pressure, abrupt hearing drop, red face and eyes, bitter taste, irritability, constipation; red tongue with yellow coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear Liver fire, open the orifice and benefit the ear
patterns.rationale: 耳三針局部開竅；中渚、俠谿為手足少陽遠端要穴（少陽入耳）；行間、太衝瀉肝火；丘墟膽原；風池清頭；外關清少陽。
patterns.rationaleEn: Three ear points open the orifice locally; Zhongzhu and Xiaxi are the key hand- and foot-shaoyang distal points (shaoyang enters the ear); Xingjian and Taichong drain Liver fire; Qiuxu is the Gallbladder yuan; Fengchi clears the head; Waiguan clears shaoyang.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。暴聾實火者補腎留邪。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying the Kidney in sudden deafness from fire retains the pathogen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 infant-fontanelle：GV20］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone infant-fontanelle: GV20] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：陽明太陰穴不入耳， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Yangming and taiyin points do not enter the ear; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

patterns.presentation: 耳鳴如蟬、耳內閉塞感、頭重昏蒙、胸悶痰多、口苦，苔黃膩、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Cicada-like tinnitus with a blocked sensation, heavy clouded head, chest oppression with phlegm, bitter taste; yellow greasy coat, slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear fire and resolve phlegm, open the orifice
patterns.rationale: 豐隆、中脘、陰陵泉化痰；內庭、曲池清熱；耳三針與中渚開竅；內關寬胸。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fenglong, Zhongwan and Yinlingquan resolve phlegm; Neiting and Quchi clear heat; the ear points and Zhongzhu open the orifice; Neiguan expands the chest.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.presentation: 耳鳴漸起如蟬、夜間尤甚、按之減輕、聽力漸退、頭暈目眩、腰膝痠軟、遺精健忘，舌淡紅、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Gradual cicada-like tinnitus worse at night and eased by pressure, slowly declining hearing, dizziness, weak lumbar region and knees, seminal emission and poor memory; pale red tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Tonify the Kidney and essence, nourish the ear
patterns.rationale: 太谿、腎俞、關元補腎（腎開竅於耳）；照海滋陰；懸鐘髓會；三陰交調三陰；翳風、聽宮輕刺引氣上達。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi, Shenshu and Guanyuan tonify the Kidney (which opens into the ear); Zhaohai enriches yin; Xuanzhong is the hui of marrow; Sanyinjiao regulates the three yin; Yifeng and Tinggong lightly needled guide qi to the ear.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。瀉少陽肝火於虛者更虛。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Reducing shaoyang/Liver fire points in deficiency depletes further.

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

patterns.presentation: 耳鳴時輕時重、勞累後加重、休息減輕、神疲乏力、食少腹脹、便溏，舌淡苔白、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Tinnitus fluctuating, worse after exertion and eased by rest, fatigue, poor appetite, distension and loose stool; pale tongue with white coat, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and boost qi, raise the clear to the ear
patterns.rationale: 足三里、脾俞、中脘健脾益氣；氣海補氣、百會升清陽上達清竅；三陰交；耳部局部輕刺。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli, Pishu and Zhongwan fortify the Spleen; Qihai tonifies qi and Baihui raises clear yang to the orifice; Sanyinjiao; local ear points lightly.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

wrong.zh: 沉降、通下之穴用於氣虛下陷，正氣更陷：脫肛、泄瀉、乏力加重。
wrong.en: Descending or purging points in sinking qi deficiency drive the qi further down: prolapse, diarrhoea and fatigue worsen.

combos.why: 局部開竅配手足少陽遠端。
combos.whyEn: Local orifice-opening with hand and foot shaoyang distal points.

combos.why: 耳部局部輕刺配太谿腎俞關元補腎、懸鐘填髓。
combos.whyEn: Light local ear points with Taixi, Shenshu and Guanyuan to tonify the Kidney and Xuanzhong to fill marrow.

combos.why: 耳局部配少陽遠端與肝膽滎火穴，暴鳴暴聾實證用。
combos.whyEn: Local ear points with shaoyang distal points and Liver-Gallbladder ying-spring Fire points, for sudden excess tinnitus or deafness.

conditions.overview: 手陽明入下齒、足陽明入上齒：上牙痛取下關、四白、內庭；下牙痛取頰車、大迎、合谷（對側）。證型：風火牙痛（外感）、胃火牙痛（實）、虛火牙痛（腎陰虛）。合谷為治牙痛總穴。
conditions.overviewEn: Hand-yangming enters the lower teeth and foot-yangming the upper: upper toothache takes ST7, ST2 and ST44; lower toothache takes ST6, ST5 and contralateral LI4. Patterns: wind-fire (external), Stomach fire (excess), deficiency fire (Kidney yin deficiency). Hegu is the master point for toothache.
conditions.redFlags: 顏面腫脹迅速擴散、發燒、張口困難、吞嚥困難（深頸部感染、路德維希咽峽炎）、牙痛放射至下頜伴胸悶冷汗（心肌缺血）、牙齒膿瘍或齲齒 → 牙科／急診，針灸僅止痛輔助。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Rapidly spreading facial swelling, fever, trismus, dysphagia (deep neck infection, Ludwig's angina), jaw pain with chest oppression and cold sweat (cardiac ischaemia), dental abscess or caries: dentist or emergency; acupuncture is only adjunctive analgesia.

patterns.presentation: 牙痛突發、齦腫、遇風加重、得冷稍減、發熱惡寒，苔薄白或薄黃、脈浮數
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden toothache with swollen gums, worse in wind, slightly eased by cold, fever and chills; thin white or yellow coat, floating rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and clear heat, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 合谷（對側）為面口總穴；內庭清陽明熱；外關、風池疏散風邪；下關、頰車局部依上下牙取；曲池、大椎清熱。
patterns.rationaleEn: Contralateral Hegu commands the face and mouth; Neiting clears yangming heat; Waiguan and Fengchi disperse wind; Xiaguan or Jiache locally by upper or lower tooth; Quchi and Dazhui clear heat.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：下肢太陽少陽太陰穴不入齒， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：GB34］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Leg taiyang, shaoyang and taiyin points do not enter the teeth; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: GB34]

patterns.presentation: 牙痛劇烈、齦紅腫或出血溢膿、口臭口渴、便秘尿黃、喜冷惡熱，舌紅苔黃、脈洪數
patterns.presentationEn: Severe toothache with red swollen bleeding or purulent gums, halitosis and thirst, constipation and dark urine, prefers cold; red tongue with yellow coat, surging rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear the Stomach and drain fire, reduce swelling and stop pain
patterns.method: 瀉法，厲兌、二間可點刺出血；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; Lidui and Erjian may be bled; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 內庭瀉胃火為主（滎主身熱）；合谷、曲池、二間清陽明；厲兌井穴放血；下關、頰車、承漿局部；勞宮清心胃之火。
patterns.rationaleEn: Neiting drains Stomach fire (ying-spring for heat); Hegu, Quchi and Erjian clear yangming; Lidui bled; Xiaguan, Jiache and Chengjiang locally; Laogong clears Heart-Stomach fire.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸補足三里、中脘、胃俞助胃火。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV12、CV4］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL21］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa or tonifying Zusanli, Zhongwan or Weishu feeds Stomach fire. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV12, CV4] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL21] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。實火誤作虛火滋陰，無效且留邪。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Mistaking excess fire for deficiency fire and nourishing yin fails and retains the pathogen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

patterns.presentation: 牙痛隱隱、時作時止、午後或夜間加重、齒齦微紅不腫或萎縮、牙齒鬆動、腰膝痠軟、口乾不欲飲，舌紅少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Dull intermittent toothache worse in the afternoon or at night, slightly red non-swollen or receding gums, loose teeth, weak lumbar region and knees, dry mouth without desire to drink; red tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish yin and descend fire, secure the teeth and stop pain
patterns.method: 太谿、照海、三陰交補法，行間、合谷瀉法；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Tonify KI3, KI6 and SP6; reduce LR2 and LI4; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 齒為骨之餘、腎主骨：太谿、照海、腎俞滋腎陰；行間、然谷瀉虛火；合谷止痛；下關、頰車局部輕刺。
patterns.rationaleEn: Teeth are the surplus of bone and the Kidney governs bone: Taixi, Zhaohai and Shenshu nourish Kidney yin; Xingjian and Rangu drain deficiency fire; Hegu stops pain; Xiaguan and Jiache lightly.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。強瀉放血於陰虛者傷陰。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong reduction or bleeding in yin deficiency injures yin.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

combos.why: 足陽明入上齒：下關、四白局部，合谷內庭遠端。
combos.whyEn: Foot-yangming enters the upper teeth: Xiaguan and Sibai locally, Hegu and Neiting distally.

combos.why: 手陽明入下齒：頰車、大迎、承漿局部，合谷、二間遠端。
combos.whyEn: Hand-yangming enters the lower teeth: Jiache, Daying and Chengjiang locally, Hegu and Erjian distally.

combos.why: 太谿照海滋腎固齒，行間瀉虛火，合谷下關止痛。
combos.whyEn: Taixi and Zhaohai nourish the Kidney and secure the teeth; Xingjian drains deficiency fire; Hegu and Xiaguan stop pain.

conditions.overview: 咽喉為肺胃之門戶。實證（急）：風熱外襲、肺胃熱盛，治以清熱利咽：少商、商陽放血，合谷、尺澤、魚際、內庭、天突、廉泉；虛證（慢）：肺腎陰虛、虛火上炎，治以滋陰降火：太谿、照海、魚際、列缺（列缺照海為咽喉八脈交會對）。
conditions.overviewEn: The throat is the gateway of the Lung and Stomach. Excess (acute): wind-heat or Lung-Stomach heat, treated by clearing heat and benefiting the throat with bled LU11 and LI1, LI4, LU5, LU10, ST44, CV22 and CV23; deficiency (chronic): Lung-Kidney yin deficiency with fire flaring, treated by nourishing yin with KI3, KI6, LU10 and LU7 (LU7-KI6 is the confluent pair for the throat).
conditions.redFlags: 吞嚥困難流涎、呼吸窘迫或喘鳴、不能平躺（會厭炎、咽後膿瘍）、單側扁桃體腫脹伴張口困難（扁桃體周圍膿瘍）、頸部僵硬、高燒不退、頸部腫塊持續 → 急診／耳鼻喉科；鏈球菌性咽炎需抗生素。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Dysphagia with drooling, respiratory distress or stridor, inability to lie flat (epiglottitis, retropharyngeal abscess), unilateral tonsillar swelling with trismus (peritonsillar abscess), neck stiffness, persistent high fever, persistent neck mass: emergency or ENT; streptococcal pharyngitis needs antibiotics.

patterns.presentation: 咽痛初起、咽部紅腫、吞嚥痛、發熱惡風、頭痛咳嗽，苔薄黃、脈浮數
patterns.presentationEn: Early sore throat with redness and swelling, painful swallowing, fever with aversion to wind, headache and cough; thin yellow coat, floating rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and clear heat, benefit the throat and reduce swelling
patterns.method: 瀉法，少商、商陽點刺出血
patterns.rationale: 少商、商陽為肺與大腸經井穴，放血清咽喉急性腫痛；合谷、魚際清肺胃利咽；外關、風池疏風；大椎、曲池退熱。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shaoshang and Shangyang, jing-well points of Lung and Large Intestine, are bled for acute throat swelling; Hegu and Yuji clear Lung-Stomach and benefit the throat; Waiguan and Fengchi dispel wind; Dazhui and Quchi reduce fever.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3、LU9］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3, LU9]

wrong.zh: 固表止汗、收斂之穴用於外感表證，表閉邪留：無汗、發熱更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：HT6］
wrong.en: Exterior-consolidating, sweat-stopping or astringent points in an exterior pattern lock the pathogen in: anhidrosis and fever worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: HT6]

patterns.presentation: 咽喉紅腫劇痛、扁桃腺腫大或化膿、高熱口渴、便秘尿黃、口臭，舌紅苔黃、脈洪數
patterns.presentationEn: Severe red swollen throat, enlarged or suppurating tonsils, high fever and thirst, constipation and dark urine, halitosis; red tongue with yellow coat, surging rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear and drain Lung and Stomach, resolve toxins and benefit the throat
patterns.method: 瀉法，少商放血，大椎刺絡拔罐；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; bleed Shaoshang; bleed and cup Dazhui; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 尺澤肺經合水穴瀉肺熱；內庭、曲池瀉胃熱；少商放血；合谷清陽明；天突、廉泉局部利咽；支溝通腑泄熱。
patterns.rationaleEn: Chize, Lung he-sea Water, drains Lung heat; Neiting and Quchi drain Stomach heat; Shaoshang bled; Hegu clears yangming; Tiantu and Lianquan locally; Zhigou frees the bowel to vent heat.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL13］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL13] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 出現紅旗徵象時，針灸不是答案：任何穴位（包括這些）都不應取代急救或轉診，延誤即是傷害。若呼吸窘迫、流涎不能吞嚥，應急診而非放血。
wrong.en: When red flags are present acupuncture is not the answer: no point (including these) may replace emergency care or referral; delay itself is harm. With respiratory distress and drooling, go to emergency rather than bleeding points.

patterns.presentation: 咽乾微痛、午後或入夜加重、咽部暗紅不腫、乾咳少痰、手足心熱、腰膝痠軟，舌紅少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Dry slightly painful throat worse in the afternoon or evening, dusky red non-swollen pharynx, dry cough with scanty sputum, hot palms and soles, weak lumbar region and knees; red tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish Lung and Kidney yin, descend fire and benefit the throat
patterns.method: 補法為主（太谿、照海、列缺），魚際、然谷平補平瀉；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Mainly tonifying (KI3, KI6, LU7); even method at LU10 and KI2; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 列缺配照海為八脈交會對穴，主咽喉胸膈（任脈、陰蹻）；太谿滋腎；魚際、然谷清虛火利咽；肺俞、腎俞金水相生；三陰交滋陰。
patterns.rationaleEn: Lieque with Zhaohai is the confluent pair for the throat (Conception and yin qiao vessels); Taixi enriches the Kidney; Yuji and Rangu clear deficiency fire; Feishu and Shenshu nourish Metal and Water together; Sanyinjiao nourishes yin.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。放血清瀉於陰虛者傷陰。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Bleeding and clearing reduction injure yin in yin deficiency. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

combos.why: 井穴放血配合谷、魚際、尺澤清肺胃。
combos.whyEn: Bled jing-well points with Hegu, Yuji and Chize to clear Lung-Stomach.

combos.why: 列缺照海八脈交會對為核心。
combos.whyEn: Lieque-Zhaohai confluent pair as the core.

conditions.overview: 針灸為降壓輔助，不取代藥物。病機以肝陽上亢為主，兼痰濕、陰虛陽亢、陰陽兩虛。基本方：曲池、足三里、太衝、風池、三陰交；肝陽加行間、太谿；痰濕加豐隆、中脘；陰虛加太谿、腎俞；陽虛加關元、氣海（灸）。人迎降壓須輕刺避開頸動脈。
conditions.overviewEn: Acupuncture is adjunctive and never replaces antihypertensive medication. The main mechanism is Liver yang rising, with phlegm-damp, yin deficiency with yang hyperactivity, or dual yin-yang deficiency. Base: LI11, ST36, LR3, GB20, SP6; Liver yang adds LR2 and KI3; phlegm-damp adds ST40 and CV12; yin deficiency adds KI3 and BL23; yang deficiency adds CV4 and CV6 (moxa). Renying for blood pressure requires gentle needling away from the carotid artery.
conditions.redFlags: 高血壓急症（收縮壓 >180 或舒張壓 >120 伴劇烈頭痛、胸痛、視力改變、神經缺損、呼吸困難、意識改變）→ 急診；妊娠高血壓／子癇前症、年輕續發性高血壓（腎、內分泌）、血壓波動伴心悸出汗（嗜鉻細胞瘤）→ 專科。不可因針灸自行停藥。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Hypertensive emergency (systolic >180 or diastolic >120 with severe headache, chest pain, visual change, neurological deficit, dyspnoea or altered consciousness): emergency; gestational hypertension/pre-eclampsia, secondary hypertension in the young (renal, endocrine), labile pressure with palpitations and sweating (phaeochromocytoma): specialist. Patients must not stop medication because of acupuncture.

patterns.presentation: 頭痛眩暈、面紅目赤、煩躁易怒、口苦、失眠，舌紅苔黃、脈弦有力
patterns.presentationEn: Headache and dizziness, red face and eyes, irritability, bitter taste, insomnia; red tongue with yellow coat, forceful wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Pacify the Liver and subdue yang, clear heat and extinguish wind
patterns.rationale: 曲池清熱降壓、足三里和胃降濁為降壓經驗對穴；太衝、行間、俠谿瀉肝膽；風池清頭息風；太谿滋水涵木；三陰交調肝脾腎。
patterns.rationaleEn: Quchi clears heat and lowers pressure while Zusanli harmonises and descends turbidity - an empirical antihypertensive pair; Taichong, Xingjian and Xiaxi reduce Liver-Gallbladder; Fengchi clears the head and extinguishes wind; Taixi enriches Water to nourish Wood; Sanyinjiao regulates the three yin.

wrong.zh: 升提、助陽之穴（或灸）用於肝陽上亢、火熱上擾，助陽上衝：頭痛眩暈加劇、血壓上升。灸百會、關元、命門於肝陽上亢者升壓。［風險區 infant-fontanelle：GV20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4、CV6］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Lifting or yang-assisting points (or moxa) in Liver-yang rising or fire flaring push yang further upward: headache and dizziness intensify and blood pressure climbs. Moxa on Baihui, Guanyuan or Mingmen raises pressure in Liver-yang rising. [risk zone infant-fontanelle: GV20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4, CV6] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 人迎可降壓，但深刺、強刺或雙側同時刺激可引發頸動脈竇反射（風險區 carotid-sinus）。
wrong.en: Renying can lower pressure, but deep, strong or bilateral stimulation can trigger the carotid-sinus reflex (risk zone: carotid-sinus).

patterns.presentation: 頭重如裹、眩暈胸悶、形體肥胖、肢體麻木困重、噁心痰多，苔白膩、脈弦滑
patterns.presentationEn: Heavy wrapped head, dizziness and chest oppression, obesity, numb heavy limbs, nausea with phlegm; white greasy coat, wiry slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Resolve phlegm and dispel damp, fortify the Spleen and harmonise the Stomach
patterns.rationale: 豐隆、中脘、陰陵泉化痰除濕；曲池、足三里降壓和中；風池、頭維清頭；太衝平肝；內關寬胸。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fenglong, Zhongwan and Yinlingquan resolve phlegm-damp; Quchi and Zusanli lower pressure and harmonise; Fengchi and Touwei clear the head; Taichong pacifies the Liver; Neiguan expands the chest.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12]

patterns.presentation: 頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、五心煩熱、失眠健忘、口乾，舌紅少苔、脈弦細數
patterns.presentationEn: Dizziness and tinnitus, weak lumbar region and knees, heat in the palms and soles, insomnia and poor memory, dry mouth; red tongue with scanty coat, wiry thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish yin and subdue yang
patterns.method: 太谿、三陰交、照海補法，太衝、曲池瀉法；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Tonify KI3, SP6 and KI6; reduce LR3 and LI11; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 太谿、照海、三陰交、腎俞滋腎陰；太衝潛陽；曲池降壓；風池清頭；神門安神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi, Zhaohai, Sanyinjiao and Shenshu nourish Kidney yin; Taichong subdues yang; Quchi lowers pressure; Fengchi clears the head; Shenmen calms the spirit.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone forbidden: CV8]

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

patterns.presentation: 頭暈眼花、心悸氣短、畏寒肢冷或潮熱、夜尿頻多、腰膝痠軟、乏力，舌淡、脈沉細
patterns.presentationEn: Dizziness and blurred vision, palpitations and breathlessness, cold limbs or tidal fever, nocturia, weak lumbar region and knees, fatigue; pale tongue, deep thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Regulate and tonify yin and yang, benefit the Kidney
patterns.method: 補法；關元、氣海可溫和灸；風池、曲池輕刺
patterns.methodEn: Tonifying; gentle moxa at Guanyuan and Qihai; Fengchi and Quchi lightly
patterns.rationale: 太谿、腎俞補腎陰陽；關元、氣海培元；足三里、三陰交補氣血；命門溫陽；曲池、風池輕刺調壓。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi and Shenshu tonify Kidney yin and yang; Guanyuan and Qihai cultivate the origin; Zusanli and Sanyinjiao tonify qi and blood; Mingmen warms yang; Quchi and Fengchi lightly regulate pressure.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice.

combos.why: 曲池足三里降壓對穴，太衝平肝，風池清頭，三陰交調三陰，各型基礎。
combos.whyEn: Quchi-Zusanli antihypertensive pair, Taichong to pacify the Liver, Fengchi to clear the head, Sanyinjiao for the three yin - base for all patterns.

combos.why: 瀉肝膽、清頭目、滋水涵木，為最常見之高血壓證型組合。
combos.whyEn: Reduce Liver-Gallbladder, clear the head, enrich Water to nourish Wood - the set for the commonest hypertensive pattern.

combos.why: 滋腎陰以潛陽，太衝輕瀉，不灸。
combos.whyEn: Nourish Kidney yin to subdue yang; Taichong lightly reduced; no moxa.

conditions.overview: 心悸分驚悸（實，外因）與怔忡（虛，內因）。虛證：心膽氣虛、心血不足、陰虛火旺、心陽不振；實證：水飲凌心、心血瘀阻、痰火擾心。基本方：內關、神門、郄門、心俞、巨闕、膻中；內關為心胸要穴。
conditions.overviewEn: Palpitations divide into fright palpitations (excess, external cause) and severe palpitations (deficiency, internal cause). Deficiency: Heart-Gallbladder qi deficiency, Heart blood deficiency, yin deficiency with fire, Heart yang deficiency; excess: water-fluids assaulting the Heart, Heart blood stasis, phlegm-fire. Base: PC6, HT7, PC4, BL15, CV14, CV17; Neiguan is the key point for the chest.
conditions.redFlags: 心悸伴暈厥或近暈厥、胸痛、呼吸困難、持續快速或極慢心律、新發心房顫動、心臟病史或家族猝死史、甲狀腺功能亢進徵象 → 心電圖／急診；針灸僅輔助。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Palpitations with syncope or near-syncope, chest pain, dyspnoea, sustained very fast or very slow rhythm, new atrial fibrillation, cardiac history or family history of sudden death, signs of hyperthyroidism: ECG or emergency; acupuncture is adjunctive only.

patterns.presentation: 心悸因驚而發、善驚易恐、坐臥不安、少寐多夢，舌淡、脈細數或弦細
patterns.presentationEn: Palpitations triggered by fright, easily startled and fearful, restless, poor sleep with dreams; pale tongue, thin rapid or wiry thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Settle fright and the will, nourish the Heart and calm the spirit
patterns.rationale: 心俞、膽俞補心膽之氣；內關、神門寧心；巨闕心募；丘墟膽原壯膽；百會、四神聰定志；足三里益氣。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xinshu and Danshu tonify Heart-Gallbladder qi; Neiguan and Shenmen calm the Heart; Juque is the Heart mu; Qiuxu, Gallbladder yuan, strengthens resolve; Baihui and Sishencong settle the will; Zusanli boosts qi.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡：下肢太陽少陽太陰穴不主心神， 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：GB34］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points: Leg taiyang, shaoyang and taiyin points do not govern the Heart spirit; Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: GB34]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：ST25］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：ST25］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: ST25] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: ST25]

patterns.presentation: 心悸頭暈、面色無華、倦怠乏力、失眠健忘，舌淡、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Palpitations with dizziness, lustreless complexion, fatigue, insomnia and poor memory; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish blood and the Heart, boost qi and calm the spirit
patterns.rationale: 心俞、脾俞、膈俞補心脾養血；足三里、三陰交健脾生血；氣海補氣；內關、神門安神；巨闕心募。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xinshu, Pishu and Geshu tonify Heart and Spleen to nourish blood; Zusanli and Sanyinjiao make blood; Qihai tonifies qi; Neiguan and Shenmen calm; Juque is the Heart mu.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。強瀉郄門、滎火穴於血虛者更虛。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strongly reducing Ximen or the ying-spring Fire points in blood deficiency depletes further.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

patterns.presentation: 心悸不寧、心煩少寐、五心煩熱、盜汗口乾、頭暈耳鳴，舌紅少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Restless palpitations, vexation and poor sleep, heat in the palms and soles, night sweats and dry mouth, dizziness and tinnitus; red tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish yin and descend fire, nourish the Heart and calm the spirit
patterns.method: 補太谿、三陰交、照海；瀉神門、內關；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Tonify KI3, SP6 and KI6; reduce HT7 and PC6; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 太谿、照海、三陰交、腎俞滋腎陰；陰郄清心止盜汗；神門、內關寧心；心俞腎俞交通心腎。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi, Zhaohai, Sanyinjiao and Shenshu nourish Kidney yin; Yinxi clears the Heart and stops night sweats; Shenmen and Neiguan calm; Xinshu with Shenshu reconnects Heart and Kidney.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸之助火。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4、CV6］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 infant-fontanelle：GV20］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa feeds the fire. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4, CV6] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone infant-fontanelle: GV20]

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

patterns.presentation: 心悸不安、胸悶氣短、動則加劇、面白肢冷、形寒，舌淡苔白、脈沉細或結代
patterns.presentationEn: Restless palpitations, chest oppression and breathlessness worse on exertion, pale face and cold limbs; pale tongue with white coat, deep thin or knotted-intermittent pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm and tonify Heart yang, calm the spirit and settle palpitations
patterns.rationale: 心俞、厥陰俞灸之溫心陽；膻中氣會寬胸；關元、氣海、命門溫補元陽；內關、神門寧心；足三里益氣。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xinshu and Jueyinshu moxa'd warm Heart yang; Danzhong, hui of qi, expands the chest; Guanyuan, Qihai and Mingmen warm the original yang; Neiguan and Shenmen calm; Zusanli boosts qi.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。強瀉放血耗散心陽。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong reduction or bleeding scatters Heart yang. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

wrong.zh: 出現紅旗徵象時，針灸不是答案：任何穴位（包括這些）都不應取代急救或轉診，延誤即是傷害。若伴胸痛冷汗、脈結代，先急診，而非以醒神穴強刺。
wrong.en: When red flags are present acupuncture is not the answer: no point (including these) may replace emergency care or referral; delay itself is harm. With chest pain, cold sweat and an irregular pulse, emergency care comes first, not strong resuscitation points.

patterns.presentation: 心悸眩暈、胸脘痞滿、渴不欲飲、下肢浮腫、小便不利、形寒肢冷，苔白滑、脈弦滑
patterns.presentationEn: Palpitations with dizziness, chest and epigastric fullness, thirst without desire to drink, leg oedema, dysuria, cold limbs; white slippery coat, wiry slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm yang and transform fluids, calm the Heart
patterns.methodEn: Even method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 陰陵泉、豐隆、水分利水化飲；關元灸之溫陽；膻中、內關寬胸寧心；三焦俞通調水道；足三里健脾。
patterns.rationaleEn: Yinlingquan, Fenglong and Shuifen drain water and transform fluids; Guanyuan moxa'd warms yang; Danzhong and Neiguan expand the chest and calm; Sanjiaoshu regulates the waterways; Zusanli fortifies the Spleen.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。滋陰助水。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. Yin-nourishing points add to the water. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

combos.why: 心包經絡穴郄穴配心經原穴，心俞巨闕俞募。
combos.whyEn: Pericardium luo and xi-cleft with the Heart yuan point; Xinshu-Juque shu-mu pair.

combos.why: 心俞脾俞補心脾，足三里三陰交生血，內關神門安神。
combos.whyEn: Xinshu and Pishu tonify Heart and Spleen; Zusanli and Sanyinjiao make blood; Neiguan and Shenmen calm.

combos.why: 灸心俞膻中關元命門溫通心陽，內關通脈。
combos.whyEn: Moxa Xinshu, Danzhong, Guanyuan and Mingmen to warm Heart yang; Neiguan frees the vessels.

conditions.overview: 胸痹為心脈痹阻，本虛（心氣、心陽、心陰虛）標實（寒凝、氣滯、痰濁、血瘀）。基本方：內關、膻中、心俞、厥陰俞、郄門、陰郄、巨闕；急性發作以內關、郄門為先，同時立即就醫。針灸為穩定型心絞痛之輔助，不可取代硝酸甘油與急救。
conditions.overviewEn: Chest bi is obstruction of the Heart vessels, with root deficiency (Heart qi, yang or yin) and branch excess (cold congealing, qi stagnation, phlegm turbidity, blood stasis). Base: PC6, CV17, BL15, BL14, PC4, HT6, CV14; in an acute episode Neiguan and Ximen first while seeking medical care at once. Acupuncture is adjunctive in stable angina and never replaces nitroglycerin or emergency treatment.
conditions.redFlags: 急性胸痛持續超過15–20分鐘、壓迫感放射至左臂下頜、冷汗噁心、呼吸困難、暈厥、硝酸甘油無效（心肌梗塞）→ 立即呼叫急救；撕裂樣胸痛放射至背（主動脈剝離）、胸痛伴單側下肢腫（肺栓塞）→ 急診。針灸絕非急救手段；胸背穴深刺之氣胸於心肺病患尤危。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Acute chest pain lasting over 15-20 minutes, pressure radiating to the left arm or jaw, cold sweat and nausea, dyspnoea, syncope, no response to nitroglycerin (myocardial infarction): call emergency services immediately; tearing pain radiating to the back (aortic dissection), chest pain with unilateral leg swelling (pulmonary embolism): emergency. Acupuncture is never a rescue measure; pneumothorax from deep chest or back needling is especially dangerous in cardiopulmonary patients.

patterns.presentation: 胸痛如刺、痛有定處、夜間或情緒激動加重、唇紫，舌紫暗有瘀斑、脈澀或結代
patterns.presentationEn: Stabbing fixed chest pain worse at night or with emotion, purple lips; purple tongue with stasis spots, choppy or knotted pulse
patterns.principleEn: Invigorate blood and dispel stasis, free the vessels and stop pain
patterns.method: 瀉法；膈俞、心俞沿肋淺刺或拔罐
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; Geshu and Xinshu shallow along the rib, or cupping
patterns.rationale: 內關、郄門為心包經絡穴郄穴，急性心痛要穴；膻中氣會、膈俞血會氣血同調；心俞、厥陰俞俞募相應；血海活血；太衝行氣；陰郄止痛。
patterns.rationaleEn: Neiguan and Ximen, luo and xi-cleft of the Pericardium, are the key points for acute cardiac pain; Danzhong (hui of qi) and Geshu (hui of blood) regulate qi and blood together; Xinshu and Jueyinshu correspond to the chest; Xuehai moves blood; Taichong moves qi; Yinxi stops pain.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。瘀阻發作時純補留瘀。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Pure tonification during a stasis episode retains the stasis. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 劇烈心痛時只以水溝、十宣、湧泉急救而不送醫，是把心肌梗塞當暈厥處理；呼叫急救為先，針刺僅是途中輔助。
wrong.en: Treating severe cardiac pain with Shuigou, Shixuan and Yongquan alone instead of calling for help mistakes a myocardial infarction for simple fainting; emergency services first, needling only as an adjunct en route.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20] [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.en: Cold congealing in the Heart vessels
patterns.presentation: 胸痛徹背、遇寒誘發、心痛如絞、形寒肢冷、面白，苔白、脈沉緊
patterns.presentationEn: Chest pain penetrating to the back, triggered by cold, gripping pain, cold body and limbs, pale face; white coat, deep tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Warm yang and scatter cold, free the vessels and stop pain
patterns.method: 瀉法加灸；膻中、關元、心俞灸
patterns.methodEn: Reducing with moxa; moxa Danzhong, Guanyuan and Xinshu
patterns.rationale: 內關通心脈；膻中、心俞、厥陰俞灸之溫通胸陽；關元、氣海、命門溫補元陽；郄門止痛；足三里益氣。
