patterns.rationaleEn: Neiguan frees the Heart vessels; Danzhong, Xinshu and Jueyinshu moxa'd warm chest yang; Guanyuan, Qihai and Mingmen warm the original yang; Ximen stops pain; Zusanli boosts qi.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。化痰利水通便之穴與寒凝心脈無關。
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Phlegm-, water- or bowel-draining points are unrelated to cold congealing in the Heart vessels.

wrong.zh: 胸痛徹背持續不解屬心肌梗塞徵象，以急救穴代替送醫即為延誤。
wrong.en: Unrelenting chest pain penetrating to the back signals myocardial infarction; substituting resuscitation points for emergency transfer is delay.

patterns.presentation: 胸悶如窒而痛、痰多氣短、形體肥胖、肢體沉重、納呆，苔白膩或黃膩、脈滑
patterns.presentationEn: Suffocating chest oppression with pain, copious phlegm and breathlessness, obesity, heavy limbs, poor appetite; white or yellow greasy coat, slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Free yang and discharge turbidity, sweep phlegm and open the binding
patterns.rationale: 豐隆、中脘、陰陵泉化痰濁；膻中、內關寬胸通陽；足三里健脾絕痰源；間使、尺澤化痰寬胸。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fenglong, Zhongwan and Yinlingquan resolve phlegm turbidity; Danzhong and Neiguan expand the chest and free yang; Zusanli fortifies the Spleen to cut the source of phlegm; Jianshi and Chize resolve phlegm.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20] [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.presentation: 胸悶隱痛、時作時止、心悸氣短、動則加劇、倦怠、口乾盜汗，舌紅少苔或淡、脈細弱或結代
patterns.presentationEn: Intermittent dull chest pain, palpitations and breathlessness worse on exertion, fatigue, dry mouth and night sweats; red tongue with scanty coat or pale tongue, thin weak or knotted pulse
patterns.principleEn: Boost qi and nourish yin, invigorate blood and free the vessels
patterns.method: 補法；氣虛可溫和灸氣海、足三里，陰虛不灸
patterns.methodEn: Tonifying; gentle moxa at Qihai and Zusanli for qi deficiency, none for yin deficiency
patterns.rationale: 心俞、巨闕俞募補心；足三里、氣海補氣；太谿、三陰交養陰；內關、神門寧心通脈；陰郄止汗；膻中理氣。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xinshu and Juque (shu-mu) tonify the Heart; Zusanli and Qihai tonify qi; Taixi and Sanyinjiao nourish yin; Neiguan and Shenmen calm and free the vessels; Yinxi stops sweating; Danzhong regulates qi.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。強瀉活血於氣陰虛者傷正。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］［風險區 pregnancy：SP10］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong blood-moving reduction in qi-yin deficiency injures the upright qi. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17] [risk zone pregnancy: SP10]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。陰虛有盜汗者灸之助火傷陰。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. With yin deficiency and night sweats, moxa feeds fire and injures yin. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

combos.why: 內關郄門急症要穴，膻中氣會，心俞厥陰俞與巨闕前後相應。
combos.whyEn: Neiguan and Ximen for acute episodes, Danzhong hui of qi, Xinshu and Jueyinshu with Juque front and back.

combos.why: 氣會血會同用，郄穴止痛，血海活血。
combos.whyEn: Hui of qi and hui of blood together; xi-cleft points stop pain; Xuehai moves blood.

combos.why: 補心氣、養心陰，緩解期治本。
combos.whyEn: Tonify Heart qi and nourish Heart yin - root treatment between episodes.

conditions.overview: 鬱證以肝氣鬱結為始，可化火、生痰（梅核氣）、傷心脾（心脾兩虛）、耗心腎之陰。基本方：百會、印堂、內關、神門、太衝、膻中、三陰交；肝鬱加期門、陽陵泉；化火加行間、俠谿；痰氣加豐隆、天突、廉泉；心脾虛加心俞、脾俞、足三里；心腎陰虛加太谿、心俞、腎俞。針灸為心理治療與藥物之輔助。
conditions.overviewEn: Yu zheng begins with Liver qi constraint, which may transform to fire, generate phlegm (plum-stone qi), injure Heart and Spleen (dual deficiency) or exhaust Heart-Kidney yin. Base: GV20, EX-HN3, PC6, HT7, LR3, CV17, SP6; Liver constraint adds LR14 and GB34; fire adds LR2 and GB43; phlegm-qi adds ST40, CV22 and CV23; Heart-Spleen deficiency adds BL15, BL20 and ST36; Heart-Kidney yin deficiency adds KI3, BL15 and BL23. Acupuncture complements psychotherapy and medication.
conditions.redFlags: 自殺意念或計畫、自傷、精神病性症狀（幻覺、妄想）、躁狂、嚴重功能障礙（不能進食自理）、產後憂鬱伴傷嬰念頭、物質濫用 → 立即精神科／急診；針灸不取代危機處置。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Suicidal ideation or plans, self-harm, psychotic symptoms (hallucinations, delusions), mania, severe functional impairment (unable to eat or care for self), post-partum depression with thoughts of harming the infant, substance misuse: immediate psychiatric or emergency care; acupuncture never replaces crisis management.

patterns.presentation: 情緒抑鬱、胸脅脹悶、善太息、脘痞噯氣、月經不調，苔薄白、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Low mood, chest and flank oppression, sighing, epigastric fullness and belching, menstrual irregularity; thin white coat, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Spread the Liver and resolve constraint, regulate qi and calm the spirit
patterns.rationale: 太衝、期門、陽陵泉疏肝；膻中氣會、內關寬胸理氣；百會、印堂醒神解鬱；神門寧心；三陰交調肝脾腎。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong, Qimen and Yanglingquan spread the Liver; Danzhong (hui of qi) and Neiguan regulate chest qi; Baihui and Yintang rouse the spirit; Shenmen calms the Heart; Sanyinjiao regulates the three yin.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。補肝於肝鬱更鬱。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying the Liver while constrained tightens the constraint. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

patterns.presentation: 急躁易怒、焦慮不安、胸脅脹痛、口苦口乾、頭痛目赤、失眠、便秘，舌紅苔黃、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Irritability, anxiety and restlessness, flank pain, bitter dry mouth, headache and red eyes, insomnia, constipation; red tongue with yellow coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear Liver fire, resolve constraint and calm the spirit
patterns.rationale: 行間、俠谿肝膽滎火穴瀉火；太衝疏肝；神門、內關寧心；百會、印堂、風池清頭安神；內庭清陽明以通便。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xingjian and Xiaxi, Liver-Gallbladder ying-spring Fire points, drain fire; Taichong spreads the Liver; Shenmen and Neiguan calm; Baihui, Yintang and Fengchi clear the head; Neiting clears yangming and frees the bowel.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 升提、助陽之穴（或灸）用於肝陽上亢、火熱上擾，助陽上衝：頭痛眩暈加劇、血壓上升。灸百會、氣海助火。［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］
wrong.en: Lifting or yang-assisting points (or moxa) in Liver-yang rising or fire flaring push yang further upward: headache and dizziness intensify and blood pressure climbs. Moxa on Baihui or Qihai feeds the fire. [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

patterns.presentation: 咽中如有物梗阻、吞之不下吐之不出、胸悶、情緒波動加重、咳痰，苔白膩、脈弦滑
patterns.presentationEn: Sensation of something stuck in the throat that cannot be swallowed or expelled, chest oppression, worse with emotion, phlegm; white greasy coat, wiry slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Move qi and resolve phlegm, resolve constraint and dissipate binding
patterns.rationale: 天突、廉泉局部利咽散結；膻中、內關、太衝理氣；豐隆、中脘、陰陵泉化痰；神門安神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Tiantu and Lianquan locally benefit the throat and dissipate binding; Danzhong, Neiguan and Taichong regulate qi; Fenglong, Zhongwan and Yinlingquan resolve phlegm; Shenmen calms.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。咽喉無實熱者放血無益。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. Bleeding helps nothing when the throat has no excess heat. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

patterns.presentation: 憂思過度、心悸膽怯、失眠健忘、神疲食少、面色無華、便溏，舌淡、脈細弱
patterns.presentationEn: Excessive worry, palpitations and timidity, insomnia and poor memory, fatigue and poor appetite, lustreless complexion, loose stool; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and nourish the Heart, boost qi and calm the spirit
patterns.rationale: 心俞、脾俞補心脾；足三里、三陰交、氣海健脾益氣生血；神門、內關寧心；百會、四神聰升清安神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xinshu and Pishu tonify Heart and Spleen; Zusanli, Sanyinjiao and Qihai boost qi and make blood; Shenmen and Neiguan calm; Baihui and Sishencong raise the clear and settle the spirit.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 neck-trachea：CV22］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone neck-trachea: CV22]

patterns.presentation: 情緒不寧、心悸健忘、失眠多夢、五心煩熱、盜汗、腰膝痠軟、遺精或月經不調，舌紅少苔、脈細數
patterns.presentationEn: Emotional unrest, palpitations and poor memory, insomnia with dreams, heat in the palms and soles, night sweats, weak lumbar region and knees, seminal emission or menstrual irregularity; red tongue with scanty coat, thin rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish Heart and Kidney yin, calm the spirit and settle the will
patterns.rationale: 太谿、照海、三陰交滋腎陰；心俞、腎俞交通心腎；神門、內關寧心；陰郄止盜汗；百會安神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taixi, Zhaohai and Sanyinjiao nourish Kidney yin; Xinshu and Shenshu reconnect Heart and Kidney; Shenmen and Neiguan calm; Yinxi stops night sweats; Baihui settles the spirit.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4、CV6］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4, CV6] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 利水滲濕、發汗之穴用於陰虛或津虧，更耗陰液：口乾、便秘、盜汗加重。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Water-draining or sweat-promoting points in yin or fluid deficiency further exhaust the fluids: dryness, constipation and night sweats worsen. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

combos.why: 醒神（百會印堂）、寧心（內關神門）、疏肝（太衝膻中）、調三陰（三陰交），各型鬱證基礎。
combos.whyEn: Rouse the spirit (Baihui, Yintang), calm the Heart (Neiguan, Shenmen), spread the Liver (Taichong, Danzhong), regulate the three yin (Sanyinjiao) - base for all patterns.

combos.why: 太衝期門陽陵泉疏肝，內關膻中理氣寬胸。
combos.whyEn: Taichong, Qimen and Yanglingquan spread the Liver; Neiguan and Danzhong regulate qi and expand the chest.

combos.why: 補心脾、生氣血，百會升清安神，加灸。
combos.whyEn: Tonify Heart and Spleen to generate qi and blood; Baihui raises the clear and calms; add moxa.

conditions.overview: 癇證為風痰上擾、蒙蔽清竅。發作期：醒神開竅、息風止痙—水溝、內關、太衝、後谿、湧泉、十宣（放血）；間歇期：治本—印堂、鳩尾（任脈絡穴）、間使、豐隆、太衝、大椎、身柱、百會，分痰火、風痰、瘀阻、心脾兩虛、肝腎陰虛。針灸為抗癲癇藥之輔助，絕不可停藥。
conditions.overviewEn: Epilepsy is wind-phlegm rising to cloud the clear orifices. During a seizure: revive and open the orifices, extinguish wind and stop convulsion - GV26, PC6, LR3, SI3, KI1, bled EX-UE11; between seizures treat the root - EX-HN3, CV15 (luo of the Conception vessel), PC5, ST40, LR3, GV14, GV12, GV20, differentiated into phlegm-fire, wind-phlegm, stasis, Heart-Spleen deficiency and Liver-Kidney yin deficiency. Acupuncture complements antiepileptic drugs, which must never be stopped.
conditions.redFlags: 癲癇持續狀態（發作超過5分鐘或連續發作未恢復意識）→ 立即急救；首次發作、發作型態改變、發作後持續神經缺損、發燒伴發作（腦膜炎）、頭部外傷後、孕婦發作 → 急診／神經科。發作中不可在四肢、口腔強行針刺（折針、咬傷），保護頭部與氣道為先。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Status epilepticus (seizure over 5 minutes or repeated seizures without recovery): immediate emergency care; first seizure, change in seizure type, persistent post-ictal deficit, fever with seizure (meningitis), after head trauma, seizure in pregnancy: emergency or neurology. During a seizure never force needles into convulsing limbs or the mouth (needle breakage, bites); protect the head and airway first.

patterns.presentation: 突然昏仆、不省人事、四肢抽搐、口吐涎沫、兩目上視、喉中痰鳴
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden collapse with loss of consciousness, limb convulsions, frothing at the mouth, eyes rolled upward, phlegm rattling in the throat
patterns.principle: 醒神開竅、息風止痙（同時保護氣道、計時、必要時急救）
patterns.principleEn: Revive and open the orifices, extinguish wind and stop convulsion (while protecting the airway, timing the seizure and calling for help if needed)
patterns.method: 強刺激瀉法，水溝雀啄至神志恢復；十宣點刺；抽搐肢體不留針
patterns.methodEn: Strong reducing; sparrow-pecking at Shuigou until consciousness returns; prick Shixuan; no retained needles in convulsing limbs
patterns.rationale: 水溝、百會通督醒腦；內關寧心開竅；太衝、合谷（四關）息風止痙；後谿通督主癲癇；湧泉引火下行；十宣放血開竅泄熱。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shuigou and Baihui open the Governor vessel and awaken the brain; Neiguan calms and opens; Taichong and Hegu (Four Gates) extinguish wind and stop convulsion; Houxi, confluent of the Governor vessel, governs epilepsy; Yongquan draws fire down; bled Shixuan opens the orifices and vents heat.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。發作期補益無用。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4、CV6］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Tonifying during a seizure is useless. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4, CV6]

wrong.zh: 枕下穴朝內上方深刺可傷延髓（風險區：medulla），此處針向與深度錯誤屬危險選擇。抽搐中針刺枕下穴極度危險。
wrong.en: Suboccipital points directed deep inward-upward can injure the medulla (risk zone: medulla); wrong direction or depth here is a dangerous choice. Needling suboccipital points during convulsions is extremely dangerous.

patterns.presentation: 發作頻繁、急躁易怒、面紅目赤、口苦痰黃、便秘，舌紅苔黃膩、脈弦滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Frequent seizures, irritability, red face and eyes, bitter taste with yellow phlegm, constipation; red tongue with yellow greasy coat, wiry slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and resolve phlegm, extinguish wind and settle epilepsy
patterns.rationale: 印堂、鳩尾、間使為治癇經典三穴（鳩尾任脈絡穴主癲癇）；豐隆化痰；行間瀉肝火；大椎、內庭、曲池清熱；神門安神。
patterns.rationaleEn: Yintang, Jiuwei and Jianshi are the classic epilepsy trio (Jiuwei, luo of the Conception vessel, governs epilepsy); Fenglong resolves phlegm; Xingjian drains Liver fire; Dazhui, Neiting and Quchi clear heat; Shenmen calms.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

patterns.presentation: 發作前頭暈胸悶、痰多、神疲、苔白膩、脈弦滑
patterns.presentationEn: Dizziness and chest oppression before seizures, copious phlegm, fatigue; white greasy coat, wiry slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Sweep phlegm and extinguish wind, open the orifices and settle epilepsy
patterns.rationale: 治癇三穴；豐隆、中脘、陰陵泉化痰；風池、太衝息風；大椎、身柱通督寧神。
patterns.rationaleEn: The epilepsy trio; Fenglong, Zhongwan and Yinlingquan resolve phlegm; Fengchi and Taichong extinguish wind; Dazhui and Shenzhu regulate the Governor vessel and calm.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 枕下穴朝內上方深刺可傷延髓（風險區：medulla），此處針向與深度錯誤屬危險選擇。風池對證但針向須正確。
wrong.en: Suboccipital points directed deep inward-upward can injure the medulla (risk zone: medulla); wrong direction or depth here is a dangerous choice. Fengchi fits but direction must be correct.

patterns.zh: 間歇期—心脾兩虛／肝腎陰虛
patterns.presentation: 久病發作次數減少但神疲乏力、健忘、心悸失眠、面色無華；或頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、五心煩熱，脈細
patterns.presentationEn: Chronic course with fewer seizures but fatigue, poor memory, palpitations, insomnia and lustreless complexion; or dizziness, tinnitus, weak lumbar region and heat in the palms and soles; thin pulse
patterns.principle: 補益心脾／滋養肝腎、安神定癇
patterns.principleEn: Tonify Heart-Spleen or nourish Liver-Kidney, calm the spirit and settle epilepsy
patterns.rationale: 心俞、脾俞、足三里、三陰交補心脾；太谿、肝俞、腎俞滋肝腎；百會、神門、印堂安神；鳩尾輕刺定癇。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xinshu, Pishu, Zusanli and Sanyinjiao tonify Heart-Spleen; Taixi, Ganshu and Shenshu nourish Liver-Kidney; Baihui, Shenmen and Yintang calm; Jiuwei lightly settles epilepsy.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。間歇期虛證強瀉放血更虛。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong reduction or bleeding in interictal deficiency depletes further. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。偏肝腎陰虛者灸之傷陰動風。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. In the Liver-Kidney yin-deficient type moxa injures yin and stirs wind. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：ST25］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：ST25］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: ST25] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: ST25]

combos.why: 醒神開竅、四關止痙，同時保護氣道計時。
combos.whyEn: Revive and open the orifices, Four Gates to stop convulsion, with airway protection and timing.

combos.why: 治癇三穴配豐隆太衝大椎百會。
combos.whyEn: The epilepsy trio with Fenglong, Taichong, Dazhui and Baihui.

conditions.overview: 顫證病位在筋脈，與肝腎脾相關：肝腎陰虛、風陽內動為本，痰熱、氣血不足為變。基本方：百會、四神聰、風池、本神、合谷、太衝、陽陵泉（筋會）、足三里、三陰交；頭針運動區常用。針灸為藥物之輔助，改善僵硬、步態、非運動症狀。
conditions.overviewEn: Tremor syndrome lies in the sinews and relates to Liver, Kidney and Spleen: Liver-Kidney yin deficiency with internal wind-yang as the root, phlegm-heat or qi-blood deficiency as variations. Base: GV20, EX-HN1, GB20, GB13, LI4, LR3, GB34 (hui of sinews), ST36, SP6; the scalp motor area is commonly used. Acupuncture complements medication, improving rigidity, gait and non-motor symptoms.
conditions.redFlags: 快速進展、早期反覆跌倒、早期痴呆或幻覺、自主神經衰竭（直立性低血壓暈厥）、對左旋多巴無反應（非典型帕金森）、吞嚥困難伴吸入性肺炎 → 神經科；針灸不替代藥物，跌倒風險高者治療時注意體位安全。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Rapid progression, early recurrent falls, early dementia or hallucinations, autonomic failure (orthostatic syncope), no response to levodopa (atypical parkinsonism), dysphagia with aspiration pneumonia: neurology; acupuncture does not replace medication, and positional safety matters in patients at high fall risk.

patterns.en: Liver-Kidney yin deficiency with internal wind
patterns.presentation: 肢體顫抖、動作遲緩、肌肉僵硬、頭暈耳鳴、腰膝痠軟、失眠、五心煩熱，舌紅少苔、脈弦細
patterns.presentationEn: Limb tremor, bradykinesia, rigidity, dizziness and tinnitus, weak lumbar region and knees, insomnia, heat in the palms and soles; red tongue with scanty coat, wiry thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish the Liver and Kidney, extinguish wind and stop tremor
patterns.method: 頭穴平刺；太谿、三陰交補法；太衝、合谷平補平瀉
patterns.methodEn: Scalp points transverse; tonify KI3 and SP6; even method at LR3 and LI4
patterns.rationale: 百會、四神聰、本神頭部醒腦；風池息風；太衝、合谷四關止顫；太谿、三陰交、肝俞、腎俞滋肝腎；陽陵泉筋會、懸鐘髓會柔筋填髓。
patterns.rationaleEn: Baihui, Sishencong and Benshen rouse the brain; Fengchi extinguishes wind; Taichong and Hegu (Four Gates) stop tremor; Taixi, Sanyinjiao, Ganshu and Shenshu nourish Liver-Kidney; Yanglingquan (sinews) and Xuanzhong (marrow) soften sinews and fill marrow.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸之助陽傷陰動風。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa warms yang, injures yin and stirs wind. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone forbidden: CV8]

wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

patterns.presentationEn: Tremor with limb weakness, lustreless complexion, fatigue, dizziness and palpitations, poor appetite; pale tongue, thin weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Boost qi and nourish blood, nourish the sinews
patterns.rationale: 足三里、三陰交、氣海、脾俞補氣血；血海、膈俞養血；陽陵泉柔筋；百會、四神聰醒腦；合谷、太衝輕刺息風。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli, Sanyinjiao, Qihai and Pishu tonify qi and blood; Xuehai and Geshu nourish blood; Yanglingquan softens sinews; Baihui and Sishencong rouse the brain; Hegu and Taichong lightly extinguish wind.

wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery.

wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone neck-trachea: CV22]

patterns.presentation: 顫抖伴胸悶痰多、頭重、口苦口黏、煩躁、便秘，苔黃膩、脈弦滑
patterns.presentationEn: Tremor with chest oppression and copious phlegm, heavy head, bitter sticky mouth, agitation, constipation; yellow greasy coat, wiry slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and resolve phlegm, extinguish wind and stop tremor
patterns.rationale: 豐隆、中脘、陰陵泉化痰；曲池、內庭清熱；風池、太衝息風；陽陵泉柔筋；百會醒腦；內關寬胸。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fenglong, Zhongwan and Yinlingquan resolve phlegm; Quchi and Neiting clear heat; Fengchi and Taichong extinguish wind; Yanglingquan softens sinews; Baihui rouses the brain; Neiguan expands the chest.

combos.why: 頭部醒腦、四關息風、筋會柔筋、足三里三陰交補益。
combos.whyEn: Scalp points to rouse the brain, Four Gates to extinguish wind, hui of sinews to soften, Zusanli and Sanyinjiao to tonify.

combos.why: 滋肝腎、填髓、平肝，治顫證之本。
combos.whyEn: Nourish Liver-Kidney, fill marrow and pacify the Liver - the root treatment of tremor.

conditions.overview: 戒菸：針灸降低戒斷症狀與渴求，取列缺（肺）、合谷、神門、內關、百會、印堂，配耳穴（肺、神門、口）；肥胖：以脾虛濕盛、胃熱濕阻、肝鬱氣滯、脾腎陽虛辨證，取中脘、天樞、大橫、水分、關元、曲池、足三里、豐隆、三陰交、陰陵泉；皆須配合行為、飲食與運動。
conditions.overviewEn: Smoking: acupuncture reduces withdrawal and craving with LU7 (Lung), LI4, HT7, PC6, GV20 and EX-HN3 plus auricular points (lung, shenmen, mouth). Obesity: differentiated into Spleen deficiency with damp, Stomach heat with damp, Liver qi constraint and Spleen-Kidney yang deficiency, using CV12, ST25, SP15, CV9, CV4, LI11, ST36, ST40, SP6 and SP9. Both require behavioural, dietary and exercise programmes.
conditions.redFlags: 續發性肥胖（甲狀腺功能低下、庫欣氏症、藥物）、短期快速體重改變、飲食失調（暴食、催吐）、肥胖伴睡眠呼吸中止或代謝症候群未評估 → 內分泌／營養／精神科；戒菸者若伴嚴重憂鬱或焦慮 → 精神科；腹部穴注意孕婦與臟器。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Secondary obesity (hypothyroidism, Cushing's, drugs), rapid short-term weight change, eating disorders (bingeing, purging), obesity with sleep apnoea or unassessed metabolic syndrome: endocrinology, dietetics or psychiatry; smokers with severe depression or anxiety: psychiatry; abdominal points require care in pregnancy and over the viscera.

patterns.zh: 戒菸—肺熱痰擾、心神不寧
patterns.en: Smoking - Lung heat with phlegm, unsettled spirit
patterns.presentation: 戒菸期煩躁、渴求、失眠、咳痰、口乾、注意力不集中
patterns.presentationEn: Agitation, craving, insomnia, phlegmy cough, dry mouth and poor concentration during cessation
patterns.principle: 清肺化痰、寧心安神、降低渴求
patterns.principleEn: Clear the Lung and resolve phlegm, calm the spirit, reduce craving
patterns.rationale: 列缺為肺經絡穴、合谷表裡配穴，調肺氣化痰；神門、內關寧心減渴求；百會、印堂安神；魚際清肺熱；豐隆化痰；足三里調脾胃防戒菸後體重增加。
patterns.rationaleEn: Lieque, luo of the Lung, with Hegu as its interior-exterior pair, regulates Lung qi and phlegm; Shenmen and Neiguan calm the Heart and reduce craving; Baihui and Yintang settle the spirit; Yuji clears Lung heat; Fenglong resolves phlegm; Zusanli regulates digestion to limit post-cessation weight gain.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸之助肺熱煩躁。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL13］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa feeds Lung heat and agitation. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL13] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：GB30］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: GB30]

patterns.presentation: 食慾亢進、消穀善飢、口乾口臭、便秘、面紅，舌紅苔黃膩、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Excessive appetite and hunger, dry mouth and halitosis, constipation, red face; red tongue with yellow greasy coat, slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear Stomach heat, drain damp and free the bowels
patterns.methodEn: Reducing, electroacupuncture may be added; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 內庭、曲池清胃熱；中脘、天樞、大橫、上巨虛通腑導滯；豐隆、陰陵泉、水分化濕。
patterns.rationaleEn: Neiting and Quchi clear Stomach heat; Zhongwan, Tianshu, Daheng and Shangjuxu free the bowel; Fenglong, Yinlingquan and Shuifen resolve damp.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。胃熱者補脾胃助食慾。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. Tonifying the Spleen-Stomach increases appetite in Stomach heat. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6]

patterns.presentation: 形體臃腫、神疲乏力、肢體困重、食少腹脹、便溏、浮腫，舌淡胖有齒痕、脈濡細
patterns.presentationEn: Puffy body, fatigue, heavy limbs, poor appetite and distension, loose stool, oedema; pale swollen tongue with teeth marks, soggy thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and boost qi, drain damp and reduce swelling
patterns.methodEn: Even method; moxa may be added
patterns.rationale: 足三里、脾俞、太白健脾；中脘和中；陰陵泉、水分、豐隆利濕；氣海補氣；三陰交調三陰。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli, Pishu and Taibai fortify the Spleen; Zhongwan harmonises; Yinlingquan, Shuifen and Fenglong drain damp; Qihai tonifies qi; Sanyinjiao regulates the three yin.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。強瀉清熱於脾虛者更虛。
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Strong heat-clearing reduction worsens Spleen deficiency.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

patterns.presentation: 情緒性進食、壓力大時暴食、胸脅脹滿、月經不調、善太息，苔薄、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Emotional eating, bingeing under stress, chest and flank fullness, menstrual irregularity, sighing; thin coat, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Spread the Liver and regulate qi, fortify the Spleen and resolve damp
patterns.rationale: 太衝、陽陵泉疏肝；內關、膻中理氣寧神、減情緒性進食；神門安神；中脘、天樞、豐隆、足三里調脾胃化濕；三陰交調經。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong and Yanglingquan spread the Liver; Neiguan and Danzhong regulate qi and calm to curb emotional eating; Shenmen settles the spirit; Zhongwan, Tianshu, Fenglong and Zusanli regulate digestion; Sanyinjiao regulates menses.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。肝鬱化熱者灸之助火。［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Where constraint has turned to heat, moxa feeds the fire. [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。且腹部穴取用前須排除懷孕。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. And pregnancy must be excluded before any abdominal point is used. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

combos.why: 肺經表裡配穴加寧心安神穴。
combos.whyEn: Lung-Large Intestine pair with Heart-calming points.

combos.why: 腹部局部調腸胃，曲池足三里豐隆三陰交陰陵泉清熱健脾化濕。
combos.whyEn: Local abdominal points to regulate digestion; Quchi, Zusanli, Fenglong, Sanyinjiao and Yinlingquan to clear heat, fortify the Spleen and resolve damp.

conditions.overview: 癮疹為風邪客於肌表，「治風先治血，血行風自滅」。急性：風寒、風熱、胃腸濕熱；慢性：血虛風燥。基本方：曲池、合谷、血海、膈俞、三陰交、委中（刺絡）、風市、大椎；風寒灸風門肺俞，風熱加外關，胃腸濕熱加天樞足三里內庭，血虛補足三里脾俞肝俞。
conditions.overviewEn: Urticaria is wind lodging in the skin: 'to treat wind first treat blood; when blood moves, wind is extinguished'. Acute: wind-cold, wind-heat, intestinal damp-heat; chronic: blood deficiency with wind-dryness. Base: LI11, LI4, SP10, BL17, SP6, bled BL40, GB31, GV14; wind-cold moxas BL12 and BL13, wind-heat adds TE5, damp-heat adds ST25, ST36 and ST44, blood deficiency tonifies ST36, BL20 and BL18.
conditions.redFlags: 血管性水腫（唇舌眼瞼腫）、喉頭緊縮聲音嘶啞、呼吸困難喘鳴、低血壓暈厥（過敏性休克）→ 立即腎上腺素與急救；蕁麻疹伴發燒關節痛、皮疹持續超過24小時留瘀斑（蕁麻疹性血管炎）→ 專科。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Angioedema (lips, tongue, eyelids), throat tightness with hoarseness, dyspnoea or stridor, hypotension or syncope (anaphylaxis): adrenaline and emergency care at once; urticaria with fever and joint pain, or lesions lasting over 24 hours leaving bruising (urticarial vasculitis): specialist.

patterns.presentation: 風團色紅、灼熱劇癢、遇熱加重得冷減、伴發熱咽痛，舌紅苔薄黃、脈浮數
patterns.presentationEn: Red wheals, burning intense itch, worse with heat and eased by cold, fever and sore throat; red tongue with thin yellow coat, floating rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and clear heat, cool blood and stop itching
patterns.method: 瀉法，委中、大椎刺絡放血；不灸
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; bleed Weizhong and Dazhui; no moxa
patterns.rationale: 曲池、合谷清陽明熱、祛風止癢（曲池為皮膚病要穴）；血海、膈俞涼血活血；大椎、委中放血清熱；外關疏風熱；風市祛風。
patterns.rationaleEn: Quchi and Hegu clear yangming heat and dispel wind (Quchi is the key skin point); Xuehai and Geshu cool and move blood; Dazhui and Weizhong bled clear heat; Waiguan dispels wind-heat; Fengshi dispels wind.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸風門肺俞於風熱助熱。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12、BL13］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa at Fengmen or Feishu in wind-heat feeds the heat. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12, BL13] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20、BL18］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20, BL18] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

patterns.presentation: 風團色淡紅或白、遇冷或風吹即發、得暖則減、惡風，苔薄白、脈浮緊
patterns.presentationEn: Pale pink or white wheals triggered by cold or wind, eased by warmth, aversion to wind; thin white coat, floating tight pulse
patterns.principleEn: Dispel wind and scatter cold, harmonise nutritive and defensive
patterns.method: 平補平瀉加灸風門、肺俞、大椎
patterns.methodEn: Even method with moxa at Fengmen, Feishu and Dazhui
patterns.rationale: 風門、肺俞（灸）散寒固表（肺主皮毛）；曲池、合谷祛風；血海活血；風池、風市祛風；三陰交養血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Fengmen and Feishu (moxa) scatter cold and consolidate the exterior (the Lung governs skin and hair); Quchi and Hegu dispel wind; Xuehai moves blood; Fengchi and Fengshi dispel wind; Sanyinjiao nourishes blood.

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。放血清熱於風寒者加重。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Bleeding and heat-clearing worsen wind-cold. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3、HT7］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3, HT7] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

patterns.presentation: 風團伴脘腹疼痛、噁心嘔吐、腹瀉或便秘、食魚蝦後發作，苔黃膩、脈滑數
patterns.presentationEn: Wheals with abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting, diarrhoea or constipation, triggered by seafood; yellow greasy coat, slippery rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear heat and drain damp, dispel wind and stop itching
patterns.rationale: 天樞、足三里、中脘調腸胃；內庭、曲池清陽明濕熱；陰陵泉利濕；血海活血祛風；內關止嘔。
patterns.rationaleEn: Tianshu, Zusanli and Zhongwan regulate the bowel; Neiting and Quchi clear yangming damp-heat; Yinlingquan drains damp; Xuehai moves blood and dispels wind; Neiguan stops nausea.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20]

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。滋陰助濕。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. Yin-nourishing feeds the damp. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

patterns.presentation: 反覆發作數月、午後或夜間加重、皮膚乾燥、心煩失眠、面色無華，舌淡、脈細
patterns.presentationEn: Recurrent for months, worse in the afternoon or at night, dry skin, vexation and insomnia, lustreless complexion; pale tongue, thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Nourish blood and moisten dryness, dispel wind and stop itching
patterns.rationale: 血海、膈俞、三陰交養血活血；足三里、脾俞補脾生血；肝俞養血；曲池、風市祛風（輕刺）；神門安神止癢。
patterns.rationaleEn: Xuehai, Geshu and Sanyinjiao nourish and move blood; Zusanli and Pishu make blood; Ganshu nourishes blood; Quchi and Fengshi gently dispel wind; Shenmen calms and eases itch.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。放血清熱於血虛者更傷血。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Bleeding and heat-clearing further injure the blood. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV9］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV9]

combos.why: 曲池合谷祛風、血海膈俞三陰交治血、風市止癢。
combos.whyEn: Quchi and Hegu dispel wind, Xuehai, Geshu and Sanyinjiao treat blood, Fengshi stops itching.

combos.why: 大椎、委中放血清熱涼血。
combos.whyEn: Bleed Dazhui and Weizhong to clear heat and cool blood.

conditions.overview: 帶狀疱疹（蛇串瘡）急性期為肝經鬱熱或脾虛濕蘊，後遺神經痛為餘毒未清、氣滯血瘀、絡脈不通。取相應節段夾脊穴、皮損區阿是圍刺、循經遠端（胸脅：支溝、陽陵泉、太衝；頭面：合谷、翳風、太陽；腰腹：足三里、三陰交），配血海、膈俞活血，曲池、合谷清餘熱。
conditions.overviewEn: Herpes zoster in its acute phase is Liver-channel constrained heat or Spleen deficiency with damp; the post-herpetic pain is residual toxin with qi stagnation, blood stasis and blocked collaterals. Use jiaji points of the corresponding segment, surround needling of the lesion area, distal channel points (chest/flank: TE6, GB34, LR3; head/face: LI4, TE17, EX-HN5; lumbar/abdomen: ST36, SP6), SP10 and BL17 to move blood, LI11 and LI4 to clear residual heat.
conditions.redFlags: 眼部帶狀疱疹（鼻尖疱疹 Hutchinson 徵、眼痛視力改變）→ 眼科急診；耳部疱疹伴面癱（Ramsay Hunt）、免疫低下者播散性疱疹、急性期72小時內應抗病毒治療；疱疹未癒合處不可直接針刺（感染擴散）。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Ophthalmic zoster (vesicles on the nose tip - Hutchinson's sign, eye pain or visual change): urgent ophthalmology; otic zoster with facial palsy (Ramsay Hunt), disseminated zoster in the immunocompromised; antivirals within 72 hours of the acute phase; never needle through unhealed vesicles (spread of infection).

patterns.presentation: 皮損鮮紅灼痛、口苦咽乾、煩躁易怒、便秘尿黃，舌紅苔黃、脈弦數
patterns.presentationEn: Bright red burning lesions, bitter dry throat, irritability, constipation and dark urine; red tongue with yellow coat, wiry rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear Liver fire, resolve toxins and stop pain
patterns.method: 瀉法；皮損周圍圍刺（不刺疱疹）；可配電針
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; surround needling around (never through) the lesions; electroacupuncture may be added
patterns.rationale: 相應節段夾脊調節神經；行間、俠谿、太衝瀉肝膽火；陽陵泉、支溝為脅肋要穴（少陽、三焦）；曲池、合谷清熱；血海涼血；委中放血。
patterns.rationaleEn: Segmental jiaji regulate the nerve; Xingjian, Xiaxi and Taichong drain Liver-Gallbladder fire; Yanglingquan and Zhigou are the key flank points (shaoyang, Triple Energizer); Quchi and Hegu clear heat; Xuehai cools blood; Weizhong bled.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL18］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL18]

patterns.presentation: 皮損色淡、水疱多或糜爛滲液、痛而身重、食少腹脹、便溏，苔白膩、脈濡
patterns.presentationEn: Pale lesions with many vesicles or oozing erosions, pain with heaviness, poor appetite, distension and loose stool; white greasy coat, soggy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and drain damp, resolve toxins and stop pain
patterns.rationale: 陰陵泉、豐隆、中脘化濕；足三里、脾俞健脾；三陰交、血海調血；夾脊、陽陵泉通絡止痛；曲池清餘熱。
patterns.rationaleEn: Yinlingquan, Fenglong and Zhongwan resolve damp; Zusanli and Pishu fortify the Spleen; Sanyinjiao and Xuehai regulate blood; jiaji and Yanglingquan free the collaterals; Quchi clears residual heat.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL17］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL17]

wrong.zh: 清熱、寒涼之穴用於寒證，寒上加寒：惡寒、疼痛反而加重，陽氣更傷。脾虛無熱者放血瀉火傷正。［風險區 vessels-nerves：BL40］
wrong.en: Heat-clearing, cooling points in a cold pattern add cold to cold: chills and pain worsen and yang is further injured. Bleeding and fire-draining with no heat injure the Spleen-deficient patient. [risk zone vessels-nerves: BL40]

patterns.presentation: 疱疹消退後疼痛持續數月、刺痛灼痛或觸痛、夜間加重、痛處固定、情緒低落，舌暗有瘀斑、脈弦澀
patterns.presentationEn: Pain persisting months after the rash, stabbing, burning or allodynic, worse at night, fixed, with low mood; dusky tongue with stasis spots, wiry choppy pulse
patterns.principleEn: Invigorate blood and dispel stasis, free the collaterals and stop pain
patterns.method: 阿是圍刺配電針，平補平瀉；膈俞淺刺或拔罐
patterns.methodEn: Surround needling with electroacupuncture, even method; Geshu shallow or cupped
patterns.rationale: 夾脊與局部圍刺通絡；血海、膈俞、三陰交活血化瘀；四關（合谷太衝）行氣止痛；陽陵泉、支溝循經；內關、神門寧神止痛。
patterns.rationaleEn: Jiaji and local surround needling free the collaterals; Xuehai, Geshu and Sanyinjiao dispel stasis; the Four Gates (Hegu, Taichong) move qi and stop pain; Yanglingquan and Zhigou follow the channels; Neiguan and Shenmen calm and ease pain.

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL12］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL12]

combos.why: 節段夾脊加阿是圍刺，少陽三焦遠端，血海曲池調血清熱。
combos.whyEn: Segmental jiaji with surround needling, shaoyang and Triple Energizer distal points, Xuehai and Quchi for blood and heat.

combos.why: 夾脊通絡，血海膈俞化瘀，四關行氣止痛，內關寧神。
combos.whyEn: Jiaji free the collaterals; Xuehai and Geshu dispel stasis; the Four Gates move qi and stop pain; Neiguan calms.

conditions.overview: 暈動病為胃失和降、清陽不升、痰濁上擾，與脾胃、肝相關。內關為預防與治療要穴（出發前按壓或埋針），配中脘、足三里、印堂、百會；痰濕加豐隆陰陵泉，脾胃虛弱灸脾俞氣海，肝陽上擾加太衝風池。
conditions.overviewEn: Motion sickness is failure of Stomach descent with clear yang not rising and phlegm turbidity disturbing above, relating to Spleen-Stomach and Liver. Neiguan is the key point for prevention and treatment (pressed or intradermal needle before travel), with CV12, ST36, EX-HN3 and GV20; phlegm-damp adds ST40 and SP9, Spleen-Stomach weakness moxas BL20 and CV6, Liver yang adds LR3 and GB20.
conditions.redFlags: 非行車相關之持續眩暈嘔吐、伴頭痛神經症狀、聽力改變、兒童反覆嘔吐伴嗜睡 → 排除中樞病變與前庭疾病。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Persistent vertigo and vomiting unrelated to travel, with headache or neurological signs, hearing change, or recurrent vomiting with drowsiness in a child: exclude central and vestibular disease.

patterns.presentation: 乘車船即頭暈噁心嘔吐、胸悶、頭重、面色蒼白出冷汗，苔白膩、脈滑
patterns.presentationEn: Dizziness, nausea and vomiting on travel, chest oppression, heavy head, pallor and cold sweat; white greasy coat, slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Resolve phlegm and harmonise the Stomach, descend rebellion and stop vomiting
patterns.method: 平補平瀉；出發前按壓或埋針內關
patterns.methodEn: Even method; press or embed a needle at Neiguan before travel
patterns.rationale: 內關為止嘔定眩要穴；中脘、足三里和胃；豐隆、陰陵泉化痰濕；印堂、百會清頭；公孫配內關。
patterns.rationaleEn: Neiguan is the key anti-emetic, anti-dizziness point; Zhongwan and Zusanli harmonise the Stomach; Fenglong and Yinlingquan resolve phlegm-damp; Yintang and Baihui clear the head; Gongsun pairs with Neiguan.

wrong.zh: 痰濁為患而只取滋陰補血之穴，滋膩助濕，痰愈膠固，頭重胸悶更甚。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］
wrong.en: In a phlegm-turbidity pattern, choosing only yin- and blood-nourishing points adds cloying dampness, phlegm thickens and heaviness and oppression worsen. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6]

wrong.zh: 遠端穴選錯經絡，所取之經不過病所。 不循經則經氣不達病所，「經脈所過、主治所及」落空，療效差。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］
wrong.en: Wrong channel for the distal points - the channel chosen does not pass through the affected region. Points off the affected channel do not carry qi to the site, so 'where the channel passes, its points treat' no longer applies and the effect is poor. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

patterns.presentation: 平素食少倦怠、易暈車、乘車後嘔吐乏力久久不復、面色萎黃，舌淡、脈弱
patterns.presentationEn: Habitually poor appetite and fatigue, prone to sickness with prolonged vomiting and weakness after travel, sallow; pale tongue, weak pulse
patterns.principleEn: Fortify the Spleen and boost qi, harmonise the Stomach
patterns.rationale: 足三里、脾俞、中脘健脾益氣（平時灸之預防）；氣海補氣；百會升清；內關、公孫止嘔。
patterns.rationaleEn: Zusanli, Pishu and Zhongwan fortify the Spleen (moxa'd routinely for prevention); Qihai tonifies qi; Baihui raises the clear; Neiguan and Gongsun stop vomiting.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。［風險區 vessels-nerves：PC3］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. [risk zone vessels-nerves: PC3]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 medulla：GB20］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone medulla: GB20]

patterns.presentation: 暈車伴頭痛頭脹、煩躁、面紅、口苦，舌紅、脈弦
patterns.presentationEn: Motion sickness with distending headache, agitation, red face, bitter taste; red tongue, wiry pulse
patterns.principleEn: Pacify the Liver and descend rebellion, harmonise the Stomach
patterns.rationale: 太衝、俠谿平肝；風池、太陽、印堂清頭目；內關、中脘降逆止嘔；足三里和胃。
patterns.rationaleEn: Taichong and Xiaxi pacify the Liver; Fengchi, Taiyang and Yintang clear the head; Neiguan and Zhongwan descend and stop vomiting; Zusanli harmonises.

wrong.zh: 升提、助陽之穴（或灸）用於肝陽上亢、火熱上擾，助陽上衝：頭痛眩暈加劇、血壓上升。灸百會、氣海升陽。［風險區 infant-fontanelle：GV20］［風險區 pregnancy：CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV6］
wrong.en: Lifting or yang-assisting points (or moxa) in Liver-yang rising or fire flaring push yang further upward: headache and dizziness intensify and blood pressure climbs. Moxa at Baihui or Qihai lifts yang. [risk zone infant-fontanelle: GV20] [risk zone pregnancy: CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV6]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23] [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4]

combos.why: 內關為核心，出發前按壓。
combos.whyEn: Neiguan at the core, pressed before departure.

combos.why: 內關公孫止嘔，豐隆陰陵泉中脘化痰濕。
combos.whyEn: Neiguan and Gongsun stop vomiting; Fenglong, Yinlingquan and Zhongwan resolve phlegm-damp.

conditions.overview: 暈厥為氣機逆亂、清竅閉塞，分實（氣鬱、痰閉）與虛（氣血虛脫）；中暑分陽暑（高熱汗出、煩渴）與暑厥（昏迷抽搐）。急救以水溝（人中）為第一要穴，配內關、中衝、湧泉、十宣（放血）、合谷、足三里；虛脫者灸關元、氣海、百會、神闕（隔鹽）。針灸急救為暫時措施，必須同時呼叫急救、降溫、補液。
conditions.overviewEn: Syncope is chaotic qi closing the clear orifices, divided into excess (qi constraint, phlegm closing) and deficiency (collapse of qi and blood); heat stroke divides into yang summer-heat (high fever, sweating, thirst) and summer-heat collapse (coma, convulsions). First aid centres on Shuigou (Renzhong) with PC6, PC9, KI1, bled EX-UE11, LI4 and ST36; collapse patterns moxa CV4, CV6, GV20 and salt-insulated CV8. Acupuncture first aid is a temporary measure that must accompany calling emergency services, cooling and fluids.
conditions.redFlags: 熱射病（核心體溫 >40°C、意識改變、無汗或抽搐）為致命急症，立即降溫與送醫；暈厥伴胸痛、心律不整、呼吸困難、神經缺損、外傷、懷孕、年長者或反覆暈厥 → 急診評估心源性／神經性原因；低血糖、過敏性休克、出血性休克不以針灸處理。
conditions.redFlagsEn: Heat stroke (core temperature >40°C, altered consciousness, anhidrosis or convulsions) is a lethal emergency: cool and transfer immediately; syncope with chest pain, arrhythmia, dyspnoea, neurological deficit, trauma, pregnancy, old age or recurrence: emergency assessment for cardiac or neurological causes; hypoglycaemia, anaphylaxis and haemorrhagic shock are not treated with acupuncture.

patterns.presentation: 情緒激動或劇痛後突然昏仆、面赤或青、牙關緊閉、呼吸氣粗、四肢厥冷，脈沉弦或滑
patterns.presentationEn: Sudden collapse after emotional shock or severe pain, red or bluish face, clenched jaw, coarse breathing, cold limbs; deep wiry or slippery pulse
patterns.principleEn: Open the orifices and revive, regulate qi and resolve phlegm
patterns.method: 強刺激瀉法；水溝雀啄、十宣中衝點刺出血；同時平臥通風、檢查氣道脈搏
patterns.methodEn: Strong reducing; sparrow-pecking at Shuigou; bleed Shixuan and Zhongchong; meanwhile lay flat, ventilate, check airway and pulse
patterns.rationale: 水溝通督脈、醒腦開竅為急救第一穴；內關寧心開竅；中衝、十宣井穴放血泄閉；合谷、太衝四關理氣；湧泉引氣下行；豐隆化痰。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shuigou opens the Governor vessel and awakens the brain - the first point of resuscitation; Neiguan calms and opens; Zhongchong and Shixuan bled vent the closure; Hegu and Taichong (Four Gates) regulate qi; Yongquan draws qi downward; Fenglong resolves phlegm.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。閉證用灸關元氣海之回陽固脫法，閉上加閉，邪無出路。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4、CV6］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Using the yang-restoring moxa method of Guanyuan and Qihai in a closed pattern adds closure to closure and leaves the pathogen no exit. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4, CV6] [risk zone forbidden: CV8]

wrong.zh: 與本證病機無關之穴：徒增刺激而不對證，分散經氣，不能視為正確選擇。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：GB34］
wrong.en: Points unrelated to this pattern's mechanism: extra stimulation without matching the pattern scatters channel qi and cannot count as a correct choice. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: GB34]

patterns.en: Syncope - deficiency (collapse of qi and blood)
patterns.presentation: 久病體弱、失血或過勞後眩暈昏仆、面色蒼白、汗出肢冷、呼吸微弱、目合口張，脈微細
patterns.presentationEn: Collapse after chronic illness, blood loss or exhaustion, pallor, sweating and cold limbs, feeble breathing, closed eyes and open mouth; faint thin pulse
patterns.principleEn: Boost qi and restore yang, secure against collapse and revive
patterns.method: 大艾炷灸關元、氣海、百會、神闕（隔鹽）；足三里補法；水溝輕刺；同時平臥抬腿、保暖、補液、送醫
patterns.methodEn: Large moxa cones at Guanyuan, Qihai, Baihui and salt-insulated Shenque; tonify Zusanli; gentle Shuigou; meanwhile lie flat with legs raised, keep warm, give fluids, transfer
patterns.rationale: 關元、氣海、神闕為元氣所聚，灸之回陽救逆；百會升陽固脫；足三里補中益氣；命門溫陽；水溝、內關輕刺醒神不耗氣。
patterns.rationaleEn: Guanyuan, Qihai and Shenque gather the original qi and are moxa'd to restore yang; Baihui raises yang against collapse; Zusanli tonifies the middle; Mingmen warms yang; Shuigou and Neiguan lightly revive without draining qi.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。脫證放血強瀉，氣隨血脫。［風險區 pregnancy：LI4］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Bleeding or strong reduction in collapse lets the qi escape with the blood. [risk zone pregnancy: LI4]

wrong.zh: 開關理氣、化痰、清熱之穴為閉證所設，脫證用之徒散正氣。［風險區 spinal-cord：GV14］
wrong.en: Gate-opening, phlegm-resolving and heat-clearing points are meant for the closed pattern; in collapse they only scatter the upright qi. [risk zone spinal-cord: GV14]

wrong.zh: 出現紅旗徵象時，針灸不是答案：任何穴位（包括這些）都不應取代急救或轉診，延誤即是傷害。出血性休克、低血糖須先急救補液；肢體痹痛之穴更與急救無關。［風險區 pregnancy：BL60］［風險區 vessels-nerves：GB34］
wrong.en: When red flags are present acupuncture is not the answer: no point (including these) may replace emergency care or referral; delay itself is harm. Haemorrhagic shock and hypoglycaemia need emergency resuscitation and fluids first; limb-pain points are irrelevant to rescue. [risk zone pregnancy: BL60] [risk zone vessels-nerves: GB34]

patterns.en: Heat stroke - yang summer-heat (mild heat exhaustion)
patterns.presentation: 高溫下頭暈頭痛、身熱汗多、煩渴、噁心、乏力、尿少，舌紅苔黃、脈洪數
patterns.presentationEn: Dizziness and headache in heat, fever with profuse sweating, thirst, nausea, weakness, scanty urine; red tongue with yellow coat, surging rapid pulse
patterns.principleEn: Clear summer heat and vent fire, revive the spirit
patterns.method: 瀉法；大椎、委中、十宣刺絡放血；同時移至陰涼處、降溫、補充水鹽
patterns.methodEn: Reducing; bleed Dazhui, Weizhong and Shixuan; meanwhile move to shade, cool and replace fluids and salt
patterns.rationale: 大椎為諸陽之會清熱；曲池、內庭清陽明熱；委中放血清暑（「腰背委中求」，暑熱吐瀉亦取）；水溝醒神；十宣放血泄熱；內關止嘔；足三里和中。
patterns.rationaleEn: Dazhui, meeting of all yang, clears heat; Quchi and Neiting clear yangming heat; Weizhong bled clears summer heat; Shuigou revives; Shixuan bled vents heat; Neiguan stops nausea; Zusanli harmonises.

wrong.zh: 溫補或艾灸之穴用於熱證／陰虛火旺，助熱傷陰：口乾煩躁、出血或疼痛加重。灸之助熱。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］［風險區 spinal-cord：GV4］［風險區 kidney-region：BL23］
wrong.en: Warming or moxa points in a heat or yin-deficiency-fire pattern feed the heat and scorch yin: dryness, agitation, bleeding or pain increase. Moxa feeds the heat. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4] [risk zone forbidden: CV8] [risk zone spinal-cord: GV4] [risk zone kidney-region: BL23]

wrong.zh: 補益之穴用於實證或外感：閉門留寇，邪無出路，病程延長甚至由表入裡。［風險區 vessels-nerves：KI3］［風險區 pregnancy：SP6］［風險區 thorax-pneumothorax：BL20］
wrong.en: Tonifying points in an excess or exterior pattern 'shut the door with the thief inside': the pathogen has no exit, the course drags on and may sink from the exterior to the interior. [risk zone vessels-nerves: KI3] [risk zone pregnancy: SP6] [risk zone thorax-pneumothorax: BL20]

patterns.zh: 中暑—暑厥（重症，急救輔助）
patterns.en: Heat stroke - summer-heat collapse (severe, adjunct only)
patterns.presentation: 高熱無汗、突然昏迷、面赤氣粗或面白肢冷、抽搐、脈洪數或微細
patterns.presentationEn: High fever without sweating, sudden coma, red face with coarse breathing or pale face with cold limbs, convulsions; surging rapid or faint pulse
patterns.principle: 開竅醒神、泄熱息風（立即降溫送醫為先）
patterns.principleEn: Open the orifices and revive, vent heat and extinguish wind (immediate cooling and transfer come first)
patterns.method: 強刺激；十宣、中衝放血；此為送醫途中之輔助，絕不延誤降溫與急救
patterns.methodEn: Strong stimulation; bleed Shixuan and Zhongchong; adjunct during transfer only, never delaying cooling and emergency care
patterns.rationale: 水溝、中衝、十宣、湧泉為閉證醒神泄熱組合；內關寧心；合谷太衝息風止痙；大椎、委中放血清熱。
patterns.rationaleEn: Shuigou, Zhongchong, Shixuan and Yongquan form the orifice-opening, heat-venting set for closed patterns; Neiguan calms; Hegu and Taichong extinguish wind; Dazhui and Weizhong bled clear heat.

wrong.zh: 瀉法、放血或強刺激之穴用於虛證，犯「虛虛」之戒：正氣愈傷，頭暈乏力、病更難復。暑厥閉證灸關元回陽為誤；若轉脫證（汗出肢冷脈微）則反之。［風險區 pregnancy：CV4、CV6］［風險區 abdomen-viscera：CV4、CV6］［風險區 forbidden：CV8］
wrong.en: Reducing, bleeding or strongly stimulating points in a deficiency pattern break the rule 'never deplete the deficient': upright qi is further injured, with dizziness, fatigue and slower recovery. Moxa at Guanyuan to restore yang is wrong in the closed pattern; it reverses only if collapse (sweating, cold limbs, faint pulse) supervenes. [risk zone pregnancy: CV4, CV6] [risk zone abdomen-viscera: CV4, CV6] [risk zone forbidden: CV8]

wrong.zh: 枕下穴朝內上方深刺可傷延髓（風險區：medulla），此處針向與深度錯誤屬危險選擇。抽搐中針刺枕下穴危險。
wrong.en: Suboccipital points directed deep inward-upward can injure the medulla (risk zone: medulla); wrong direction or depth here is a dangerous choice. Needling suboccipital points during convulsions is dangerous.

combos.why: 實證閉證之標準急救組合，同時呼叫急救。
combos.whyEn: The standard resuscitation set for closed excess patterns, with emergency services called simultaneously.

combos.why: 虛證脫證以灸為主。
combos.whyEn: Collapse patterns rely on moxa.

combos.why: 大椎委中放血清暑，曲池內庭清陽明，水溝醒神；同時降溫補液。
combos.whyEn: Bleed Dazhui and Weizhong to clear summer heat; Quchi and Neiting clear yangming; Shuigou revives; cool and rehydrate at the same time.

glossary.text: 針刺後經氣感應：患者感到痠、麻、脹、重或沿經傳導，醫者指下沉緊如魚吞鉤。「刺之要，氣至而有效」—得氣是療效的前提，不得氣則需調整針向、深淺或候氣、催氣。
glossary.textEn: The response of channel qi to needling: the patient feels soreness, numbness, distension, heaviness or propagation along the channel, while the practitioner feels the needle grip 'like a fish taking the hook'. 'The essence of needling is that qi arrives and the effect follows' - deqi is the prerequisite for efficacy; without it adjust direction or depth, or wait for and encourage the qi.

glossary.text: 針刺手法的兩大類：虛證用補法（徐入疾出、順經、小幅輕捻、呼進吸出、留針、出針按壓），實證用瀉法（疾入徐出、逆經、大幅重捻、吸進呼出、出針搖大針孔不按）。虛實夾雜或不明顯者用平補平瀉。灸法偏溫補，亦可瀉（如燈火灸、吹灸）。
glossary.textEn: The two families of needle technique: tonifying for deficiency (slow insertion and quick withdrawal, with the channel flow, small gentle rotation, insert on exhalation, retain, press the hole on withdrawal) and reducing for excess (quick insertion and slow withdrawal, against the flow, large forceful rotation, insert on inhalation, enlarge the hole on withdrawal without pressing). Mixed or unclear cases use the even method. Moxibustion is mainly warming-tonifying, though reducing moxa variants exist.

glossary.text: 十二經氣血依時辰盛衰流注：寅肺、卯大腸、辰胃、巳脾、午心、未小腸、申膀胱、酉腎、戌心包、亥三焦、子膽、丑肝。按時開穴（納甲法、納子法）選取當令經之五輸穴，以順應氣血盛衰而增效；臨床亦用以解釋定時發作之病證。
glossary.textEn: The circulation of qi and blood through the twelve channels peaking at two-hour watches: Lung 3-5, Large Intestine 5-7, Stomach 7-9, Spleen 9-11, Heart 11-13, Small Intestine 13-15, Bladder 15-17, Kidney 17-19, Pericardium 19-21, Triple Energizer 21-23, Gallbladder 23-1, Liver 1-3. Time-based point selection (najia and nazi methods) chooses the five transport points of the channel in season to ride the tide of qi, and the system is also used to interpret disorders that recur at fixed hours.

glossary.text: 每條正經肘膝以下的井、滎、輸、經、合五穴，經氣由小到大如水流：所出為井（主心下滿、急救）、所溜為滎（主身熱）、所注為輸（主體重節痛）、所行為經（主喘咳寒熱）、所入為合（主逆氣而泄、腑病）。陰經井木、陽經井金，依五行相生排列，據此有「虛補其母、實瀉其子」的子母補瀉法。
glossary.textEn: The five points on each primary channel below the elbow or knee - jing-well, ying-spring, shu-stream, jing-river and he-sea - where channel qi grows like a stream becoming a river: jing-well (fullness below the heart, emergencies), ying-spring (heat of the body), shu-stream (heaviness and joint pain), jing-river (cough, wheezing, chills and fever), he-sea (rebellious qi, diarrhoea, fu disorders). Yin channels start with Wood, yang channels with Metal, following the generating cycle; from this derives the mother-child method ('tonify the mother in deficiency, drain the child in excess').

glossary.text: 十二經各一，位於腕踝附近（陰經以輸穴為原），為臟腑原氣經過留止之處，「五臟有疾，當取之十二原」。原穴可補可瀉，診察其反應可知臟腑虛實；常與表裡經絡穴相配（原絡配穴）。
glossary.textEn: One on each of the twelve channels, near the wrist or ankle (on yin channels the shu-stream point doubles as yuan), where the source qi of the organ passes and collects: 'for disorders of the five zang, take the twelve yuan points'. They may be tonified or reduced, their reactivity reflects organ excess or deficiency, and they are classically paired with the luo point of the coupled channel.

glossary.text: 十五絡穴：十二經各一、任督各一、脾之大絡（大包），為絡脈別出之處，聯繫表裡兩經，故一穴可治表裡兩經病證（如列缺治肺與大腸）。絡脈實則見於外（刺絡放血），虛則見於內（補之）。
glossary.textEn: The fifteen luo points: one per primary channel, one each on the Conception and Governor vessels, plus the great luo of the Spleen (Dabao). Here the connecting vessel branches off to link the coupled channels, so a single point treats disorders of both (Lieque for the Lung and Large Intestine). Excess in the luo shows outwardly (bleed it); deficiency shows inwardly (tonify it).

glossary.text: 十六郄穴：十二經各一，加陰陽蹻、陰陽維各一，為經氣深聚之孔隙，多在肘膝以下。主治本經急性病證與疼痛，陰經郄穴又善治血證（孔最治咯血、郄門治心痛、地機治痛經）。
glossary.textEn: Sixteen xi-cleft points: one on each of the twelve channels and one each on the yin/yang qiao and yin/yang wei vessels, located mostly below the elbow and knee where channel qi gathers deeply. They treat acute disorders and pain of their channel; those on yin channels also treat blood disorders (Kongzui for haemoptysis, Ximen for cardiac pain, Diji for dysmenorrhoea).

glossary.text: 臟腑之氣結聚於胸腹的十二穴，多在本臟腑體表投影附近（中府、巨闕、期門、章門、京門、中脘、天樞、關元、中極、膻中、石門、日月）。募穴壓痛可助診斷；「腑病取募」，常與背俞穴相配（俞募配穴）。
glossary.textEn: Twelve points on the chest and abdomen where the qi of each organ gathers, mostly near the organ's surface projection (Zhongfu, Juque, Qimen, Zhangmen, Jingmen, Zhongwan, Tianshu, Guanyuan, Zhongji, Danzhong, Shimen, Riyue). Tenderness here aids diagnosis; fu disorders favour the mu point, which is commonly paired with the back-shu point.

glossary.text: 臟腑之氣輸注於背腰部的十二穴，皆在膀胱經第一側線，位置與臟腑高低相應（肺俞T3、心俞T5、肝俞T9、脾俞T11、腎俞L2…）。「臟病取俞」，可補可瀉，亦為灸法常用；多數位於胸背區，深刺有氣胸風險。
glossary.textEn: Twelve points on the back where the qi of each organ is transported, all on the inner Bladder line at levels corresponding to the organs (Feishu T3, Xinshu T5, Ganshu T9, Pishu T11, Shenshu L2...). Zang disorders favour the shu point; they can be tonified, reduced or moxa'd. Most lie over the thorax, so deep insertion carries pneumothorax risk.

glossary.text: 臟會章門、腑會中脘、氣會膻中、血會膈俞、筋會陽陵泉、脈會太淵、骨會大杼、髓會懸鐘。各為該類組織精氣會聚之處，凡該類病證（如一切筋病取陽陵泉、一切血證取膈俞）皆可取用。
glossary.textEn: Zang - Zhangmen (LR13); fu - Zhongwan (CV12); qi - Danzhong (CV17); blood - Geshu (BL17); sinews - Yanglingquan (GB34); vessels - Taiyuan (LU9); bone - Dazhu (BL11); marrow - Xuanzhong (GB39). Each is where the essence-qi of that tissue gathers, used for any disorder of that category (all sinew disorders at GB34, all blood disorders at BL17).

glossary.text: 十二經通於奇經八脈之八穴：公孫通衝、內關通陰維、後谿通督、申脈通陽蹻、足臨泣通帶、外關通陽維、列缺通任、照海通陰蹻。上下兩兩相配（公孫—內關、後谿—申脈、足臨泣—外關、列缺—照海），各主一區域病證。
glossary.textEn: Eight points through which the twelve channels communicate with the extraordinary vessels: Gongsun-Chong, Neiguan-yin wei, Houxi-Governor, Shenmai-yang qiao, Zulinqi-Dai, Waiguan-yang wei, Lieque-Conception, Zhaohai-yin qiao. Used in upper-lower pairs (SP4-PC6, SI3-BL62, GB41-TE5, LU7-KI6), each pair governing a region of the body.

glossary.text: 六腑之氣下合於足三陽經的六穴：胃—足三里、大腸—上巨虛、小腸—下巨虛、膀胱—委中、三焦—委陽、膽—陽陵泉。「合治內腑」，六腑病證首取下合穴，手三陽之腑病（大腸、小腸、三焦）亦取足部下合穴。
glossary.textEn: Six points on the three foot yang channels where the qi of the six fu gathers: Stomach - Zusanli, Large Intestine - Shangjuxu, Small Intestine - Xiajuxu, Bladder - Weizhong, Triple Energizer - Weiyang, Gallbladder - Yanglingquan. 'He-sea points treat the fu': they are the first choice for fu disorders, including those of the hand-channel fu (Large Intestine, Small Intestine, Triple Energizer).

glossary.text: 「以痛為腧」：無固定名稱位置，以壓痛點或反應點為穴，患者按之呼「啊、是」而得名。主治局部痛證、痹證、筋傷，常與循經遠端穴配合；亦是經絡病理反應的直接證據。
glossary.textEn: 'Where it hurts is the point': points without fixed name or location, chosen at tender or reactive spots - named from the patient's exclamation 'ah, yes!'. They treat local pain, bi syndrome and soft-tissue injury, usually combined with distal channel points, and are direct evidence of channel pathology.

glossary.text: 「左病取右，右病取左」的兩種交叉刺法：巨刺治「邪客於經」，刺健側經脈之穴，取其脈證（如面癱取對側合谷）；繆刺治「邪客於絡」，刺健側絡脈或井穴放血，病在痛處而脈象不變。急性扭傷、面癱、偏癱常用。
glossary.textEn: Two crossed methods ('left disease, needle right'): juci for pathogens in the channel, needling channel points on the healthy side when pulse signs are present (contralateral Hegu for facial paralysis); miuci for pathogens in the collaterals, needling or bleeding luo or jing-well points on the healthy side when pain is local and the pulse unchanged. Common in acute sprains, facial paralysis and hemiplegia.

glossary.text: 暈針：針刺中出現頭暈、面色蒼白、出冷汗、心慌噁心，甚至暈厥。處置：立即停針、全部出針，平臥頭低足高、鬆解衣領、保暖，給溫糖水；重者指掐或針水溝、內關，灸百會、足三里；觀察心率血壓，不恢復則送醫。預防：空腹、疲勞、緊張、初診者選臥位、少穴、輕刺激。
glossary.textEn: Needle fainting: dizziness, pallor, cold sweat, palpitations and nausea during treatment, progressing to syncope. Management: stop and remove all needles at once, lay the patient flat with the head low and legs raised, loosen clothing, keep warm, give warm sugared water; in severe cases press or needle Shuigou (GV26) and Neiguan (PC6) and moxa Baihui (GV20) and Zusanli (ST36); monitor pulse and blood pressure and refer if no recovery. Prevention: treat fasting, exhausted, anxious or first-time patients lying down, with few points and gentle stimulation.

glossary.text: 「肚腹三里留，腰背委中求，頭項尋列缺，面口合谷收」—四個分區總治之穴，為遠端取穴的入門口訣，後世加「心胸取內關、脅肋尋支溝（或陽陵泉）」成六總穴。
glossary.textEn: 'For the abdomen keep Zusanli; for the back seek Weizhong; for head and nape find Lieque; for face and mouth collect Hegu' - four points each commanding a body region, the beginner's rule for distal point selection. Later tradition added Neiguan for the chest and Zhigou (or Yanglingquan) for the flank, making six.

glossary.text: 依五輸穴五行屬性與本經五行的生克關係取穴：「虛則補其母，實則瀉其子」。如肺（金）虛補太淵（輸土，土生金），肺實瀉尺澤（合水，金生水）；肝火旺瀉行間（滎火），肝血虛補曲泉（合水）。
glossary.textEn: Point selection by the five-phase relationship between a channel and its transport points: 'in deficiency tonify the mother, in excess drain the child'. For Lung (Metal) deficiency tonify Taiyuan (shu-stream Earth, Earth generates Metal); for Lung excess reduce Chize (he-sea Water, Metal generates Water); for Liver fire reduce Xingjian (ying-spring Fire); for Liver blood deficiency tonify Ququan (he-sea Water).
